Two Dutch MPs (Voordewind and Groothuizen) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the European Court of Auditors report on asylum, relocation and return of migrants in Greece and Italy, including use of EU funds, relocation shortfalls, return rates, backlogs and conditions for unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered at length, largely agreeing with the report's findings and recommendations, explaining relocation and funding figures, and pointing primarily to Greek and Italian authorities for implementation while promising continued support and some concrete steps.
The cabinet therefore takes due note of the relevant analyses in the report and in principle agrees with the recommendations.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook goede nota van de betreffende analyses in het rapport, en sluit zich in beginsel aan bij de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het rapport 'The burning question' van Tearfund en overige berichtgeving over het verbranden van plastic afval in ontwikkelingslanden en de verantwoordelijkhei

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the government about the Tearfund report on plastic waste burning in developing countries, corporate responsibility of major beverage and food companies, export of plastic waste, and whether Dutch plastic waste is incinerated instead of recycled. The State Secretary answered that companies should map and address risks in line with OECD guidelines, outlined existing pacts, export rules and pilot projects, and said a study on banning incineration of recyclable waste is underway, promising to inform parliament later.
I am conducting an exploration into a ban on incinerating recyclable waste.
Ik voer een verkenning uit naar een verbod op het verbranden van recyclebaar afval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over het optreden van de Griekse grenspolitie en de gewonden en de dood van een migrant

MPs Voordewind, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Greek border police fired live rounds at migrants near the Turkish border on 4 March, leaving six wounded and one Pakistani man dead, and asked for investigations and clarification. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greek authorities deny using live fire, and that the government expects border actions to respect international law, pointing to existing complaint routes rather than committing to new action.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the situation at the Greek-Turkish border in early March and the reports about it.

Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de genoemde situatie begin maart aan de Grieks-Turkse grens en de berichten daaromtrent te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en van Helvert over de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea n.a.v. de excommunicatie van patriarch Antonios van de Eritrees-Orthodoxe Tewahedo-Kerk en de gedwongen s

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Eritrea, including the detention of Patriarch Antonios and other religious figures, the forced closure of Catholic clinics, and interference by Eritrean authorities in religious life among the diaspora in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, has taken diplomatic steps against interference, but that Eritrea shows little sensitivity to pressure and the available instruments are limited.

The Netherlands consistently speaks out about the worrying human rights situation in Eritrea and calls on the country to respect human rights and cooperate with the Special Rapporteur on the human rights situation in Eritrea.

Nederland spreekt zich voortdurend uit over de zorgwekkende mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea en roept het land op om de mensenrechten te respecteren en om samen te werken met de Speciaal Rapporteur voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Kuik, Bouali en Voordewind over de opschorting van de steun van de VS aan de WHO

Three MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands was warned about the US suspension of WHO funding, what consequences it has for COVID-19 response, and whether the EU will press the US to reverse it. The minister answered that the Netherlands learned of it via media, opposes suspension, will press US counterparts and coordinate an EU resolution, and pledged additional funds to the WHO.
On behalf of the Dutch government I have expressed support for the WHO.
Namens de Nederlandse regering heb ik steun uitgesproken voor de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vernieling van graven van christenen in Turkije

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the desecration of Christian graves in Turkey, whether this reflects a rising trend of pressure on Christians, who spreads hate speech, whether Turkish school books label missionary activity a national threat, and whether Turkey effectively prosecutes grave desecration. The minister answered that Turkish authorities prosecute such acts, that the cemetery is being restored and guarded, that reports show no clear increase in pressure on Christians, and that the Dutch government raises minority concerns with its Turkish counterpart.
I also do that in my conversations with my Turkish counterpart.
Ook ik doe dat in mijn gesprekken met mijn Turkse ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Voordewind over het bericht dat Corona de armoede versterkt

Two MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about the effects of COVID-19 on poverty and health systems in developing countries, the overview of EU and other donor funding, the impact of the expected economic crisis on the 0.7% ODA budget, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that Nederland has released EUR 100 million, supports Team Europe coordination, asked the Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken for urgent advice, and that the ODA budget will be assessed later once economic forecasts are clearer.
I have immediately earmarked EUR 100 million from my budget as part of this internationally coordinated effort.
Om die reden heb ik per direct EUR 100 mln vrijgemaakt op mijn begroting als onderdeel van deze internationale gecoördineerde inzet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de schrijnende humanitaire situatie op de Griekse eilanden

MP Voordewind asked the government about the humanitarian crisis on the Greek islands, what the EU and the Netherlands could do to ease it, and whether the Netherlands would relocate vulnerable migrants and unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered that the issue was discussed in EU Justice and Home Affairs councils, that the Dutch line focuses on enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement with support for Greece, that material and financial aid was sent, and that ad hoc relocation is not currently envisaged.
Accelerated relocation procedures are currently not under consideration.
Van versnelde relocatieprocedures is momenteel geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de kabinetsbrief Vervolgmaatregelen aanpak coronavirus

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether suspending new asylum applications until 6 April removes access to reception and where arrivals will stay, plus questions on the IND, deportation talks, and COVID measures in asylum centres. The State Secretary confirmed new asylum procedures are suspended with only essential registration, that emergency shelter is being arranged, and that centre protocols and GGD cooperation are in place, though much remains uncertain.
The decision taken is that for asylum seekers who newly register, the asylum procedure is suspended.
Het besluit dat is genomen is dat voor asielzoekers die zich nieuw aanmelden de asielprocedure wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins en Voordewind over het bericht ‘F-35 mag straks laagvliegen over oostelijk Fryslân’

MPs Bruins and Voordewind asked whether the government will reopen the Linkroute-10A low-flying route over eastern Friesland for F-35s, whether Friesland was involved, whether a nature permit is needed and whether alternatives were studied. The State Secretary for Defence answered that there is currently no reason to reopen the route, that a permit and ecological analysis are still being prepared, that alternatives abroad are being examined, and promised a decision by 1 June 2020.
At the consultation on 18 February I promised the House to provide clarity on the future of Linkroute-10A by 1 June 2020.
Tijdens het VAO op 18 februari heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om voor 1 juni 2020 duidelijkheid te bieden over de toekomst van de Linkroute-10A.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat de VN een zwarte lijst gepubliceerd heeft van bedrijven die zakendoen in Israëlische nederzettingen

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's published list of businesses active in Israeli settlements is justified, whether it amounts to political condemnation fuelling BDS, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The ministers answered that the list follows a 2016 Council mandate, carries no legal judgment or call for boycott, that the Netherlands discourages economic ties with settlements, and that they will raise concerns with EU partners while pushing to remove the agenda item.
The cabinet consults with European partners on the joint approach to the Middle East peace process and the joint approach in the UN Human Rights Council.
Het kabinet overlegt met de Europese partners over de gezamenlijke inzet in het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de gezamenlijke inzet in de VN Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Oxfam: nieuwe wet verslechtert situatie asielzoekers Griekse eilanden’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether asylum seekers in Greece lack access to a fair asylum procedure and legal aid, whether the European Commission will supervise access to lawyers in closed centres, and how much EU money supports legal aid. The State Secretary acknowledges remaining bottlenecks including limited legal aid, says the government presses Greece for improvements, notes the Commission's oversight role and EUR 322,000 in EU legal-aid funding, but lacks exact figures and deems Commission involvement in closed centres premature.
The cabinet does not have the exact figures for the number of asylum seekers currently having access to legal aid.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de exacte cijfers van het aantal asielzoekers dat momenteel toegang heeft tot juridische bijstand.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de stand van zaken in de processen tegen de door Nederland uitgeleverde Rwandezen I. en M. en de zaak tegen de moeder van de Rwandese oppositiepolitica Victoire Ingabire

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the progress of trials in Rwanda against two genocide suspects extradited from the Netherlands, the delay in their trials, and the case concerning the mother of Victoire Ingabire, including the confiscation of her passport. The ministers answered that trials are being monitored by the ICJ, that the High Court trial of one suspect is nearing conclusion while no end date is given for the other, that they see no unreasonable delay, and that they decline to comment on the passport case while defending extradition as responsible.
It is my custom to exercise restraint in my statements on ongoing cases.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het intrekken van perskaarten in Turkije

MPs from SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey revoked press cards of journalists from the paper Evrensel, whether this fits a pattern of state repression, and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Evrensel revocations were reversed, that Turkey has revoked nearly 3,804 press cards since 2015, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey at all levels, including with the Turkish foreign minister and within the EU and Council of Europe.
The Netherlands therefore continuously raises concerns about the lack of press freedom in Turkey with Turkey at all levels.
Nederland brengt daarom in contacten met Turkije voortdurend en op alle niveaus de zorgen over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Turkije op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Syrische vluchtelingen die christen zijn geweigerd worden in VN-opvangkampen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers whether Syrian Christian refugees are refused entry to UN camps in Jordan and whether separate camps or investigation are needed. The government says it has no information confirming refusals, is in ongoing dialogue with UNHCR on non-discrimination, sees no structural discrimination, and rejects separate camps.
The government has no information that Christian refugees are being refused in the UN refugee camps in Jordan.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie dat christelijke vluchtelingen geweigerd worden in de VN-vluchtelingenkampen in Jordanië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over De veroordeling van de Chinese voorganger Wang Yi

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the criminal convictions of Chinese church leaders Wang Yi and Qin Defu, the implications of China's 2018 religion law, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed Dutch concern, described an embassy statement and EU-level advocacy, and promised to raise Qin Defu's case through regular dialogues and to pass on concerns about the religion law.
The cabinet is also willing to raise the case of Qin Defu with the Chinese government through the regular dialogues with the Chinese authorities.
Het kabinet is tevens bereid om de zaak van Qin Defu aan te kaarten bij de Chinese overheid via de reguliere dialogen met de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Voordewind over het bijwonen van de herdenking in  Armenië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister which minister would attend the April 2020 Armenian genocide commemoration in line with a motion, whether he would visit the Tsitsernakaperd monument and lay a wreath, and how he would raise the genocide with Armenia. The minister confirmed he visited Yerevan and laid a wreath, but said the attending minister for April would be announced later.

That is still being discussed. As also mentioned during the 2019 foreign affairs budget debate, the House will be informed in advance of the commemoration about who will attend on behalf of the Netherlands.

Daarover wordt nog gesproken. Zoals ook gemeld tijdens de BZ Begrotingsbehandeling voor 2019, zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan de herdenking worden geïnformeerd wie namens Nederland aanwezig zal zijn bij deze herdenking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling De Hoenderloo Groep

MP Voordewind asks the Minister of Health about the planned closure of youth care institution De Hoenderloo Groep, including the risk that children return home without adequate care, whether a coordinated regional approach and Jeugdautoriteit advice are needed, and whether the ministry will guarantee continuity of care. The Minister answers that Pluryn is responsible for a careful transition plan supervised by the IGJ, that municipalities hold statutory responsibility for youth care and must coordinate across regions under Utrecht's lead, and that the Jeugdautoriteit is involved without need for extra advice now.
Pluryn is responsible for setting up a careful approach with suitable tailored solutions for each child.
Pluryn is verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige aanpak met passende maatwerkoplossingen voor elk kind in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Voordewind over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden uitgehongerd in Libië

MPs Van Dijk and Voordewind asked whether refugees in Libya are being starved out of the UNHCR gathering centre in Tripoli, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges the dire conditions, explains that UNHCR is shifting aid to urban centres and phasing out catering, and points to additional funding and existing resettlement and evacuation channels, without committing to new resettlement.
As the House has been informed on several occasions, the difficult conditions for refugees and migrants in Libya are a cause for concern.
Zoals vaker aan uw Kamer gemeld zijn de zware omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen en migranten in Libië zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Vluchtelingenwerk bezorgd om uitzetting Afghaanse tolk'

MPs Belhaj, Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether an Afghan former interpreter for the US army, refused asylum and facing deportation, is consistent with government statements on risk groups for interpreters in Afghanistan, and how such cases are weighed. The government declined to discuss individual cases, explained that interpreters who worked for international missions are now treated as a systematically persecuted group following a motion, and estimated about ten former local staff granted asylum.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Het kamp op Lesbos was nooit zó vol’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that the Lesbos camps are overcrowded, the departure of camp directors, the worsening conditions on Greek islands, EU funding use, and the Greek proposal to designate Turkey as a safe country. The State Secretary answered that conditions have deteriorated, that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns with Greek authorities, that asylum procedure reform is the responsibility of the Greek government, and that the Chamber will be informed of significant changes.
If new agreements are made at European level on the Netherlands' involvement regarding the situation in the Greek refugee camps, your House will of course be informed.
Mochten er nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt in Europees verband over de inzet omtrent de situatie in de Griekse vluchtelingenkampen, dan zal uw Kamer uiteraard geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Briefing on the Situation of Religious Persecution of Christians and Muslims in India’ van Jubilee Campaign

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Jubilee Campaign report on religious persecution of Christians and Muslims in India, including discriminatory laws, arbitrary detentions, and violence, and whether the government would press India on the report's nine recommendations and support religious freedom initiatives. The minister said the government shares concerns, raises them diplomatically and in EU and multilateral settings, supports Mensenrechtenfonds projects, and that the special envoy for religion will travel to India, but did not commit to specific demands on India's implementation of the recommendations.
In conversations with India, the government emphasises the importance of respect for human rights for everyone.
Het kabinet benadrukt in gesprekken met India het belang van respect voor mensenrechten voor iedereen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Schonis en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Italy holds Netherlands, EU ‘responsible’ for migrant boat’

MPs asked the government about Italy holding the Netherlands and the EU responsible for migrants aboard the Sea-Watch 3, about Dutch obligations under the SAR convention, and about progress on a structural EU solution for disembarkation. The minister answered that Netherlands requested a port and asked the Commission to coordinate, that primary SAR responsibility lies with the state of the rescue zone, that no structural solution has yet been found, and that the government keeps pressing for one.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van 113 Zelfmoordpreventie

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the 113 suicide prevention line could be made directly reachable via the 113 number, since the 0900 number is less known and costly, after a family tragedy where a caller dialled a non-existent 113 number. The State Secretary answered that a 0800 number now removes cost barriers, that the 1-1-3 number could potentially be made available subject to a number-plan change by the ACM, a process of at least three months with conditions and misdialling risks still being studied, and committed to further investigation with the Minister of Justice.
Together with the Minister of Justice we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister how the Afghan state protects religious minorities and non-believers, how it treats converts, and whether the General Asylum Report (Algemeen Ambtsbericht) on freedom of religion is accurate and should be amended. The minister acknowledged limited legal space and intimidation of minorities but rejected the claim that the report downplays risks, declined to amend the report, and said the Mensenrechtenambassadeur and Special Envoy would engage on religious freedom.
I see no reason to amend the report.
Ik zie geen reden het ambtsbericht aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over etikettering van producten afkomstig uit de Palestijnse gebieden

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked how the Netherlands enforces labelling of Israeli-occupied-territory products, whether the Ten Broeke motion and the Commission interpretive notice are being followed, and whether the 'Palestine' origin label implies recognition of a Palestinian state. The government answered that the NVWA follows the Commission notice, applies a warning policy, awaits a CJEU ruling, and that the footnote means the label does not imply recognition, which is unchanged.
The cabinet honours European agreements and the NVWA acts in line with the guidance in the Commission interpretive document mentioned above.
Het kabinet komt Europese afspraken na en de NVWA handelt conform de aanwijzingen uit het bovengenoemd interpretatiedocument van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mediterranean will be 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, UN warns’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a UN warning that the Mediterranean would become a 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, and about related asylum trends and deaths at sea. The government answered that causal links between NGO rescue ships and drowning are hard to show, that the EU is discussing disembarkation and longer-term measures, and that Operation Sophia's mandate does not include rescue.
Such causal links are difficult to demonstrate.
Dergelijke oorzakelijke verbanden zijn lastig aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Opvangkampen op Samos een hel: dit niet eerder gezien’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the state secretary about reports of overcrowded and inhumane camps on Samos, including lack of electricity, water and toilets, long asylum waiting times, and EU funding and NGO support. The government acknowledged the problems, said Greece bears primary responsibility, and pointed to Dutch expert support and the new Greek government's priorities without committing to new funding.
Progress on this support will be reported to your House separately.
Over de voortgang van deze steun wordt uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Haga over het opschorten van de hulp aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind and Van Haga asked whether the UNRWA leadership should be replaced and whether Dutch payments should resume only after the ethics investigation, citing alleged misconduct, nepotism and procurement bypassing. Minister Kaag replied that Dutch funding is suspended pending the UN's independent inspection, that payments will require the usual preconditions, and that the government will not pre-empt the UN findings or the outcome on the Commissioner-General.
It is up to the UN to provide clarity and to act adequately.
Het is aan de VN om opheldering te geven en toereikend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de humanitaire noodsituatie waarin vluchtelingen in Libië verkeren

MPs asked the government about the humanitarian crisis facing migrants in Libyan detention centres near the conflict zone, including reports of an airstrike on the Tajoura centre, forced labour, and whether the Netherlands would evacuate migrants or offer asylum. The minister answered that the centres are unsafe, that Libya's GNA government agreed to close three centres including Tajoura, that Nederland supports IOM/UNHCR evacuations and ETM resettlement from Niger, but that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission route like Italy's and direct evacuation to the Netherlands is not possible.
The Netherlands has no admission on humanitarian grounds, unlike Italy. Direct evacuation from Libya to the Netherlands is therefore not among the possibilities.
Nederland kent geen toegang op humanitaire gronden, zoals Italië. Directe evacuatie vanuit Libië naar Nederland behoort dan ook niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de toepassing van de nieuwe werkinstructie voor de beoordeling van lhbti’s en bekeerlingen

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about criticism from COC and Stichting Gave of the IND's new guidelines for assessing LGBTI and convert asylum claims, including use of 'self-acceptance' criteria, stereotyping, third-party statements, passive conversion and expectations about religious study. The State Secretary largely rejected the criticism, stating the guidelines are applied correctly, that the concepts were dropped but may still arise, and that existing cases need not be reassessed except via new facts or the motion-based repeat-application route.
However, I do not rule out that errors are occasionally made.
Ik sluit echter niet uit dat er af en toe fouten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'We’re Indians too' van organisatie Open Doors inzake geweld, uitsluiting en geloofsvervolging van christelijke en moslimminderhe

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on violence and exclusion of Christian and Muslim minorities in India, including whether the government would raise anti-conversion laws, Dalit classification, and religious freedom with India at bilateral, EU and UN level. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom in human rights dialogues and UN forums, and plans to ask the new Special Envoy for freedom of religion to visit India, while declining to speculate on post-election developments.

I also intend to ask the recently appointed Special Envoy for freedom of religion and belief to travel to India to speak with the government and civil society organisations about freedom of religion and belief.

Ook ben ik voornemens om de onlangs aangestelde Speciaal Gezant religie en levensovertuiging te vragen naar India te gaan om daar met overheid en maatschappelijke organisaties te spreken over vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de brandbrief van het Strategisch Overleg Mensenhandel (SOM) aan Tweede Kamer inzake de tijdelijke werkwijze Dublinoverdrachten

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Minister about an SOM/ZoCo letter claiming a de facto stop on human trafficking reports because Dublin transfers proceed before victims can file complaints, and about links to Operation Koolvis. The State Secretary replied that no new procedure exists, that transfers of claimants who could not report are rare, that police are working to handle reports faster, and that a new working method and further steps are being developed.
There is no new, temporary working method.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuwe, tijdelijke, werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het tegengaan van het gebruik van lachgas

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the state secretary about municipalities and festivals banning recreational nitrous oxide, its health and environmental harm, and whether national measures are needed after voluntary retailer agreements. The state secretary said he will consult VNG and municipalities, commissioned a new CAM risk assessment due late November, and will report on it, while stating he lacks data on how many municipalities have banned use.
I do not have such data.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VVD en CDA zien geen heil in terughalen IS-kinderen’

MPs Ploumen, Kuiken and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about the situation of Dutch IS women and children held in Syrian camps, their ability to reach Dutch consulates, the Red Cross offer to bring children to Erbil, and calls for an international tribunal. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult jihadist travellers and their children, that conditions in Al-Hol are very poor, and that it is working on options for prosecution with international partners while stating no tribunal has yet been agreed.
The cabinet sees the children in this matter first and foremost as victims.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen in deze kwestie in de eerste plaats als slachtoffer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de behandeling van het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the General Asylum Report on Afghanistan wrongly portrayed religious freedom and the position of Christians, converts and apostates, including omitting parts of the US State Department findings and a Open Doors claim about trials framed as other crimes. The Minister denied intending such a picture, defended the report's treatment of non-Muslims and converts, and declined to amend the text.
I therefore see no reason to amend the said paragraph.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om genoemde paragraaf aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een Brits rapport inzake geloofsvervolging waarin grote zorgen worden geuit over de wereldwijde christenvervolging

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about a British interim report on Christian persecution that said persecution in some regions approaches the UN definition of genocide, and asked what Dutch action would follow. The minister responded that the Netherlands shares concern, cites its existing human rights commitments, the planned Special Envoy and an international conference in November 2019, and that sanctions and genocide-prevention obligations are available instruments without committing to new specific measures.
The cabinet is committed, and will remain committed, to upholding the Universal Declaration, including article 18.
Nederland zet zich in, en zal zich blijven inzetten, voor naleving van de Universele Verklaring, met inbegrip van artikel 18.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Voordewind over het bericht ‘De jezidi’s zijn hun familie en cultuur kwijt’

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Yazidi women and children remain missing or enslaved, the role of Yazidi support organisations, Syrian regime action, aid withdrawal from Duhok and psychosocial programmes. The ministers answered that about 3,083 Yazidis were still held or missing as of late 2018, outlined existing Dutch and EU support, and committed to no new concrete steps beyond ongoing programmes and an October 2019 conference.
The Netherlands has no diplomatic relations with the Assad regime and the cabinet has no independent information on regime actions to free possibly enslaved Yazidis.
Nederland onderhoudt geen diplomatieke betrekkingen met het Assad-regime en het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over regime-acties om mogelijke tot slaaf gemaakte jezidi’s te bevrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bombardementen van Turkije op christenen in Irak

MPs Van Helvert, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about reported Turkish airstrikes forcing Christian villagers in northern Iraq to flee, and about civilian casualties and compliance with international humanitarian law. The minister said the reports could not be verified, attributed the strikes to Turkey's campaign against the PKK, denied any targeting of religious minorities, and called on Turkey to exercise restraint and proportionality.
The cabinet has no precise information about the exact times and precise locations of these bombings.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de exacte tijd en precieze locaties van deze bombardementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over erkenning van de Golanhoogten als deel van Israël

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands recognises the Golan Heights as Israeli territory, on what resolutions its position rests, when it would recognise Israeli sovereignty, and whether residents are safer under Israel. The minister answered that the Golan remains Syrian territory under Israeli occupation, based on international law and UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 497, and that the Netherlands will only recognise border changes agreed by both parties.
The Netherlands will only recognise changes to the 1967 border if both parties, in this case Israel and Syria, agree to them.
Nederland zal alleen wijzigingen van de grens van 1967 erkennen als de beide partijen, in dit geval Israël en Syrië, daarover afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mensenrechten in Iran gruwelijk geschonden’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating human rights situation in Iran, including executions, harsh crackdowns, the morality police and the appointment of Ebrahim Raisi as head of the judiciary. The minister answered that the government shares concerns, raises them multilaterally, bilaterally and through the EU, but does not comment on appointments in other countries.
The cabinet does not concern itself with appointments in other countries.
Het kabinet gaat niet over benoemingen in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over de berechting van Syriëgangers

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked why the Ministry of Foreign Affairs classifies some Syrian armed groups as moderate while the public prosecutor treats some as terrorist, and whether the government would align its classifications and share information to prevent lenient sentences. The minister answered that prosecutors make their own assessments, that the ministry relies on EU and UN terrorist listings, that NLA support does not rule out prosecution, and that information will be shared case by case on request.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will where possible share information with the Public Prosecution Service to promote the course of justice.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal waar mogelijk informatie delen met het Openbaar Ministerie om de rechtsgang te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de belemmerde vervolging van Syriëgangers

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether Dutch jihadist fighters in Syria could cite Dutch non-lethal assistance (NLA) to armed groups in their defence, and whether the Public Prosecution Service had been informed about which groups received NLA. The minister replied that such use is not known, that information on two specific groups was shared with the prosecutor only for a pending case, and that prosecution decisions are independent of NLA support.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no general statements about fighting groups.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen algemene uitspraken over strijdende groeperingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Uitgezette Bahreini zonder eerlijk proces veroordeeld tot levenslang’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the State Secretary about reports that a deported Bahraini asylum seeker was sentenced to life imprisonment after an unfair trial, including questions on torture reports, monitoring, Sudan deportations and independent investigation. The government answered that it monitors the case via the Kuwait embassy, cannot confirm torture reports, declines an independent inquiry and deportation suspension, and says it will request an updated Sudan country report.
Out of respect for private life, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon en Van der Staaij over het bericht op de website van de Jerusalem Post waarin staat dat Nederland een kritisch onderzoek naar het Israëlische hooggerechtshof heeft gefi

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch government funded B'Tselem, a critical report on the Israeli Supreme Court, and whether the government shaped its aims or findings. The minister answered that the €176,000 grant was based on B'Tselem's own strategic plan, that the Dutch government did not steer its research goals or conclusions, and that funding critical civil society work fits Dutch support for human rights and the two-state solution.
The Netherlands in no way steered the research objectives or conclusions in advance or during the implementation of the research.
Nederland heeft op geen enkele manier op voorhand, of tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek sturing gegeven aan onderzoeksdoelen of conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over banden tussen BDS en terroristen

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the government about alleged links between BDS organisations and Palestinian terrorists, whether Dutch subsidies could indirectly fund such organisations, and about an Amnesty campaign urging tourism platforms to boycott Israeli settlement businesses. The government rejected the general claims, said subsidy procedures and sanctions are adequate, maintained its opposition to BDS and its policy of not funding BDS-promoting activities, and referred to the company's own responsibility under international CSR norms.
Funds from both the Netherlands and the EU are only provided once careful selection procedures have been completed.
Fondsen van zowel Nederland als de EU worden pas verstrekt zodra zorgvuldige selectieprocedures zijn doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen januari-juni 2018

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about the 2018 resettlement quota, missions, Turkey-related resettlement and selection withdrawals. The State Secretary reported about 610 selections and 530 arrivals under the national quota, cut the 2019 quota to 500, and admitted earlier Turkey figures in the Rapportage were wrong.
The national quota you ask about is part of the multi-year resettlement policy framework 2016–2019.
Het nationale quotum waarnaar wordt gevraagd maakt deel uit van het meerjarig beleidskader hervestiging 2016–2019.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de advocaat van de Asia Bibi, de heer Saif ul-Malook, nu hij teruggekeerd is naar Pakistan om haar zaak te verdedigen

MPs asked whether the Minister would nominate lawyer Saif ul-Malook for the Human Rights Tulip, offer him protection when threats recur, confirm the validity of his Schengen visa, and say how the Netherlands could help his safety in Pakistan. The Minister said the Tulip nomination process is independent, declined to pre-empt any new protection request, would not confirm visa validity, and noted Pakistani authorities are responsible for his safety.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the validity of individuals' Schengen visas, partly because it is not authorised to share this personal data.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de geldigheid van het Schengenvisum van individuen, mede omdat het kabinet niet gemachtigd is deze persoonsgegevens te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Vulnerable and abandoned’ van Oxfam Novib

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the government about the Oxfam Novib report on vulnerable refugees on the Greek islands, covering medical care, vulnerability screening, EU expert deployment, detention conditions, safety of women and children, and EU funding. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in medical staffing and reception, outlines the vulnerability procedures and expert numbers, and says the government will keep raising the issue with Greece and the Commission, without disclosing the content of diplomatic talks.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic communications, I cannot go into the remarks of my Greek colleague.
In het kader van de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik niet ingaan op de uitlatingen van mijn Griekse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport van Amnesty International Nederland inzake uitzettingen naar Soedan

An MP asked whether deportations to Sudan should be suspended in light of an Amnesty report on detention and torture of returnees, and whether the case of one individual should be halted. The Secretary of State answered that he sees no reason to adopt Amnesty's recommendations, stating that the asylum procedure already assesses Article 3 ECHR risks and he will monitor Sudan and act if needed.
I will not go further into individual cases.
Op individuele zaken ga ik verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de ranglijst christenvervolging 2019 uitgebracht door 'Open Doors'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2019 Open Doors ranking of Christian persecution, its trend, and Dutch responses in Iraq, China, India and Algeria, plus the Asia Bibi case and the planned special envoy for freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concern about rising persecution, described ongoing bilateral and EU diplomacy, and said the special envoy would start work as soon as possible.
The Netherlands continues to work for freedom of religion and belief bilaterally and through various multilateral fora and will intensify this effort in the coming years.
Nederland blijft zich zowel bilateraal als via de diverse multilaterale fora inzetten voor de vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging en zal deze inzet in de komende jaren intensiveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over promotieonderzoek naar de rechterlijke toetsing in het asielrecht

An MP asks the State Secretary about a PhD study concluding that judicial review in asylum cases is too deferential and that the IND's credibility assessments and the Council of State's case law weaken asylum seekers' protection. The State Secretary largely rejects these conclusions, arguing that judicial review has intensified since 2015, that EU and ECHR standards are met, and that the burden of proof is shared with the authorities.

The Dutch administrative law system of legal protection in asylum cases as a whole ensures that an asylum seeker in the Netherlands receives the protection to which he is entitled under EU law and the ECHR.

Het Nederlandse bestuursrechtelijke stelsel van rechtsbescherming in asielzaken als geheel waarborgt dat in Nederland een asielzoeker de bescherming wordt gegeven die hem op grond van het unierecht en het EVRM toekomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over mogelijke staatsgeheimen die gepubliceerd zijn in WOB-stukken over Non Lethal Assistance aan Syrische ‘rebellen’

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether state secrets were published in FOIA documents on Non Lethal Assistance to Syrian rebel groups, and what the penalties and actions are. The minister admits some names were wrongly left unredacted, says the government will not publicly name supported groups for security and alliance reasons, reports a data-leak investigation, and offers Parliament renewed confidential access to the documents.
The cabinet nevertheless maintains the principle that no public statements are made about groups that received support under the Non Lethal Assistance (NLA) programme.
Het kabinet blijft evenwel bij het uitgangspunt dat er geen openbare uitspraken gedaan worden over groepen die steun ontvingen in het kader van het Non Lethal Assistance (NLA)-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Asielzoeker uit Bahrein na gedwongen vertrek uit Nederland meteen gearresteerd'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands deported a Bahraini asylum seeker who was arrested on arrival, and about his legal status, access to counsel, risk groups and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, held that the general asylum framework and sources suffice, saw no reason for a moratorium or an Inspectorate investigation, and promised only to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, for privacy reasons relating to the person concerned I cannot comment on individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderarbeid en niet betalen van minimumlonen bij Nederlandse en in Nederland actieve zaadbedrijven die in India actief zijn

MP Voordewind asks the minister about child labour and non-payment of minimum wages at Dutch seed companies operating in India, citing a 2018 Landelijke India Werkgroep report, and asks about sector convenants, grievance mechanisms, living wage support and whether companies will be held to account. Minister Kaag answers that the government expects companies to follow OECD guidelines and monitor risks, has raised child labour bilaterally, has discussed a sector convenant that the sector declined in favour of its own OECD-based approach, and points to funding and ILO projects while leaving most follow-up to dialogue with the sector.
The cabinet expects companies operating in or from the Netherlands to conduct business in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die in of vanuit Nederland opereren dat zij ondernemen volgens de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Van Ojik over het rapport ‘Extra beschermd of extra beschadigd?’

MPs asked the State Secretary about a report finding that disabled and seriously ill children in asylum procedures and reception centres are not protected under UN child and disability treaties, and how the IND's medical assessments differ from treating doctors' views. The State Secretary responded that COA adapts housing and care case by case, that medical permits follow a separate IND/BMA assessment with discretionary power, and that individual cases are not addressed.
From that standpoint I cannot answer your question.
Ik kan uw vraag vanuit dat oogpunt dus niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over overlast en geweld door bepaalde groepen asielzoekers in asielzoekerscentra

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about reports that a group of young men from Morocco and Algeria placed in the Beverwaard asylum centre caused rising nuisance and violence, including whether COA staff avoid intervening, how placement in the special supervision location works, and why return of safe-country asylum seekers is problematic. The State Secretary confirmed the placement and rising police involvement, said COA and partners share information and apply tailored measures, and pointed to existing return cooperation efforts and capacity of 100 places, largely without new commitments.
When placing people, COA applies the principle of spreading groups and, together with partners, works to adequately deploy available measures to ensure manageability and safety at locations.

Het COA hanteert bij plaatsing het uitgangspunt van spreiding van groepen en zet daarnaast, samen met betrokken partijen, in op adequate inzet van beschikbare maatregelen om de beheersbaarheid en veiligheid op locaties te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bedreiging, onderdrukking en roof van christenen in Irak

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of militia intimidation of Christians in Iraq, illegal seizure of their homes, the Shia militias' status, and whether Dutch pressure and UN investigation were planned. The minister said the Bartella incident was a wedding celebration rather than religious restriction, acknowledged property seizures, and said the government raises minority rights with Iraqi authorities but sees no reason for a separate UN inquiry.
The cabinet sees no reason to additionally start a UN investigation into the alleged oppression, threats and persecution of vulnerable minorities in Iraq.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om hiernaast nog een VN onderzoek te starten naar de vermeende onderdrukking, bedreiging en vervolging van kwetsbare minderheden in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Koopmans over de situatie van Asia Bibi nu zij is vrijgesproken van godslastering door het Pakistaanse Hof

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Asia Bibi after her acquittal by Pakistan's Supreme Court, including efforts to secure her release, safe exit for her and her family, and protection for Christians in Pakistan. The minister answered that a review petition is pending under Pakistani procedure, that the Netherlands is pursuing quiet diplomacy with allies, offered the lawyer and family a place in the Shelter City programme, and will raise minority protection at the Foreign Affairs Council.
To the lawyer of Asia Bibi, as well as his wife and child, the cabinet has offered a place in the Shelter City programme.
Aan de advocaat van Asia Bibi, alsmede zijn echtgenote en kind, heeft het kabinet een plek in het Shelter City-programma aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Baudet, De Roon en Voordewind over de Nederlandse instemming met een Palestijns voorzitterschap van de G77

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN resolution granting the Palestinian delegation rights to chair the G77, given the resolution's reference to a "Palestinian State" and the Netherlands not recognising such a state. The minister answered that the rights are temporary and limited to the 2019 chairmanship, that the Netherlands reaffirmed its non-recognition in a vote explanation, and that the Kingdom will keep clarifying its position where needed.
At the same time, the Kingdom reaffirmed its long-standing consistent position on the non-recognition of the "State of Palestine" in a vote explanation.
