Tegelijkertijd heeft het Koninkrijk zijn jarenlange consistente positie ten aanzien van de niet-erkenning van de «Staat Palestina» in een stemverklaring herbevestigd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de sluiting van Aramese scholen door de Koerdische YPG in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that the YPG had closed Christian schools in north-east Syria, how he assessed this, what contacts the government has with the YPG, and what steps it would take on the risk of ethnic cleansing and a ceasefire. Minister Blok answered that the government finds the reports worrying, will raise them informally with the Benelux representation of the PYD/YPG, and that contacts are sporadic; on ceasefire efforts he described support for initiatives in Idlib without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat eenvijfde van de Syriërs wordt afgewezen vanwege extremistische of conservatieve denkbeelden

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether one-fifth of Syrian refugees nominated by UNHCR for resettlement from Turkey are rejected for extremist or conservative views, how the integration screening works, and about conditions in Greek camps. The State Secretary says the one-fifth figure conflates all rejection grounds, that conservative views alone are not a ground for refusal, and that integration screening does not reduce the national resettlement quota; the Greek camp questions were referred to earlier answers.
Holding conservative views is in itself not a ground for refusal.
Het hebben van conservatieve denkbeelden is op zichzelf geen grond voor weigering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris in hoger beroep is gegaan in de zaak van Lili en Howick en daarmee het advies van de Raad voor kind

MPs asked why the State Secretary appealed the Lili and Howick ruling and disregarded Raad voor de Kinderbescherming conditions, and whether removal of supervised children without achieved goals is responsible. The State Secretary answered that asylum law under the CJEU M'Bodj judgment excludes these socio-economic circumstances from Article 3 ECHR, that the Raad van State ruled in his favour, that the children may now stay after events of 8 September 2018, and that the RvdK, IND and DT&V cooperate while each applies its own context.

The circumstances invoked in this case, namely that the goals formulated by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming have not yet been achieved, cannot and may not, according to this case law of the Court of Justice, lead to asylum status.

De aangevoerde omstandigheden in deze zaak, erin gelegen dat de door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming geformuleerde doelen nog niet zijn bereikt, kunnen en mogen volgens deze jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie niet leiden tot een asielstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de berichtgeving dat hulpgelden niet terechtkomen bij yezidi’s en christenen

MPs Kuik, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the minister whether EU and Dutch aid reaches Yazidis and Christians in northern Iraq, how EU funds are controlled, and what is being done to free abducted Yazidi women and children. The minister disputed the reports, described Dutch and EU humanitarian funding and partner-vetting mechanisms, and gave overviews of projects, while pointing to the Iraqi government for inclusive governance and promising a country strategy and an annual letter on EU external financing.
Based on the GNI distribution key, the Dutch share of this contribution is approximately 4.7%.
Op basis van de BNI-verdeelsleutel is het Nederlandse aandeel in deze bijdrage circa 4,7%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Afghanistan

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the State Secretary about deportations of Afghan families with minor children, the compatibility with children's rights, recognition rates across EU states, and the number of families in return procedures. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the deportation endangered the family, defended the policy change and the Afghan recognition rate, and said unaccompanied minors are not returned where no family or adequate care is available.
I do not share this conclusion.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat de Europese Unie een plan heeft opgesteld voor infrastructuur tussen Gaza en Judea-Samaria, zonder Israël en de Palestijnse Autoriteit hierbij te betrekken o

The MP asks whether the EU drew up an infrastructure plan linking Gaza and the West Bank without involving Israel or the Palestinian Authority, and what the Netherlands thinks of it. The minister answers that the study supports the Palestinian Ministry of Transport, that coordination with Israel will be needed for concrete projects, and that the government supports opening crossings and the two-state solution.
Since this is an exploratory study that helps the PA shape its own vision, permission was not requested from the Israeli authorities.
Aangezien het gaat om een verkennend onderzoek dat de PA helpt diens eigen visie vorm te geven, is geen toestemming gevraagd van de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de toekenning van de mensenrechtentulp aan Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein

MPs Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked why the Dutch human rights award was given to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein despite whistleblower allegations of cover-ups, and whether he would apologise to whistleblowers Reilly and Kompass. The minister answered that the one-off award honoured his record defending human rights defenders, that no independent committee was involved, that the whistleblower cases were handled by UN bodies with proceedings still pending, and that the government will not ask him to apologise.
No independent committee was involved in the decision-making on the award.
Bij de besluitvorming rond de toekenning was geen onafhankelijke commissie betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de brief van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU Federica Mogherini aan de Israëlische minister van Strategische Zaken Gilad Erdan

MPs asked the government about an EU High Representative letter to Israeli minister Erdan and reports that a Palestinian NGO, Ma'an Development Center, employed a man allegedly linked to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reached it and whether NGO funding policy should change. The government answered that the man worked on a project basis and not in permanent employment, that it has no independent evidence of the alleged affiliation, that its selection criteria are adequate and it would act if subsidy conditions were breached, and that no policy revision is currently needed.
Revision of the Dutch policy towards NGOs is currently not on the agenda.
Herziening van het Nederlandse beleid ten aanzien van NGO's is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van Dam over de Amerikaanse steun voor het Joint Investigation Team (JIT) onderzoek naar de daders van MH17

MPs from VVD, CU, D66 and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US State Department went silent or softened its MH17 statement after the Trump-Putin summit, and whether MH17 was discussed there. The minister replied that the US fully supports the JIT and the Dutch approach, reaffirmed in the G7 statement of 16 July, while declining to share confidential allied information and calling Russia's criticism unfounded.
As the House is aware, on the basis of alliance agreements no statements can be made about information confidentially shared by allies.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over door bondgenoten vertrouwelijk gedeelde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Kuik en Voordewind over de opvang van Venezolanen in Colombia

MPs Bouali, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister about the number of Venezuelan refugees in Colombia and neighbouring countries, Dutch contributions and support, and the situation of women and girls forced into prostitution. The minister replied with estimates of roughly 600,000 to 700,000 (UNHCR: about 1 million) Venezuelans in Colombia, a EUR 500,000 unearmarked contribution, and general statements on monitoring vulnerable groups, while stating that further support depends on priorities and available funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela and its consequences for the region, and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de gevolgen voor de regio, en blijft de situatie nauwlettend volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind en Özdil over de hogeschool Saxion, die een stuk over de Aramese genocide niet plaatst omdat er ophef en discussie over is in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind and Özdil asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Saxion's decision not to publish a student interview on the Aramean genocide due to public controversy, questioning whether such concerns justify withholding publication and whether the institution should be told so. The Minister replied that controversy alone should not be a reason to withhold publication, that the editorial decision was made independently for safety reasons, that the article was later published internally and on Saxion's website, and that she sees no need for further action or a joint statement.
I am of the view that controversy and debate should not be reasons to avoid speaking or writing about a subject.
Ik ben van mening dat ophef en discussie geen redenen mogen zijn om over een onderwerp niet te spreken of te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het vertrek van de Verenigde Staten uit de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the US withdrawal from the UN Human Rights Council over alleged bias against Israel, and whether Dutch membership legitimises unreliable human rights policy. The minister rejects that view, acknowledges shortcomings such as agenda item 7, describes reform efforts and says the Netherlands will keep working in the Council rather than follow the US out.
The cabinet does not want to sideline itself, but rather wants to stay in dialogue within the Human Rights Council, including with the difficult countries.
Het kabinet wil zichzelf niet buiten spel zetten, maar wil juist in gesprek blijven in de Mensenrechtenraad, ook met de moeilijke landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het scheiden van ouders en kinderen door Amerikaanse grensbewakers aan de grens tussen de VS en Mexico

MPs Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether US border separation of children from parents is compatible with international treaties and whether he would ask the US ambassador for clarification. The minister expressed concern, said the Refugee Convention does not apply, noted the US is not party to the Children's Rights Convention, and said Dutch concerns were conveyed diplomatically while awaiting the outcome of the US debate and court proceedings.
That is how it should be in a democratic constitutional state. We are awaiting the outcome of the discussion.
Zo hoort dat in een democratische rechtsstaat. De uitkomst van de discussie wachten we af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de stijgende christenvervolging in China onder Xi Jinping

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Catholic bishop Guo Xijin, new Chinese restrictions on unregistered religious activity, and what the government will do about religious freedom in China. The minister said the Netherlands is seriously concerned, raised religious freedom in bilateral and multilateral talks, and will use the UN Universal Periodic Review, but made no commitment on the bishop's appointment, which he called a matter between China and the Vatican.
The cabinet makes no statement on the official appointment and approval of bishops; this is a matter between China and the Vatican.
Over de officiële benoeming en goedkeuring van bisschoppen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken – dit is een kwestie die speelt tussen China en het Vaticaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'IND-beleid bekeerlingen geregeld onzorgvuldig'

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether the IND handles conversion-based asylum claims carelessly, citing an open letter from Stichting Gave, and asked about assessment criteria and implementation of the Groothuizen motion. The Secretary of State rejects Gave's conclusions, says the IND has the expertise for a careful integral assessment, and promises a letter before the summer recess covering the motion, third-party reports and the assessment framework.
As you know, I will send your House a response before the summer recess to the Groothuizen et al. motion on the IND's credibility assessment of LGBT asylum seekers and converts.
Zoals u bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces een reactie sturen op de motie Groothuizen c.s inzake de geloofwaardigheidsbeoordeling van lhbt-asielzoekers en bekeerlingen door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Noodkreet Vluchtelingenwerk over retourtickets migranten'

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that the Netherlands is resuming Dublin transfers of asylum seekers to Greece and whether tickets were issued, and about reception conditions and Article 3 ECHR concerns. The State Secretary confirmed limited resumption of take-back claims for non-vulnerable persons, said no transfer decisions or tickets have been issued yet, and said individual guarantees from Greece will be assessed.
So far, none of the claims already sent have led to a decision that the asylum seeker must be transferred to Greece.
Vooralsnog hebben geen van de al verzonden claims geleid tot een besluit met de strekking dat de asielzoeker overgedragen dient te worden aan Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Voordewind, Kuik en Bouali over het bericht dat OS-ontvanger Rwanda de nieuwe shirtsponsor van voetbalclub Arsenal wordt

MPs from VVD, ChristenUnie, CDA and D66 asked the minister whether Rwanda, a development aid recipient, becoming Arsenal's shirt sponsor is consistent with aid dependency concerns and whether the government would raise this with Rwanda. The minister answered that the choice of partner is Rwanda's, that the Netherlands continues a transition relationship with bilateral aid being phased out, and that it will keep discussing the effectiveness of such tourism investments with Rwanda's development board.
The Rwanda Development Board has made no statements about the costs associated with this partnership.
De Rwanda Development Board heeft geen uitspraken gedaan over de kosten die gepaard gaan met dit partnerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de pushbacks van vluchtelingen door Griekenland

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked whether Greece is pushing refugees back to Turkey without allowing asylum claims, whether this breaches the Refugee Convention, and whether the Netherlands will confront Greece about it. The Secretary of State says the government takes such reports seriously, that Greece denies pushbacks at its borders, and that the Commission is responsible for enforcing EU law, while listing EU and bilateral financial and personnel support to Greece.
Incidentally, it is primarily the responsibility of the European Commission to monitor the application of the EU acquis.
Overigens is het primair aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de toepassing van het EU-acquis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de antisemitische uitspraken van president Abbas

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether President Abbas's antisemitic remarks were unacceptable, whether the EU would take follow-up action, and what consequences should follow. The minister answered that the government shares the EU's view that parts of the speech are unacceptable, has protested bilaterally and in the UN Security Council, and sees no reason to suspend Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
The cabinet sees no reason to suspend or end (partly) Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de Nederlandse steun aan de Palestijnse gebieden (gedeeltelijk) op te schorten of te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Van Dam en Voordewind over de persconferentie van het JIT over de ramp met MH17

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the JIT press conference on MH17, in particular Russia's failure to share information on the Buk missile's origin and whether Russia breaches UN resolution 2166. The minister agreed that the Buk belonged to the Russian military, that Russia must cooperate fully, and that he raised the matter in the UN Security Council.
In the Security Council I called on Russia to take its responsibility, to engage with Australia and the Netherlands on this, and to cooperate fully as demanded by UN Security Council Resolution 2166.

In de Veiligheidsraad heb ik Rusland opgeroepen zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, met Australië en Nederland daarover in gesprek te gaan en volledig mee te werken zoals wordt geëist door VNVR-resolutie 2166.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Strengere regels inburgering: geslaagde migranten moeten opnieuw toets afleggen’

MPs asked whether migrants who passed the state NT2 language exam must now take extra civic tests (KNM and ONA) before the IND grants a permanent residence permit, and why DUO and the IND apply different rules. The minister answered that the stricter requirement since 2015 applies to the Vreemdelingenwet for applications filed from 1 January 2015, that information for the target group will be improved, and refused to drop the extra test while promising to monitor effects.

It is therefore possible that someone who holds the NT2 diploma and became subject to the civic integration obligation before 1 January 2015 is exempt from the integration obligation under the Wet inburgering but still must pass the KNM and ONA components if they file an application for a stronger residence right after 1 January 2015.

Het is dus mogelijk dat iemand die in het bezit is van het NT2 diploma en vóór 1 januari 2015 inburgeringsplichtig is geworden, is vrijgesteld van de inburgeringsplicht op grond van de Wet inburgering maar nog wel de onderdelen KNM en ONA moet behalen indien hij ná 1 januari 2015 een aanvraag indient voor een sterker verblijfsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over toenemende inperking van de godsdienstvrijheid in China

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the worsening of religious freedom in China, including tighter rules on unregistered religious groups, the detention of Dr. Wang Bingzhang without trial, and the treatment of Taiwanese activist Li Ming Che. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch raising of the issue bilaterally and in EU forums, and said the government will keep raising individual cases with China.
The Cabinet raises individual cases both within the EU and bilaterally and will continue to do so.
Het Kabinet kaart zowel in EU-verband als in bilateraal verband individuele gevallen aan en zal dat blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Iran stiekem delen van het atoomprogramma zou hebben voortgezet

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Israeli claims that Iran secretly continued parts of its nuclear weapons programme after the JCPOA were new, whether the IAEA and the Dutch government had received the material, and how the Dutch government would keep the JCPOA in place after the US withdrew support. The minister answered that the information offers no new insight, that the IAEA reports Iran is complying, that Nederland urges Israel to share the material with the IAEA, and that Nederland is working with EU partners to preserve the agreement and consider measures on ballistic missiles.
The information presented by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu does not lead to new insights into the Iranian nuclear programme.
De informatie die de Israëlische minister-president Netanyahu presenteerde leidt niet tot nieuwe inzichten over het Iraanse nucleaire programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de komst van een zelfmoordmachine naar de uitvaartbeurs in Amsterdam

Three MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a suicide machine (euthanasia demonstration) was shown at an open funeral fair in Amsterdam, and what the government would do about it and about suicide prevention investment. The Staatssecretaris called such a demonstration highly undesirable, said the government has no legal power to ban it, and promised to inform the House this spring on suicide prevention funding.
I have no legal powers to prohibit such demonstrations, the aim of which is to stimulate discussion.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om te verbieden dat dergelijke demonstraties plaatsvinden, waarvan het doel is de discussie aan te jagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Kuik en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Promotiemeisjes van Heineken verkopen bier met hun lichaam’

MPs Alkaya, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Heineken promotion girls in Africa are subjected to sexual harassment, and about the responsibility of parent companies, legal options, and Heineken subsidies. The minister said companies must address abuses throughout their supply chain under UN and OECD guidelines, that the government lacks legal powers to compel them, that a call with Heineken's CEO produced a commitment to prioritise the issue, and that a 2019 evaluation of the IMVO covenants will determine whether legislation is needed.
The government has no legal means to compel Dutch companies to take measures in such cases.
De overheid heeft geen juridische mogelijkheden om Nederlandse bedrijven te dwingen tot het nemen van maatregelen in dergelijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Voordewind over een door Oxfam Novib en een Hamas-activist georganiseerde workshop

Two MPs asked whether a workshop organised with Oxfam Novib involving Abou Amin Rashed, linked by the government to Hamas-related fundraising, involved government participation or funding. The ministers answered that the event was organised by United Civilians for Peace without government involvement, that Dutch officials attended only as ordinary participants, and that government funding does not support BDS-promoting activities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in organising the meeting or in the invitation policy.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is niet betrokken geweest bij de organisatie van de bijeenkomst of het uitnodigingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over verhoging van betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

An MP asked the government whether it supports Israeli measures withholding tax revenue from the Palestinian Authority over payments to prisoners and whether Dutch aid should be cut similarly. The government answered that it opposes cutting aid, that the revenue transfers are binding under the Paris Protocol, and that it will keep raising the issue bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
The cabinet is not in favour of reducing support to the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van korten van de steun aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de Poolse wet die bepaalde uitingen over de rol van Polen in de Holocaust strafbaar stelt

Parliamentarian Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister how the Polish law criminalising statements attributing Polish complicity in Nazi crimes would affect public debate, whether the Polish ambassador and counterparts would be questioned, whether the EU Court of Justice should review it, and whether similar laws in Lithuania, Latvia and Ukraine exist. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands has voiced concerns through the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance, will raise further clarification with Polish authorities if needed, sees no clear EU-law basis for CJEU review, and reported that Lithuania and Latvia have no comparable laws while Ukraine's 2015 decommunisation law is under amendment after Venice Commission criticism.
The cabinet will, if necessary, again contact the Polish authorities to request further clarification on the law, in addition to the concerns already expressed.
Het kabinet zal zich zo nodig opnieuw in verbinding stellen met de Poolse autoriteiten om, in aanvulling op de eerdergenoemde reeds geuite zorgen, nadere opheldering te vragen over de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2018

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 Open Doors persecution ranking, including religious freedom in Pakistan, North Korea, India and other countries, and whether religious freedom should be a priority in asylum policy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, describes bilateral, EU and Human Rights Fund activities, and sees no reason to make Christian asylum seekers a separate priority in asylum policy.
The government cannot independently confirm the exact number of North Korean Christians in prison camps.
Het kabinet kan het exacte aantal Noord-Koreaanse christenen in strafkampen niet eigenstandig bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, Groothuizen en Kuiken over de uitzettingen van afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

Four MPs asked whether the Netherlands should investigate the fate of Sudanese asylum seekers deported to Sudan after Belgium opened an inquiry into alleged torture of deportees, whether Sudanese diplomats played a role in deportations, and whether they gather information on asylum seekers in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State refused to start an own investigation or pause deportations, arguing the Dutch situation differs from Belgium's and no concrete signal of irregularities was received, and denied knowledge of diplomats gathering information.

The investigation started by the Belgian government into statements from some Sudanese foreigners expelled by Belgium is for me no reason to conduct an independent investigation into deportation to Sudan or to suspend return to Sudan.

Het onderzoek dat de Belgische regering is gestart naar de verklaring van enkele door België uitgezette Sudanese vreemdelingen vormt voor mij geen reden om een eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar uitzetting naar Sudan dan wel om terugkeer naar Sudan op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Becker en Kuik over het naar voren halen van de Nederlandse bijdrage aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind, Becker and Kuik asked why the Netherlands should fill budget gaps at UNRWA caused by the US funding freeze, and about effects on Israel, the PA, other donors and future funding. Minister Kaag answered that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 13 million was brought forward to address an acute liquidity problem, not to replace US money, and that the government will reassess later in the year without a commitment to top up.
The cabinet decided to make the planned annual contribution to UNRWA available early to mitigate an acute financing problem and give UNRWA the chance and time to find other donors.

Het kabinet heeft besloten de geplande jaarbijdrage voor UNRWA versneld beschikbaar te stellen om een acuut financieringsprobleem te mitigeren en UNRWA de kans en tijd te geven om andere donoren te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de voortgang van het kledingconvenant en het tekortschieten van de verbeterplannen van kledingbedrijven

MP Voordewind asked the minister about slow progress under the textile covenant, low participation by clothing firms, and weak improvement plans on child labour, living wages and supply-chain transparency. The minister replied that the 18% and 17% figures were aggregate self-assessment answers rather than shares of firms, that nearly all 57 firms submitted plans, and that the government will evaluate the covenant approach in two years.
The coalition agreement states that the cabinet will evaluate the IMVO covenant policy in two years and decide on that basis whether and which additional (binding) measures are needed.
In het regeerakkoord staat dat het kabinet het IMVO-convenantenbeleid over twee jaar zal evalueren, en op basis daarvan besluiten of en welke aanvullende (dwingende) maatregelen nodig zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over het stemgedrag van Nederland in de Verenigde Naties

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked how Dutch voting positions on UN resolutions are determined, how parliament exercises democratic control over them, and whether the government is bound by an alleged EU principle that all member states vote the same. The minister answered that positions are set by the minister after substantive review and EU coordination, that parliament controls this through regular debates, questions and motions, and that no EU principle requires identical voting, though member states must coordinate under Article 34 TEU.
There is no principle agreement within the EU that all member states vote the same.
Er is geen principe-afspraak binnen de EU dat alle lidstaten hetzelfde stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over een zelfmoordaanslag op een kerk in Pakistan

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a suicide attack on a church in Pakistan, its victim numbers, the attackers' background, the state of radical Islamist groups and Dutch efforts on religious freedom, including the cases of death-sentenced Christians. The minister answered with casualty figures, attributed the attack to ISIS-Khorasan, described the Pakistani government's counter-terrorism plan and reported Dutch and EU engagement on religious freedom.
It cannot be determined from the figures whether the victims were of terrorist, sectarian or separatist violence.
Het is niet uit de cijfers op te maken of het hierbij gaat om slachtoffers van terroristisch, sektarisch of separatistisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het doel van 3FM Serious Request, het herenigen van ouders en vermiste kinderen na een ramp of conflict

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of the Red Cross Restoring Family Links work to reunite families and missing children after disasters and conflicts, how the government supports it, whether it will put prevention of child disappearance on the EU and UN agenda, and how it reduces the vulnerability of young migrants in Europe. The government answered that it funds the ICRC and UNHCR, supports family reunification projects, pushes for child protection in the UN Global Compacts, and works on child trafficking via EMPACT, without new binding commitments.
The Netherlands works to trace missing persons, restore contact with family and make reunification possible.
Nederland zet zich in om vermiste personen op te sporen, contacten met familie te herstellen en hereniging mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de steun aan het Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat en de samenwerking met de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee

MPs asked why the Dutch government ended funding for the Women's Affairs Technical Committee after it refused to distance itself from a youth centre named after a convicted terrorist, and why the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat still lists WATC and touts its advocacy against Israel. The ministers answered that donors ended the partnership after WATC refused to distance itself from glorifying violence, that the last payment was in May 2017, that the website figures were adjusted, and that support for Israeli and Palestinian human rights organisations will continue under review.
The cabinet considers glorifying violence simply unacceptable and expects all its partners to keep well away from it.
Het kabinet acht het verheerlijken van geweld simpelweg onacceptabel en verwacht van al zijn partners dat zij zich hier verre van houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland in de VN meestemt met anti-Israëlische resoluties als gevolg van EU-beleid

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch voting on anti-Israel UN resolutions is determined by EU policy and whether this conflicts with a parliamentary motion, and whether the government will change its voting. The minister answered that each proposal is assessed on its merits, that EU unity is pursued for influence, and that the motion is seen as encouragement to continue the current approach, without committing to a change in voting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het behalen van de huidige doelstellingen binnen het Bangladesh Veiligheidsakkoord en de verlenging van het akkoord

Voordewind asked whether the minister knows that not all Dutch apparel brands have signed the new Bangladesh Safety Accord, whether she will press Dutch signatories to meet the targets by May 2018, how many Dutch brands source from Bangladesh, whether accord membership is required under the Dutch textile covenant, and what she will do to urge firms to sign the extended accord. Minister Kaag answered that the targets are about 80 percent realised, that the covenant is the channel for pressure, that the number of Dutch importers is unknown (about 20 percent of Dutch clothing comes from Bangladesh), that accord membership is advised but not required, and that the government supports signing the successor accord and aims for 50 percent market coverage by the covenant in 2018.
The exact number of Dutch clothing brands importing clothing from Bangladesh is not known.
Het exacte aantal Nederlandse kledingmerken dat kleding importeert vanuit Bangladesh is niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het feit dat het NOS Jeugdjournaal een reportage heeft gerectificeerd, omdat er onvolledige en verkeerde informatie werd gegeven

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NOS Jeugdjournaal's rectified report on Gaza children, and the unrectified archived broadcast, meet rules on correction and online archiving. The minister answered that the NPO journalistic code requires prompt correction, that the NPO ombudsman handles complaints, and that she will not judge the editorial handling of corrections given broadcaster autonomy.
I do not express a view on substantive and editorial matters.
Ik spreek mij niet uit over inhoudelijke en redactionele kwesties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over bedreiging van christenen in Rotterdam

Two MPs (Van der Staaij and Voordewind) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a converted Christian couple in Rotterdam was threatened by Muslims for evangelising, asking how police and prosecutors respond and whether other cases exist. The minister confirmed that threats are criminal, that the couple has regular contact with police, and that cases can be investigated, but declined to discuss individual casework.
Beyond that, it is not appropriate for me to address individual casework in parliamentary questions.
Voor het overige past het mij niet om in Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een fatwa tegen Somalische christenen in Europa

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a fatwa calling for action against Somali Christians in Europe poses a real threat, and what protection is needed. The minister answered that the threat cannot be confirmed, the video had only 135 views, no signals of unrest were received, and that threats reported to authorities would be investigated with measures taken if needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over mensenrechtenschendingen tegen Burundese vluchtelingen

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about human rights violations against Burundian refugees in Congo, including shootings, EU diplomatic pressure, MONUSCO's protection role, refugee camp conditions and the safety of returnees to Burundi. The government condemned the violence, reported that Congolese authorities and MONUSCO opened investigations, and said Burundi's repression and economic weakness make returns risky.
The cabinet is shocked by the incident and condemns the disproportionate use of force by the Congolese security services.
Het kabinet is geschokt door het incident en veroordeelt het disproportioneel gebruik van geweld door de Congolese veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnse terroristen of hun nabestaanden

An MP asked the government whether it would press the Palestinian Authority to stop payments to convicted Palestinian prisoners and their families, which reward more violence, and whether Dutch aid could be reduced. The ministers answered that the government favours transparent, need-based payments, will increase pressure on the PA and PLO to change the system, but will not cut aid because that would harm Palestinians and the PA's credibility.
The cabinet is working, together with like-minded countries, to increase pressure on the Palestinian Authority and PLO to change the system of payments to prisoners.
Het kabinet zet zich in, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, om de druk op de Palestijnse Autoriteit en PLO op te voeren om het systeem van uitkeringen aan gevangenen te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's decision to place the Old City of Hebron on the World Heritage List, which they said neglects Jewish history, distorts history, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister answered that the decision was taken by the World Heritage Committee members, that ICOMOS could not verify the emergency procedure criteria because Israel denied a site visit, that the cabinet follows ICOMOS advice, and that the Netherlands will not protest but will urge coexistence.
The cabinet's position is that it follows the advice of ICOMOS.
Het kabinet hanteert als standpunt dat het de adviezen van ICOMOS volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de 1f-status van alle oud-medewerkers van de Afghaanse geheime dienst

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 1F status of former Afghan secret service staff and whether MPs had access to the sources behind a 2000 country report, including verification and whether access would be granted now. The minister said several MPs were given confidential access to the underlying documents, that the Council of State found the report supported, and that future access requests would be assessed on their merits.

The cabinet will assess any concrete requests from MPs for access benevolently and on their merits, in light of necessity and the cabinet's responsibility to handle the confidential nature of the sources carefully.

Het kabinet zal eventuele concrete inzageverzoeken van Kamerleden welwillend en op hun merites beoordelen in het licht van noodzaak en tegen de achtergrond van de verantwoordelijkheid van het kabinet om zorgvuldig om te gaan met het vertrouwelijke karakter van de bronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over een politieteam in Indonesië tegen LHBT'ers (Lesbiënnes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) moet opsporen

MPs Van Helvert, Ten Broeke and Voordewind asked about a planned West Java police unit to hunt LHBT people, alleged threats of harsh punishment, Dutch aid to Indonesia, and whether the Netherlands will act via EU dialogue. The government says the unit has not been formally established, confirms the Netherlands raised LHBTI concerns bilaterally and via the EU, lists aid being phased out by 2020 while support to civil society continues, and commits to raising the issue in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bezoek van minister-president Modi van India aan Nederland

MP Voordewind asked the government to raise with PM Modi the restrictions on civil society and NGOs in India, visa problems for Dutch critics, labour and child labour abuses in supply chains, and violence against Dalits, Muslims and Christians. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally, without committing to specific new steps beyond ongoing dialogue.
In contacts with the Indian government, the cabinet consistently underlines the importance of civil society organisations for a well-functioning democratic constitutional state.
Het kabinet onderstreept in contacten met de Indiase overheid voortdurend het belang van maatschappelijke organisaties voor een goed functionerende democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over de berichten dat Turkije Koerdische doelen in Noord-Syrië en Noord-Irak heeft aangevallen

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish strikes on Kurdish targets in northern Syria and Iraq, including whether evidence supports Turkey's claim the targets were PKK smugglers and what is known of casualties among Syrian Christians and Yazidis. The minister answered that Turkey has a right to self-defence but should show restraint and act proportionately, that the government has no evidence to confirm or refute Turkey's claim, and that it has no independent information on casualties, only open-source reports of protests.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Israël het visum van NRC-correspondent Derk Walters niet wil verlengen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to press Israel over its refusal to extend the visa of NRC correspondent Derk Walters, questioning press surveillance and the claim that content was not a factor. The minister replied that Israel cites visa violations, acknowledges it is free to set its admission policy, regrets the decision, and says it has repeatedly raised press freedom with Israeli authorities.
Israel, like any other country, is free to determine its admission policy.
Israël is net als ieder ander land vrij zijn toelatingsbeleid te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de behandeling van verzoeken tot gezinshereniging door de IND

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about long processing times, missed statutory deadlines, default-penalty notices, and refusals of family reunification applications by the IND. The State Secretary answered with processing-time and caseload figures, attributed delays mainly to case complexity and the high asylum inflow, and gave counts of notices and refusals while stating that refusal grounds could not be fully generated from IND systems.

The grounds for refusal in regular MVV-TEV family reunification cases include, among others, failure to meet the civic integration requirement, the income requirement, the passport requirement, public order, etc.
De afwijzingsgronden in reguliere MVV-TEV gezinsherenigingszaken zijn onder meer het niet voldoen aan het inburgeringsvereiste, het inkomensvereiste, paspoortvereiste, openbare orde etc.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Voordewind over over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden mishandeld langs en binnen de grenzen van de Europese Unie

MP Voordewind asked the ministers about an Oxfam Novib report on pushbacks and abuse of migrants at EU borders, asking whether the government would press Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia and Macedonia on rights and abuses and support more safe asylum routes. The government condemned violence against refugees, said enforcement of EU law rests primarily with the Commission, said Bulgaria's border protection does not imply abuse was state policy, and pointed to existing support for Serbia and Macedonia and to resettlement as the preferred route.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat UNESCO een resolutie in stemming wil brengen waarin de soevereiniteit van Israël over West-Jeruzalem ontkend

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and VVD asked whether the government would use its influence in UNESCO to block a draft resolution denying Israeli sovereignty over West Jerusalem, and why UNESCO engages with such politicised texts. The minister said the Netherlands criticised the draft, voted against the adopted version together with Germany, Greece and Lithuania, and that UNESCO's focus on the Old City reflects its World Heritage listings, but did not commit to further action.
The Netherlands therefore voted against the decision, as explained in a joint statement of vote with Germany, Greece and Lithuania.
Nederland heeft daarom tegen het besluit gestemd, zoals toegelicht in een gezamenlijke stemverklaring met Duitsland, Griekenland en Litouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de behandeling van Pakistaanse asielzoekers en vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the treatment of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including whether Thailand treats them as an immigration matter, arbitrary detention risks, Dutch dialogue results and NGO support. The minister answered that Thailand still treats refugee matters as immigration, that Pakistanis are not singled out, that Dutch and EU raise the issue regularly, and that resettlement destinations are a matter for the State Secretary of Justice and Security.
Thailand still regards the fate of refugees and asylum seekers within its borders as an immigration matter.
Thailand beschouwt het lot van vluchtelingen en asielzoekers binnen de landsgrenzen nog altijd als een immigratiezaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de voorgestelde versobering van opvang van asielzoekers in Griekenland

Four MPs asked the State Secretary about a proposed tightening of reception for asylum seekers in Greece under the EU-Turkey deal Joint Action Plan, and Human Rights Watch's criticism. The government answered that the JAP aims to speed up asylum procedures and improve safety and reception capacity, denied that Greece is a policy laboratory, and said it expects no worse conditions or longer stays on the islands.

The government does not expect a severe deterioration of conditions for people on the Greek islands or longer stays, because the JAP also works on faster and more efficient Greek asylum procedures and more regular returns to Turkey.

Het kabinet verwacht geen grove verslechtering van de situatie voor de mensen of een langere verblijfsduur op de Griekse eilanden, omdat onder het JAP ook wordt gewerkt aan bijvoorbeeld het sneller en efficiënter verlopen van de Griekse asielprocedures en terugkeer naar Turkije op regelmatiger basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de conferentie georganiseerd door een aan Hamas verbonden organisatie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether a Rotterdam conference organised by a Palestinian Return Centre, allegedly linked to Hamas, should be banned, and about its links, funding and ECOSOC status. The government answered that it cannot be concluded from known information that Hamas organises the conference, that funding of terrorism is monitored via FIU-NL, and that banning would require a threat to public order, which is not present.
From the information known to us, it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas.
Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over humanitaire visa

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about the CJEU ruling of 7 March 2017 on humanitarian visas, which says member states are not obliged to issue them under the Visa Code, and asked which states issue them, whether the Netherlands has such a procedure, and whether it will issue them to Syrians in Turkey. The government answered that the Netherlands issues no territorially limited short-stay humanitarian visas for stays over 90 days, that such a procedure existed only until 2003, and that resettlement via UNHCR and the EU-Turkey statement is the preferred route, with about 710 Syrians resettled from April 2016 to March 2017.
The Netherlands therefore does not issue territorially limited short-stay visas to persons who wish to stay here for longer than 90 days.
Nederland verstrekt daarom geen territoriaal beperkte visa voor kort verblijf aan personen die hier langer dan 90 dagen willen verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over de 9e rapportage van de Europese Commissie over relocatie en hervestiging van vluchtelingen

MPs asked the State Secretary about the Commission's 9th relocation report, including the number of asylum seekers eligible for relocation from Greece and how Dutch refusals were justified. The State Secretary answered that about 20,000 relocation candidates are now present in Greece, that roughly 20 cases were refused on public order or national security grounds, and that the 10th report will clarify figures.
That is why the Cabinet considers it important to communicate about this consistently and unambiguously.
Daarom vindt het Kabinet het belangrijk om hier steeds helder en eenduidig over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht “Textielindustrie ontdekt Myanmar: lage lonen, lange dagen en kinderarbeid”

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of low wages, long hours and child labour in Myanmar's garment industry, and whether Dutch firms should disclose their activities there and be bound by stricter transparency rules. The minister answered that voluntary supply-chain transparency under the textile convenant suffices for now, that existing due diligence guidance applies without Myanmar-specific indicators, and described development support for labour inspection and unions.
At this moment it is not yet known which factories in Myanmar produce for the Dutch market.
Op dit moment is nog niet bekend welke fabrieken in Myanmar produceren voor de Nederlandse markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen die van de leden Voordewind, Voortman , Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen (SP) over de motie inzake de Regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen

MPs asked whether the government would accept that citing the coalition agreement does not justify ignoring an adopted motion, and whether it would impose a deportation stop for long-resident asylum children until a new cabinet forms.
