The Secretary of State says the coalition agreement was not decisive, but declines to amend the Regeling or impose a deportation stop, citing disruption of removal procedures and raised expectations.
However, I did not want to leave out of the letter my observation that the motion is at odds with the coalition agreement.
Ik heb echter de constatering dat de motie op gespannen voet staat met het regeerakkoord niet achterwege willen laten in de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat de UNHCR gehinderd wordt door Turkije in de monitoring van de vluchtelingendeal

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that UNHCR lacks unhindered access to Turkish reception centres and to monitor returned migrants under the EU-Turkey deal, and about deaths at the Syrian border. The minister replied that access is a recurring topic with Turkey and the Commission, that there is no systematic refusal, that the government cannot confirm the reported shooting deaths, and that it will keep raising access in the Commission's regular reporting.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to press the Commission that regular access forms part of the joint approach, and that this receives attention in the regular reporting.
Nederland zal dan ook bij de Commissie blijven bepleiten dat regelmatige toegang deel uitmaakt van de gezamenlijke aanpak, en dat daarvoor bij de reguliere rapportage aandacht bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het illegaal de grens overzetten van migranten naar Servië

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary about reports that migrants are illegally pushed back across the border from Hungary and Croatia into Serbia, with police violence, and about reception shortfalls in Serbia, EU responsibility and safe routes. The government condemns violence against refugees, says the Commission is primarily responsible for enforcing EU law and that Serbia has enough reception capacity, and declines to start resettlement from Serbia or to take a new EU initiative.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de oprichting van een internationaal fonds voor abortussen

Two MPs asked why the Dutch government is funding an international abortion fund focused on abortion rather than broader maternal care, and how it will be financed amid budget cuts. Minister Ploumen answered that the initiative promotes women's reproductive rights, that 10 million euro fits within the existing budget, and that the impact of the US Mexico City Policy is still being monitored.
The cabinet makes ten million euro available under the She Decides initiative.
Het kabinet stelt tien miljoen euro beschikbaar in het kader van het initiatief She Decides.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de positie van vrouwen en meisjes in de watersector

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the disadvantaged position of women and girls in access to and control over water, and about gender analysis, due diligence and protection of women human rights defenders. The minister agreed with the concerns, described existing gender analysis requirements, water strategy commitments, CSR and due diligence efforts, and measures on women human rights defenders.
A condition for approval of all programmes the Netherlands supports, including water, food security and climate, is carrying out a gender analysis.
Voorwaarde voor goedkeuring van alle programma's die Nederland ondersteunt, inclusief water, voedselzekerheid en klimaat, is het uitvoeren van een genderanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontslag van 1500 textielwerkers in Bangladesh

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the dismissal of 1,500 garment workers in Bangladesh after a strike for higher minimum wages and the arrest of trade union leaders, and what the government would do on union freedom and living wages. The minister expressed concern, said the embassy raised union rights with Bangladeshi authorities and that the government would discuss the matter with the Bangladesh Accord and Dutch brands, while noting that the Accord focuses on fire and building safety.
The Netherlands emphasised the importance of freedom of association, workers' rights and social dialogue in these discussions.
Nederland heeft het belang van vrijheid van vereniging, de rechten van werknemers en sociale dialoog in deze gesprekken benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kledingmerken die bijdragen aan lage lonen, lange werktijden, kinderarbeid en schooluitval in Bangladesh

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Branded Childhood report linking clothing brands' low wages and excessive overtime to child labour and school dropout in Bangladesh, and what the government would do about living wages, rising living costs, transparency and wage benchmarks. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to existing actions such as the textile covenant, round tables, a Bangladesh conference and ISEAL benchmark work, and declined to commit to new binding legislation.
Government policy is aimed at voluntarily concluding IMVO covenants.
Het kabinetsbeleid is gericht op het vrijwillig afsluiten van IMVO-convenanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht “NOS gaat door het stof voor FC Utrecht-supporters”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about anti-Semitic chants at football matches, whether the KNVB guideline is applied, when matches have been stopped, and what a 'gedoogcategorie' in a club protocol means. The minister says there are no signals the guideline is not followed, no match has yet been stopped under the new rule, the KNVB reports no tolerance category exists, and that action should always be taken against discriminatory chants.
I have no signals from the KNVB or the other football and safety partners that the existing guideline is not being complied with.
Ik heb geen signalen van de KNVB of van de andere bij voetbal en veiligheid betrokken partners dat de bestaande richtlijn niet wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het weren van maatschappelijke organisaties door de Indiase overheid

An MP asked the ministers whether India's freezing of funds and restrictions on NGOs such as Compassion and Navsarjan Trust, and its restrictive Foreign Contributions Regulation Act, were of concern and whether the Netherlands would press India to reverse them. The ministers said they share concern about the Act, have raised it bilaterally and multilaterally, will raise it at the March 2017 consultations and in the EU, and that embassy contact with Compassion is under way.
The Netherlands has made efforts at various levels, in bilateral contacts and multilaterally, to draw attention to this situation and will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft zich op verschillende niveaus in bilaterale contacten en in multilateraal verband ingespannen om aandacht te vragen voor deze situatie en zal dit onverminderd blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraak van de Vreemdelingenkamer van de Raad van State van 30 december 2016, over een Iraanse vreemdeling die bekering tot het christendom aanvoerde als reden om te vr

An MP asked the State Secretary how the IND handles conversion claims in asylum cases, whether asylum seekers can use experts, and why the IND did not commission its own expert after a Council of State ruling on an Iranian convert. The State Secretary answered that the IND draws on expert and church input, that asylum seekers may consult experts and submit reports, and that the IND weighs such reports but may still find a conversion not credible with proper reasoning.
The European Court of Human Rights has classified the investigative method used by the IND as surrounded by sufficient safeguards and careful.
Het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) heeft de onderzoeksmethode die de IND hanteert, aangemerkt als met voldoende waarborgen omkleed en zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het tekort aan materieel voor de missie in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether shortages of night-vision devices, jammers and new body armour were preventing Dutch troops in Mali from patrolling, and why troop numbers were not matched to equipment. The minister acknowledged the unit handover caused delays, said all needed equipment is now in theatre, confirmed five reconnaissance groups are operational, and said night-vision devices were shared with other units and new ones will be delivered from February 2017.
Defence has since purchased new night-vision devices. These will become available in phases from February 2017.
Defensie heeft inmiddels nieuwe nachtzichtmiddelen gekocht. Deze komen vanaf februari 2017 gefaseerd beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de eindejaarswensen van de Nederlandse ambassade in Berlijn

MPs Knops, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch embassy in Berlin sent only New Year wishes and no Christmas wishes, and whether other Dutch embassies do the same. The minister replied that embassies are not obliged to send season's greetings, that the choice is left to each post, and that the Berlin embassy did send a digital card wishing a merry Christmas and a happy 2017, so no reference was avoided.
So there is no question of messages being avoided.
Er is dus geen sprake van dat boodschappen worden gemeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse staat New York Nederlandse bedrijven op een zwarte lijst heeft gezet omdat zij Israël zouden boycotten en het bericht over

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would act after New York State blacklisted four Dutch firms for allegedly boycotting Israel, and what it thought of a German CDU position calling the BDS campaign antisemitic. The minister said the ambassador raised due-process concerns with New York, the firms denied any boycott, the government opposes boycotts of Israel, and it rejected the view that BDS is antisemitic.
The cabinet considers that before publishing such a list, careful hearing and rebuttal should take place.
Het kabinet vindt dat voor publicatie van een dergelijke lijst zorgvuldige hoor en wederhoor zou moeten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de bosbranden in Israël

The MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the wildfires in Israel and whether the Netherlands would offer firefighting help as other European countries had. The minister confirmed awareness, said talks with Israeli authorities about help took place but the Netherlands lacked the requested firefighting aircraft, and expressed sympathy.
However, the specific Israeli need could not be met, because the Netherlands does not have the requested firefighting aircraft.
Er kon echter niet in de specifieke Israëlische behoefte worden voorzien, omdat Nederland niet over de gevraagde blusvliegtuigen beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over misstanden op Indiase theeplantages

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about labour abuses on Rainforest Alliance-certified Indian tea estates supplying Unilever, including demands for a public action plan and a living wage. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to industry initiatives (IDH, TRUSTEA, Team Up India, living wage benchmarks) and to Dutch diplomatic and ILO efforts, without committing to new binding measures.
The cabinet shares the analysis that many improvements have taken place on the tea plantations, but that the work is not yet finished.
Het kabinet deelt de analyse dat er veel verbeteringen hebben plaatsgevonden op de theeplantages, maar dat het werk nog niet af is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Sjoerdsma, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

Five MPs asked whether the Netherlands is extraditing two genocide suspects to Rwanda despite expert doubts about fair trials there, and whether this should be suspended pending independent review. The minister confirmed the extradition proceeds after appeal courts found no real risk of an unfair trial, argued trial in the country of the crime is preferred, and refused to suspend extradition or commission new independent research.
I am therefore not willing to suspend the extradition.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid de uitlevering op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Grashoff over hongerlonen en zeer slechte arbeidsomstandigheden bij Indiase leveranciers aan Nederlandse kledingmerken

MPs Voordewind and Grashoff asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about very low wages and poor working conditions, including gender-based violence, at Indian garment suppliers to Dutch brands, and what the government will do about living wages, pressure on Dutch firms, Indian government engagement and OECD involvement. The minister largely agreed the situation is unacceptable, described Dutch support for living wage action, sectoral agreements, the Fair Wear Foundation programme and planned talks under the textile covenant, and noted that responsibility for enforcement also lies with the Indian government.
The cabinet wants to make agreements with the covenant parties on a roadmap for a living wage in the first quarter of 2017.
Het kabinet wil in het eerste kwartaal van 2017 afspraken maken met de convenantspartijen over de routekaart voor leefbaar loon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over de brand in het vreemdelingendetentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fire at the Rotterdam immigration detention centre, including the lack of aftercare, isolation and searches of detainees, the non-central unlocking of doors, and why the Inspectorate did not investigate earlier. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will investigate the events, expected to finish by late November 2016, and will report to parliament afterwards, and that it has now decided to open a further inquiry since the Amnesty account covers different facts.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the course of events surrounding the fire.
Inspectie VenJ) zal onderzoek verrichten naar de gang van zaken rond de brand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Agnes Mulder over het achterblijven van de financiering aan maatschappelijke organisaties

MPs Voordewind and Agnes Mulder asked why only about 22% of the 2016 development budget flows through civil society organisations, below the 25% target in their motion, and how the target will be met in 2016 and 2017. Minister Ploumen answered that the percentage is depressed by budget items counted as ODA (such as first-year asylum reception costs), that about 30% would flow via civil society excluding these, that the government aims for 25% without steering the channel mix, and that several programmes will be implemented through civil society organisations.
The cabinet has committed to aim for spending 25% of the ODA budget via civil society.
Het kabinet heeft toegezegd te streven naar besteding van 25% van het ODA-budget via het maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de reactie van de staatssecretaris op het inspectierapport: Het overlijden van een Irakese asielzoeker in de noodopvang in Alphen aan de Rijn

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about information provision to asylum seekers in emergency shelters, IOM support for voluntary return, financial allowances, suicide-risk handling and meal arrangements following an inspection report on a death in Alphen aan den Rijn. The State Secretary answered that information duties are shared among agencies, that the letter was not handed out in Goes due to unrest, that policy on allowances and cooking has been partly adjusted, and that current coordination is adequate, while committing to ongoing optimisation with partners.
In addition, COA and IND are working with Vluchtelingen Werk Nederland and Rode Kruis Nederland to further optimise information provision at all locations.
Daarnaast werken COA en IND samen met Vluchtelingen Werk Nederland en Rode Kruis Nederland om de informatievoorziening op alle locaties verder te optimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over de VNG-pilot blurring

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health about the VNG pilot on alcohol blurring, which they say breaches the Drank- en Horecawet, including in supermarkets and in light of a poll showing 75% opposition. The State Secretary answered that a court found Nieuwegein acted unlawfully, that municipalities must enforce rather than tolerate violations, that he raised the issue with the VNG, and that he will weigh the poll and supermarket participation in the ongoing evaluation of the law.
Municipalities must enforce violations of the Drink and Catering Act rather than tolerate them.
Gemeenten dienen overtredingen van de Drank- en Horecawet te handhaven en niet te gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de rechten van alleen-staande minderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary about the rights of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMVs): how many special building-exception residence permit requests were made and refused, long-term prospects, the revised Dublin Regulation, the COA improvement plan, and placement procedures. The State Secretary answered that about ten such requests were filed and all refused, stressed family reunification and child-interest considerations, committed to monitoring and a possible evaluation, supported the best-interests principle in Dublin revision, and promised the COA improvement letter before the summer recess ends.
No permits have been issued ex officio under the building-exception policy either. The reason for this is not recorded in the IND's automated system.
Ook zijn er geen ambtshalve vergunningen verstrekt op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid. De reden hiervoor wordt niet in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat de regering-Merkel er zeker van is dat Erdogan bewust radicaalislamitische bewegingen helpt

The ChristenUnie MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the German government believes Erdogan knowingly supports radical Islamist movements can be confirmed, and what political consequences the Netherlands would draw, including halting Turkey's visa liberalisation and EU accession talks and condemning Turkish support for Hamas and Syrian rebels. Minister Koenders answered that the leaked part is confidential and that Germany still regards Turkey as an essential partner against terrorism, that the government will not halt the talks given Turkey's rule-of-law developments, and that Turkish border support for armed groups cannot be excluded and will be addressed through border control.
The cabinet is not of the view that the current negotiations with Turkey on visa liberalisation or EU accession should be stopped because of this reporting.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de huidige onderhandelingen met Turkije over visumliberalisatie of EU-toetreding gestopt moeten worden omwille van deze berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de beperking van godsdienstvrijheid in islamitische landen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on religious freedom in Islamic countries, the US State Department findings, Dutch action, and Boko Haram's calls for violence against Christians. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch human rights support and multilateral efforts, and outlined counter-Boko Haram measures without providing precise casualty figures.
It is not possible to provide precise figures on the number of Christians and churches affected by violence in Islamic countries in the recent period.
Het is niet mogelijk om precieze cijfers te verstrekken van het aantal christenen en kerken dat in de afgelopen periode getroffen is door geweld in islamitische landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over de verstoring van een Israëlkraam in een Jumbo supermarkt

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked the ministers whether an online protest campaign against an Israeli product display in a Jumbo supermarket in Krimpen aan den IJssel was undesirable, and what the government would do to protect supermarkets and staff from intimidation. The minister answered that such actions fall under freedom of expression, that criminal law applies to threats or intimidation, that no signals of disruption of public order were received, and that no extra measures against protest campaigns are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures against protest campaigns.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om extra maatregelen te nemen tegen protestcampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Azc's krijgen vertrouwenspersonen voor homoseksuele asielzoekers’

MPs Van der Staaij, Keijzer and Voordewind asked whether asylum reception centres have dedicated confidants for vulnerable groups such as gay asylum seekers and Christians, about prosecution of crimes against vulnerable groups, and about cameras protecting them. The State Secretary answered that a coordinating confidant function and staff confidants serve all residents without targeting specific groups, that training is being shaped with NGOs, that a new report will show incident-to-prosecution figures without group breakdown, and that cameras are used under an internal framework.
The registration does not break down cases by specific target groups.
In de registratie wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt naar specifieke doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over de doelstelling van de International Labour Organisation (ILO) om uiterlijk in 2016 de ergste vormen van kinderarbeid uit te bannen

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the ILO goal to eliminate the worst forms of child labour by 2016 and what the Netherlands and the Initiative Sustainable Trade (IDH) have done to achieve it. The minister acknowledged the goal is not yet met, listed new Dutch measures such as a child labour fund and EU Council conclusions, and described IDH programmes and lessons learned.
The figure of 168 million children comes from the ILO report 'Global child labour trends 2008 to 2012'.
Het cijfer van 168 miljoen kinderen stamt uit het ILO-rapport «Global child labour trends 2008 to 2012».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de beperking van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in India

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asks the Foreign Minister whether he shares Human Rights Watch and UN rapporteur Kiai's concerns that Indian authorities misuse vague laws, including the foreign contributions regulation law, to silence critics, and whether he will raise this with India, the EU and in the UPR. Minister Koenders answers that the Netherlands shares the rapporteur's concerns about the foreign contributions law, that it raises civil society and free expression in bilateral, EU and multilateral dialogue, and that it has no information showing anti-terror laws are disproportionately used against minorities.
The Dutch government shares the concerns of UN rapporteur Maina Kiai about the law on foreign donations.
De Nederlandse overheid deelt de zorgen van VN-rapporteur Maina Kiai over de wet m.b.t. buitenlandse giften
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ypma over gezinshuizen in Gouda

MPs Voordewind and Ypma asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about Horizon Jeugdzorg's plan to end the 'projectgezinnen' care form in Gouda, its effect on children's care continuity, and whether municipalities should be consulted. The State Secretary answered that Horizon will seek suitable alternatives per child, that the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can mediate, that he sees no reason to talk to Gouda directly, and that VNG will help inventory whether the problem is broader.
I am not familiar with the individual specific casuistry of the children who are placed in the project families.
Ik ken de individuele specifieke casuïstiek van de kinderen die in de projectgezinnen worden opgevangen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de indirecte Nederlandse steun aan de Boycot, Desinvesteringen en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

Three MPs asked whether Dutch-funded NGOs fund other NGOs promoting the BDS campaign against Israel, whether this fits subsidy criteria, and to list supported NGOs. The minister answered that the government does not finance BDS activities against Israel, that support for BDS is not a disqualifying criterion because of freedom of expression, and that it does not keep an overview of such organisations.
The cabinet ensures that it does not finance BDS activities against Israel.
Het kabinet stelt zeker dat het geen BDS-activiteiten tegen Israël financiert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Gave: ook christenen in Nederlandse azc’s bedreigd’

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Christians in asylum centres are threatened, including comparisons with Germany and reporting and information measures. The State Secretary declined to make quantitative comparisons with other countries, said each incident requires a firm approach, and pointed to earlier letter measures on reporting encouragement, safety across locations and information for asylum seekers.
I do not have information on the basis of which I can make such quantitative comparisons with Germany or another country.
Ik beschik niet over informatie op basis waarvan ik dergelijke kwantitatieve vergelijkingen kan maken met Duitsland of een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over Subsidie voor ontwikkelingsprojecten van Heineken in Afrika

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch subsidies to Heineken development partnerships in Africa, including additionality, job losses, tax avoidance, water use and alcohol promotion. The minister defended the partnerships, said additionality is assessed by market conditions rather than a mathematical test, and rejected repayment, committing to no concrete new action.
Additionality of the government contribution is a condition for a partnership with the business sector.
Additionaliteit van de overheidsbijdrage is een voorwaarde voor een partnerschap met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over Nederlandse subsidies aan de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and PVV asked whether Dutch subsidies to the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence should be reconsidered after reports it collected classified IDF information, and how the government ensures subsidies are lawfully spent. The minister replied that no charges have been filed, that the government is concerned about NGO space in Israel, and that the Human Rights Secretariat has strict selection and monitoring procedures with no finding of breach so far.
However, no such finding has been made in the case of the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence.
Van een dergelijke constatering is in het geval van de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence evenwel geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Knops over de aanslag op Eerste Paasdag in Lahore, Pakistan, waarbij 72 mensen om het leven zijn gekomen en in het bijzonder christenen doelwit waren

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Easter Day bombing in Lahore that killed 72 people, including whether Christians are targeted, whether Pakistani state protection for religious minorities is adequate, and how Pakistan's fight against Taliban-linked groups can be supported. The minister acknowledged the attack, described the claimed motives, said the Netherlands raises minority protection bilaterally and multilaterally, and pointed to planned NGO programmes and EU and GCTF cooperation on counterterrorism.
The Netherlands therefore intends to support NGO programmes in Pakistan from this autumn via the Addressing Root Causes fund.
Nederland is daarom voornemens om vanaf dit najaar via het Addressing Root Causes fonds ngo-programma's in Pakistan te steunen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Voordewind, Leijten en Van der Staaij over het supermarktkartel tegen leeftijdsverificatiesystemen voor de verkoop van alcohol en tabak

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling against the CBL's campaign and code on age verification for alcohol and tobacco sales, and whether the sector is living up to its duty to keep sales from minors. The State Secretary declined to comment on the ruling pending appeal, said the government expects the law to be followed, and will report to parliament on the tobacco display-ban convenant by 1 July 2016 if no agreement is reached.
Since this is a court ruling against which the parties will appeal, I cannot go into the content of this ruling or the conduct of any of the parties in this lawsuit.
Aangezien het een uitspraak van een rechtbank betreft waartegen partijen in hoger beroep zullen gaan, kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze uitspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Knops en Voordewind over het onderzoeksrapport over christenvervolging door Boko Haram in Nigeria

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on Christian persecution by Boko Haram and related violence in Nigeria, and how Dutch efforts compare and what concrete action is possible. The minister answered that the violence is serious but driven largely by economic and ethnic-religious conflicts, described existing Dutch and EU support for dialogue, deradicalisation and a regional task force, and acknowledged the particular vulnerability of Christian communities.
The Netherlands actively works worldwide for freedom of religion and belief for everyone.
Nederland zet zich wereldwijd actief in voor vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over een toename van het aantal comazuipers

An MP asks the state secretary about a reported rise in alcohol intoxications among minors, the government's response to NSCK figures, and measures on alcohol policy, a municipal pilot expanding outlets, and enforcement funding. The state secretary calls the trend worrying, points to ongoing ZonMw research and the DHW evaluation, and says enforcement funding is left to municipalities.
I will therefore certainly discuss this with municipalities in the context of the evaluation, in which this theme will be explicitly addressed.
Ik zal dan ook zeker met gemeenten in gesprek gaan in het kader van de evaluatie, waarin dit thema nadrukkelijk aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over dreigende hongersnood in Zuidelijk Afrika als gevolg van El Niño en het tekort aan klimaatfinanciering

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about the food crisis in Southern Africa caused by El Niño, the case for early action and climate finance. Minister Ploumen answered that the government has provided emergency aid through several channels, supports resilience programmes, and will press donors and promote climate finance, without addressing any oversight of the executive.
The cabinet closely follows the situation around El Niño and is aware of the effects of El Niño in Southern Africa.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie rond El Niño nauwlettend en is zich bewust van de effecten van El Niño in Zuidelijk Afrika
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht 'Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit'

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about reports of intimidation of Eritrean regime critics in the Netherlands, including threats at asylum locations and whether IND interpreters are linked to the regime. The government said it has no specific registration of such incidents, pointed to police and prosecution duties, outlined vetting and a code of conduct for IND interpreters with two interpreters dropped and an external audit, and referred back to earlier answers on regime levies.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not specifically record in their systems the link between offences and the Eritrean regime.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registeren niet specifiek in de systemen op de relatie van delicten met het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over financiering van veroordeelde terroristen door de Palestijnse Autoriteiten

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Palestinian Authority funds convicted terrorists with foreign aid should change Dutch donor policy and how the government implements earlier motions calling for pressure on the PLO to stop such payments. The minister replied that the Israeli deputy minister's claims are her own, that the World Bank made no such finding, and that the government keeps raising the PLO's payment policy bilaterally and in the EU, where only one member state shares the concern.
The cabinet continues to raise the PLO's policy in bilateral talks with the PA and the PLO.
Het kabinet blijft het beleid van de PLO aankaarten in bilaterale gesprekken met de PA en de PLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderarbeid bij de productie van batterijen voor smartphones in Congo

An ChristenUnie MP asked the minister about child labour in Congolese cobalt mines supplying smartphone batteries, and whether she would engage the electronics sector and how the Amnesty report and traceability schemes factor into convenant negotiations. The minister acknowledged the risks, expects companies to apply OECD due diligence, says she is in talks with the electronics sector on a responsible-sourcing covenant, and outlines the iTSCi and PACT traceability projects, which currently do not cover cobalt.
The cabinet expects companies to comply with these guidelines and incorporate them into their business operations.
Het kabinet verwacht dat bedrijven deze richtlijnen naleven en in hun bedrijfsvoering opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Van der Staaij over voorlichting aan asielzoekers in Nederland

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Van der Staaij asked whether information for asylum seekers in reception centres is limited to LHBT groups, whether incidents involving asylum seekers are registered, whether incidents are more frequent in emergency reception locations, and whether an independent confidential person should be appointed. The minister answered that COA is consulting on broader information covering Christians, atheists and other minorities, that incidents are not registered by asylum status or sexual orientation, that the data do not show more incidents in larger locations, and that the government sees no added value in a separate confidential person.
The sexual orientation of a resident is not registered in COA's systems.
De seksuele gerichtheid van een bewoner wordt in de systemen van het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het loslaten van de duurzame doelstelling door de koffiesector

MP Voordewind asks why the coffee sector has abandoned its 75% sustainable coffee target, whether independent certification will be safeguarded, and whether convenants need a legal framework. The minister replies that the sector should set new measurable targets with transparency, that certification alone is insufficient but independent verification remains necessary, and that no legal framework is currently needed for IMVO convenants.
The cabinet is certainly willing to continue talks with the coffee sector and to press it for ambitious targets.
Het kabinet is zeker bereid om met de koffiesector verder in gesprek te gaan en bij de koffiesector aan te dringen op ambitieuze doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Knops en De Roon over de ranglijst christenvervolging van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and PVV asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2016 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising killings, Dutch policy response, a proposed UN inquiry and ISIS treatment of minorities. The minister said the government shares serious concern, cites funding for religious freedom projects and EU/UN engagement, but opposes a UN inquiry focused on one group in favour of an inclusive approach.
The cabinet is however not in favour of a UN inquiry focused on one specific group.
Het kabinet is echter geen voorstander van een VN-onderzoek gericht op één specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven en Voordewind over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt, Verhoeven and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the provisional application of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, including which articles apply, whether unanimity and parliamentary consent were needed, and what happens if the Netherlands rejects it in the referendum. The minister answered that about 355 articles (roughly 70%) are provisionally applied under EU competence, that the Council decisions were adopted by unanimity with Dutch consent, and that the Netherlands will follow the referendum law without prejudging the outcome.
The cabinet does not have continuous insight into the timing and manner in which the national parliaments of the 27 member states are informed of the decision on provisional application.
Het kabinet heeft niet voortdurend zicht op het tijdstip en wijze van informeren van de nationale parlementen in 27 lidstaten over het besluit tot voorlopige toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over de Special Olympic World Games

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the Health Minister about the Dutch team's medal results at the Special Olympics in Los Angeles and whether the government would encourage athletes at the 2017 Winter Games in Austria. The minister expressed pride in the athletes and said she would try to attend and cheer them on in Austria, depending on her agenda.
I will work to give the athletes encouragement, just as during the preparation for the World Summer Games in Los Angeles.
Ik zal mij inzetten om net zoals tijdens de voorbereiding van de World Summer Games in Los Angeles de sporters een hart onder de riem te steken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over jongeren die gemakkelijk onbeperkt kunnen drinken op oudejaarsavond

An MP asked the state secretary whether all-you-can-drink New Year's Eve offers by bars endanger young people, whether municipalities should act, and whether the Drink and Hospitality Act should be tightened, including a Finnish-style ban on volume discounts. The state secretary acknowledged the risks, pointed to existing municipal enforcement powers and to the evaluation of the Act, but said there was no clear breach of the rules, promised only to raise the issue with entrepreneurs and monitor plans, and gave no figures on youth alcohol incidents.
Municipalities have a supervisory and enforcement task regarding the supply of alcohol to minors and to persons who are intoxicated.
Gemeenten hebben een toezichthoudende en handhavende taak waar het gaat om de verstrekking aan minderjarigen en mensen die in staat van dronkenschap verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de bedreiging van christenen op AZC’s

An MP asked the State Secretary whether reported threats against Christians in asylum centres are serious, why COA says no concrete reports exist, and whether an independent confidant, closer cooperation with advocacy groups, or a new study of safety and reporting willingness will be introduced. The State Secretary answered that threats are serious, that residents do report incidents to COA staff, that COA cooperates with stichting Gave, but declined an independent confidant and a new study.
No. COA has indicated that since the Deloitte report it has paid more attention to the problems of vulnerable groups.
Nee. Het COA heeft aangegeven sinds het rapport van Deloitte meer aandacht te hebben voor de problematiek van kwetsbare groepen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het besluit de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand voor bepaalde groepen asielzoekers af te schaffen

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked whether asylum seekers need a lawyer from the first decision stage, and questioned the planned removal of state-funded legal aid for an asylum group expected to be granted, plus the speed, documentation and security screening of that track. Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the procedure keeps sufficient safeguards, that legal aid is removed only where a grant is foreseeable, and that the rest of the questions are addressed through consultation and implementation, while refusing to postpone the measure.
Only asylum seekers who belong to the designated group and for whom a grant is foreseeable will no longer receive subsidised legal aid.
Enkel de asielzoekers die behoren tot de aangewezen doelgroep en waarvan voorzienbaar is dat de aanvraag zich leent voor inwilliging krijgen niet langer gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en De Roon over resoluties bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister why 19 or 20 of the UN General Assembly resolutions in the 70th session target Israel, how the Netherlands voted, whether the Golan resolution language is fair, and how the UN could better address states that violate international law. The minister replied that the Netherlands pushed for balance and proportionate wording, supported 15 of 19 resolutions in EU coordination, saw many actors responsible for the Golan conflict, and pointed to resolutions on other states and the UN Human Rights Council review.
The Netherlands works in several ways to ensure that countries violating international law are called to account by the UN General Assembly.
Nederland zet zich er op verschillende manieren voor in dat landen die het internationaal recht schenden daarop worden aangesproken door de AVVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Voordewind over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse en in Nederland actieve zaadbedrijven die in India actief zijn

MPs Van Laar and Voordewind asked the minister about child labour and underpayment of women in Dutch-linked vegetable seed companies operating in India, citing a 2015 NGO report and asking about industry follow-up, a convenant, complaint mechanisms and raising the issue bilaterally. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to Plantum's engagement with members, a planned IMVO risk analysis, a new child-labour fund, and openness to a sector convenant and bilateral raising of the issue, without committing to a specific sanction or binding measure.
I consider a sector convenant with the seed sector and directly involved parties a suitable means to deal properly with the issues the report draws attention to.
Een sectorconvenant met de zadensector en direct betrokkenen acht ik een geschikt middel om goed om te gaan met kwesties waar het rapport aandacht voor vraagt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het besluit van de Duitse Bondsdag om nieuwe richtsnoeren over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Jordaanoever, Oost-Jeruzalem en de

MPs Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the German Bundestag's reported rejection of EU labelling guidance for products from the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, and whether Griechenland and Hungary also refuse to implement it. The minister says the cabinet has no knowledge of a German decision, that the Netherlands stands by its signature on the earlier letter, and that member states are expected to implement the interpretive communication, with the implementation question left to the businesses and to the member states' own deliberation.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise its position, which is based on established policy.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om zijn standpunt, dat gebaseerd is op staand beleid, te herzien.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kinderarbeid bij goudwinning voor de elektronicasector

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the government about child labour in gold mining supplying the electronics sector, including responsibility of electronics firms, EU and OECD action, development programmes in Mali, and due diligence convenants. Minister Ploumen answered that the government will raise the issue with the Conflict Free Smelters Program, pursue a sector IMVO covenant for gold by summer 2016, seek EU Council conclusions during the Dutch presidency, and support child labour programmes in Mali.
In the process towards an IMVO covenant for the gold sector, the ministry is in close consultation with, among others, several companies from the electronics sector.
In het traject om te komen tot een IMVO-convenant voor de goudsector is het ministerie in nauw overleg met onder meer enkele bedrijven uit de elektronicasector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de gezondheidsscreening van asielzoekers

Christian Union MP Voordewind asked whether the April 2015 tuberculosis screening protocol for asylum seekers is being followed, given signals that screening is far from optimal, and how coverage and responsibility are monitored. The state secretary answered that screening of Syrians was temporarily suspended due to low TB prevalence, that over 900 people had not yet been screened in mid-October but the backlog is being cleared, and that GGD and COA share coordination, with COA records used for monitoring and changes to crisis emergency shelter procedures announced.
Following the high influx, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport decided to (temporarily) suspend the screening of asylum seekers from Syria.
Naar aanleiding van de hoge instroom heeft het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) besloten de screening van asielzoekers uit Syrië (tijdelijk) op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat meer dan 10.000 vluchtelingen vast komen te zitten in Servië en een tekort aan humanitaire hulp ontstaat in landen op de ‘Balkanroute’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that over 10,000 refugees were stranded in Serbia and that aid shortages were emerging along the Balkan route after border closures, and asked what the EU and the Netherlands were doing. The minister answered that the Netherlands is engaging EU partners, that EU emergency funding and 50,000 extra reception places in Greece and 50,000 along the route were agreed, and that hotspots are key to implementing the relocation agreements, without any institutional change to executive oversight.
In addition, the Netherlands has made 100 camp beds and 10 light towers available to Slovenia, following a Slovenian request for more materials to better organise the reception of the many refugees.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland 100 veldbedden en 10 lichttorens ter beschikking gesteld aan Slovenië, naar aanleiding van een oproep van Slovenië voor meer materialen om de opvang van de vele vluchtelingen beter te kunnen organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme, Klaver en Voordewind over het rapport van de onafhankelijke klachtencommissie van de Nederlandse financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden FMO m.b.t. de Barro Blanco dam i

MPs Thieme, Klaver and Voordewind asked the minister about the FMO complaints committee finding that indigenous rights were not fully assessed before approving the Barro Blanco dam loan in Panama, and about human rights impact assessments, parliamentary oversight of FMO, and the state's influence over FMO investment decisions. The minister acknowledged the incomplete information, promised to raise FMO's tightened approval process and transparency with FMO, supported a dialogue process with indigenous authorities, and rejected several proposals such as a public open session of FMO's supervisory board and a construction halt.
At the next consultation with FMO I will explicitly raise this issue.
In het eerstvolgende overleg met FMO zal ik dit nadrukkelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Klaveren over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit veroordeelde Hamas terroristen heeft betaald

MPs asked whether the Palestinian Authority pays convicted Hamas terrorists, the total amounts paid, and what the government will do to press the EU to stop the policy. The minister declined to confirm the reported amounts, referred to earlier answers, said Pegase payments do not fund prisoners, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally with the PA and PLO.
The cabinet cannot confirm the amounts mentioned in the news report.
Het kabinet kan de in het nieuwsbericht genoemde bedragen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over jonge ouder te weinig toegerust

An MP asked whether the government would revisit the 2010 family note and act on proposals to better prepare young parents, including a mandatory parenthood pledge. The state secretary replied that no new family note is needed, that municipalities now hold preventive and youth-care responsibilities under the Jeugdwet, and that parents cannot be obliged to use such services.
At this moment there is no reason to draft a new family note.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om een nieuwe gezinsnota op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de vernietiging van kerken op Atjeh door de Indonesische politie onder druk van moslims

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the destruction of churches in Aceh under pressure from Muslim groups and the wider threat to religious freedom in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the incidents, said the Indonesian authorities condemned the violence and arrested suspects, and committed to raising the issue with his Indonesian counterpart.
This subject will be raised in my next meeting with the Indonesian Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Dit onderwerp zal in mijn eerstvolgend onderhoud met de Indonesische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het oplaaiend geweld van Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the surge of Palestinian violence, President Abbas's role and silence on attacks, and Palestinian media incitement before Abbas's visit. The minister condemned attacks on Israelis, attributed the violence to lack of political perspective and largely youth-driven, social-media-organised attacks beyond Abbas's control, and said de-escalation and the issue would be raised during the visit.
During the visit, the current violence and the need for de-escalation will be discussed extensively, and it will naturally be urged that a call to renounce violence be made.
Bij het bezoek zal uitgebreid worden stilgestaan bij het huidige geweld, en de noodzaak tot de-escalatie, waarbij vanzelfsprekend ook zal worden aangedrongen op een oproep tot afzien van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek van de Rwandese president Kagame aan Nederland

An MP asked whether the working visit of Rwandan President Kagame to the Netherlands was appropriate given UN findings on Rwanda's support for abuses in Congo and the M23 rebels, whether human rights would be raised, and why the visit was not announced earlier and had no press moment. The minister replied that the visit was a working visit announced in the usual way, that Nederland is a critical-constructive partner, and that human rights and press freedom were raised in talks.
It concerned a working visit, which was announced in the usual way.
Het betrof een werkbezoek, dat op gebruikelijk wijze is aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over Dublin overdrachten naar Hongarije

MPs Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma and Voordewind asked about reports of poor reception conditions in Hungary, continued Dublin transfers there, and whether transfers should be suspended. The State Secretary answered that Dublin transfers to Hungary continue under the mutual trust principle, that the matter is before the Council of State, and that no concrete suspension is planned.
As answered to the questions from MPs Voortman, Kuiken and Maij, I maintain the principle of inter-state trust towards Hungary and see insufficient reason to suspend Dublin transfers.

Zoals geantwoord op de vragen van de leden Voortman, Kuiken en Maij houd ik vast aan het interstatelijke vertrouwensbeginsel ten opzichte van Hongarije en zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om Dublinoverdrachten op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bisschop en Potters inzake vernomen onjuistheden in Nederlandse schoolboeken over Israël

MPs Voordewind, Bisschop and Potters asked the education state secretary about alleged factual errors and antisemitic wording in Dutch textbooks on Israel and the Middle East, and about schools avoiding Holocaust and Middle East lessons. The state secretary declined to intervene in individual textbook content, but reported forwarding a correction request to ThiemeMeulenhoff and committed to supporting teachers through School en Veiligheid.
It is not for me to pronounce on the content of individual teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om een uitspraak te doen over de inhoud van individuele lesmethodes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Omtzigt over dood van een Nederlandse activist in Oost-Timor

MPs Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the article alleging state-sanctioned killing of Dutch activist Paulino Gama in East Timor, whether the government would press for an independent investigation and autopsy, and what consular support the family received. The minister confirmed the death, said the investigation is the responsibility of the East Timorese government, that the Netherlands has asked about an inquiry and is monitoring, and that consular contact with the family was maintained.
The investigation into Mr Gama's death is the responsibility of the East Timorese government.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de heer Gama is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Oost-Timorese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over scheiding van gezinnen vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs Gesthuizen, Voordewind and Voortman asked whether families separated by an Article 1F exclusion would have the exclusion re-examined, whether the government could guarantee the utmost care, and which countries still prosecute alleged war crimes. The State Secretary replied that Article 1F is assessed in the asylum procedure separately from family life under Article 8 ECHR, that the exclusion is examined with all safeguards, that the choice to leave lies with family members, and that prosecution abroad is a separate matter that the Public Prosecution Service monitors.
Can you guarantee the Chamber that, where a family's situation is so serious, the Article 1F exclusion will be examined with the utmost care to determine whether it can stand?

Vraag 2 Kunt u de Kamer garanderen dat, indien sprake is van een voor een gezin dusdanig ernstige situatie, met de groots mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wordt onderzocht of de 1F-tegenwerping stand moet houden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de mogelijkheid in een handomdraai aan een vals Syrisch paspoort te komen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the government about a press report that a forged official Syrian passport could be obtained easily, and whether Dutch services detect such documents and cooperate with intelligence services. The government answered that Syrian documents are checked extra thoroughly, that the damaged document cannot be examined for detection purposes, and that the IND cooperates with the AIVD and MIVD and with European partners.
The document described in the article was rendered unusable by the journalist.
Het document waar in het artikel over wordt geschreven is door de journalist onbruikbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht 'IS ontvoert zeker 230 Syriërs, onder wie tientallen christenen'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm reports that ISIS abducted around 230 Syrians, including Christians, and asked about the whereabouts of the hostages, ISIS motives, the status of an earlier abduction, and whether the UN envoy or the UN could be pressed for their release. The minister confirmed the abductions but said there was no further information on their location, gave a general motive (possibly ransom), reported that 22 Assyrians from the earlier abduction were released, said the envoy has no contact with ISIS, and described multilateral efforts to protect religious and ethnic minorities.
Own sources confirm the abduction but give no clear indication of the current whereabouts.
Eigen bronnen bevestigen de ontvoering, maar geven geen uitsluitsel over de huidige verblijfplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over de scheiding van een gezin vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 1F exclusion (Refugee Convention) against a father, which has split his family, could be re-examined, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute. The State Secretary confidentially provided the court and Council of State rulings, declined to comment on prosecution, and refused to reopen the 1F assessment because the Council of State had already confirmed it.
I cannot inform your House. The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about this individual case.
