Ik kan uw kamer niet informeren. Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededelingen over dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra’s (AZC’s)

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van der Staaij) asked the State Secretary about safety and intimidation of Christian asylum seekers in reception centres, including a claimed shared room and COA's implementation of Deloitte's 2011 recommendations. The State Secretary answered that COA found no hard evidence of intimidation in the individual case, that room use is regulated by COA, and that most recommendations were implemented while some (clustering groups) were not, with a follow-up plan for training and reporting.
After talks with those involved in this individual case, COA found no hard evidence of intimidation, discrimination or threats.
Het COA heeft na gesprekken met betrokkenen in dit individuele geval geen harde aanwijzingen gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over onnodige verhuizingen van asielkinderen

MPs Voordewind, Schouw and Voortman asked whether the planned conversion of the Almelo family location into an asylum centre, forcing about 120 residents including children to move, could be postponed, and how the government weighs the harm of repeated relocations to children. The State Secretary confirmed the conversion, said COA is consulting the municipality and residents and tries to limit the impact, but that high intake makes avoiding moves impossible.
COA is in discussion with both the municipality and the residents.
Het COA is in gesprek met zowel de gemeente als de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra's (AZC’s)

Two MPs (ChristenUnie and SGP) asked the State Secretary about the safety of Christian asylum seekers in asylum centres, following a report of intimidation by Muslim residents, and asked whether staff enforced house rules, how many religion-related incidents occurred, whether complaint reporting is effectively encouraged, and whether additional measures or research are needed. The State Secretary answered that the picture is not accurate as presented, that COA staff spoke with those involved and no sanction was imposed for lack of evidence, that complaint channels and staff training have been strengthened, and that further research is not considered necessary while COA maintains ongoing consultation with partner organisations.
COA did not impose a sanctioning measure because no indications of intimidation, discrimination or threats were found at the individual level.
Het COA heeft geen sanctionerende maatregel opgelegd omdat tot op het individuele niveau geen aanwijzingen zijn gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de impact van certificering op de arbeidsomstandigheden in de landbouwsector in ontwikkelingslanden

MP Voordewind asked the ministers whether they know the SOMO report on certification and labour conditions in developing-country agriculture, and whether they will engage supermarkets, ISEAL and the Sustainability Consortium on stronger certification, due diligence and convenants. The minister answers that the report is noted, that the Alliance and supermarkets are working on sustainability agendas, and that certification is one tool among others, with no binding government commitment beyond ongoing dialogue and subsidy.
The initiative for the agreements lies with the sectors themselves.
Het initiatief voor de convenanten ligt bij de sectoren zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van pensioenen van personen op de West bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the government will cut AOW pensions to the single-rate (50% minimum wage) for new recipients living in Israeli-occupied West Bank territory from 1 January 2016, whether Israel can lawfully bind itself to treaty obligations there, and how this squares with the 1967 borders and the Oslo framework. The government answered that Israel as occupying power cannot conclude treaties applying to the occupied territory, that existing recipients keep the 70% rate, and that the Netherlands does not recognise the territories as Israeli.

This decision will be announced and communicated as soon as possible, so that it should be clear enough what the consequences of living in Israeli-occupied territory are for the AOW benefit of single AOW recipients.

Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd, waardoor het voldoende helder moet zijn welke gevolgen wonen in door Israël bezet gebied heeft voor de AOW-uitkering van alleenstaande AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether the government would adopt preventive, family-centred approaches to domestic violence in Caribbean Netherlands instead of a mainly justice-based response, and whether they would fund and roll out a pilot run by the Bonaire youth and family centre. The government answered that an integrated approach covering prevention, care and justice is needed, pointed to existing measures and funding, and said it would support a Bonaire Eigen Kracht pilot and share results if successful, without committing to a rollout.
If the conference proves successful, the results will be shared with the other islands.
Mocht de conferentie een succes blijken te zijn, dan zullen de resultaten gedeeld worden met de andere eilanden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat godsdienstige minderheden in India steeds meer in de knel komen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked whether attacks on religious minorities in India are rising, particularly against Christians, and what Indian authorities and the Dutch government are doing about it. The minister answered that USCIRF reports rising religious violence while official Indian figures show a drop in communal incidents, that Indian leaders have condemned such violence and arrests were made, and that the Netherlands raises religious freedom through EU and UN channels and funds local dialogue projects.
Freedom of religion and belief is a priority of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is een prioriteit van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de beoordeling door de IND van de geloofwaardigheid van Koptische asielzoekers

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked whether IND officials wrongly disbelieve Coptic asylum seekers from Egypte, whether staff have sufficient expertise and knowledge of Coptic conditions, the grant rate for Christian asylum seekers, and how abolishing the POK test affects credibility assessments. The Secretary of State replied that credibility is assessed case by case using the official country report, that staff receive training, that IND does not systematically record religion so grant rates cannot be given, and that dropping the POK test is a motivation change rather than a policy change.
The IND assesses the asylum application within the context of everything known from public, reliable sources about the country of origin.
De IND beoordeelt de asielaanvraag binnen de context van al hetgeen uit openbare, betrouwbare bronnen bekend is over het land van herkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de positie van christenen in Syrië

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the kidnapping of a Syrian-Christian cleric near Homs, the decline of Christian populations in Syria and Iraq under ISIS, Dutch contacts with the anti-ISIS coalition on Christian protection, and whether the international community will act. The minister confirmed the kidnapping, gave rough population estimates, said the Netherlands raises the issue through all channels and within the coalition, and described pluralism-oriented political work without committing to a new concrete step.
Precise figures for the current number of Christians in Syria and Iraq are not available.
Precieze cijfers van het huidige aantal christenen in Syrië en Irak zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over mogelijke wapenleveranties aan Boko Haram via Turkish Airlines

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to assess alleged arms transports to Nigeria via Turkish Airlines, a leaked call, and UNODC findings on arms trafficking, and whether the government would verify the call or seek independent investigation. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the recording, will not speculate on unconfirmed reports, declined to raise it with Turkey, and will only generally urge research into how Boko Haram obtains weapons.
There is too little confirmed information to justify a Dutch diplomatic intervention, in a matter that primarily concerns the relationship between Turkey and Nigeria.
Er is te weinig bevestigde informatie om een Nederlandse diplomatieke interventie te rechtvaardigen, in een zaak die primair de relatie tussen Turkije en Nigeria betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het bericht dat alleen Israël door de World Health Organization is veroordeeld voor het schenden van gezondheidsrechten

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind) asked why the WHO assembly adopted a resolution singling out Israel's health conditions in occupied territories and whether the Netherlands backed it. The minister answered that the decision was a compromise, all EU states voted for it, the US, Canada and Australia opposed it, and that the Netherlands favours non-politicised WHO texts and supports phasing out country-specific resolutions.
Where possible, the Netherlands therefore works within the EU framework for balanced, non-politicised texts and advocates within the EU for phasing out these resolutions and decisions.
Nederland zet zich waar mogelijk in EU-kader dan ook in voor gebalanceerde, niet-politiserende teksten en pleit in EU-kader voor uitfasering van deze resoluties en besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bisschop inzake trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs

MPs Voordewind and Bisschop asked about slow internet connections in schools, whether all schools can meet digital learning targets, and how to fund fast connections in rural areas. The State Secretary answered that most schools have adequate bandwidth via cable, that an 8 Mbps connection is too slow, and that a joint approach with school associations and the Ministry of Economic Affairs is being explored.
I want to examine together with the PO-Raad, the VO-raad and the Ministry of Economic Affairs whether a joint approach can be created that provides all schools with fast internet
Ik wil samen met de PO-Raad, de VO-raad en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken bekijken of er een gezamenlijke aanpak te creëren is die alle scholen van snel internet kan voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over een verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary why he is awaiting a ruling on vrijheidsbeperkende locaties (VBL) rather than the pending cases on municipal bed-bad-brood shelters, and whether the expected Council of State ruling was about VBL adequacy. The State Secretary answered that he is not waiting for a ruling, that the existing system complies with treaty obligations, that the Council of State cases were withdrawn on 11 May 2015 so no ruling will follow in them, and that other related cases are pending.
First of all, I consider it important to note that I am not waiting for a court ruling.
Allereerst acht ik van belang op te merken dat ik niet wacht op een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over slavernij en kinderarbeid in steengroeves

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked about child labour and slavery in South Indian granite quarries, due diligence by Dutch firms, the government's own procurement of granite, and whether municipalities and other public bodies are engaged. Minister Ploumen answers that she will engage sector federations on IMVO agreements, raise the issue during her India visit, pilot and implement evaluation recommendations on international social procurement conditions, and that PIANOo has worked with local authorities on procurement tools.
I am in discussion with the relevant trade organisations about the support the government can offer the sectors to reach IMVO agreements.
Ik ben in gesprek met de desbetreffende brancheorganisaties over de ondersteuning die de overheid kan bieden aan de sectoren om te komen tot IMVO afspraken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van het pensioen van een holocaustoverlevende, omdat zij woont op de West Bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor's AOW pension was cut after she moved to the West Bank, and whether it would be reversed and prevented in future. The government answered that the cut was based on the Wet BEU and Israel's lack of treaty competence in occupied territory, that the SVB has reversed the decision, and that people living in occupied areas will keep 70% AOW from now on, while from 1 January 2016 new single residents there will get the 50% rate.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded. For the person concerned, the situation has now been corrected and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken. Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het lot van Pakistaanse vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about arbitrary detention of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including children, and Thailand's treatment of them under the Child Rights Convention. Minister Koenders answered that Thailand treats all refugees alike under immigration law, that the Netherlands raises rights violations with Thai authorities and accepted 38 Pakistani refugees for resettlement, and that UNHCR is aware of long waiting times.
The Netherlands, including within the EU, regularly raises the deteriorating human rights situation in contacts with the Thai authorities.
NL brengt, o.a. in EU-verband, de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie met regelmaat op in contacten met Thaise autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over labeling van producten uit Israëlische steden op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether 16 EU member states want products from Israeli settlements on the West Bank labelled, what their request to Mogherini means, why the Netherlands supported it, and whether labelling harms trade and the peace process. The minister answered that the request concerns correct labelling of settlement products as consumer information rather than a boycott or import ban, that the Netherlands opposes boycotts, and that the Netherlands continues to promote a two-state solution through negotiations.
The Netherlands' co-signing of this reminder letter fits existing cabinet policy.
Mede-ondertekening door Nederland van deze herhalingsbrief past in het staande kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de uitgifte van Turkse paspoorten aan jihadgangers. Deze vragen werden ingezonden op 15 april 2015

MPs asked whether reports that over 100,000 Turkish passports were given to ISIS fighters, and that around 50,000 Uyghurs joined ISIS through a loophole in Turkish law, are true, and what Turkey does with detained jihadists and to prevent departures. The minister said the government has no independent information to verify the claims, that Dutch jihadists are removed from Turkey after procedures with Dutch authorities informed, and that Turkey cooperates with origin countries and in the anti-ISIS coalition working group.
The cabinet does not have independent information to verify the claims in this article.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de beweringen in dit artikel te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Laar over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in de kledingindustrie in India

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Van Laar asked the government about modern slavery and child labour in the South Indian textile industry, including reported deaths and abuse of girls under the Sumangali scheme, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that the embassy and industry are engaged in multi-stakeholder initiatives, the MVO conference will explore EU-level supply chain measures, and the ILO and OECD frameworks are used to press India on forced and child labour standards.
Once the initiative takes firm shape, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will consider how this initiative can be supported.
Zodra het initiatief vaste vormen aanneemt, zal het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bezien op welke manier dit initiatief ondersteund kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'Rotterdam fnuikt thuisonderwijs'.

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether Rotterdam's approach to home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet complies with the law, whether parents are properly informed, and whether pressure on parents is being exerted. The State Secretary answered that Rotterdam acts within the law, that exemptions are ultimately decided by courts, that parents can complain to the municipal ombudsman, and that he intends to remove the exemption ground from the law but no amendment takes effect for 2015–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de slechte positie van cacaoboeren in de productieketen

MP Voordewind asked the minister about the weak position of cocoa farmers in the supply chain, who live far below the poverty line, and whether certification and the sustainability initiatives IDH and Solidaridad address this, including a living-income requirement, market concentration research and dialogue with companies. The minister replied that certification, productivity gains, land access and financing help raise farmer incomes, that IDH subsidy terms now target living incomes, and that dialogue continues within existing consultations, but no new binding measures were committed.
I am in discussion with sustainability initiatives and companies about the challenges in the cocoa sector.
Ik ben in gesprek met verduurzamingsinitiatieven en bedrijven over de uitdagingen in de cacaosector.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de gedwongen terugkeer van een uitgeprocedeerde Afghaanse vreemdeling naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the State Secretary about the forced return of a rejected Afghan asylum seeker, including whether force was used on the flight, whether injuries occurred, and why the embassy did not verify reports of hospital treatment. The State Secretary answered that force use is documented by the Marechaussee but declined to specify the measures, stated no monitoring occurs after return, and refused to release the individual case documents.
I consider restraint important when it comes to providing information about individual cases.
Ik acht terughoudendheid van belang als het gaat om het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes en Sjoerdsma over De ontvoering van tenminste 150 Syrische christenen

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction of at least 150 Syrian Christians by ISIS, about Dutch military and material support to Kurdish forces in Iraq, how minority protection is built into the anti-ISIS strategy, and how the international community could secure the hostages' release. The minister answered that Dutch support (helmets, vests, instructor teams, humanitarian aid) is aimed at training Peshmerga who protect all civilians, that inclusiveness and minority protection are addressed in training and EU policy, and that no ground options exist for freeing the hostages, while about twenty had been released.
Yes. Question 2: What material and military support has the Netherlands by now given to the Kurds in Iraq?
Ja. Vraag 2 Welke materiële en militaire steun heeft Nederland inmiddels gegeven aan de Koerden in Irak?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de sluiting van een theologische hogeschool in Jakarta

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of a theological college in Jakarta, whether the embassy had mediated, and what the implications are for religious freedom in Indonesia and bilateral relations. The minister answered that the dispute appears non-religious, concerning a missing permit and a municipal relocation order, that the Netherlands raises religious minority issues regularly with Indonesia, and that there are no consequences for bilateral relations.
Based on the above information, this case appears to be a non-religiously motivated dispute between the school and the local authorities.
Op basis van bovengenoemde informatie lijkt in dit geval sprake te zijn van een niet-religieus gemotiveerd geschil tussen de school en de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het artikel ‘Asielopvang tikkende tijdbom’

Voordewind asks whether tensions and threats against Christian asylum seekers at reception centres are rising, what measures and monitoring exist, and whether a new study or more reporting support is needed. Teeven replies that tensions stem from diverse residents rather than religion or ethnicity, describes COA house rules and police involvement, says the 2010 Gave recommendations were followed and no new study is needed, and reports 72 registered violent incidents in 2014.
The COA registered a total of 72 violent incidents in 2014.
Het COA heeft in 2014 in totaal 72 geweldsincidenten geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over suïcidepogingen in de gesloten gezinslocaties in Zeist

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary about reported suicide attempts at the Zeist closed family facility, how families and children are supported, separated transports of families, and whether causes were investigated. The State Secretary answered that no suicide attempts occurred per the incident protocol, only observations, a light self-injury and a food/fluid refusal, that families are kept together, and that medical and psychological care is available, without announcing an investigation or ending separated transports.
According to the incident protocol, this does not concern suicide attempts.
Het betreft volgens het incidentenprotocol geen suïcidepogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat er veel minder asielzoekers binnen zijn gekomen dan werd verwacht

An MP asks why the asylum inflow forecast for 2014 was set at 65,000 when the actual figure was about 25,000, and whether the 2015 budget and any surplus accounted for that forecast. The minister says the 65,000 figure was a scenario rather than a forecast, that the 2014 budget used 30,000, that realised inflow was 30,020, and that a 375 million euro reserve for reception costs was added and will be reviewed.
That was therefore not an annual forecast.
Daarmee was geen sprake van een jaarprognose.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over rapportages waaruit blijkt dat de EU honderden woningen laat verrijzen voor Palestijnen in de zogenaamde C-gebieden op de West Bank

Two MPs asked whether EU-funded housing structures for Palestinians in Area C of the West Bank are lawful and whether the EU is creating facts on the ground, and whether it will stop cooperating. The minister said the EU supports humanitarian needs of Palestinian and Bedouin communities facing demolitions, that no new facts are created since the people already lived there, and rejected calling on the EU to stop.
Do you see reason to raise these alleged illegal structures in European context and to promote that the EU immediately stops its cooperation in creating facts on the ground, if proven?

Ziet u aanleiding om genoemde illegale bouwwerken in Europees verband aan te kaarten en te bevorderen dat de EU onmiddellijk haar medewerking, indien bewezen, aan het creëren van feiten op de grond stopt?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2015

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Open Doors 2015 ranking of Christian persecution, whether religious freedom should get more weight in foreign policy, whether a thematic country report on Nigeria, Kenya and China would be prepared, and whether more countries would be added to the religious freedom pilot. The minister answered that religious freedom is a priority and that the pilot countries, with an evaluation to follow in the 2014 human rights report, may be adjusted depending on the outcome, while declining a thematic report for Kenya and China, citing low asylum inflow.
Depending on the outcome of the evaluation, it will be examined whether countries are added to or removed from the pilot.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst van de evaluatie zal bekeken worden of landen aan de pilot worden toegevoegd of verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over ID-scanners

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Health about ID-scanners for age checks in alcohol and tobacco sales, including the independence of the Bureau Nuchter mystery-shop research, the Trimbos findings on their effectiveness, and the State Lottery co-funding of scanners. The State Secretary answered that scanners are only a supporting tool within a broader approach, that the ministry will commission the national mystery-shop study from Bureau Nuchter with a scientific committee checking its objectivity, and that the state is not formally a shareholder of the State Lottery.

In response to the questions about conflicts of interest, Bureau Nuchter itself proposed setting up a scientific committee to test the objectivity of this research, and I have responded positively to this.

Naar aanleiding van de gestelde vragen over belangenverstrengeling heeft Bureau Nuchter zelf voorgesteld om een wetenschappelijke commissie in te stellen die de objectiviteit van dit onderzoek zal toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik- Faber over het bericht dat therapie de kans op zelfdoding verkleint

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health about a Danish study showing outpatient talking therapy after suicide attempts reduces repetition, and whether the Netherlands should study this model. The minister said Dutch practice already offers similar therapy under existing guidelines and the national suicide prevention agenda, and sent the Lancet article.
I hereby send you the relevant article from The Lancet of 24 November 2014 explaining the findings of this study.
Ik doe u hierbij het betrokken artikel uit the Lancet van 24 november 2014 toekomen waarin de uitkomsten van deze studie toegelicht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Hamas mogelijk van de Europese terreurlijst verdwijnt

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas might be removed from the EU terrorist list after a General Court ruling, and whether the designation was based on media reports. The minister answered that the court annulled the listing on procedural grounds but kept its effects for three months, so Hamas remains listed for now, that the Council may appeal or re-list, and that the government will work with other member states to address the defects.
The General Court decided to annul the listing on procedural grounds.
Het Gerecht heeft besloten de plaatsing op de lijst nietig te verklaren, wegens procedurele gebreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontbreken van een bed-bad-brood voorziening voor uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen in Nederland

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about UN rapporteurs' criticism that the Netherlands lacks a bed-bath-bread facility for rejected asylum seekers, and whether this causes health harm and international reputational damage. The State Secretary answered that no international obligation requires such a facility, pointed to Article 3 ECHR as a minimum, said shelter is available to those cooperating with return and medical care is always available, and referred to his letter of 18 December for the rest, declining to answer in time.
International legal obligations do not require the Netherlands to provide a bed-bath-bread facility for rejected asylum seekers.
Uit volkenrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt niet dat Nederland verplicht is een bed-bad-brood voorziening te treffen voor uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat scholieren in Amsterdam zijn mishandeld, afgeperst en met de dood bedreigd

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about reports that pupils in Amsterdam were extorted, assaulted and threatened, and whether this is widespread in schools. The government answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate monitors the situation and has found limited signals at three schools, and that it will keep watching and support schools via the School and Safety centre.
The inspectorate remains alert to the situation and will explicitly hold schools to account for adequately safeguarding pupils' safety where necessary.
De inspectie blijft alert op de situatie en spreekt scholen zo nodig nadrukkelijk aan op adequate borging van de veiligheid van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de vernieling van diverse kerken in Khartoum door het regime in Sudan

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about the demolition of churches in Khartoum, arrests of church members, a claimed ban on new church construction, and whether the government would protest and seek further sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the seizures as stemming from a land dispute and missing permits, said the ban was announced in 2012 and is unclear in writing, and stated the Netherlands raises religious freedom bilaterally and in EU and UN fora but sees no current plans for new sanctions.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of Dutch human rights policy; the cabinet therefore rejects any obstacle a government places on people in practising their faith.

Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de speerpunten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid, elke belemmering die een overheid aan mensen oplegt in de uitvoering van hun geloof keurt het kabinet daarom af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderen in Friesland die vanwege de stelselwijziging niet tijdig adequate zorg krijgen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether children in Friesland who apply before the 2015 youth care reform will face waiting lists and delayed care, and how transfer to municipalities will be arranged. The State Secretary answered that children with an existing indication keep their entitlement under transitional law and are not automatically waitlisted, that a warm handover agreement is being arranged with VNG, CIZ and insurers, and that Friesland aims to have no children on the waiting list by 31 December 2014.
It is certainly not the case that these children automatically end up on a waiting list.
Het is zeker niet zo dat deze kinderen automatisch op een wachtlijst komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Scholen spelen privégegevens leerlingen door naar uitgevers”

MPs Rog, Voordewind and Van Dijk asked whether schools pass non-anonymised pupil data to publishers without parental consent, and why a 2014 privacy audit was not sent to parliament. The state secretary answered that consent is not required under the school's task-based legal ground, that pseudonymisation is being developed, and that the audit was withheld as a limited, policy-confirming exploration later published online.
The report was therefore not sent to your House.
Het rapport is daarom niet aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het besluitmoratorium voor vluchtelingen uit Irak

MPs Voordewind and Kuiken asked whether the decision moratorium for Iraqi asylum applications leaves vulnerable minorities waiting up to 18 months, how family reunification is affected, how long the moratorium lasts, and what the IND can still decide individually. State Secretary Teeven answered that the moratorium only allows the IND to postpone decisions, that individual cases with clear risk can still be granted, that minority groups are assessed on their merits, and that the moratorium lasts six months with a possible single six-month extension.
The decision moratorium has been set for a period of six months. After this period I will consider whether there is reason to extend the moratorium once by six months.
Het besluitmoratorium is ingesteld voor de duur van zes maanden. Na afloop van deze termijn zal ik bezien of er aanleiding is het moratorium eenmalig met zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van Ojik over Textiel/Bangladesh, Compensatie Rana Plaza slachtoffers

MPs asked the minister what results followed their call for companies to compensate Rana Plaza victims, how to fill the half-empty fund, whether Dutch firms must sign the Bangladesh safety accord, and about supply-chain transparency and safety nets for workers. The minister reported an extra 2 million USD raising the fund to 19.4 million of the needed 40 million, said companies bear responsibility, and noted voluntary contributions and ongoing IMVO covenant talks.
I will continue to raise this issue with my colleagues and the government of Bangladesh.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp bij mijn collega’s en de overheid in Bangladesh agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in India

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about the Flawed Fabrics report on modern slavery and child labour in Indian textile supply chains, and whether mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence should be introduced. The minister answered that voluntary sector approaches are still early, that she is open to exploring EU-level mandatory due diligence, and that she raised the issue during her India visit and with the ILO, EU and OECD.

I am in favour of creating a more level playing field in terms of regulation. In that context I am willing to explore whether there are possibilities at European level to achieve mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence.

Ik ben wel voorstander van het creëren van een meer gelijk speelveld op het gebied van regelgeving. In dat kader ben ik bereid te verkennen of er in Europees verband mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot verplichte keten transparantie en due diligence.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over uitzettingen naar landen waar ebola heerst

Three MPs asked the State Secretary whether Belgium's suspension of forced returns to Ebola-affected countries (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was justified given the travel advice, and whether returns endanger migrants' health care access. The State Secretary answered that forced returns are temporarily suspended for staff safety, that individual risk assessments under Article 3 ECHR continue, and that returns of migrants needing medical care will be handled cautiously and case by case.

However worrying the situation in the affected countries is, I am of the view that at this moment not all foreigners who must return to the affected countries are automatically at risk of violating Article 3 ECHR.

Hoe zorgwekkend de situatie in de getroffen landen ook is, ben ik van oordeel dat op dit moment niet bij voorbaat alle vreemdelingen die naar de getroffen landen moeten terugkeren, risico op schending van artikel 3 EVRM lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de beperking van de persvrijheid door justitie

An MP asks why press access to detention facilities such as Schiphol is refused while other detention footage exists, and whether press freedom justifies access for photographer Robert Glas. The Secretary of State replies that access is granted when conditions are met, that press freedom is not unconditional access, and that DJI invited Glas to amend his request.
The principle of press freedom does not, however, yet carry an unconditional right of access to every place.
Het beginsel van persvrijheid brengt evenwel nog geen ongeclausuleerd recht op toegang tot elke plaats met zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ypma over de implementatie van het familiegroepsplan door gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Ypma asked whether the VNG adequately informed municipalities about the legal obligation, from 1 January 2015, to enable use of the family group plan (familiegroepsplan) under the Jeugdwet, and whether municipalities have incorporated it into policy and budgets. The state secretary rejects that the VNG failed seriously, notes municipal policy gives little attention to the plan, and reports a VNG model regulation revision and a factsheet to raise awareness.
As promised in the general debate with your House of 24 September 2014, I have since held consultations with the VNG to examine how awareness of the family group plan can be increased.
Zoals toegezegd in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 24 september 2014 heb ik inmiddels met de VNG overleg gevoerd om te bezien hoe de bekendheid van het familiegroepsplan kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘Hulpdiensten mochten niet in vluchtgebouw’ en ‘Van der Laan wil opvang voor vluchtelingen’

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about reports that ambulance staff were not allowed into an Amsterdam asylum shelter due to asbestos, causing delay in treating an injured asylum seeker, and about the mayor's call for a national bed-bath-bread scheme. The minister answered that protocol requires a safety clearance before entering asbestos-risk buildings, that the delay was 5-7 minutes for the patient and 10-15 minutes wait in the garage case, and referred the bed-bath-bread question to a separate answer.
The ambulance team was told when dispatched that rescue workers could not simply enter the building because of the presence of asbestos.
Het ambulanceteam kreeg bij de ritopdracht de vermelding mee dat hulpverleners het gebouw niet zomaar mochten betreden vanwege de aanwezigheid van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over afspraken tussen supermarkten over het weren van effectieve controlesystemen handhaving alcoholleeftijd

MPs asked the state secretary whether supermarkets agreed to exclude effective age-verification systems for alcohol sales, whether this is unacceptable, what the government knew and what it has done about alcohol-age enforcement compliance (around 50%). The state secretary answered that it is up to supermarkets to choose their approach, that the ACM has not closed its investigation into possible prohibited agreements, that the government is monitoring compliance and is reluctant to impose systems, and that a pilot did not improve compliance.
The ministry is not aware of unlawful agreements between supermarkets.
Het ministerie is niet bekend met ongeoorloofde afspraken tussen supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over de zelfmoord van een 17-jarige Afghaanse jongen op de campus voor alleenstaande minderjarigen in Oude Pekela

MPs asked the State Secretary about the suicide of a 17-year-old Afghan boy at the Oude Pekela campus for unaccompanied minors, including his psychological care, his residence permit, the delay in finding him, communication with relatives, and prevention measures. The State Secretary declined to address individual aspects of the case, said suicide is not always preventable, and reported that the Inspectorate for Youth Care received notification and decided not to start a further investigation.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht Christenen in Irak vluchten voor ISIS

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether ISIS targets Christians in Mosul and whether the Netherlands would follow France in admitting them as refugees, possibly via the UNHCR quota. Minister Teeven confirmed the persecution, said the Netherlands does not operate asylum-on-the-post policy, deferred any Iraq-specific asylum decision until a new country report, and said the resettlement quota for 2015 will follow UNHCR priorities while humanitarian aid is increased.
In the short term the Minister of Foreign Affairs will issue a general country report on Iraq.
Op korte termijn wordt door de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een algemeen ambtsbericht Irak uitgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Discussie illegalen op scherp’

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether he would immediately ensure that rejected asylum seekers have access to bed, bath and bread after two such people died or were seriously injured in Amsterdam. The state secretary expressed regret but rejected any link to national policy, arguing that the reception system covers vulnerable groups and that those who fulfil their departure obligation need not be without shelter.
Providing shelter to people without prospect or conditions, without requiring work towards departure, would not only undermine the credibility and sustainability of the Dutch migration system.

Het zonder perspectief of voorwaarden bieden van onderdak aan personen zonder te verlangen dat wordt gewerkt aan vertrek, zou niet enkel afbreuk doen aan de geloofwaardigheid en houdbaarheid van het Nederlandse migratiestelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over onveilige kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh en het gebrek aan openheid van kledingbedrijven

MP Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the continued unsafe state of Bangladeshi garment factories, whether Dutch firms such as Mexx and Hunkemöller have signed the Safety Accord, the refusal of most Dutch signatories of the Bangladesh Accord to disclose suppliers, and whether transparency should be enforced. The answers are a referral to the letter 'Reactie op het bericht dat textielfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn' (Kamerstuk 33 625, nr. 121) without substantive answers in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over zware aanklacht tegen Iraanse voorganger

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and possible death-penalty charge against Iranian pastor Matthias Haghnejad, and about the persecution of Iranian Christians and EU action on religious freedom. The minister replied that the facts of the charge are not yet known, that the government shares concern and monitors the case, and that Nederland and the EU raise religious freedom with Iran bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, while acknowledging that individual cases are better addressed at EU level.
Nothing has been made public about the background of the charge.
Over de achtergrond van de aanklacht is niets bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de anti-Israëldemonstratie die zaterdag 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag is gehouden

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked the Justice Minister whether he regretted Nazi and ISIS symbols shown at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, how they would be countered, and whether mayors should get more powers. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service now treats displaying IS and Hamas flags as punishable, noted that free expression and demonstration can be restricted under ECHR and criminal law, and said existing mayoral powers appear sufficient.
At present there is no reason to assume that those powers fall short.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat die bevoegdheden tekortschieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de uitspraken van de Turkse premier Erdogan inzake het handelen van Israël in Gaza

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon) asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemned Turkish PM Erdogan's comparisons of Israel's conduct in Gaza to Hitler, whether he would summon the Turkish ambassador, seek EU support against Turkey, suspend EU accession talks, or reconsider the Patriot mission. The minister answered that the remarks were regrettable, that summoning the ambassador was unnecessary, that accession talks remain the best lever, and that the Patriot mission fulfils NATO solidarity.
The cabinet does not consider it necessary to summon the Turkish ambassador specifically for this.
Het kabinet vindt het niet nodig specifiek hiervoor de Turkse ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Omtzigt, Van Haersma Buma, Voordewind, Slob en Van der Staaij over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak

Members of parliament from the CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the government about the humanitarian emergency facing Yazidis and Christians fleeing IS in Iraq, US airstrikes and genocide claims, and whether Dutch and EU action is adequate. The minister answered that the government supports US aid to Iraq, has given an extra 400,000 euro via the Red Cross, is examining airlift support through defence, and is pressing for a unity government in Baghdad.

In response to the current humanitarian crisis, the cabinet has decided to immediately provide an extra 400,000 euro via the Netherlands Red Cross to the International Red Cross for emergency aid in Iraq.

Naar aanleiding van de huidige humanitaire crisis heeft het kabinet besloten onverwijld een extra bijdrage van 400 000 Euro via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis te geven aan het Internationale Rode Kruis ten behoeve van noodhulp in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht “Grensdetentie is niet langer houdbaar”

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report calling border detention of asylum seekers, including children, incompatible with human rights norms and EU law. The State Secretary answered that detention and refusal of entry are applied under EU and national rules with individual assessment, that about 77% of asylum seekers detained at the border in 2013 eventually gained access, and that new policy for families with minor children and an IND work instruction would be introduced.
Furthermore, refusing entry and imposing border detention must take place with care.
Voorts geldt dat het weigeren van toegang en het opleggen van grensdetentie zorgvuldig moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over de dramatisch zorgelijke situatie van christenen in Mosul

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about threats by ISIS against Christians in Mosul, how such groups can be protected, and whether a safe haven could be created and the issue raised at the UN General Assembly. The minister answered that minorities' rights are a priority, cited UN Security Council and UNAMI calls for accountability, ISIS UN sanctions, EU aid, and said a political solution in Iraq is needed, without committing to a specific new step.
Both the protection of minority rights and freedom of religion or belief are priority subjects of Dutch foreign policy.
Zowel bescherming van de rechten van minderheden als vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging zijn prioritaire onderwerpen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over het uiten van extreme geweldsdreigementen en het plegen van daadwerkelijk terroristisch geweld tegen (de Joodse inwoners van) Israël door te

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked whether Fatah officials and affiliated groups calling for violence and firing rockets at Israel should be treated as terrorism, whether the Palestinian Authority is responsible, and whether EU and Dutch funding and cooperation should be halted. Minister Timmermans answered that these are not formal Fatah statements, that Fatah is a political movement that renounced violence, and that suspending cooperation is not on the table, while pledging to raise the issue at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
No. Fatah is a political movement that has renounced violence.
Nee. Fatah is een politieke beweging die geweld heeft afgezworen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen en Van Laar over kinderarbeid en schending van andere arbeidsrechten

MPs Voordewind, Gesthuizen and Van Laar asked the minister about a Fair Labor Association study on child labour and long hours in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and what the government, ILO, Turkish authorities and Dutch retailers and firms would do about it. The minister acknowledged the findings, said Turkey is primarily responsible, pointed to Dutch support for an ILO project and a 90,000 euro contribution, and said she raised the issue with Turkish officials and FNLI, which committed to a meeting with industry.
I have committed a contribution of 90,000 euros to the above-mentioned follow-up project of the ILO.
Ik heb hier een bijdrage van 90.000 euro toegezegd aan het hierboven genoemde vervolgproject van de ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de Global Partnership for Education Replenishment Meeting

MPs Smaling, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the Netherlands was absent from the Global Partnership for Education replenishment meeting, whether it supports investment in education and urges other donors including the EU to contribute, and whether it will push for the Lucens Guidelines protecting schools from military use. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not represented because its basic education support is being phased out, that it has urged other donors to keep funding education, and that it could not raise the Lucens Guidelines at the meeting.
Given the phase-out of basic education policy and therefore also the phase-out of Dutch support to the GPE, the Netherlands is not represented at this meeting.
Gegeven de afbouw van het beleid voor basisonderwijs en hiermee ook de afbouw van de Nederlandse steun aan het GPE is Nederland niet vertegenwoordigd op deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat gemeenten in de biblebelt fors minder geld per jongere krijgen dan andere gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Bible Belt municipalities receive much less youth care funding per young person, and whether the allocation model's use of historical spending is fair, citing the low figure for Bunschoten. The state secretaries answered that the 2015 budget follows historical youth care use, that many municipalities outside the Bible Belt also receive less, and that municipalities must bear high-cost risks themselves.
All municipalities now receive budget for what they use, and therefore the amount of money they need in 2015.
Alle gemeenten krijgen nu budget voor wat ze gebruiken, en dus de hoeveelheid geld die ze in 2015 nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de leeftijdscontrole op alcohol in supermarkten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about whether age verification systems in supermarkets should be restricted to proven effective ones, and about the role of the trade association CBL and franchise restrictions on effective systems. The State Secretary answered that research on effectiveness is underway, that compliance remains insufficient, that the ACM is investigating possible unlawful agreements, and that choice of system is up to the sector.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is currently investigating whether there are unlawful agreements within the CBL regarding the use of certain effective control systems.
Op dit moment onderzoekt de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) of al dan niet sprake is van ongeoorloofde afspraken binnen het CBL over de inzet van bepaalde effectieve controlesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over kledingbedrijven die geen inzicht geven in de aanpak van gebonden (kinder)arbeid in India

MPs from four parties asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch garment companies that give little insight into their handling of bonded child labour in South India, and whether the government would press companies, India and the OECD on it. The minister confirmed the problem, pointed to due diligence promotion, a textile sector work group under the Plan van Aanpak with aggregated transparency rather than company-level disclosure, and raised labour rights bilaterally and through the ILO and EU, while stating no garment company named received international-activity support.
Information that could link factories to individual companies, or information on purchasing volumes, is not included here.
Informatie die fabrieken kan linken aan individuele bedrijven of informatie over inkoopvolumes wordt hier niet in opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Omtzigt, Van Bommel over de vernietiging van 64 kerken in de Chinese provincie Zhejiang

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 64 churches in China's Zhejiang province were demolished or stripped of Christian elements under a demolition campaign, and whether central authorities back it. The minister confirmed the reports, said the campaign targets illegal buildings and anti-corruption, and said Dutch concerns on religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands will continue to raise this worrying development both bilaterally and through the EU.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als via de EU aandacht blijven vragen voor deze zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de doodstraf voor een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the government about the death sentence imposed on a pregnant Christian woman in Sudan for refusing to return to Islam, including protests, possible sanctions and Sudan's debt relief. The minister answered that the Sudanese ambassador was summoned, the verdict was condemned, an appeal is pending, the EU was engaged, no documented overview of recent anti-Christian incidents exists, and debt relief is conditional on proven progress.
The cabinet had the Sudanese ambassador summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het kabinet heeft de Sudanese ambassadeur laten ontbieden op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de betekenis van de uitspraak van het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten (ECSR)

MPs asked the State Secretary how his refusal to take immediate measures after a European Committee of Social Rights ruling squares with a Amsterdam court ruling recognising a right to a dignified existence, and whether he will provide bed, bath and bread to rejected asylum seekers living on the street. The State Secretary replied that the court case concerned municipal welfare obligations rather than the ECSR letter, that the individual still had ongoing procedures, and that he sees no reason to change his position, judging the Dutch system balanced.
The ruling of the Amsterdam court therefore gives me no reason to revisit my position following the ECSR letter.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam vormt voor mij dan ook geen aanleiding om terug te komen op mijn standpunt naar aanleiding van de brief van het ECSR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brandbrief van de regio Zuid-Oost Utrecht over de inkoop van jeugdzorg

An MP (Voordewind, ChristenUnie) asked the State Secretary about a municipal warning letter on a shortfall in youth care funding in the Zuid-Oost Utrecht region, and about how the government will address the budget gap caused by the residence-principle and the concentration of institutions. The State Secretary answered that a difference analysis is underway with the municipalities, that the May 2014 circular raised the macro budget and corrected the residence principle, and that the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can help providers if needed.
I take these signals seriously and am also in consultation with this specific region about them.
Ik neem deze signalen serieus en ben hierover ook in overleg met deze specifieke regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Laar, Thieme en Voordewind over misstanden bij de productie van handgeknoopte tapijten in India

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdD and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and forced labour in India's hand-knotted carpet industry, and whether Dutch importers are involved. The minister acknowledges the severe abuses, reports that the Dutch import market is small and that voluntary initiatives such as Goodweave and Care & Fair have limited reach, and lists development projects and dialogue with India as follow-up.
Statistics Netherlands publishes only aggregated data and provides no overview of individual companies importing carpets from India.
Het CBS publiceert alleen geaggregeerde data en geeft geen overzicht van individuele bedrijven die tapijten uit India importeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Voortman en Gesthuizen over de uitzending van Zembla van 30 april jl. en de schriftelijke verklaring van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie aangaande het uitzett

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Zembla broadcast and ministry statement on deporting people to Guinea, including whether Dutch authorities are responsible for checking the validity of travel documents issued by Guinean officials and whether deportations should be halted. The State Secretary answered that Guinea is responsible for the validity of its documents, that no concerns have been raised by the Guinean government, that monitoring deportees is not appropriate, and that the Commission Integraal Toezicht Terugkeer is reviewing the matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on whether certain (replacement) travel documents for return are valid or not.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid uitspraken te doen over of bepaalde (vervangende) reisdocumenten ten behoeve van terugkeer al dan niet rechtsgeldig zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over het bericht dat voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel bij terugkeer in Guinee geen enkele opvang beschikbaar is

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about reports that Guinean trafficking victims returning from the Netherlands would find no shelter, and whether deportations should be suspended. State Secretary Teeven replied that the trafficking residence scheme and asylum rules offer adequate safeguards, that a general Guinea country report will address FGM and vulnerable women and minors, and that deportation will not be suspended since minors are not returned without adequate reception.
Yes, I am willing to examine the possibilities.
Ja, ik ben bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de NIX18 campagne

An MP asked the state secretary about the NIX18 alcohol age campaign, including agreements with partners, the timing of the new slogan, the withdrawal of the logo by supermarkets and industry, and confidence in compliance with the 18+ rule.
