The state secretary listed partners, explained the transition dates set by the alcohol industry's code, said the supermarket sector now uses the logo or slogan depending on context, and pointed to improved compliance and planned monitoring and engagement.
I have been in contact with the CBL about this.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met het CBL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Schouw en Voortman over schade die kinderen oplopen tijdens het verblijf in asielzoekerscentra

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether children suffer developmental harm while living in asylum reception centres, citing a court ruling, and asked about oversight, relocation of children and the state's duty under the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary rejected the claim that children face harm merely from reception centre stay, pointed to existing oversight by the COA Supervisory Board and inspectorates, and committed to no new independent oversight body or relocation study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Keijzer over het ouderschapsplan

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked the government about reports that children in high-conflict divorces are in a difficult position, the effectiveness of the parenting plan, and whether relationship counselling is covered by basic insurance. The government answered that it has sent an implementation plan to parliament, that a WODC evaluation is preliminary, that basic insurance does not cover relationship problems without a psychiatric diagnosis, and that municipalities may buy such help from 2015.
To this end, we sent an implementation plan to your House by letter of 31 March 2014.
Daartoe hebben wij bij brief van 31 maart 2014 een uitvoeringsplan naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brandbrief van Drentse scholen over CITO-scores als afrekenlijstje

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary whether school boards' concerns that CITO test scores are used as an inspectorate accountability tool and disadvantage schools with many pupils needing extra support are justified. The state secretary denied that scores are used to penalise schools, said the inspectorate corrects for pupil population, refused to lower the weight of scores now, but promised a broader quality framework under differentiated supervision and a written reply to Prisma Drenthe.
I see no reason to change the inspectorate's assessment of final outcomes in the short term, because in my view it already sufficiently takes the pupil population into account.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op korte termijn de beoordeling van de eindopbrengsten door de inspectie aan te passen, omdat deze naar mijn inzicht al voldoende rekening houdt met de leerlingpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de test van de Consumentenbond, waaruit blijkt dat supermarkten onvoldoende presteren op het gebied van arbeidsomstandigheden in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the minister about a Consumentenbond test showing major supermarkets perform poorly on labour conditions in producing countries, and whether the government will monitor supermarkets and inform consumers. The minister answered that a sector risk analysis is underway with possible dialogue with retailers, pointed to the fruit convenant and existing initiatives, and said corporate reporting is primarily the companies' responsibility.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are currently commissioning a sector risk analysis.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken laten op dit moment een sectorrisicoanalyse uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de carnavalscampagne drinken als een prins

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary for Health about Bavaria's carnival campaign showing the outdated age-16 limit and the alcohol industry's refusal to join the NIX18 campaign. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said Bavaria regrets it and has corrected online material and posters, and defended the self-regulatory approach while reporting early positive campaign results.
I regret this conduct by Bavaria because it may have created confusion about the minimum age for selling and serving alcohol to young people.
Ik betreur deze handelswijze van Bavaria omdat hierdoor onduidelijkheid heeft kunnen ontstaan over de minimumleeftijd voor het verkopen en schenken van alcohol aan jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het EU-lidmaatschap voor Turkije

MPs Segers, Voordewind and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Foreign Minister's remark that the Netherlands would welcome Turkey as an EU member was premature, given Turkey's rule-of-law shortcomings, the Cyprus blockade of chapters 23 and 24, and recognition of the Armenian genocide. The minister answered that accession talks are open-ended and conditional on meeting strict criteria, acknowledged serious shortcomings on press freedom and rule of law, and said concerns were raised in Ankara, while recognition of the genocide is not an accession criterion.
The cabinet particularly emphasised its concerns about press freedom and freedom of expression.
Het kabinet benadrukte in het bijzonder de zorgen over persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over het bericht dat een ernstig zieke vader is uitgezet naar Guinee

Four MPs (SP, ChristenUnie, D66, GroenLinks) asked State Secretary Teeven why a seriously ill Guinean father was deported despite pending Article 8 ECHR proceedings, medical concerns, questions about travel documents, and Utrecht's offer of care. The State Secretary defended the deportation as the outcome of careful individual assessments, said medication was confirmed available in Guinea, and declined to discuss the individual case beyond what was necessary.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to enter into individual cases in public debate.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht in het publieke debat in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over Consulaire bijstand aan een Nederlandse vader

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about consular assistance to a Dutch father denied contact with his daughter in Turkey since 2011, including whether the embassy attended court hearings and whether Turkey is obstructing his case. The minister reports repeated formal and informal embassy contact with Turkish authorities, a Turkish Supreme Court ruling confirming his access right, and no evidence of active obstruction, while noting the practical barrier of denied entry and that a Dutch court cannot enforce visitation.
Although the father has thus been upheld by Turkey's highest court regarding his access right, he faces the practical obstacle that he is not admitted to Turkish territory.

Hoewel betrokkene dus door de hoogste Turkse rechter in het gelijk is gesteld ten aanzien van zijn omgangsrecht, bestaat voor hem de praktische belemmering dat hij geen toegang krijgt tot het Turkse grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over diens uitspraak aangaande de vermeende excuses van Vitens

MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he stood by his claim that Vitens had apologised for suggesting the ministry gave a negative opinion on cooperation with Mekorot, and whether he would apologise to Vitens for putting it in a bad light. The minister replied that the ministry gave neither a negative nor a positive opinion, that he had discussed the matter with Vitens' CEO, and that the issue was considered closed.
The ministry has given neither a negative nor a positive opinion on the planned cooperation with Mekorot.
Het ministerie heeft geen negatief en geen positief advies gegeven over de voorgenomen samenwerking met Mekorot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Schouw over diens uitspraken tijdens het debat van de Volkskrant over het asielbeleid op zondag 9 februari 2014

MPs Voordewind and Schouw asked State Secretary Teeven to explain his remarks at a Volkskrant debate comparing the child pardon (sour) with criminalising illegal residence (sweet), and whether these remarks fit a humane asylum policy. Teeven said he was describing coalition party positions, did not regret implementing the child pardon, intended no signal to children granted status, and did not mean to depart from humane asylum policy.
I did not want to give a signal.
Ik heb geen signaal willen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘Working on the Right Shoes’

An MP asked the minister about the 'Working on the Right Shoes' report scoring 28 shoe companies on child labour and about engaging shoe importers, retailers and trade bodies. The minister answered that talks with firms, the trade association and embassies are underway, a sector risk analysis will guide which sectors are approached, and that public procurement already requires suppliers to prevent child labour.
There is no overview, for example at customs, of shoe retailers that import shoes produced in Turkey.
Er bestaat geen overzicht, bijvoorbeeld bij de douane, van schoenenretailers die in Turkije geproduceerde schoenen importeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat er asielzoekerscentra (AZC's) worden geopend in voormalige gevangenissen en detentiecentra

MPs Voordewind and Voortman asked whether the COA is seeking to open asylum centres in former prisons and detention centres, how many asylum seekers lack regular reception places, and whether such unsuitable sites will be dropped in favour of alternatives. The State Secretary answered that COA searches broadly for reception sites (not only prisons), that about 1,700 places have been opened or reopened at former sites in Bellingwolde, Geeuwenbrug, Sweikhuizen, Uithuizen and Wassenaar, that every eligible asylum seeker currently has a place, and declined to discuss specific planned locations, citing municipal agreements.
Because of municipal and administrative agreements when acquiring locations, I do not consider it desirable to discuss locations intended for COA reception.
Vanwege gemeentelijke/bestuurlijke afspraken bij het verwerven van locaties vind ik het niet wenselijk om in te gaan op locaties die beoogd zijn voor de opvang door het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontmoedigingsbeleid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government withdrew a minister's visit to Mekorot, whether the settlement-discouragement policy is coherent with indirect investment, and how it fits the Oslo accords. The minister answered that the policy rests on international law on settlements, that the Oslo allocation of C-areas does not change this, and that cooperation with Mekorot is acceptable if not benefiting settlements.
I refer you to the letter to your House of 16 January 2014, reference 2014.35843, which addresses this matter.
Ik verwijs u graag naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 16 januari 2014, met kenmerk 2014.35843, waarin op deze kwestie wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mali-missie in matig pak’

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister whether combat uniforms for the Mali mission were chosen for financial reasons, were of inferior quality, and offered less fire protection than Dutch-made Defender M fabric. The Minister denied buying inferior clothing, said the current desert-pattern uniform meets the set requirements, and promised to inform parliament on the new combat clothing requirement later this year.
Once the requirement for the new combat clothing has been established, I will inform the House about it, in line with the Defence Materiel Process.
Zodra de behoefte aan de nieuwe gevechtskleding is vastgesteld, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren, in overeenstemming met het Defensie Materieel Proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind over het gegeven dat waterbedrijf Vitens zijn samenwerkingsverband met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot heeft beëindigd 'om neutraal' te

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government was involved in Vitens ending its cooperation with Israel's Mekorot, whether this harms innovation and the peace process, and whether it fits the water top-sector policy. The minister answered that the government does not interfere in individual companies' decisions, that the ministry only explained Dutch non-encouragement policy when consulted, and that companies decide their own economic relations.
The government does not intervene in the decisions of individual companies.
De regering treedt niet in de besluiten van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over de verwoesting van het Syrische christelijke dorp Sadad

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass killings and destruction in the Christian Syrian village of Sadad, the background, international responses, and possible action. The minister said SOHR reported 45 civilian deaths but no destruction of the village, that no further information was available, and that the Netherlands would press for respect for minorities and referral of Syria to the International Criminal Court.
No information is available about the background of these killings.
Over de achtergronden van deze moorden is geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de toenemende vervolging van christenen op Sri Lanka

MPs Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported rising persecution of Christians in Sri Lanka, including church closures, an attack on a church in Hanwella, police inaction, and removal of Sri Lanka from the human rights fund country list. The minister acknowledged rising religious tensions, said no independent information was available on several specifics, explained the 2011 reduction of the fund's country list, and noted EU and UN expressions of concern without committing to new national measures.
There is no independent information available to make a statement about this.
Er is geen onafhankelijke informatie beschikbaar om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over seks in Schooltv Weekjournaal

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether teachers knew in advance about the 'Dr. Corrie' sex-education item in Schooltv Weekjournaal, why this format was chosen, and whether schools retain freedom over methods. The government answered that schools and broadcasters decide content and methods, that the state has no prior control over broadcasts under article 7 of the Constitution, and declined to discuss the presentation with the broadcaster.
The government has no prior supervision of or influence over the content or form of a television broadcast (art. 7 of the Constitution).
De overheid heeft geen voorafgaand toezicht of invloed op de inhoud of vorm van een televisie-uitzending (art. 7 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over mensenrechtenbeleid met betrekking tot Saudi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the government agrees with Amnesty's finding that Dutch and EU support for persecuted Saudi human rights defenders has been weak and whether quiet diplomacy should be replaced. The minister agrees the human rights situation is serious, defends quiet diplomacy with EU coordination, and says it will consult partners on Amnesty's recommendations, noting some are already practiced.
As promised during the Human Rights Policy consultation on 30 September, the cabinet will consult other member states on this and inform the House of the outcomes.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Notaoverleg Mensenrechtenbeleid op 30 september jl. zal het kabinet zich hierover verstaan met andere lidstaten en de Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Angolese asielzoeker

MPs from ChristenUnie, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government would reconsider the age cutoff of the Kinderpardon scheme, which excludes a 22-year-old Angolan asylum seeker who arrived at age ten, and whether he could await his objection procedure in the Netherlands and why he remains in detention. The State Secretary refused to revisit the upper age limit, allowed the man to await his objection procedure in the Netherlands, and defended detention given his earlier evasion of lighter measures.
I have now decided that the person concerned may await his objection procedure in the Netherlands.
Inmiddels heb ik besloten dat betrokkene zijn bezwaarprocedure in Nederland mag afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het belang van de ondersteunende rol die NGO’s kunnen hebben voor het aannemelijk maken van het asielrelaas door asielzoekers

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether NGO support can help asylum seekers substantiate their claims, whether documents from the NGO CLAAS should be treated as reliable given Dutch funding, and why IND document research cannot always give a verdict on authenticity. The state secretary acknowledged the role of NGOs, said CLAAS funding concerns a different activity and does not determine evidentiary status, and stated that the IND assesses each document individually and considers its content acceptable.
I consider this approach careful and adequate.
Ik acht deze werkwijze zorgvuldig en toereikend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht van een negatief Nederlands bouwadvies

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the government advised Royal HaskoningDHV to stop building a sewage treatment plant in East Jerusalem, and what legal basis and consequences such advice has. The minister replied that the government only informed the company about the occupation and its obligations, that settlement investment is discouraged as policy, but that companies are not forbidden and bear responsibility themselves.

The Cabinet considers Israeli settlements unlawful and an obstacle to peace and therefore discourages Dutch companies from making investments or undertaking other activities in or for the benefit of Israeli settlements.

Het Kabinet acht Israëlische nederzettingen onrechtmatig en een obstakel voor de vrede en ontmoedigt daarom Nederlandse bedrijven investeringen te doen of andere activiteiten te ontplooien in of ten behoeve van Israëlische nederzettingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Irakees gezin met kinderen die onder toezicht zijn gesteld en uit huis zijn geplaatst

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked about the planned deportation of an Iraqi family whose children were under supervision and placed out of home, questioning the state's conduct in detaining the children and whether their rights were protected. The state secretary declined to discuss the individual case, but said the children's detention was lifted, the family was placed in a family location, and a plan is being worked out with Nidos and the family.
As you know, when answering parliamentary questions I do not go into specific aspects of individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik bij de beantwoording van kamervragen niet in op specifieke aspecten van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht ‘Egypt’s Christians face backlash for Morsi ouster’

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Coptic Christians face backlash after Morsi's ouster, including how many have been attacked, whether the interim government protects minorities, and whether Copts should be treated as a risk group in asylum policy. The minister answered that sectarian violence has increased, the security forces and local authorities have not sufficiently prevented it, but no new country report or asylum risk-group designation is deemed necessary.
There is currently no unambiguous and reliable information available on the number of victims and the number of churches destroyed.
Er is op dit moment geen eenduidige en betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar over aantallen slachtoffers en over aantallen kerken die vernield zijn.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Online porno automatisch geblokkeer

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about the UK plan to automatically block online pornography, whether the Dutch government agrees porn is harmful to children, whether such blocking is feasible in the Netherlands, whether it will research an automatic block, and whether search engines can be prohibited from showing child pornography results. The minister answered that porn is not banned in the Netherlands, filters have technical hurdles and limited effectiveness, the government will not commission research on an automatic block, and it cannot regulate foreign search engines though it values their cooperation.
We therefore do not consider it appropriate for the government to pursue or conduct research into an automatic block.
Wij achten het daarom niet opportuun om van overheidswege aan te sturen op of onderzoek te doen naar een automatische blokkade.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Thieme, Krol en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse zaadbedrijven in India

Four MPs asked the minister about child labour and low wages at Dutch seed companies Bejo Zaden and Nunhems in India, and about the sector's due diligence and CSR commitments. The minister responded that the government wants child labour eliminated, that Bejo Sheetal did not join the FLA, that Plantum will evaluate members' policies, and that Bejo and Nunhems will introduce new measures including monitoring and minimum wage commitments.
In the meeting with Plantum, the implementation of the Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour was discussed.
In het gesprek met Plantum is de uitvoering van de « Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour» aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de veiligheidssituatie in Irak

Three MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the deteriorating security situation in Iraq, especially Baghdad and central Iraq, including civilian casualty figures compared with 2011-2012 and when a departure moratorium would be needed. The state secretary reported a rise in violence in April-June 2013 but argued the situation does not amount to a breach of Article 3 ECHR, and said a departure moratorium is not the appropriate instrument, with a general country report due in autumn.
In my view, however, the available information does not show that the situation in Iraq is so serious that return to that country would amount to a violation of Article 3 ECHR.
Naar mijn opvatting kan echter uit de beschikbare informatie niet worden opgemaakt dat de situatie in Irak zo ernstig is dat terugkeer naar dat land een schending van artikel 3 EVRM oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de ledenr Omtzigt, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de EU-richtsnoeren over vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the minister did not inform parliament in advance about the EU guidelines on freedom of religion or belief adopted in June 2013, and whether the Netherlands would discuss a ranking of persecuted religious minorities in EU fora. The minister answered that the guidelines were prepared in the Council working group, were not discussed substantively at the Foreign Affairs Council, will be communicated to parliament by letter, and that the freedom of religion topic will be raised in EU consultations after parliament debates the human rights note.
As promised to your House during the committee meeting on freedom of religion of 15 May, your House will be informed by letter about the adoption of these guidelines.
Zoals tijdens het AO godsdienstvrijheid van 15 mei jl. aan uw Kamer toegezegd, wordt uw Kamer per brief over de aanname van deze richtsnoeren geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over ‘vechtscheidingen’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the health ministry about rising 'high-conflict divorces', the sources behind claims about their outcomes, research on relationship support and parenting plans, registration of such cases, and whether divorce costs should be studied. The state secretary replies that no rising trend is established, points to ZonMw-funded research and WODC studies on parenting plans, declines to create a statistical definition or register, and says the cost study would not establish causation.
The Ministry of VWS has instructed ZonMw to include 'divorce' as a priority theme within the programme.
Het ministerie van VWS heeft ZonMw opdracht gegeven om «echtscheiding» als prioritair thema binnen het programma op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de besteding van EU-geld aan Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about the Court of Auditors' finding that EU aid to Egypt failed to improve governance, its transparency and conditionality, and whether EU funds should be recovered or frozen. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings, said the EU is now withholding about EUR 200 million pending reforms, and stated the Commission is responsible for enforcing conditionality.
The cabinet broadly agrees with the Court of Auditors' recommendations to increase the effectiveness of aid.
Het kabinet is het in de kern eens met de aanbevelingen die de Rekenkamer doet om de effectiviteit van steun te vergroten.

Vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spoedige oplossingen voor abonnementen in het scholie

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the state secretaries whether regional public transport operators and authorities had reached agreements protecting pupils from steep fare increases, including the Amersfoort/Zeewolde case, and proposed a national pupil discount and a joint solution. The government replied that decentralisation allows regional differences, that a national discount framework is being pursued via a vision process and future OV-chipkaart rules, and that regions remain responsible for fares, offering no immediate binding fix.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de verslechtering van de veiligheidssituatie in bepaalde gebieden in Irak

MPs asked the state secretary about the worsening security situation in central Iraq and whether a new country report, a departure moratorium for asylum seekers, and asylum policy changes were warranted. The state secretary said an updated report on Iraq, including security by region and the position of ethnic and religious groups, is expected in autumn, and that a departure moratorium is not necessary at present while developments are monitored.
I have already asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs for an updated country report on the general situation in Iraq.
Ik heb reeds aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een geactualiseerd ambtsbericht gevraagd over algehele situatie in Irak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Schouw over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the state secretary whether Guinean laissez-passers for deportations were issued despite the Guinean ambassador's claim that he signed none, and why Guinea did not take part in taskforces. The state secretary answered that about 20 laissez-passers were obtained in 2013 from the Brussels mission, signed by the consul, that two deportations have taken place, and that there is no reason to suspend deportations to Guinea.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

An MP asked the government about sexual violence against women in India, the restrictions on human rights NGOs under India's FCRA rules, the treatment of the Dutch Human Rights Tulip winner, and visa problems for Dutch aid workers and journalists. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises civil society freedom in EU and UN forums, that India decides its own conditions for enforcing its law, and that no Dutch-funded organisation has been prevented from working by Indian restrictions.
The Netherlands is committed to keeping the issue of freedom for human rights organisations on the EU and UN agendas and will also do so at the EU Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland spant zich ervoor in dat het onderwerp «vrijheid voor mensenrechtenorganisaties» op de agenda van de EU en VN aandacht blijft krijgen en zal dat ook doen bij de EU Mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het initiatief Second love

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether the government finds it undesirable that the Second love initiative, which advertises in media, undermines relationships, including via public broadcasting, and what it will do to promote relationship support. The State Secretary answered that relationships are a private matter that cannot be imposed by government, that municipalities and Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin are responsible for relationship support (with a handreiking), and that government does not judge advertisements, which are assessed by the Reclame Code Commissie.
The government has no substantive involvement in, nor any judgement on, advertising.
De overheid heeft geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis met en ook geen oordeel over reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Schouw en Voordewind over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked about cooperation between the Guinean embassy in Brussels and the Guinean taskforce in the Netherlands on deportations, why a May 2013 taskforce was postponed, and whether there is a dispute between them. The state secretary answered that presentations are coordinated with both channels, that the postponement was due to unspecified Guinean reasons, that he knows of no dispute, and that about 100 travel documents were issued in 2012 with roughly a third of those returned, with no reason to suspend deportations.
I am not aware of any disagreement between the Guinean taskforce and the Guinean government.
Van onenigheid tussen de Guineese taskforce en de Guineese overheid is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Schouw van Uw Kamer over de medische behandeling van vreemdelingen

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Schouw asked the state secretary about the medical treatment of a hunger-striking asylum seeker at a Rotterdam detention centre, including allegations of mistreatment by a physician and restricted access for the trusted doctor. The state secretary defended the use of force by an internal assistance team, said the detainee refused a medical examination, referred the assault complaint to a police investigation, and stated that access and care procedures were followed.
If the outcomes give reason to do so, I will inform your House confidentially about this individual case.
Indien de uitkomsten daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik uw Kamer vertrouwelijk over deze individuele casus informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind Bonis en Thieme over financiering van bouwprojecten in India waar schending van arbeids- en kinderrechten plaatsvindt

MPs Voordewind, Bonis and Thieme asked whether Dutch-funded Asian Development Bank projects in India involve child labour and labour rights abuses, and what the Netherlands will do about oversight and sanctions. Minister Ploumen answered that the ADB has labour standards in its contracts and monitoring mechanisms, that the Netherlands has pressed the bank to strengthen complaint and sanction mechanisms, and that she will ask Dutch-represented constituencies at other development banks to scrutinise labour standards.
In talks with the ADB, the Netherlands has pointed out that complaint handling, a sanctions mechanism and monitoring are important.
Nederland heeft in gesprek met de ADB erop gewezen klachtenbehandeling, een sanctiemechanisme en monitoring belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Omtzigt en Voordewind over Islamitisch-extremistisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MPs Van der Staaij, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about Islamist violence against Christians in northern Nigeria, including whether the Nigerian state is failing to protect its citizens and what the Netherlands and the EU will do. The minister acknowledged the violence, said Nigeria bears national responsibility and that the Netherlands will raise it bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, but gave no concrete commitments beyond ongoing dialogue and EU follow-up.
The Netherlands will, through the usual multilateral channels and mainly in the bilateral relationship with Nigeria, point to Nigeria's national responsibility for protecting its citizens.

Nederland zal via de gebruikelijke multilaterale kanalen en vooral in de bilaterale relatie met Nigeria wijzen op de nationale verantwoordelijkheid van Nigeria ten aanzien van de bescherming van haar burgers.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een ernstig zieke vreemdeling

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why a seriously ill Togolese former unaccompanied minor, resident over eleven years, faces deportation, why the state appealed a court ruling in his favour, and whether the discretionary power should be used. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, restated the medical-stay procedure and the general policy framework, and said rootedness is not an objective criterion.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat supermarktketens weigeren effectieve naleving van leeftijdgrenzen bij alcoholverkoop toe te passen

Two MPs asked the government about reports that supermarket chains resist effective age checks for alcohol sales, including remote age-verification systems. The state secretary answered that compliance is the supermarkets' own responsibility, that the burgomaster supervises compliance and can impose sanctions, and that the government has contacted the VNG and will evaluate the law after three years.
However, it is up to the supermarkets themselves to determine how the age limits for the sale of alcoholic beverages are complied with and which systems they use for this.
Het is echter aan de supermarkten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze de leeftijdsgrenzen bij de verkoop van alcoholhoudende dranken worden nageleefd en welke systemen zij daarvoor hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek ‘Do time restrictions on alcohol advertising reduce youth exposure’

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Kooiman asked whether a study showing the 6:00–21:00 time slot for alcohol advertising has counterproductive effects for high-risk youth should lead to extending the slot or other measures, and about compliance with the advertising code. The state secretary replied that the time slot is effective for young children, that he will discuss further protection of 12–18 year olds with the education ministry and report back, that code compliance is good, and that no further evaluation is needed beyond the existing one.

As indicated earlier during the debate on the private member's bill raising the alcohol age, I will soon discuss with the education ministry how young people aged 12–18 can be further protected from the influence of alcohol advertising.

Ik zal, zoals eerder aangegeven tijdens het debat over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel verhoging leeftijd alcohol, binnenkort met het ministerie van OCW bespreken op welke manier jongeren tussen de 12–18 jaar verder kunnen worden beschermd tegen de invloed van alcoholreclame.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind  en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘IJsland wil porno blokkeren’

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about Iceland's plan to block internet pornography and about what is known of its effects on Dutch children, including exposure, help-seeking and research. The government answered that Iceland's plans are only under study, that the evidence on harm is mostly correlational, and that no further research is considered necessary beyond the ongoing NHL study.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport and I do not consider initiating additional research necessary.
Het entameren van aanvullend onderzoek achten de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon en Ten Broeke over de aanval op een christelijke wijk in de Pakistaanse stad Lahore

Four MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke) asked the foreign minister about a mob attack on a Christian neighbourhood in Lahore over alleged blasphemy, Pakistan's government response, the misuse of blasphemy law and what the Netherlands will do to press Pakistan. The minister answered that Punjab ordered a judicial inquiry and compensation was paid, that the blasphemy law is open to abuse, and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally, multilaterally and in GSP+ assessment, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing channels.
I do not have confirmed figures on the number of people imprisoned on charges under this law.
Ik beschik niet over geconfirmeerde cijfers over het aantal personen dat gevangen zit vanwege een beschuldiging op grond van deze wet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over het bericht dat circa 100 huizen van Pakistaanse christenen zijn verbrand vanwege vermeende belediging van Mohammed

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether the Pakistani government adequately protects Christian minorities after about 100 homes were burned over an alleged blasphemy case, and why Christians are not classed as a risk group for asylum purposes. The state secretary answered that Pakistani authorities often fail to protect and prosecute perpetrators, that no reliable data on 2012 incidents exists, and that after considering the Lahore incident he still does not consider Pakistani Christians a risk group.
No, there is no reliable information available on this.
Nee, er is hierover geen betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de moord op een christelijke asielzoeker

The MP asks the State Secretary whether a Christian asylum seeker murdered after converting was threatened, whether COA knew, and what protections exist for converted Christians in asylum centres. The State Secretary answers that COA was aware of his faith, received no threat reports, and that existing measures and interest groups provide adequate protection, while rejecting an independent confidential contact person.
I do not share the view that an independent confidential contact person should be set up through which asylum seekers can, if needed anonymously, first report violence and intimidation.
De mening dat er een onafhankelijke vertrouwenspersoon moet worden ingesteld waarbij asielzoekers, zonodig anoniem, een eerste melding kunnen doen van geweld en intimidatie, deel ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht dat loverboyslachtoffers hun veiligste haven verliezen

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether no closed youth care facility for girls remains in the Netherlands after the merger of two institutions, and how safe care for loverboy victims is ensured. The State Secretary answered that capacity exists in open and closed youth care across regions, that some girls-only categorical groups exist, that professionals choose between mixed and girls-only groups case by case, and that a categorical pilot is only in an exploratory phase.
With the merger of the institutions De Lindenhorst and Almata, there are no youth care plus institutions where only girls reside.
Met het samengaan van de instellingen De Lindenhorst en Almata zijn er in de jeugdzorg plus geen instellingen waar uitsluitend meisjes verblijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the imprisonment of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, the outcome of an Iranian parliamentary inquiry, the conviction of lawyer Mohammad Ali Dadkhah, and EU action. The minister described her sentence, said the Iranian delegation's findings may not be published, confirmed Dadkhah's sentence and Dutch concern, and reported new EU sanctions and repeated EU calls for release.
If the results of their inquiry are made public, which is not certain, I will share them with your House.
Als de resultaten van hun onderzoek publiek worden gemaakt, wat niet zeker is, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer mededelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over uitlatingen premier Erdogan over het zionisme

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remark describing Zionism as a crime against humanity, whether the Netherlands had protested, and why the UN Secretary-General had not condemned it. The minister distanced the government from the remark, said it was raised with Turkey politically and at official level, and noted the UN Secretary-General had distanced himself from it.
I explicitly distance myself from this.
Ik neem hier uitdrukkelijk afstand van.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de zelfmoord van een Russische activist

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary whether reports of a Russian activist's suicide in a Rotterdam detention centre are accurate, including claims about his past work, asylum grounds and why he was transferred to detention while his appeal was pending, and asked about policy on political refugees from Russia. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual's account, said an Inspectorate investigation into the handling of the detention was awaited, and stated that Russian asylum claims are assessed individually without special policy.
Following this incident I have asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) to start an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van dit incident heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘sociaal economische gevolgen van echtscheiding’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretaries and minister about a report on the socio-economic costs of divorce, including its effects on health, well-being, public finances, poverty risk and family policy. The government answered that the report does not directly establish effects on public finances and that a further cost study would not isolate causal links, pointed to work participation and social safety nets against poverty, and described the handreiking and planned evaluations on relationship support and family policy.
In view of the above, further research into the total societal costs of divorce will be insufficient to demonstrate causal relationships.
Gezien het voorgaande zal nader onderzoek naar de omvang van de totale maatschappelijke kosten van echtscheiding onvoldoende oorzakelijke verbanden kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de stijgende regionale vervoertarieven voor scholieren vanaf het schooljaar 2013-2014

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about sharp regional public transport fare increases for pupils from 2013-2014, the lack of clarity for schools and parents, and whether alternative subscriptions or harmonisation were agreed. The state secretary said fare decisions are regional, acknowledged the criticism, pointed to a compensation scheme in Zuid-Holland and to a planned permanent structure for harmonising discount products, but declined to take formal action or set a maximum increase.
From my current role, however, I have no formal powers to act against this.
Vanuit mijn huidige rol heb ik echter geen formele bevoegdheden om hier tegen op te treden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat GGD Nederland, het Trimbos-instituut en het Nederlands Instituut voor Alcoholbeleid (STAP) adviseren zo snel mogelijk over te stappen op effectieve leeftijds

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether they support calls by GGD Nederland, Trimbos and STAP for supermarkets to adopt effective age verification for alcohol sales, and what they will do to ensure this. The government supports the call, notes that enforcement has passed to municipalities with new sanction powers, and agrees that effective age checks would reduce municipal supervision burden.
We support the call of these parties.
Wij ondersteunen de oproep van deze partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de publicatie ‘Ontheemd: de verhuizingen van asielzoekerskinderen in Nederland’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report on asylum-seeker children moving frequently between reception centres, whether a COA study was too narrow, and whether the situation conflicts with the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The state secretary acknowledged that such children move more often, said the COA's registration is not comparable to the report's sample, cited protocols and policies to reduce moves, and referred to an earlier letter for the substantive response.
Retroactive registration was not reliably possible based on the COA systems because those systems were not set up for it.
Registratie met terugwerkende kracht was op basis van de COA-systemen niet op een betrouwbare wijze mogelijk omdat de systemen daar niet op waren ingericht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het rapport van Human Rights Watch waaruit blijkt dat Syrische oppositiegroepen kerken plunderen

Members Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about a Human Rights Watch report on Syrian opposition groups looting churches, including who was responsible, whether sectarian violence is increasing, and whether attacks on religious buildings are war crimes for the ICC. The minister answered that responsibility cannot be established, acknowledged the sectarian trend and the crime, but said the ICC cannot act without a Security Council referral, which the Netherlands supports, and that the letter to the Council did not specifically mention church attacks.
No. Is it possible to establish which groups were responsible for these lootings?
Vraag 2 Is vast te stellen welke groepen verantwoordelijk zijn geweest voor deze plunderingen?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over het gebrek aan dranktoezicht van de gemeenten

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about municipalities being unprepared for taking over alcohol enforcement from the NVWA on 1 January 2013, including the shortage of trained enforcement officers and the risk of more youth alcohol access. The government acknowledged the reports, said a transitional arrangement lets untrained officers work within a year of appointment, expects municipalities to train staff, and says the NVWA's team remains available in 2013 to support them.
In the coming months I will closely monitor developments regarding the decentralisation of supervision.
De komende maanden zal ik de ontwikkelingen omtrent de decentralisatie van het toezicht op de voet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de katoensector in Turkije

MPs Voordewind, Van Ojik and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about child labour in Turkey's cotton sector, including unconditioned state price-support subsidies and Dutch clothing retailers selling products made with child labour. Minister Ploumen answered that Turkey is primarily responsible, that she raised ILO cooperation with Turkish authorities, and that she will support a textile-sector action plan on supply-chain transparency and ending child labour, expected mid-2013.
I am willing to play an active role in supporting the textile sector in fulfilling its supply-chain responsibility.
Ik ben bereid een actieve rol te spelen om de textielsector te ondersteunen bij het invullen van hun ketenverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraken van de Raad van State inzake christelijke vluchtelingen van Iraanse afkomst

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether he would change asylum policy for Iranian Christians following two Council of State rulings, and whether he would halt planned deportations to Iran. The state secretary answered that the rulings follow the EU Court of Justice's framework on religious freedom, that the IND already applies this framework, and that no further measures are warranted.
The clarity you requested has existed since 2 November, and I therefore see no reason to take the measures you propose.
De door u gevraagde duidelijkheid is er al sinds 2 november jl. en ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de door u voorgestelde maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over het bewind in Egypte onder president Morsi

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about press freedom, police violence and an anti-Semitic prayer under President Morsi in Egypt, and whether economic cooperation and arms export resumption were premature given rights concerns. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Netherlands will urge Egypt on rights and offer rule-of-law support, rejected the hateful rhetoric, and said economic cooperation uses existing instruments and the arms export permits were addressed in a letter of 8 October.
The Netherlands is willing to support Egypt, when asked, in strengthening the rule of law and improving public administration.
Nederland is bereid Egypte desgevraagd te ondersteunen bij versterking van de rechtsstaat en verbetering van openbaar bestuur.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de verslechterde positie van moslims in Birma

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether the Burmese government can contain sectarian violence against Muslims in Rakhine, whether reforms are undermined, and whether the Netherlands will push for UN-level protection. The minister answered that the government has increased military presence and that reforms continue, and that the Netherlands supports UN resolutions and humanitarian aid through CERF.
The Netherlands also campaigns for this, multilaterally for example by supporting the UN human rights resolution
Ook Nederland maakt zich hiervoor sterk, in multilateraal verband bijv. door ondersteuning van de mensenrechtenresolutie van de AVVN

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over berichten dat volgens een VN ‘Group of Experts’ Rwanda en Oeganda directe militaire steun geven aan guerillastrijders in Congo en over de mensenrechtensitua

MPs Voordewind and Van Dijk asked about a UN Group of Experts finding that Rwanda and Uganda directly arm M23 rebels in Congo, about human rights in Congo and Rwanda, and whether Dutch aid to Rwanda's justice sector should end. The minister said the leaked report cannot yet be fully assessed, that Dutch aid remains suspended without linkage to the Amnesty findings, and that Rwanda's Security Council seat will sharpen scrutiny of its compliance with norms.
Since we have not been able to see the full final report, it is not yet possible to reach a considered judgment on the report or to consider new measures.

Aangezien wij geen kennis hebben kunnen nemen van het volledige eindrapport, is het op dit moment nog niet mogelijk om tot een afgewogen oordeel over het rapport te komen of om nieuwe maatregelen te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de positie van minderheden in Egypte

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Immigration about the treatment of Coptic Christians and other minorities in Egypt, including forced displacement from Sinai, blasphemy prosecutions, unfair military trials, the Maspero investigation and arms exports. The minister answered that the government is pressing Egypt on religious freedom and rule of law, has reviewed internal flight alternatives case by case, and has kept the arms export policy unchanged, without committing to new concrete steps.
The Netherlands urges Egypt to comply with its international obligations, including guaranteeing freedom of expression and freedom of religion or belief.
Nederland spoort Egypte aan tot het naleven van zijn internationale verplichtingen, waaronder het garanderen van vrijheid van meningsuiting en vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bruins Slot over gehoorschade bij de jeugd

MPs Voordewind and Bruins Slot asked about hearing damage among young people from loud music, including its long-term costs, the adequacy of current prevention, and whether a Flemish-style noise limit should be introduced. The state secretary answered that cost data is lacking and a RIVM study is pending, that the music sector's convenant and Oorveilig label are the main tools, and that action will depend on a 2012 evaluation.
On the basis of this evaluation I will examine whether the current approach works or whether further action is necessary and desirable.
Ik zal op basis van deze evaluatie bekijken of de huidige aanpak werkt of dat er nadere actie nodig en gewenst is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind inzake het bericht dat de werkloosheid in het onderwijs stijgt

An MP asked the education minister about the rise in unemployment benefit claims among education workers, its regional distribution, and whether the government will retain young teachers and address temporary contracts. The minister attributed the rise to pupil decline, anticipated budget cuts and staffing adjustments, said retention is primarily the employers' task, and stated the government has no data on temporary contracts ending before summer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en De Roon over de bloedige onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of lethal force against Papuan demonstrators in Indonesia, whether the government would condemn it, summon the ambassador, support a free press there, and send independent observers. The minister said the 23 October clashes in Manokwari are still under investigation, denied that repression is structural, noted limits on foreign journalists' access, and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights through bilateral contacts and the EU dialogue, but rejected observers and sanctions-style steps.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the human rights situation in Papua and West Papua in bilateral contacts and through the EU human rights dialogue.
Nederland zal in bilaterale contacten en via de EU-mensenrechten dialoog aandacht blijven vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Papua en West-Papua.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, en Schouw over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration whether deportations of rejected asylum seekers to Guinea rely on corrupt authorities, how travel-document delegations and payments work, and whether a specific mother and children case and related investigations will be addressed. The minister answered that cooperation is necessary but structured via MoUs and delegations from Guinean ministries, that payments follow standard return practice, and that deportations will not be suspended, with the family case to be reported by end 2012.
Your House will be informed further about the family concerned before the end of 2012.
Uw Kamer wordt over het betreffende gezin voor het eind van 2012 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de abortusboot

MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the Women on Waves abortion boat's planned visit to Morocco, where abortion is illegal, risks prosecution, whether the government had contact with Morocco, what permits the foundation holds, its past activities and whether it receives subsidy. The minister answered that the trip is a private initiative, that Morocco regards it as an NGO matter, that the Dutch Waz permit requires a temporary permit and IGZ review for the mobile clinic which the foundation has not requested, and that it receives no ministry subsidy.
However, WoW has not applied for the temporary permit.
WoW heeft de tijdelijke vergunning echter niet aangevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over uitlatingen van scheidende Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kigali

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the outgoing ambassador to Rwanda was right to say the Netherlands had not suspended aid and that Rwanda's rebuttal of the UN experts' report was satisfactory, and about the consequences for Congo and Uganda. The minister confirmed the remarks were made to the press without judging Rwanda's reply, said Dutch sectoral budget aid remains on hold pending the final UN Group of Experts report, and that no EU partner or the US has lifted measures yet.
The Netherlands has put on hold the decision on granting bilateral sectoral budget support to the Rwandan government.
Nederland heeft de beslissing over het verlenen van bilaterale sectorale begrotingssteun aan de Rwandese overheid aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over incontinentiezorg

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether budgeting incontinence supplies into insurer-defined patient profiles leaves patients with inadequate material, and what remedies exist when supplies run out early. Minister Schippers answered that the Zvw guarantees adequate care, that patient profiles are a cost-efficiency measure, and that patients can turn to their insurer, while she has no role in insurer-pharmacy contracts.
I have no role in the agreements that are concluded between the parties.
Ik heb geen rol in de overeenkomsten die tussen partijen worden afgesloten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over ketentransparantie, kinderarbeid en uitbuiting in de kledingindustrie

MPs from GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and SP asked the government about implementing a motion on full supply-chain transparency and ending child labour in the garment sector, including IMVO policy, EU action and India/Bangladesh cases. The government answered that talks with textile industry associations continue, that a national action plan on business and human rights will come around the new year, and that it is primarily up to the industry to set feasible transparency commitments.
The cabinet expects internationally active companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die internationaal actief zijn dat zij de OESO Richtlijnen naleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Bommel over het martelen van een Molukse demonstrant

MPs Voordewind and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that Moluccan prisoner Johan Teterissa was beaten, denied medical care, moved without notice and held despite peaceful protest.
