The minister said the mistreatment reports are not confirmed by independent sources, that the government raised past abuse with Indonesia, and that it raises prisoner treatment and sentences bilaterally and within the EU, without committing to a specific request for release.
I raise both bilaterally and within the EU the treatment of prisoners and the heavy sentences imposed on persons who peacefully express their political views, including Mr Teterissa.

Ik vraag zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband aandacht voor de behandeling van gevangenen en de hoge straffen die zijn opgelegd aan personen die op geweldloze wijze hun politieke opvatting ventileren, onder wie de heer Teterissa.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de toegenomen spanningen tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

An ChristenUnie MP asked the foreign minister about rising tensions between Armenia and Azerbaijan, including Azerbaijan's pardon and hero status for convicted murderer Ramil Safarov, and what Dutch and EU steps were taken. The minister answered that the events harm regional stability, that the EU and Netherlands call for restraint, and that the OSCE Minsk Group is the proper forum, with the EU supporting confidence-building measures.
The government has urged Azerbaijan at the highest level to show restraint in the conflict with Armenia over Nagorno-Karabakh.
De regering heeft in Azerbeidzjan op het hoogste niveau aangedrongen op terughoudendheid in het conflict met Armenië over Nagorno Karabach.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een 11-jarig meisje met Down Syndroom vanwege schending van de blasfemiewet in Pakistan

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of an 11-year-old girl with Down syndrome under Pakistan's blasphemy law, and whether the Netherlands would seek her release, press Pakistan to repeal or reform the law, and continue funding a legal aid NGO. The minister answered that the girl was released on bail, Pakistan's government ordered an inquiry and an imam was arrested, the Netherlands raised concern discreetly with the EU and via quiet diplomacy, and the embassy already funds a legal aid project for 2011–2013.
For security reasons, the Netherlands, like the EU and the Pakistani government, acts very discreetly in such cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen handelt Nederland evenals de EU, en ook de Pakistaanse overheid, zeer discreet in dergelijke zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de bezuinigingen bij FIOM

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister why subsidies to the counselling organisation Fiom were cut, how quality and expertise would be preserved, and how teenage mothers and the advisory report on women's shelters were treated. The minister replied that taboos have fallen and mainstream care can provide the help, that Fiom receives a phased transition subsidy to transfer expertise to mainstream organisations, and that teenage mothers will move under municipal shelter policy.

Given the reduced taboo, the availability of offerings within regular provisions and citizens' freedom of choice, I no longer consider it appropriate for the central government to subsidise Fiom's specific psychosocial activities.

Gelet op de afname van het taboe, de beschikbaarheid van het aanbod binnen de reguliere voorzieningen en met het oog op de keuzevrijheid van de burger acht ik het niet langer opportuun om vanuit de rijksoverheid de specifieke activiteiten op het terrein van psychosociale hulpverlening van Fiom te subsidiëren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de meldlijn zelfdoding

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister whether she would act against the NVVE's new hotline for assisted suicide and its publication of stories about helping others die, which they argued may breach article 294 of the Criminal Code. The minister replied that she sees no reason to act while the NVVE stays within the law, that the legal question is for the courts, and that she will not talk to the NVVE to stop it.
The weighing and assessment of that is ultimately reserved for the judge.
De weging en waardering daarvan is uiteindelijk aan de rechter voorbehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de relatietherapie

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the government would follow the CVZ advice to remove relationship therapy from the basic insurance package, and about the costs and child effects of divorce. The state secretary said the government follows the CVZ view that relationship problems fall outside the basic GGZ package because relationships belong to citizens' private sphere, declined a national study of divorce costs, and pointed to municipal support and a forthcoming guidance document for Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin.
We follow the CVZ's judgement, because this contributes to the sustainability of the geneeskundige GGZ package.
Wij volgen het oordeel van het CVZ, omdat hiermee wordt bijgedragen aan de houdbaarheid van het pakket voor geneeskundige GGZ
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Thieme, Schouw over het bericht 'Syrische asielzoekers eisen duidelijkheid'

Six MPs asked the minister about a report that Syrian asylum seekers demanded clarity on their status, including whether group-wide protection under the Qualification Directive applies and how hunger strikes could be prevented. The minister replied that a 3 August letter sets out the policy, that individual assessment remains the starting point, and that Syrians not shown to be active supporters of the regime may receive temporary asylum residence permits under the Aliens Act.
On 3 August I informed your House about how I have shaped the country-based asylum policy regarding Syria.
Op 3 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië heb vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat tien presentatoren bij de Publieke Omroep een salaris boven de Balkenende-norm ontvangen

An MP asked the minister about reports that ten Public Broadcasting presenters still earn above the Balkenende norm, and why the number has not been reduced, and asked for pressure on broadcasters to pay the excess from membership funds. The minister answered that the NPO reports exceptions fell to ten in 2011, that remaining older contracts explain the excess and will be phased out toward eight by 2013, and that excess pay is already paid from association funds, so no further action is needed.
That is not necessary, see the answer to question 4.
Dat is niet nodig, zie het antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dijksma over het bericht ‘Nieuwe onderzoeksmethode biedt asielkinderen houvast in procedure’

MPs Voordewind and Dijksma asked whether the minister would adopt the BIC-Q child-interest assessment tool in asylum procedures to assess the best interest of the child transparently. Minister Leers answered that the best interest of the child is weighed within the family context and alongside other interests, and that he sees no place for the BIC-Q as a standard element of the asylum procedure.
I recognise that a methodical and transparent assessment can be a useful tool to gain more insight into different situations of children.
Ik onderken dat een methodische en transparante beoordeling een nuttig hulpmiddel kan zijn om meer beeld te krijgen bij verschillende situaties van kinderen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Dijksma, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Oproep: stop uitzetten kinderen’

MPs from four parties asked the immigration minister whether he knew of the Children's Ombudsman's call to halt deportations of children, how many child-involved deportations were planned, when he would respond to the report, and whether he would suspend planned removals until the Samsom/Voordewind bill is debated. The minister refused a deportation stop, arguing it would not serve the children's interests, create legal inequality and undermine return procedures, and said he could not give a count of planned deportations because the information changes daily.
It is not possible to indicate how many deportations involving minor children are planned for the coming months.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel uitzettingen, waarbij minderjarige kinderen zijn betrokken, er voor de komende maanden gepland zijn.
Antwoord vragen Ormel, Voordewind en Ten Broeke over 'een Palestijnse Christen'

MPs Ormel, Voordewind and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Christian Daoud Nassar, who cancelled a Dutch visit, and about a long-running land and legal dispute with Israeli authorities over the family farm. The minister confirmed the cancellation, disputed that the family was described as illegal residents, outlined the land registration dispute and court process, and said there was no reason for the Netherlands to intervene.
Based on the available information, I currently see no reason for the Netherlands to get involved in this matter.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich te mengen in deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Voordewind, Dibi en Schouw over de ontstane situatie in Ter Apel

Five MPs asked the minister whether a clearance of the tent camp of rejected asylum seekers in Ter Apel had begun, and about its course, the pending summary proceedings, and the medical condition of residents. The minister replied that residents were offered temporary shelter with a freedom-restriction measure, that the Iraqi group left voluntarily, and that the mayor issued an emergency order to end the action on safety grounds.
In line with my commitment made in the emergency debate of 15 May 2012, I will inform you fully in writing as soon as possible once the action has ended.
Conform mijn toezegging gedaan in het spoeddebat van 15 mei 2012, zal ik u schriftelijk zo spoedig mogelijk volledig informeren zodra de actie is afgelopen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Rechten asielkinderen geschonden’ en ‘Nederland riskeert berisping VN’

MPs Voordewind and Van Dam asked the immigration minister whether the Netherlands risks a UN reprimand over children's rights of asylum-seeking children, and whether prolonged uncertainty is causing serious psychological harm. The minister said the Netherlands has not been raised before the UN committee, denied a declining reputation, acknowledged uncertainty can harm children, and pointed to faster procedures and existing exceptions rather than a new scheme.
No. The Dutch state has not been addressed.
Nee. De Nederlandse staat is niet aangesproken.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam, Gesthuizen, Dibi, Schouw en Voordewind over het stopzetten van zestien hoger beroepprocedures en het niet uitzetten van zestien Somaliërs

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister why he withdrew appeals in sixteen Somali asylum cases and stopped detention and removals, given the security situation in Mogadishu. The minister replied that return to North Somalia remains possible via Mogadishu airport, that the appeals were withdrawn because forced return could not be organised in a way he considered responsible at present, that detention was lifted, and that returnees without state-funded shelter are not entitled to accommodation.
That is why the appeals were withdrawn.
Daarom zijn de hoger beroepen ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over de positie van Assyrische christenen in Irak

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven) asked the Foreign Minister about the position of Assyrian Christians in Iraq, including a human rights report on their exodus, Dutch support for UNDP projects in Nineveh, police deployment there, and the status of the Zakho attacks investigation. The minister described the UNDP projects and said he would raise concerns about church attacks and police in Nineveh with Iraqi authorities, while noting that some arrests were made and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
I will discuss this shortly with the Iraqi authorities and specifically ask for attention to the deployment of police in Nineveh.
Ik bespreek dit op korte termijn met de Iraakse autoriteiten en vraag daarbij specifiek aandacht voor de inzet van de politie in Nineveh.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Dibi, Samsom en Gesthuizen over de gevolgen van verschillende gerechtelijke uitspraken voor lopende procedures van Iraanse bekeerlingen

MPs from several parties asked the minister how pending CJEU prejudicial questions and an ECtHR interim measure on Iranian converts affect asylum cases, and whether processing and removals should be suspended. The minister replied that the questions do not specifically target Iranian converts, that the interim measure is unreasoned and has no general effect, and that Dutch policy on religious persecution remains unchanged, so no suspension is planned.
The interim measure taken by the European Court of Human Rights is not reasoned.
De door het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens getroffen voorlopige maatregel (interim measure) is niet gemotiveerd.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen.

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about a reported call by Saudi Arabia's grand mufti to destroy all churches in the region, including the influence of the cleric, Saudi authorities' reaction and what the government would do. The minister deplored such statements, said the mufti has no formal political role, raised concerns through the EU with the GCC, and noted that human rights are discussed regularly with Saudi authorities, without committing to new steps beyond that.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the minister of Foreign Affairs whether the UN Human Rights Council's adoption of several resolutions critical of Israel, and a fact-finding mission, was disproportionate compared with its one resolution on Syria, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the number and character of the Israel resolutions were disproportionate, said the Netherlands argues for proportionality and has raised the concern within the EU and the UN, and answered all questions.
I consider the number of Israel resolutions and their character to be disproportionate.
Ik acht het aantal Israël-resoluties en het karakter ervan disproportioneel.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat een kerk in Koeweit mogelijk voor Goede Vrijdag gesloten wordt

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether a Kuwaiti evangelical church would close before Good Friday following a Saudi fatwa, and whether the government would protest or summon Kuwait's ambassador. The minister answered that the church is not closing and services will proceed, saw no reason to summon the ambassador, and noted no change in Kuwaiti policy toward churches.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ormel en Voordewind over 'de sluiting van een christelijke kerk door de Palestijnse Autoriteit'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority intends to force the First Baptist Church in Bethlehem to close, and what the background is. The minister answered that the PA says it has no plan to close the church, that the church issued marriage and birth certificates without authorisation and was asked to stop or meet legal requirements, and that Christians enjoy religious freedom in the Palestinian territories.
As previously indicated, there is no intention to close the Baptist congregation in Bethlehem.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven is er geen voornemen de Baptistengemeente in Bethlehem te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij en Sterk over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.
De wet biedt mij niet de ruimte om zonder concrete aanwijzingen voor dreigende ernstige strafbare feiten iemand de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen louter op basis van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Belofte maakt schuld? Scheiden ook’

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked the state secretary about a report on the societal costs of divorce, including whether research into those costs, measures to support couples, relationship courses and tax incentives would be undertaken. The government answered that it sees no added value in a national cost study, pointed to Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin guidance and existing programmes, declined a follow-up to the family policy note, and ruled out tax measures given the financial climate.
I do not get the impression that a national study into the total societal costs of divorce in the Netherlands would add value to supporting the responsibility of municipalities in this matter.

Ik heb niet de indruk dat een landelijk onderzoek naar de totale maatschappelijk kosten van echtscheiding in Nederland een toegevoegde waarde heeft als het gaat om het ondersteunen van de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten in deze.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de bevindingen van het boek Deception

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the book 'Deception' documenting Palestinian Authority incitement and glorification of terrorism, and whether Dutch aid should be conditioned on tackling it. The minister acknowledged the statements as unacceptable but argued the PA cannot be held responsible for every media statement, referred the matter to revived trilateral talks and EU channels, and rejected monthly conditional aid payments as counterproductive to peace talks.
In all its contacts with the PA, the government points to the need to counter incitement and glorification of violence.
Het kabinet wijst in al zijn contacten met de PA op de noodzaak haatzaaien en geweldverheerlijking tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel en Peters over het ILO rapport 'Burried in Bricks' en de betrokkenheid van NAVO/ISAF bij dwangarbeid in steenbakkerijen

MPs Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel and Peters asked the government about the ILO report 'Buried in Bricks' on bonded child and adult labour in Afghan brick kilns and whether NATO/ISAF supply chains use such bricks. The government answered that it shares the aim of ending child labour, that NATO/ISAF can not fully trace brick supply lines, and that NATO agreed four concrete follow-up steps while Afghanistan bears primary responsibility.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over kinderarbeid en de positie van Dalits in India

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about whether the EU-India trade agreement's sustainability chapter had been agreed, child labour and Dalit rights in India, an ITUC report on labour rights, and human rights follow-up such as torture reports. Minister Rosenthal answered that the trade negotiations were not concluded before the February summit, that India has relevant laws but implementation is weak, and that Dalit rights and torture are on the EU-India human rights dialogue agenda, though most answers restate existing policy.
It has not proven possible to conclude the negotiations on the EU-India free trade agreement before the EU-India Summit of 10 February.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om de onderhandelingen over het EU-India vrijhandelsverdrag voor de EU-India Top van afgelopen 10 februari af te ronden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Samsom, Dibi en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een Georgisch gezin



G.B.M. Leers

Five MPs asked the minister about the planned deportation of a 17-year-old Georgian girl after ten years in the Netherlands, including her mother's disability, the duration of asylum procedures, the father's alleged risks in Georgia, and whether she should be spared removal pending answers. The minister's reply was sent only for confidential inspection, citing privacy sensitivity, so the substantive answers are not public.

Given the privacy-sensitive aspects, I request that the answers be made available solely for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives of the States General.
Gelet op de privacygevoelige aspecten verzoek ik u de antwoorden enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Spekman en Samsom en Voordewind over een uitspraak van het Europese Hof over de vrijstelling van leges voor een verblijfsvergunning voor gezinsleven voor mensen in de bijstand

MPs Spekman, Samsom and Voordewind asked the minister whether the Netherlands should exempt benefit recipients from residence-permit fees after the ECtHR found a violation of the right to an effective remedy in G.R. v the Netherlands. The minister said exemption is available if applicants show they cannot pay and cannot rely on third parties, that the government will inform the House shortly on how it will follow the ruling, and that cost recovery remains the baseline.
You will be informed shortly about how I will follow up on the ECtHR ruling.
U zult op korte termijn worden geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik gevolg zal geven aan de uitspraak van het EHRM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over kinderarbeid in de cacaoketen

MPs Dikkers, Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked the government about child labour in the cocoa chain, including the Child Labour Platform, IDH's programme links, the Harkin-Engel Protocol targets and the reliability of industry commitments. The State Secretary answered that the CLP was set up independently of IDH programmes, that child labour is integrated in certification standards, and that guarantees cannot be given, especially in Ivory Coast.
Guarantees can certainly not be given in Ivory Coast.
Zekerheden zijn zeker in Ivoorkust niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen Spekman en Voordewind over de knelpunten bij de opvang van zieke vreemdelingen

MPs Spekman and Voordewind asked the minister why only about 15 of over 300 medical-care requests by former asylum seekers led to shelter, and whether the rules on shelter for sick foreigners pending appeal should change. The minister rejected the claim that the motion is inadequately implemented, citing low uptake against an expected 1200 per year, and said only that he would encourage completing incomplete files, rejecting changes to appeal and interim-relief rules.

For former asylum seekers who do want to use the options the motion offers but submit incomplete medical data, I will encourage reducing the number of incomplete files, for example by improving information provision.

Voor ex-asielzoekers die wèl gebruik willen maken van de mogelijkheden die de motie biedt, maar de aangeleverde (medische) gegevens niet compleet aanleveren, zal ik stimuleren dat het aantal incomplete dossiers gereduceerd wordt
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over de mogelijke samenwerking tussen de Taliban en het Afghaanse leger

An MP asked the foreign minister whether a confidential NATO report shows Taliban cooperation with the Afghan army and Pakistani intelligence support for the Taliban, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledged the report but declined to discuss its contents under NATO rules, said cooperation with the Taliban is not on the table until preconditions are met, and said there is no evidence of Taliban infiltration of the Afghan security services it works with.
Under NATO regulations, the government makes no statements about the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van twee leiders van de op te richten christendemocratische part

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of two leaders of an intended Christian Democratic party in Belarus, whether it was linked to the party's founding, and what the government would do. The minister answered that the two were detained to prevent them attending a party congress, condemned the ongoing repression, and said Netherlands and the EU would continue to raise the matter bilaterally, in the OSCE and at the UN, and through expanded EU sanctions criteria.
I strongly condemn the ongoing repression.
Ik veroordeel de voortdurende repressie scherp.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de staatsecretarissen van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel obesitas in ontwikkelingslanden (ingezonden 20 december 2011)

An MP asks the State Secretaries for Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about reports that obesity in developing countries is rising and may cause more deaths than undernutrition, and whether Dutch export of calorie-rich products contributes. The government acknowledges the trend, says its food security policy addresses nutrition knowledge and fortification, and states that food products are not intrinsically healthy or unhealthy.
In my view, food products are not intrinsically healthy or unhealthy.
Naar mijn mening zijn voedselproducten zijn niet intrinsiek gezond of ongezond.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel «Kopten zetten Marinab in brand en schuiven het in de schoenen van Moslims» (ingezond

MPs Ormel, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about a Dutch NOS report attributing the burning of a Coptic church in Egypt to Muslims, and whether the report was one-sided and should be rectified. The minister replied that media choose their own sources and content, that the NOS must decide on any rectification, and that the Egyptian investigation results were not yet known.

The results of the investigation led by the Egyptian Minister of Justice into the background of the Maspero incident on 9 October, including the events around the Al Marinab church, are not yet known.

De resultaten van het onderzoek onder leiding van de Egyptische minister van Justitie naar de achtergrond van het Maspero-incident op 9 oktober jl., waaronder de gebeurtenissen rondom de Al Marinab kerk, zijn nog niet bekend.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over onregelmatigheden bij de Egyptische verkiezingen (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Ormel asked the foreign minister about irregularities in the Egyptian elections, including campaigning near polling stations, and whether these breached Egyptian electoral law and Article 25 ICCPR, and whether protest had been lodged. The minister acknowledged the irregularities, said the Carter Center and other observers found they did not affect the outcome, and saw no reason to press Egypt for stricter enforcement since authorities had acted to correct problems.
I therefore see no reason now to press, together with my EU colleagues, for stricter enforcement of the Egyptian electoral law.
Ik zie daarom nu geen reden om samen met mijn EU-collega’s aan te dringen op strengere handhaving van de Egyptische kieswet.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks), van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse zaken over de gerechtelijke uitspraak die de Staat

MPs from several parties asked whether the government would drop cassation against the Hague appeals court ruling holding the State liable for the deaths of three men during the Srebrenica genocide, and whether it would apologise to the victims' relatives. The minister answered that the ruling is an interim judgment so cassation is not yet possible, and reaffirmed the 2002 Kok cabinet statement on Dutch political co-responsibility rather than apologising.
The appeals court ruling is, technically speaking, an interim judgment.
De uitspraak van het hof is juridisch-technisch gezien een tussenarrest.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijkhoff (VVD), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van tientallen Turkse journalisten, acad

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the government judges the Turkish police arrest of dozens of journalists, writers and publishers, whether the charges link to publications on the Armenian genocide, and what Dutch steps and EU accession consequences follow. The minister answered that detainees are held pending a formal indictment under anti-terror law, that press freedom is under growing pressure, and that the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, with Turkey unable to join until it meets the accession conditions.
The Netherlands raises with the Turkish government, both bilaterally and through the EU, the importance of press freedom and freedom of expression for Turkey's democratic reform process.
Nederland spreekt zowel bilateraal als via de EU de Turkse regering aan op het belang van persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting voor het democratisch hervormingsproces in Turkije.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de geplande uitzetting van een stateloos echtpaar naar de Oekraïne (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Spekman asked the immigration minister about the planned deportation of a stateless couple to Ukraine, whether Dutch obligations under the statelessness conventions were met, and whether the government would halt the removal and work toward return to the US. The minister answered that the couple can apply for Ukrainian nationality themselves, that the removal rests on the EU-Ukraine readmission agreement, that US authorities refused re-entry, and that a court injunction is pending the objection decision, so removal is not yet possible.
The decision on the objection will therefore be awaited before departure can be considered.
Het besluit op het bezwaar zal dientengevolge worden afgewacht alvorens vertrek aan de orde kan zijn.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Pakistaanse wetgeving omtrent godslastering (ingezonden 31 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about Pakistan's blasphemy laws, including reports of mentally ill people prosecuted under them, and whether the government would press Pakistan to repeal them and order an independent inquiry. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and expressed concern about the laws' conflict with international human rights standards without committing to an inquiry or repeal demand.

The Netherlands raises with the Pakistani authorities, both bilaterally and multilaterally, the negative effects of the legislation and calls attention to the need for fair legal proceedings and correct treatment of those convicted.

Nederland wijst zowel in bilaterale als in multilaterale context de Pakistaanse autoriteiten op de negatieve uitwerking van de wetgeving en vraagt aandacht voor de noodzaak van een eerlijke rechtsgang en correcte behandeling van veroordeelden.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bezuinigingen op de 2.42-omroepen (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why cuts to the religious broadcasters (2.42 omroepen) are justified by claims that a quarter of their programming is not religious, and whether the budget cut should be revised given doubts about the viewing data. The Minister replies that the 2010 classification and the 2009 visitation committee support the finding of a broad interpretation of the religious mandate, that the cut is partly based on it and will not be revised, and that the NPO and Commissariaat will implement the reductions gradually.
I see no reason to go back on that.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om daar op terug te komen.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over kinderarbeid en de positie van Dalits in India (ingezonden 31 o

The MP Voordewind asks the ministers about the EU-India free trade deal's sustainability chapter, child labour, and the position of Dalits in India, and whether the minister raised Dalit discrimination on his visit. The government answers that Nederland pressed for a robust sustainability chapter, that it raised the Dalit issue, funded the IDSN, and that the state secretary raised the Sumangali system with India.

The Netherlands has repeatedly voiced concern within the European Union about the progress of the negotiations and urged the European Commission several times to include good sustainability commitments in the agreement.

Nederland heeft regelmatig binnen de Europese Unie zijn zorgen geuit over de voortgang van de onderhandelingen en verschillende keren bij de Europese Commissie aangedrongen op het opnemen van goede afspraken over duurzaamheid in het akkoord.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van een Afghaans asielzoekersgezin en de verwijdering van hun oudste zoon uit z

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the deportation of an Afghan asylum family, including arguments that the daughter had become westernised and that return would breach Article 3 ECHR, and about the removal of the eldest son from school. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the general assessment framework and the policy for westernised Afghan girls, and said no facts were known about the school removal.
As I have previously informed your House, I consider it in principle undesirable to provide information about individual cases.
Zoals ik uw Kamer eerder heb gemeld, acht ik het in beginsel onwenselijk informatie te verstrekken over individuele gevallen.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Smeets (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de ca

MPs from PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the state secretaries whether the cocoa sector is failing to eliminate child and forced adult labour, whether self-regulation works, and how the Dutch government intends to lead, including the scope of the 2010 cocoa sustainability declaration and the IDH programme. The government answered that progress is being made but the problem is not solved, that certification and the declaration are the main tools, that IDH is showing results, and that dialogue continues through the Child Labor Platform and international cocoa agreement.
I do not agree with your observation that self-regulation does not work.
Ik ben het niet met uw constatering eens dat zelfregulering niet werkt.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel «Spelfout van Pakistaans meisje is «godslastering» (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

MP Voordewind asks the Foreign Minister whether the government will protest to Pakistan over the treatment of a 10-year-old girl accused of blasphemy and of religious minorities, and whether it accepts the US commission's findings on Pakistan's blasphemy laws and will press for their repeal. The minister confirms concern about the blasphemy laws, says the Netherlands raises minority positions bilaterally and multilaterally, and states it regularly raises the blasphemy laws in contacts.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the blasphemy laws in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rond de blasfemiewetten in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.

Vragen namens de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de geruchtenstroom van een mogelijke terbeschikkingstelling van faciliteiten op Bonaire ten behoeve va

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Voordewind asked whether there are plans to make facilities on Bonaire available for the US FOL (Forward Operating Locations) agreement, and whether the government will state clearly that no such plans exist. Minister Rosenthal answered that the government has no such plans, that no facilities on Bonaire will be made available for US aerial reconnaissance under the FOL agreement, and that the Bonaire authorities have been informed.
No facilities for American aerial reconnaissance activities on Bonaire will be made available for the FOL agreement.
Er worden geen faciliteiten voor Amerikaanse luchtverkenningsactiviteiten op Bonaire ten behoeve van het FOL-verdrag ter beschikking gesteld.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van vijf tankstation-houders om bier en wijn te gaan verkope

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the health minister about five petrol station owners planning to sell beer and wine despite the Drank- en Horecawet ban, and about enforcement by the nVWA and mystery-shop results on underage alcohol sales. The minister answered that the plan breaches the law and enforcement will follow, gave 2008-2011 enforcement figures, said the Inspector-General will act where needed, and noted the national mystery-shop results were already sent to parliament.
If petrol station owners start selling beer and wine, action will be taken against it.
Indien tankstationhouders bier en wijn gaan verkopen, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het onderzoek op basis waarvan een project voor ex-ama’s is

Five MPs asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government's claim that the project for former unaccompanied minor asylum seekers performed worse than the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek was a misreading of the CVO research, and whether a scientifically sound comparison would be made. The minister answered that a sound comparison was not feasible for research reasons, that the CVO findings were correctly interpreted, and that the conclusion that the project was not performing stands.
No, there is no question of an incorrect interpretation of the CVO research.
Nee, van een onjuiste interpretatie van het onderzoek van CVO is geen sprake.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verheerlijken van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism through statements by Abbas's adviser, street naming, and prisoner and family payments, and how this squares with earlier answers and the adopted motion to cut aid. The minister answered that the statements cannot be confirmed in context, the government rejects glorification of terror, the issue is raised in EU human rights dialogue, prisoner aid is a standard welfare practice, and there is no structural PA policy of glorifying terrorism, so no aid cut is warranted.
In light of the above answers, I currently see no reason to end bilateral or EU development cooperation with the PA.
In het licht van bovenstaande antwoorden zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om de bilaterale of de EU-ontwikkelingssamenwerking met de PA te beëindigen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verheerlijking van gew

Opposition MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism and pays salaries and prisoner allowances to terrorists, despite Dutch funding, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister acknowledged sympathy for terrorism among part of the population, said PA leaders distance themselves from terrorism, rejected that the aid funded terrorist payments, and saw no reason to halt the payments or the Dutch contribution.
I see no reason to call on the PA to revise this arrangement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de PA op te roepen deze regeling te herzien.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Ormel (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het oppakken door de Oezbeekse politie van vier christenen (ingezonden 29

MPs from SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister about the arrest of four Christians by Uzbek police, the number of Christians jailed for their faith, the worsening pressure on religious groups, and EU and Dutch action. The minister replied that the four were released without interrogation after one day, that the exact number of jailed Christians is unknown, and that the EU raises religious freedom and individual cases in its human rights dialogue.
The group of four was released after one day in detention.
Het viertal is na een dag hechtenis vrijgelaten.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Spekman (PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het lid Wilders (PVV) dat een immigratiedaling van 50 procent

Four MPs asked the immigration minister whether he was aware of PVV leader Wilders' claim that immigration of non-Western migrants would fall by 50 percent, and how the government would prevent such statements from damaging the Netherlands' image. The minister replied that the government's package of measures is expected to cut inflows substantially over the longer term, that there are no target percentages, that the PVV is responsible for its own statements, and that 2010 and early 2011 figures do not yet show a decline.
As the cabinet has stated several times, there are no target percentages.
Zoals het kabinet verschillende keren heeft aangegeven 2 is er geen sprake van streefpercentages.

Vragen namens de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van de Chinese huiskerkleider Shi Enhao (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether China's treatment of Christians has structurally worsened, whether the ambassador will be summoned over the administrative detention of house-church leader Shi Enhao, and whether China will be urged to ratify the ICCPR. The minister answered that Christians in unregistered house churches are tolerated but lack legal protection, that Dutch concerns will be raised via EU channels and bilateral human rights consultations, and that China has no timetable for ratification.
The Netherlands, partly within the EU, strongly advocates better legal protection for Chinese people subject to this kind of administrative measures and detention.
Nederland maakt zich mede in EU-verband sterk voor betere rechtsbescherming van Chinezen aan wie dit soort administratieve maatregelen en detenties worden opgelegd.

Vragen namens de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugdraaien van het besluit om de tegoeden van IHH-N

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked whether the government would appeal a court ruling that suspended the freezing of IHH-Nederland's assets over alleged Hamas links, and how it could guarantee funds do not reach Hamas, including via IHH-Germany. The minister answered that the government argued in court for keeping the freeze, that the ruling is only a provisional measure with no appeal possible, that the objection has now been rejected so IHH-Nederland can take the matter to the administrative court, and that German authorities supervise IHH-Germany's finances so no separate information request is planned.
However, no appeal is possible against the ruling of the provisional relief judge.
Tegen de uitspraak van de voorlopige voorzieningenrechter is echter geen beroep mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verwijzing naar de islamitische wetgeving in de «routekaart» van de Transit

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and CDA asked the foreign minister about the TNC Libya roadmap's reference to Islam as state religion and sharia as main legislative source, and whether this affects recognition of the TNC. The minister answered that the draft charter guarantees religious freedom and non-discrimination, that the NTC does not aim for a strict Islamic regime, and that Libya itself decides on a state religion while being bound by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
It is up to (the 'new') Libya to determine whether it wants a state religion, and if so which one.
Het is aan (het «nieuwe») Libië om te bepalen of het een staatsgodsdienst wil, en zo ja welke.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van 850 000 euro

MPs from several parties asked why the 850,000 euro promised in 2009 for Balongsari (Rawagede) has not been fully disbursed, how much went via Hivos and an agreement with Indonesia's Interior Ministry, and whether the funds will be released quickly. The ministers explained a 250,000 euro microcredit project run by Hivos is operating, the school/market/health project is delayed in Indonesian administrative procedures, and funds will be transferred once preparations are complete, with Dutch monitoring.
Embassy funds can only be transferred to the Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs once the aforementioned preparations are completed.
Fondsen van de ambassade kunnen pas naar het Indonesische ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken worden overgemaakt als eerdergenoemde voorbereidingen afgerond zijn.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Spekman (PvdA) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Iraanse vrouw en haar twee kinderen (in

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and SP asked the immigration minister about the possible expulsion of an Iranian woman and her two children, and about a pending new country report on Iran. The minister replied that expulsion is not currently imminent because a follow-up asylum application was filed, that the report and new country report were sent to parliament, and that the family may await the decision in the Netherlands.
There is currently no question of an imminent expulsion of the woman and her children.
Van een dreigende uitzetting van de vrouw en haar kinderen is thans geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Chinese journalisten onder huisarrest (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Chinese writers were placed under house arrest during the Beijing book fair where the Netherlands was guest of honour, and what the government is doing to raise it with Beijing. The minister says the facts are only partly confirmed, that the government raises restrictions in human rights consultations, and that individual cases are raised quietly where that is effective.
Individual cases are only raised in EU and bilateral contacts when this is effective and does not endanger those involved.
Individuele gevallen worden in EU en bilaterale contacten alleen dan genoemd wanneer dit effectief is en het geen gevaar oplevert voor betrokkenen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over steun van de gemeente Vlaardingen aan ini

MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Vlaardingen and its mayor, through subsidies and participation in a Palestinian event, supported the Gaza flotilla and anti-Israel activity, and whether this fits the law and the government's Middle East policy. The minister answered that the mayor attended in a civic capacity, that the municipality had no subsidy relationship with the organisations named, and that the government would intervene if a local authority supported antisemitic or terrorist organisations.
The government therefore does not consider the conduct of the municipality of Vlaardingen and of the mayor in this matter to be targeted support for the Gaza flotilla.
Het optreden van de gemeente Vlaardingen en van de burgemeester in onderliggende kwestie beschouwt de regering derhalve niet als gerichte ondersteuning van de Gaza-vloot.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (Christen Unie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het RTL Nieuwsinterview met de politiecommandant Samiullah Qatra (ingezonden 30 augustus

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether trained Afghan police in Kunduz would be drawn into fighting, as the provincial police chief suggested on RTL, and whether this fits agreements with Afghan authorities. The government answered that the trained police are only for civilian tasks, that agreements with Afghan authorities exclude offensive military use, and that it would take appropriate measures if they were involved in offensive action.
If Dutch-trained police were nevertheless drawn into offensive military actions, that would breach the agreements made and the government will take appropriate measures, as agreed with your House.

Als door Nederland opgeleide agenten toch betrokken zouden worden bij offensieve militaire acties, zou dat in strijd zijn met de gemaakte afspraken en zal de regering passende maatregelen nemen, zoals is afgesproken met uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Immigratie en Asiel over de dreigende doodstraf voor de Iraanse predikant Yoesef Nadarkhani (ingezonden

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether the government protested the reaffirmed death sentence against Iranian pastor Yoesef Nadarkhani, whether it would summon the Iranian ambassador, whether the sentence worsens the position of Christians in Iran, and whether deportations of Iranian Christians would be suspended pending a thematic country report. The ministers answered that EU embassies are seeking clarity, Netherlands will protest within the EU if the sentence stands, no conclusions can yet be drawn, and a new general country report was published on 25 August with asylum policy to be reviewed if needed.
If the death sentence is upheld, the Netherlands will protest against it within the EU.
Indien het doodvonnis wordt gehandhaafd, zal Nederland in EU-verband hiertegen protest aantekenen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het lot van de Iraakse familie Karim naar aanleiding van een uitzending van VARA Uitgesprok

MPs Spekman, Dibi and Voordewind asked the immigration minister why he did not assess a VARA broadcast showing risks of blood revenge against the Karim family after their forced return to Iraq, and whether he would investigate or allow a new asylum application. The minister refused further investigation, arguing a broadcast is not an objective source and reopening cases would undermine the asylum procedure, while partly explaining the six-year IND decision delay by a lengthy investigation into the father and a moratorium on Iraq decisions.
My starting point is that information on individual cases is treated confidentially.
Uitgangspunt is voor mij dat informatie over individuele zaken vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat er geen sprake zou zijn geweest van gedwong

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister whether an Iranian asylum seeker who took his own life was told that forced removal was not possible, whether detention without realistic prospects of removal is acceptable, and whether courts are misled by claims of 'prospect of removal'. The minister confirmed the matter was discussed in a 2009 departure interview, stated that forced return to Iran is not impossible in all cases if the person cooperates, and denied that courts are misled.
The conversation report can be found in the annex for confidential inspection.
Het gespreksverslag vindt u in de bijlage ter vertrouwelijke inzage.
Vragen van lid het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over bijna 1000 ondergrondse Hezbollah militaire posten in Zuid-Libanon (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the government shares concerns that nearly 1000 Hezbollah underground military sites in southern Lebanon violate UN Security Council resolution 1701, threaten renewed conflict, and breach international humanitarian law, and whether it will press for a UN investigation and dismantling. The minister answered that arms in Lebanon are subject to Lebanese government control, that the Netherlands has raised its concerns with the Lebanese army and the UN Special Envoy, and that Lebanon is responsible for compliance with UN resolutions.
The Netherlands recently conveyed its concerns to both the commander of the Lebanese armed forces and Michael Williams, the UN Secretary-General's special envoy.
Nederland heeft recent zijn zorgen overgebracht aan zowel de commandant van de Libanese strijdkrachten, als Michael Williams, de speciaal gezant van de SGVN.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld tegen christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about deadly violence against Coptic Christians in Cairo in May 2011, including its background, condemnation of the attacks, the Egyptian response, and what concrete results Dutch and EU pressure has achieved. The minister answered that the government has consistently raised religious violence with Egypt, outlined the causes and arrests (including trial before emergency security courts that lack appeal), and described Egyptian reform measures on places of worship and discrimination, while stressing that implementation and fair trials remain the real test.
The Netherlands consistently raises the violence against religious minorities with Egypt, both in multilateral frameworks and in bilateral contacts.
Nederland spreekt Egypte zowel in multilateraal kader als in bilaterale contacten consequent aan op het geweld tegen religieuze minderheden.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Van Bommel (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de eigenstandige positie van Taiwan (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

Four MPs asked the foreign minister how the EU, US and China stance on Taiwan's international standing is changing and what Dutch support for Taiwan's participation in international bodies would look like. The minister answered that the policies of the US, EU and member states have not changed, that Dutch policy follows the one-China principle, and that Taiwan's membership of international organisations is supported only where all parties agree.
The Netherlands and the other EU member states recognise the government in Beijing as the lawful government of China (one China policy).
Nederland en de andere lidstaten van de EU erkennen de regering in Peking als wettige regering van China (één China beleid).

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van het Egyptische leger bij de vervolging van koptische christenen (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Egyptian military, which governs after the revolution, actively contributed to attacks on Coptic Christians, whether it will condemn this, and whether the government will press Egypt's military council in bilateral and EU channels to protect Copts. The minister acknowledges police shortfalls outside major cities, notes the embassy is exploring local reconciliation projects, states that the Muslim Brotherhood will be judged on democratic principles, and says the Copts' position has been raised repeatedly in EU and bilateral talks.
Bilaterally too, the vulnerable position of the Copts is raised, both by the ambassador in Cairo and here with the Egyptian ambassador and visitors from Egypt.
Ook bilateraal wordt de kwetsbare positie van de Kopten aangekaart, zowel door de ambassadeur in Kairo, als alhier bij de Egyptische ambassadeur en bezoekers uit Egypte.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechten

MPs Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn and Braakhuis asked the state secretaries about labour and environmental abuses in electronics supply chains (Foxconn/Apple), transparency laws, and government procurement safeguards. The government condemned the abuses, pointed to OECD guidelines, industry initiatives and procurement criteria, but declined a Dutch supply chain transparency law as disproportionate and costly.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Ten Broeke (VVD), De Roon (PVV) een Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe Gaza-flottielje (ingezonden 21

MPs from four parties asked the foreign and justice ministers whether a Dutch charity (ISRAA) collected 100,000 euro for a new Gaza flotilla, whether an Italian partner and the Union of Good are linked, and whether this warrants reviewing participating organisations or stopping the flotilla. The government answered that Greece has banned the ships from sailing, that it cannot confirm the donation figure or the Union of Good links, and that it cannot prevent private persons or organisations from participating despite discouraging it.
I cannot make any statements about possible links with the Union of Good.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over mogelijke banden met de Union of Good.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de toenemende christenvervolging in Ch

Three MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the rising persecution of Christians in China, including arrests of churchgoers, and whether the government would condemn it and raise it with Beijing during a trade mission. The minister answered that concerns about religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU, and that human rights were discussed during the trade mission, but gave no new concrete commitments.
The Netherlands has repeatedly expressed concern to Chinese authorities about the lack of religious freedom in China and will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk tegenover Chinese autoriteiten zorg uitgesproken over de gebrekkige vrijheid van religie in China en zal dat blijven doen.
Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de minister van Defensie over criminele bendes in Kunduz (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether criminal gangs and radical Islamist groups in Kunduz change the security assessment and threaten Dutch police trainers, and whether Afghan police can handle them. The government answered that the security situation fits earlier assessments, that the training mission can proceed as planned, and that training covers dealing with the complex local security environment, without committing to new concrete steps.
The government has confidence that the police training mission will be able to carry out its activities as planned.
De regering heeft er vertrouwen in dat de politietrainingsmissie haar activiteiten zal kunnen uitvoeren zoals voorzien.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over boycot van de Durban III Conferentie (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether the Netherlands would follow the US, Canada and Israel in boycotting the Durban III conference, and what signs there were of antisemitism or anti-Israel content. The minister answered that the government will boycott the conference if the political declaration does not explicitly distance itself from Middle East references in the DDPA or if antisemitic or anti-Israel messages are expected.

The Government will boycott the conference if it becomes clear that the political declaration referred to in the answer to question 3 does not explicitly distance itself from the paragraphs of the DDPA that refer to the Middle East.

De Regering zal de conferentie boycotten, indien duidelijk wordt dat in de in het antwoord op vraag 3 bedoelde politieke verklaring, geen expliciete afstand zal worden genomen van de paragrafen in de DDPA waarin wordt verwezen naar het Midden-Oosten.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, Defensie en Veiligheid en Justitie over het mogelijke negatieve advies van de Nederlandse Politiebond inzake d

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked whether the Dutch police union's possible negative advice on the Afghanistan police training mission reflects worsening security in Kunduz, whether German signals of concern are accurate, whether trainers' safety and training plans still hold, whether security information will be shared with police unions, and whether there is concern about willingness to volunteer. Minister Opstelten answered that the security situation fits earlier briefings, that EUPOL assesses it twice daily and the government has confidence in the mission, that unions are regularly informed, and that volunteer supply is currently sufficient.
The government has confidence that the police officers in the EUPOL mission can carry out their tasks responsibly under these circumstances and closely monitors the general security situation.

De regering heeft er vertrouwen in dat de politiefunctionarissen in de EUPOL missie onder deze omstandigheden hun taken op een verantwoorde wijze kunnen uitvoeren en houdt de algemene veiligheidssituatie nauwlettend in het oog.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Defensie over de dreigende sluiting van recreatiepark «OASE Hoenderloo» dat grenst aan Schietkamp Harskamp (ingezonden 8

MPs Ten Broeke, Knops and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister why Defence will not renew the ground lease of recreation park OASE Hoenderloo, which borders a shooting range, and whether it will reconsider given budget cuts and a residents' counter-proposal. The minister answers that the range's 2007 environmental permit with noise zoning restricts its operational use, that the lease ends by law in 2013 and was announced in 2008, and that there is no link to budget cuts, so no reconsideration is planned, while ongoing talks with the owners are not disrupted by direct contact with the residents' committee.
To prevent these talks with the owners from being disrupted, Defence has communicated with the residents' committee of De Oase only in writing.
Om te voorkomen dat deze gesprekken met de eigenaren worden doorkruist, heeft Defensie met de recreantencommissie van De Oase alleen schriftelijk gecommuniceerd.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), De Roon (PVV) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de groeiende crisis tussen Hamas en Israël (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about the Hamas-Israel crisis, including the EU High Representative's statement on violence, the Arab League's call for a no-fly zone over Gaza, and whether the Arab League had condemned rocket fire. The minister answered that the EU statement does not equate both sides, opposed a no-fly zone, and said the Arab League had not issued the condemnation, a difference to be discussed in regular meetings.
Such a condemnation has not been issued by the Arab League.
Een dergelijke veroordeling is niet door de Arabische Liga uitgebracht.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraken van de minister in het programma T

The MP asks about the cost and maintenance of Paleis Soestdijk, its possible reuse and the future of the Nationaal Historisch Museum, including whether the government will commission a feasibility study.
