The minister replies that renovation costs exceed EUR 100 million with no funds available, that the state as owner bears upkeep, that the NHM's future is for the foundation to decide, and that no feasibility study will be commissioned.
The cabinet takes no position on dissolving the NHM.
Het kabinet neemt geen standpunt in over het opheffen van het NHM.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Van Bommel (SP) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bewering dat in Afghanistan producten met kinder- en slavenarbeid worde

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether NATO/ISAF-funded construction in Afghanistan uses bricks made with child and slave labour, and what NATO and the Afghan government are doing about it. The government answered that NATO screens contractors on child labour, that direct contractors can reasonably be assumed to use no child or slave labour though firm guarantees are impossible given security, that an ILO study is planned, and that a contract clause on child labour is used in Kunduz.
However, firm guarantees cannot be given given the security situation and the resulting limited possibilities for control.
Harde garanties zijn gezien de veiligheidssituatie en de daardoor beschikbare mogelijkheden tot controle echter niet te geven.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het kabinet de groei van het aantal zorgleerlingen sterk heeft overdreven (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether the government overstated growth in pupils needing special support by 65%, and why the error was acknowledged only two months later. The minister answers that the 65% refers to growth in heavy-care indications (lgf and (v)so) from about 65,000 to 107,000 between 2003 and 2009, that the overall 15% figure concerns light and heavy care combined, that no error was made, and that she sees no need for new research or to revisit the budget cuts.
I therefore will not reconsider the size of the cut to inclusive education.
Ik ga dan ook niet opnieuw kijken naar de hoogte van de bezuiniging op passend onderwijs.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat er door de gemeente Amsterdam wordt gedreigd met het bevriezen van geld voor huisvesting van scholen

MP Voordewind asks the Minister of Education whether Amsterdam's threat to freeze school housing funds as leverage over school provision is lawful, and about underinvestment in school buildings by municipalities. The Minister says using housing funds as a bargaining tool is undesirable and legally untenable, that housing is a municipal responsibility with appeal rights open to schools, and that remaining issues are local matters, while promising to await studies on municipal spending and a possible decentralisation review.
Using school housing funds by a municipality as a means of power against legitimate wishes of a school board is in my view undesirable and not legally tenable.
Het aanwenden door een gemeente van huisvestingsgeld voor scholen als machtsmiddel tegen gerechtvaardigde wensen van een schoolbestuur acht ik niet wenselijk en wettelijk niet houdbaar

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie waarin in een

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how the government will respond to a CJEU ruling that imprisoning an irregular migrant for illegal stay conflicts with the Return Directive, and whether the planned criminalisation of illegal stay and breach of entry bans is therefore incompatible with EU law. The Minister declined to pre-judge the pending bill and the Raad van State advice, said the ruling concerned Italian law, and stated the government will respect EU law while seeking to change EU rules.
It does not seem appropriate to anticipate the handling of this bill now.
Het lijkt mij niet opportuun nu reeds op de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vooruit te lopen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de nieuwe Gaza-flottielje (ingezon

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked whether the government would act against Dutch involvement in a new Gaza flotilla, including links between organisers and Hamas, a possible terrorism past of the Dutch organiser, and whether the Public Prosecution Service is investigating related organisations and whether the flotilla should be banned. The government answered that existing information does not justify action against the individuals, declined to comment on criminal records or any ongoing investigation for investigative reasons, and said it cannot prevent departures but strongly discourages participation.

As far as the question concerns whether criminal investigation is taking place or not, no statement can be made about this, because it may undermine investigative interests, not even on whether such an investigation is or is not ongoing.

Voor zover de vraag betrekking heeft op het al dan niet plaatsvinden van strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan hierover, vanwege het mogelijk doorkruisen van opsporingsbelangen, geen enkele mededeling worden gedaan, ook niet ten aanzien van de vraag of dergelijk onderzoek wel of niet loopt.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Goldstone-rapport (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs from three parties asked the foreign minister how the government views Goldstone's reconsideration of his report on alleged Israeli war crimes in Operation Cast Lead, and whether it will seek to have the report's conclusions rejected in the EU and UN. The minister welcomed Goldstone's reconsideration, said the government does not adopt the commission's qualifications and trusts Israel's internal investigations, but declined to reject the whole report and promised to raise its treatment again at the next opportunity.
For the government this was not so much premature as a reason to urge further investigation, as also set out in the cited government letter.
Voor de regering was dit niet zozeer voorbarig, als wel aanleiding voor de aansporing tot nader onderzoek, zoals ook uiteengezet in de aangehaalde brief van de regering.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van acht Iraakse gezinnen naar Irak (ingezond

MPs from several parties asked the minister about the forced deportation of eight Iraqi families, including thirteen minors, their detention in Rotterdam, and alleged rough treatment by police. The minister confirmed six families were deported, said families were informed of legal remedies, defended detention periods as within policy, denied reported mistreatment, and described the escort arrangements.

All aliens were explicitly informed, through information leaflets and my letter to the House of 30 November 2010 and the answers to earlier parliamentary questions, of the possibility to pursue legal remedies against the planned deportation and to contact their lawyer.

Alle vreemdelingen zijn door middel van informatiebladen en mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 30 november 2010 over de uitvoering van de motie Voordewind en door uitreiking van de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) van 25 november 2010 expliciet gewezen op de mogelijkheid rechtsmiddelen aan te wenden tegen de voorgenomen uitzetting en op de mogelijkheid om contact op te nemen met hun advocaat.

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

MPs Schouw, Janssen, Voordewind and Spekman asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether criminalising illegal residence, as foreseen in a second amendment to the Aliens Act implementing the Return Directive, is compatible with the Directive and with the European Commission's answers to Parliament's questions. The Minister answered that the bill sanctions only stay in breach of an entry ban, not illegal residence as such, that the Commission's position is noted and will be respected, and that no further Council of State advice is needed.
I want to emphasise that the bill as it lies before the House does not contain criminalisation of illegal residence.
Ik wil benadrukken dat het wetvoorstel zoals dat in uw Kamer voorligt, geen strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf inhoudt.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over slechte controle op leeftijdsgrenzen bij alcoholverstrekking en de falende campagnes om naleving te verbeteren (inge

An MP asks the health minister about weak age-check enforcement for alcohol sales, failed compliance campaigns, the three-strikes-out sanction in the new Drank- en Horecawet, and raising the minimum age to 18. The minister acknowledges low compliance (32%), says enforcement will move to municipalities with a one-year three-strikes window, and rejects raising the age limit for now while promising consultation with industry.
That is why the new Drank- en Horecawet proposes transferring supervision to municipalities.
Daarom is in de nieuwe Drank- en Horecawet het voorstel opgenomen het toezicht over te dragen aan gemeenten.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) Van Bommel (SP) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een aanslag op koptische christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether authorities had failed to arrest and prosecute the perpetrators of a killing of Coptic Christians in Egypt, and about the role of the Muslim Brotherhood and their stance toward it. The minister answered that the killing stemmed from a family feud with the perpetrators arrested, and that the government will judge all parties, including the Muslim Brotherhood, against democratic and rule-of-law principles.
Both the Netherlands and the EU call for Egypt's transition to a full democratic constitutional state.
Nederland als de EU pleit voor een transitie van Egypte naar een volwaardige democratische rechtsstaat.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verheerlijking van het zelfmoordterrorisme op de staatstelevisie van de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 21 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Authority state television glorifying suicide terrorism and whether this undermines the two-state solution and the invitation to President Abbas. The minister condemns such glorification, finds no evidence it is structural, rejects that the PA abandons the two-state solution, and sees no reason to withdraw the invitation.
The government distances itself from these statements on Palestinian state television.
De regering neemt afstand van deze verklaringen op Palestijnse staatstelevisie.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bewering dat in Afghanistan producten met kinder- en slavenarbeid worden gebruikt in NAVO-projecten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether NATO-funded Afghan construction contracts use bricks made with child and forced labour, and what the government will do about it. The ministers answered that NATO has zero-tolerance clauses in newer contracts, that the matter has been raised with NATO's civilian representative, and that the Netherlands supports child-rights programmes in Uruzgan and Afghan institutions, without giving a substantive verdict on the specific allegations.
It has been learned from NATO that ISAF closely monitors how ISAF funds are spent.
Van de NAVO is vernomen dat ISAF nadrukkelijk controleert op welke wijze ISAF fondsen worden uitgegeven.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over inbeslagneming van een schip met wapens door Israël (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether reports of Israel seizing a ship carrying Iranian-origin arms bound for Hamas in Gaza are confirmed, and what the Netherlands will do to counter arms smuggling. The minister answers that the government only has the information Israel provided, cannot independently confirm the origin or route, sees no binding international regime on this specific smuggling, and participates in an international counter-smuggling initiative.
The Dutch government does not have independent information to confirm these facts, or the reports about the client and sailing route.
De Nederlandse regering beschikt niet over onafhankelijke informatie om deze feiten, dan wel de berichten over de opdrachtgever en vaarroute, te kunnen bevestigen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het aantal lang verblijvende, verwesterde Afghaanse meisjes

Opposition MPs asked the immigration minister how many long-resident Afghan girls resembling Sahar Hbrahimgel face removal, and whether her case and her family's circumstances should weigh in residence decisions. The minister answered that the family will receive a residence permit, that a few dozen to about a hundred girls may qualify under new policy, and that he cannot say how many of the 110 pending cases involve fathers subject to Article 1F, citing limits of the IND information system.
It is not possible to provide figures, because asylum seekers and their family members do not always arrive at the same time.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers te geven, omdat asielzoekers en hun gezinsleden niet altijd gelijktijdig inreizen
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de steun van president Abbas aan terroristen (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether President Abbas paid $2000 to a suicide bomber's family, whether this is common practice, and whether an independent inquiry and aid consequences should follow. The minister said payments could not be confirmed, that the EU monitors such matters and that a one-off presidential survivor payment was made, and that she has confidence in EU monitoring and will act if the PA is found to endorse violence.
I have confidence in the monitoring carried out by the EU and in the means the EU has to address the PA on its conduct where cases arise.
Ik heb vertrouwen in de monitoring zoals uitgevoerd door de EU en in de middelen die de EU heeft om in voorkomende gevallen de PA aan te spreken op haar gedrag.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks), Voordewind (CU) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over uitspraken van de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel in

Six MPs asked the immigration minister whether his media remarks linking the Hbrahimgel family's repeated asylum procedures to delay were accurate, and whether the family's prolonged stay and their children's interests were fairly weighed. The minister said the remarks were about future procedural policy, that the case was reassessed under new policy on westernised girls to Afghanistan, and that because a residence permit will be granted, his appeal will be withdrawn.
Since the Hbrahimgel family will be granted a residence permit, the appeal will be withdrawn.
Aangezien aan het gezin Hbrahimgel een vergunning zal worden verleend, wordt het hoger beroep ingetrokken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Schouw (D66), Dibi (Groenlinks), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Somal

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the planned deportation of a Somali former Muslim convert to Christianity to Somaliland, citing Somaliland's constitution and sharia, and whether the IND's position on Christians being able to practise faith quietly holds. The minister answered that the courts found no risk of persecution or Article 3 ECHR violation, that such cases are assessed individually, and saw no reason to change deportation policy or the decision.
In view of the above, I do not share your view that the person concerned fears for his life upon return to Somaliland.
Gezien het bovenstaande deel ik uw mening dat betrokkene te vrezen heeft voor zijn leven bij terugkeer naar Somaliland niet.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), De Roon (PVV) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitspraken van de Britse premier Cameron (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about UK Prime Minister Cameron's statement that Israel may search ships bound for Gaza, and about a planned new Gaza flotilla and a preparatory meeting in Amsterdam. The minister confirmed Israel's inspection powers under the Oslo accords and naval blockade law, said no EU support drive was needed, opposed unfacilitated flotilla participation, and declined to ban the Amsterdam meeting.
As for measures to prohibit meetings such as the one in Amsterdam, I currently see neither the possibilities nor the reason to do so.
Voor maatregelen om bijeenkomsten zoals die in Amsterdam te verbieden, zie ik op dit moment mogelijkheden noch aanleiding.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van UNRWA bij het verheerlijken van een zelfmoordterrorist (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

Two ChristenUnie and SGP MPs asked the foreign minister whether UNRWA was involved in glorifying a female suicide bomber through a football tournament named after her. The government answered that the report was incorrect, that UNRWA had not run youth centres in the West Bank for over ten years, that the logo was used without authorisation and UNRWA asked for its removal, and that there was no basis for linking UNRWA to glorifying terrorism.
UNRWA raised the matter with the organisation and asked for the logo to be removed.
UNRWA heeft de organisatie hier op aangesproken en verzocht het logo te verwijderen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Knops (CDA), Voordewind (CU) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over Egyptische asielzoekers (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Four MPs asked the immigration minister how many Egyptian asylum seekers had been refused and told to leave, whether Coptic Christians can safely return given recent violence, when updated country reports would appear, and whether deportations should pause amid upheaval. The minister said refusals were indicative only, that individual assessment remains the basis, that no separate country report was needed, and that no departure moratorium applies to Egypt at present.
On the basis of these indicative figures it cannot be concluded that this is also the actual number of former Egyptian asylum seekers who had to leave the Netherlands.
Op basis van deze indicatieve cijfers kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat dit ook het daadwerkelijke aantal Egyptische ex-asielzoekers betreft die Nederland daadwerkelijk moest verlaten.
Vragen van de leden Ormel (CDA), Voordewind (CU) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de doodstraf opgelegd aan een Afghaanse christen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about a death sentence reportedly imposed on a Afghan convert to Christianity, and about the status of a second detained convert, plus steps to prevent executions and protect religious freedom. The minister replied that Musa has been released and is outside Afghanistan, that Assadullah is detained without a formal charge, and that the government raises the issue discreetly at high levels, stressing the need for religious freedom and a moratorium on the death penalty.
Given the sensitivity of the subject of conversion within Afghan society, it is however of utmost importance that the international effort take place discreetly.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van het onderwerp «bekering» binnen de Afghaanse samenleving is het echter van het grootste belang dat de internationale inspanning discreet plaatsvinden.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het aantal lang verblijvende, verwesterde Afghaanse meisjes

MPs asked the immigration minister how many Afghan women and girls were deported over ten years, how many lack residence status and how many have stayed over ten years, in the wake of the Sahar case. The minister gave partial figures, estimated about 400 girls in similar circumstances, said precise numbers over ten years cannot be given, and declined to change policy or use discretion in the individual case.
As your House is aware, no reliable quantitative data can be provided on persons staying illegally outside the government's view.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kunnen geen betrouwbare kwantitatieve gegevens worden gegeven over personen die in de illegaliteit buiten het zicht van de overheid verblijven.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Kortenoeven (PVV) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestaties van christenen in Iran (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister about reports that around 70 Christians were arrested in Iran at Christmas, possibly held in Evin prison and pressed to renounce their faith, and about rising persecution of Christians in Muslim-majority countries. The minister confirmed a December 2010 arrest of several dozen house-church visitors, said he had no information on those detained, and described Dutch and EU pressure on Iran and other states over religious freedom.
I have no information about the people arrested.
Ik heb geen informatie over de gearresteerde personen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Iran: Christians imprisoned without charge» (ingezonden 1

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether four Christians held in Iran without charge, including a Dutch-Iranian dual national, could be helped through consular and legal assistance and whether the government would inform parliament. The minister answered that the embassy had not obtained formal confirmation from Iranian authorities, that Iran refuses consular access to dual nationals, and that Nederland has raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU while promising to keep parliament informed.
I will keep the House regularly informed of developments.
Ik zal de Kamer met regelmaat op de hoogte houden van ontwikkelingen.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vastleggen van de evolutietheorie in de nieuwe leerlijn biologie (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the education minister whether a biology learning line that fixes evolution theory as the dominant view limits schools' freedom to teach from their own foundation, and whether schools can still balance their teaching and lesson materials. The minister replies that only the exam programme is set by government, schools keep the same room as before to present other views, and teaching materials and their selection remain free under the freedom of education.
From the government side, only the examination programme is established.
Vanuit de overheid wordt uitsluitend het examenprogramma vastgesteld.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toenemende aanvallen op christenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the conviction of Antonius Bawengan under Indonesia's blasphemy law, attacks on churches, and whether Indonesia meets its obligations to protect religious minorities. The minister said he would press the issue at the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue, noted the government condemned the church attacks and ordered prosecutions, and described the situation as incidents rather than systematic persecution.
I will urge that this issue be raised at the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue planned for March 2011.
Ik zal erop aandringen dat deze kwestie aan de orde wordt gesteld tijdens de in maart 2011 geplande EU-Indonesië mensenrechten-dialoog.

Vragen van de leden Ormel (CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gewelddadige radicale moslims in Indonesië (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Three MPs (CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP) asked the foreign minister whether violent attacks by radical Muslims on religious minorities in Indonesia are increasing, whether such incidents go unpunished, and whether the Dutch government will raise concerns with Indonesian authorities and at EU level. The minister acknowledged a rising number of incidents, mainly in West and East Java, attributed partly to local permit obstruction and inadequate local police action, and said the Indonesian government has prioritized prosecution and the embassy will raise the issue, including at the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
My ministry and the embassy in Jakarta continue to closely follow further developments.
Mijn ministerie en de ambassade in Jakarta blijven verdere ontwikkelingen op de voet volgen.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mishandeling van een christelijke dissident in China (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether he has seen reports of police beating Christian dissident Chen Guangcheng and his wife under house arrest, and whether the government will protest to the Chinese ambassador, demand medical access, and press for religious and political freedom. The minister confirms awareness, says the EU has raised the case and will continue to, and that the Netherlands raises civil and political rights and religious freedom bilaterally and in the EU.
The EU has repeatedly raised the situation of Mr Chen with the Chinese authorities and will continue to do so.
De EU heeft meermalen bij de Chinese autoriteiten aandacht gevraagd voor de situatie van de heer Chen en zal dit blijven doen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over commerciële zenders die FunX weren uit het radioluisteronderzoek (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

MPs Dibi and Voordewind asked the minister whether commercial radio broadcasters were sabotaging improvements to the Continuous Listening Survey (CLO), which excludes urban youth and minorities such as FunX's audience, and what could be done. The minister denied sabotage, said the survey is the responsibility of the broadcasters through the RAB, pointed to a tender for a new 2012 survey with attention to representativeness, and said talks were underway about earlier improvements.
The listening survey is a responsibility of the radio broadcasters themselves. I have no direct influence on it.
Het luisteronderzoek is een verantwoordelijkheid van de radiozenders zelf. Ik heb daar geen directe invloed op.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de op handen zijnde uitzetting van een Somaliër (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

An ChristenUnie MP asks the ministers whether a Christian convert from Islam from Somaliland faces danger if deported, and challenges the IND's reasoning that he need not make his faith public and the ministry's handling of Somali Christian persecution information. The minister replies that no concrete deportation is planned, that the asylum decision follows policy on minority religions, and that deportation to Somaliland remains possible.
The person has no lawful residence and must therefore leave the Netherlands independently.
Betrokkene heeft geen rechtmatig verblijf en dient Nederland derhalve zelfstandig te verlaten.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over een zelfmoordaanslag voor een kerk in Alexandrië, Egypte (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the government about the New Year's Eve suicide bombing of a church in Alexandria, Egypt, whether it was carried out by Islamic State of Iraq, and what the government would do about protecting Christians and religious freedom. The minister answered that the attack was unclaimed, that Egyptian authorities attribute it to a splinter group, that the EU condemned it, and that religious freedom is raised systematically with Egypt, including a commitment to raise it on a planned visit.
Further information on the outcome of the investigation by the Egyptian authorities has not been made public.
Verdere informatie over het resultaat van het onderzoek van de Egyptische autoriteiten is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over steun aan buitenlandse organisaties (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister about Dutch-funded ICCO support for Electronic Intifada, a website accused of anti-Semitism, and whether grantees can be conditioned on consistency with Dutch foreign policy. The minister confirms ICCO funded the site with 150,000 euro in MFS funds and 50,000 euro of own funds, says it is incompatible with policy, and commits to pressing ICCO and other MFS grantees and to possible subsidy reductions.
Continuing activities that conflict with government views may have consequences for subsidy policy.
Doorgaan met activiteiten die strijdig zijn met de regeringsopvattingen, kan gevolgen hebben voor het subsidiebeleid.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de notitie van Amnesty International over vreemdelingenbewaring (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

MPs Spekman and Voordewind asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the Dutch practice of immigration detention complies with the ultimum remedium principle, whether lighter alternatives are used in practice, whether courts assess alternatives, and how many detainees returned after various detention durations, following an Amnesty International report. The minister rejected Amnesty's conclusions, argued that alternatives such as a restricted location and reporting duties are applied, and supplied return figures by detention length for 2008 to 2010.
However, I am of the view that in recent years much has changed and improved both in the policy on immigration detention and in its implementation.
Ik ben echter van mening dat de afgelopen jaren zowel op het terrein van het beleid inzake vreemdelingenbewaring als de tenuitvoerlegging daarvan, het nodige is veranderd en verbeterd.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de vreemdelingenbewaring van Irakezen (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Voordewind asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about a Council of State ruling that an Iraqi detainee was held unlawfully during the period when the European Court of Human Rights had suspended deportations to Iraq, and whether all Iraqi detainees in that period are entitled to compensation. The Minister rejected the wider conclusions, saying the ruling concerned one individual case, that detention of about 160 Iraqis was continued where deportation remained realistic, and that roughly six cases were wrongly ended and the individual was released.
I have of course released the foreign national to whom the ruling relates.
Ik heb de vreemdeling op wie de uitspraak betrekking heeft uiteraard in vrijheid gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over restricties bij export naar Iran (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch firms export dual-use goods that could serve Iran's nuclear programme and whether the government will revoke export permits as the UK did. The state secretary replied that Iran export controls are among the strictest in Europe, that vergunningen are refused under a presumption of denial, and that permits for demonstrably civilian goods will continue.
With its export control policy towards Iran, the Netherlands is among the strictest in Europe, and the government will not deviate from this given the current situation in Iran.
Met zijn exportcontrolebeleid ten aanzien van Iran behoort Nederland tot de strengsten van Europa en de regering zal hier, gezien de huidige situatie in Iran, niet van afwijken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Schouw (D66) en Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de bedreiging van ex-moslims in asielzoekerscentra (ingezonden 26 nove

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about threats and violence against ex-Muslim and LGBT asylum seekers in reception centres, questioning the low number of registered incidents, whether a confidential reporting system and a trusted contact person should be created, and whether perpetrators should be moved to immigration detention. The minister said incidents are registered only when reported, that COA already has a low-threshold reporting system, that he sees no need for a trusted-person role, and that he will consult interest groups and inform the House, but did not answer all questions before the budget debate.
In my earlier answer to the questions I already indicated that I take the signals seriously and that COA has already put low-threshold facilities in place for reporting incidents.

In de eerdere beantwoording van de kamervragen 1 heb ik al aangegeven de signalen serieus te nemen en ook dat het COA reeds laagdrempelige voorzieningen om incidenten te kunnen melden heeft getroffen.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Neppérus (VVD), Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66), Ouwehand (PvdD) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de st

MPs from several parties asked whether asbestos, pesticides and herbicides from the Stichting Machinale Landbouw have polluted the Wageningen area in Suriname, whether Dutch responsibility and cancer mortality are involved, and whether Dutch assistance is available. The minister answered that no recent research exists, that Suriname's authorities are investigating and planning awareness activities, and that the Netherlands will consider assistance if Suriname requests it.

Due to the lack of research data, the Surinamese authorities cannot determine the extent to which the operations of Stichting Machinale Landbouw have affected negative developments in the living environment of Wageningen and surroundings.

Vanwege het ontbreken van onderzoeksdata is door de Surinaamse autoriteiten niet vast te stellen in hoeverre de bedrijfsvoering van Stichting Machinale Landbouw van invloed is op negatieve ontwikkelingen in de leefomgeving van Wageningen en omstreken.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA), Voordewind (CU), Ouwerhand (PvdD) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over de situatie in Burundi (ingezonden 26 n

MPs asked the Dutch government about a Human Rights Watch report on crackdowns on rights in Burundi, including whether it was unacceptable, whether it affects Dutch development aid, whether civil society should be supported, and the role of the Netherlands in the Great Lakes region. The government said it shares the concerns, has raised them bilaterally and multilaterally, will continue its security-sector and civil-society support, and will inform parliament in spring 2011 about its focus countries.
We share the concerns expressed in the report about the arrests of journalists, the documented cases of torture and the restriction of freedom for opposition parties and civil society.

Wij delen de in het rapport geuite zorgen over arrestaties van journalisten, de geconstateerde gevallen van marteling en de beperking van de vrijheid voor oppositiepartijen en het maatschappelijk middenveld.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Irrgang (beiden SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over kinderarbeid bij hazelnotenproductie in Turk

MPs Gesthuizen, Irrgang and Voordewind asked ministers about reports of widespread child labour and school absence in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and whether Dutch companies and the state should act in line with ILO conventions. The government answered that the problem is complex and mainly the responsibility of Turkey, that Dutch firms should exercise due diligence and will be consulted again in early 2011, and that it will raise the issue bilaterally with Turkey without committing to new investigations of Dutch companies.
Due to the confidentiality of commercially sensitive information, these data cannot be traced back to individual companies.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie zijn deze gegevens niet herleidbaar naar individuele bedrijven.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een veroordeling wegens «afvalligheid» in Iran (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the November 2010 conviction for apostasy in Iran of Youcef Nadarkhani, whether the government would act for his release, and whether Iran's apostasy laws violate the right to freedom of religion. The minister said the embassy could not confirm the case, that the government would follow it and possibly raise it with Iran in EU context, and that the Netherlands regularly raises such violations with Iran bilaterally and in the EU.
I am following the case closely and will, once this report is confirmed, decide whether to raise the matter with the Iranian authorities in an EU context.
Ik laat de zaak op de voet volgen en zal, zodra dit bericht bevestigd is, deze kwestie al dan niet in EU-verband opbrengen bij de Iraanse autoriteiten.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Economic Affairs minister about labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including KPR Mills, its SA8000 certification, and government risk lists. The government answered that the companies have tried to influence the supplier, that it does not subsidise or supervise them, and that it will continue dialogue with the sector and the Indian government without committing to new binding measures.
We see no role for the government in this.
Wij zien hierbij geen rol voor de overheid.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Sterk (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Van Klaveren (PVV), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel ov

MPs from several parties asked the immigration minister about a Stichting Gave survey reporting discrimination and threats against Christians and ex-Muslims in asylum centres, and about COA rules, reporting, police complaints, a confidential contact point and detention or revocation of asylum for perpetrators. The minister answered that the survey was methodologically flawed and small, that COA records show only three incidents between Muslims and Christians in two years, that complaints channels already exist, and that a separate confidential contact person is unnecessary; he declined to add a new study or automatic asylum revocation.
The COA will address this survey in the regular consultation with Stichting Gave.
Het COA zal in het reguliere overleg met Stichting Gave aandacht besteden aan deze peiling.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en voor Immigratie en Asiel over het artikel «Kerkgijzeling Bagdad draait uit op bloedbad» (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asked the foreign and immigration ministers about reports of a church siege in Baghdad, the number of priests killed, whether violence against Christians is increasing, and whether Iraqi refugees should be returned. The minister said there is no evidence of a targeted increase in violence against Christians, would raise the matter in the EU, and held that the incident does not change the security assessment or the return policy.
I will make an appeal to this effect at EU level at the Foreign Affairs Council of 22 November.
Ik zal hiertoe in Europees verband een oproep doen bij de Raad voor Buitenlandse Zaken van de EU op 22 november a.s.

Vragen van de leden Ormel (CDA), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (CU), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een ten dood veroordeling in Pakistan (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister about the death sentence imposed on Asia Bibi in Pakistan for blasphemy, whether it increases threats to Christians, how many others are detained on similar charges, where Pakistan's blasphemy and Hudud laws conflict with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister condemned the sentence, noted an appeal is possible, said blasphemy laws are misused and fall hardest on religious minorities, and reported that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly raised concerns with Pakistani authorities, including a planned joint letter to the prime minister.
The Netherlands has repeatedly expressed its concerns about the blasphemy legislation to the Pakistani authorities over the past year.
Nederland heeft in het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zijn zorgen over de blasfemiewetgeving aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten kenbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de uitzetting van een Somaliër (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the 2010 deportation of a Somali national to Mogadishu amid fighting that killed 230 people, and whether this should prompt reconsideration of returns to Somalia. The minister, Leers (Immigration and Asylum), said the court ruling requires that Mogadishu be treated as a situation under Article 15c, so Somali asylum seekers from Mogadishu may get temporary asylum permits unless they have an internal alternative, while returns elsewhere in Somalia remain permitted and individual assessment continues, with no monitoring of returnees planned.

Studying the ruling of 9 September, together with the ruling of 26 January 2010 and the country report on Somalia of 20 September 2010, leads me to conclude that on the basis of current information on the security situation in Mogadishu, the lack of reasoning identified by the Division cannot be remedied.

Bestudering van de uitspraak van 9 september, in samenhang met de uitspraak van 26 januari 2010 en de informatie uit het ambtsbericht over Somalië van 20 september 2010, brengt mij tot de conclusie dat op dit moment, op basis van de huidige informatie over de veiligheidssituatie in Mogadishu, het door de Afdeling geconstateerde motiveringsgebrek niet kan worden weggenomen
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de UNESCO filosofiedag in Iran (ingezonden 5 november 2010)

An MP asked the foreign minister about UNESCO holding a World Philosophy Day in Iran despite rights violations, whether a Dutch delegation would attend, and whether the government would object. The minister confirmed awareness of the New York Times article and reported that UNESCO's Director-General decided to withdraw from organising the event because Iran did not meet UNESCO's requirements.
UNESCO found that Iran did not meet all of UNESCO's requirements regarding the organisation of the event.
UNESCO heeft geconstateerd dat Iran met betrekking tot de organisatie niet aan alle eisen van UNESCO voldoet.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat doorschenken aan dronken gasten in horecagelegenheden vaak voorkomt en onbestraft blijft (ingezonden

MP Voordewind asks the health minister about a study showing that bartenders often serve already-drunk patrons without penalty, and asks whether enforcement of the ban (art. 252 Sr) is adequate, whether capacity exists, and whether licences should be revoked after repeated violations. The minister answers that police enforce the ban, the nVWA lacks capacity, sanctions are for the Public Prosecution Service and municipalities, and a wider national study and new public information are not planned.
Soon I will inform your House about the progress of the bill amending the Drink and Catering Act.
Binnenkort zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over inadequaat handelen door de Centrale Autoriteit bij een kinderontvoeringszaak (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked why authorities failed to stop a mother who abducted her 11-year-old son to Portugal, why the Dutch Central Authority took over a week to send documents, and whether there is a backlog of 96 cases. The state secretary answered that the CA acted promptly, transmitted documents to Portugal within days, and denied any waiting list, while citing privacy limits on individual case details and committing to do everything possible to locate the child.
I cannot fully inform your House about individual cases for privacy reasons.
Ik kan uw Kamer om privacyredenen niet volledig informeren over individuele zaken.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over marteling van Papoea’s door Indonesische militairen (ingezonden 2 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about video footage showing Indonesian soldiers torturing people in Papua, the background, whether anti-Papuan aggression is rising, and whether the EU and the Netherlands would raise the issue. The minister answered that Indonesia has launched an investigation and promised punishment, that the Netherlands raises Papua human rights concerns regularly, and that Indonesia's openness to a human rights dialogue is a positive development.
It was also promised that the final results of the investigation will be shared with the Netherlands and other international partners.
Tevens is toegezegd dat de definitieve resultaten van het onderzoek met Nederland en andere internationale partners zullen worden gedeeld.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het terugsturen van Birmese vluchtelingen door Thailand (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Thailand was returning Burmese refugees after fighting broke out in the border area, and whether he would press Thailand to stop expulsions and treat refugees humanely. The minister answered that fighting between Karen groups and the Burmese army has displaced people, that UNHCR, IOM and NGOs report no forced expulsion and voluntary returns, and that he will monitor humanitarian assistance.
From the refugee organisation UNHCR, but also from IOM, ECHO and NGOs on the ground, it has been learned that there is no question of forced expulsion.
Van vluchtelingenorganisatie UNHCR, maar ook van IOM, ECHO en NGO’s ter plekke is vernomen dat geen sprake is van gedwongen uitzetting.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de geplande executie van een Iraanse vrouw (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether she had seen reports of a planned execution in Iran and whether the Netherlands would press Iran in the EU and UN not to carry it out. The minister confirmed awareness, said the government asked the EU High Representative to issue a statement and asked the Belgian EU presidency to raise the case, and described a UN resolution on Iran's human rights situation in preparation.
Today the Dutch government asked HR Ashton to issue a statement on behalf of the EU expressing the EU's serious concern about the Ashtiani case.
Vandaag heeft de Nederlandse regering HV Ashton verzocht namens de EU een verklaring uit te laten gaan waarin de grote zorg van de EU over de zaak Ashtiani wordt geuit

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over salarissen boven de balkenendenorm bij de publieke omroep (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

The MP asks why public broadcasters still pay presenter salaries far above the Balkenende norm after a motion, how the NPO will close management-BV workarounds, and why the excess is not paid from membership funds. The minister acknowledges legacy contracts above the cap, commits to pressing the NPO to bring management BVs under the BPPO and to ensure excess is paid from membership funds, and accepts the point as one for improvement.
I will urge the NPO executive board to include this unambiguously in the BPPO and to supervise compliance with it.
Ik zal er bij de raad van bestuur van de NPO op aandringen dit eenduidig in het BPPO op te nemen en daarop toezicht te houden.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van o.a. de Nederlandse bedrijven Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderar

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked whether Dutch seed firms Advanta and Bejo Zaden received government support beyond subsidies for projects in India, and whether this affects a cabinet position on fines for child-labour links. The state secretary confirmed no other Indian-project support was received, and reported support in other countries and past projects, stating that this has no consequences because it cannot be reclaimed and no fine can be imposed.
This information has no consequences for the support. Outside the subsidy relationship it cannot be reclaimed and no fine can be imposed.
Deze informatie heeft geen gevolgen voor de ondersteuning. Buiten de subsidierelatie kan niet worden teruggevorderd en ook kan geen boete worden opgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about excessive director salaries at development organisation SNV, how the government will recover the excess against subsidies, whether other non-MFS organisations also pay above the cap, and whether a salary ceiling will be enforced. The state secretary answered that differences will be settled retroactively against the subsidy, that specific arrangements will be made with SNV, that other organisations will be referred to a separate letter, and that a salary cap will be agreed with non-MFS organisations largely funded by government.
Established differences between director salaries and the DG norm can be settled afterwards against the subsidy fixed afterwards for a given year.
Vastgestelde verschillen tussen directiesalarissen en de DG-norm kunnen achteraf worden verrekend met de eveneens achteraf vastgestelde subsidie over een bepaald jaar.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de groepsuitzetting naar Irak (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a group deportation of 31 Iraqi nationals to Baghdad on 8 September 2010, the deterioration of security in Iraq, UNHCR and Amnesty objections, and calls for a new country report and a suspension of deportations. The minister confirms the deportation, says a new general country report is due in October 2010, and refuses to suspend deportations because no information shows a level of indiscriminate violence that would breach Article 3 ECHR.

Since I have no information showing a situation of general violence so extreme that every deportation to Iraq would breach Article 3 ECHR, I see insufficient reason to conclude that deportations to Iraq should be suspended.

Daar ik niet beschik over informatie waaruit blijkt dat gesproken kan worden van een dusdanig extreme situatie van algemeen geweld dat elke uitzetting naar Irak een schending van artikel 3 van het EVRM zou opleveren, zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om te concluderen tot het opschorten van uitzettingen naar Irak.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie van Assyrische christenen in het Noorden van Irak (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of unfair trials and abuse by Kurdish authorities against Assyrian Christians and other minorities in northern Iraq, including the torture case of Robert Aowyamlik. The minister said the Netherlands and the EU raise fair trial and anti-torture issues bilaterally and through the EUJUST LEX mission, and will raise the Aowyamlik case if the opportunity arises.
If the opportunity arises, the case of Mr. Aowyamlik will be raised.
Indien de gelegenheid zich voordoet zal de zaak van dhr. Aowyamlik worden opgebracht.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het advies aan zwangere vrouwen over alcohol dat te vrijblijvend is (ingezo

MPs Kooiman and Voordewind asked the health minister how he would respond to research showing midwives give non-committal advice on alcohol in pregnancy, and what he would do about midwives' knowledge, consultation practice, training and warning labels. The minister said he finds the advice worrying, commissioned an intervention card and a study of how intermediaries use professional information, left training to the KNOV, and kept the government's position of no warning labels pending evidence.
I find it worrying that non-committal advice on alcohol use is given to pregnant women.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er vrijblijvend over alcoholgebruik wordt geadviseerd aan zwangere vrouwen.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «President Indonesië stelt bezoek aan Nederland uit» (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether there was consultation before Indonesia's president postponed his state visit, and what the reasons were and whether the visit could still go ahead. The minister confirmed prior consultation and reported the president's letter citing a Dutch court case seeking his arrest, expressing regret but trusting continued good relations.
In light of this, it was decided to postpone the visit.
In dit licht is besloten om het bezoek uit te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) en Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over kinderbijslag ten behoeve van ontwikkelings

Three MPs asked why Dutch development workers abroad lose child benefit despite a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and why the export rules name development workers, and asked about the lengthy SVB reclaim procedure on return. The minister replied that these workers are not insured so the rules do not apply to them, that the procedure follows standard timelines with retroactive payment, and that no change is planned.
These persons are after all not insured. These persons therefore cannot invoke article 7b or the Decree either.
Deze personen zijn immers niet verzekerd. Deze personen kunnen zich dus ook niet beroepen op artikel 7b of het Besluit.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over promotieactiviteiten van Heineken tijdens de huldiging van het Nederlands elftal (ingezonden

An MP asks ministers whether Heineken's promotional activities during the Dutch football team's celebration reached many minors, whether the 25% minors rule in the alcohol advertising code was adequate, and what action is planned on alcohol sponsorship in sport. The minister acknowledges that 165,000 youths were reached, says no revision of the 25% rule is needed for now, notes no evidence yet that municipal policy was discouraged, and declines to ban alcohol sponsorship in sport at present.
There is no reason for this at present.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ormel (CDA) en Nicolaï (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het weigeren van een delegatie burgemeesters uit Israël (ingezonden 21 septemb

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch embassy advised the VNG against receiving Israeli mayors from West Bank settlements, on what international-law grounds, and what the government would do about the diplomatic fallout. The minister denied the embassy issued a formal negative advice, said the government avoids legitimising settlements but does not prevent others from contacting them, and described the VNG as an autonomous body free to decide.
The VNG is free to decide independently with whom it wishes to have contacts.
Het staat de VNG vrij zelfstandig te beslissen met wie het contacten wil aangaan.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderarbeid in India (ingezonden 21 j

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked ministers about child labour in Indian vegetable and cotton seed production linked to Dutch firms Advanta and Bejo Zaden, and whether the government would condemn them, act on subsidies, raise the issue bilaterally and in the EU-India trade deal, and investigate the sector. The ministers answered that they expect firms to follow OECD guidelines, that Bejo is taking dialogue and remedial steps and Advanta's Dutch arm does not source from India, and that they see no need for sector-wide agreements or a separate investigation, while committing to raise the issue bilaterally where useful and to pursue human rights provisions in the EU-India agreement.
In our view both companies are using the opportunities they have to contribute to eliminating child labour in their supply chain.
Naar onze mening benutten beide bedrijven de mogelijkheden die zij hebben om bij te dragen aan de uitbanning van kinderarbeid in hun keten.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat het ouderschapsplan bij scheiding werkt (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister for Youth and Family about reports that the parenting plan requirement has reduced divorce cases handled by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and whether guidance for separating parents with children can be improved. The minister welcomed the reported effect and pointed to municipal support, better online information and the Rechtwijzer tool, without committing to a concrete new step.
I assess it as positive that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming observes this effect in practice.
Ik beoordeel het als positief dat de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming in de praktijk dit effect waarneemt.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Turkije mogelijk chemische wapens inzet tegen de PKK (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Turkey may have used chemical weapons against PKK fighters, how he assessed Turkey's denial, and whether he would raise the issue with Turkey or at the OPCW, UN, NATO or EU to press for an independent investigation. The minister answered that Turkey confirms it possesses no chemical weapons, that the cited clinic issued a correction saying it did not confirm chemical weapons caused the deaths, and that the Netherlands sees no reason to suspect Turkey and therefore no reason to raise the matter in multilateral bodies.
On the basis of the information in the cited report, the Netherlands sees no reason to suspect Turkey of using or possessing chemical weapons.
Nederland ziet op basis van de informatie in het aangehaalde bericht geen aanleiding om Turkije te verdenken van het gebruik of het bezit van chemische wapens.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de gemeente Venray (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether Venray municipality plans a questionnaire to assess whether pregnant women are fit for parenthood, and whether this is an improper intrusion. The minister answered that the questionnaire is a tool for midwives to identify support needs, that participation is voluntary, municipalities do not receive results, and that the municipality is responsible for deciding how to implement prenatal prevention with care professionals.
Municipalities do not have access to the results of the conversations.
Gemeenten hebben geen toegang tot de resultaten van de gesprekken.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over EU-hulp aan Afghanistan opgeschort (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU suspension of 600 million euro in Afghan aid, its view on demanding anti-corruption measures before Dutch aid resumes, and whether the peace jirga statement should also require renouncing violence against foreign troops. Minister Verhagen replied that the EU did not suspend aid but postponed the 2011–2013 programme until after the Kabul conference, that Dutch programmes continue with monitoring against corruption, and that renouncing violence against foreign forces is already emphasised in Dutch and EU messaging.
The European Union is not suspending development aid to Afghanistan.
De Europese Unie schort de ontwikkelingshulp aan Afghanistan niet op.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het remmen van de groei van de jeugd door alcoholgebruik (ingezonden 14 juni 2010).

An MP asks ministers whether a press report that alcohol slows youth growth should lead to changes in health education and anti-alcohol campaigns or further research. The government answers that the report adds no new scientific findings, that existing campaigns already cover growth effects, and that further research is welcome.
The article in Spits does not add any new scientific insights.
Het artikel in Spits voegt geen nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten toe.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Defensie over recreatief medegebruik van defensieterrein Infanterie Schietterrein Harskamp (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MP Voordewind asked the Defence Minister what action was taken to preserve recreational access to defence training grounds, to keep campsite De Oase near the Harskamp range open, and to seek a solution for a neighbouring house that must be removed. The minister replied that extensive recreational use continues, that talks with the campsite owners took place but the decision not to extend the leasehold stands, and that Defence is open to a tailored solution for the residents without extending the lease.
Defence is willing to look for a tailored solution, but wishes to stress that extension of the leasehold is out of the question.
Defensie is bereid te zoeken naar een maatwerkoplossing, maar wil benadrukken dat van verlenging van de erfpacht geen sprake kan zijn.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over de arrestatie van een kopstuk van de radicaal islamitische terreurbeweging Hamas (ingezonden 3 ju

MPs Voordewind and Anker asked ministers whether a Dutch citizen of Palestinian origin, released by Israel after arrest, is a Hamas leader and whether Dutch criminal or residence-law consequences follow. Minister Verhagen declined to discuss this individual case, stating the general rules on revoking Dutch nationality and that the answers could not be given in time.
I cannot provide any information on individual cases such as this one.
Over individuele zaken zoals de onderhavige kan ik geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Pechtold (D66), Peters (GroenLinks), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Venezolaanse rechter A

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the detention of Venezuelan judge María Lourdes Afiuni, whether it has raised concerns with Venezuela, and whether it will raise the case at EU level. The minister called the detention an infringement on judicial independence, supported the UN call for her release, said the Netherlands will follow the case in UN and EU contexts and will ask the High Representative to raise it with Venezuelan authorities.
I will check whether High Representative Ashton has raised this with the Venezuelan authorities, and advocate that she does.
Ik zal nagaan of Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton dit bij de Venezolaanse autoriteiten heeft aangekaart, en bepleiten dat zij dat doet.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de uitzetting van Somaliërs (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asks the Justice Minister whether preparations to deport a group of Somali ex-asylum seekers to Mogadishu, under a return agreement with the Somali transitional government, are intimidatory, given the dire security situation and a negative travel advice. The minister answers that no group deportation is planned, that individual forced returns may follow this summer under a 3 May 2010 MoU, and rejects the criticisms.
There is no planned group deportation to Somalia.
Er is geen sprake van een voorgenomen groepsgewijze uitzetting naar Somalië.
Vragen van de leden Slob en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de bedreiging van ex-moslims (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MPs Slob and Voordewind asked the Justice Minister about threats against ex-Muslims in the Netherlands, including in asylum centres, and whether anonymous reporting, safe houses and civic integration could help. The minister said such threats must be taken seriously, that the COA enforces house rules neutrally, that no separate registration of such complaints exists, and pointed to existing anonymity options, existing shelter places, and the integration exam's coverage of religious freedom.
No separate registration is kept of this.
Daarvan wordt geen afzonderlijke registratie bijgehouden.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het besluit van de Afghaanse regering om het werk van twee christelijke hulporganisaties te verbieden (ingezonden 9 juni 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister whether the Afghan government's temporary suspension of two Christian aid organisations, over suspected proselytising, conflicts with religious freedom and what the Netherlands will do about it. The minister answered that the suspension is pending an investigation, that Afghan partners may continue, that Afghan law makes conversion punishable, and that the Netherlands and the EU raise religious freedom in their dialogue with Kabul.
In talks with the Afghan authorities, the Netherlands will emphasise the importance of freedom of religion.
Nederland zal in gesprekken met de Afghaanse autoriteiten het belang van godsdienstvrijheid benadrukken.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Haverkamp (beiden CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bomaanslagen in Mosul op bussen met christelijke studenten (ingezonden

MPs asked the foreign minister about bomb attacks on buses of Christian students in Mosul and how to increase international protection of minorities, including a round-table conference and UN action. The minister confirmed the attack, said protection of minorities is the Iraqi government's responsibility, pointed to existing EU/Dutch human rights and aid efforts, and reported that the UN mission discussed minority protection, without committing to a new conference or UN initiative.
Guaranteeing the safety and human rights of minorities is a matter for the Iraqi government.
De waarborging van de veiligheid en mensenrechten van minderheden is een zaak voor de Irakese regering.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Pechtold (D66), Nicolaï (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Iraanse toetreding tot de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN (in

MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would oppose Iran's candidacy for the UN Human Rights Council given its human rights record, and what that would mean for the Council's credibility. The minister replied that Iran withdrew its candidacy and that the Netherlands had actively lobbied against it, and that it will continue to keep notorious rights violators out of the Council.
In the future too, the Netherlands will continue to work unabatedly to keep notorious human rights violators out of the Council.
Ook in de toekomst zal Nederland zich onverminderd blijven inzetten om notoire mensenrechtenschenders buiten de Raad te houden.
qn: Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Armeense genocide (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the 1915 Armenian events constitute genocide under the 1948 Convention, why the government does not use that term, and whether its letter departs from the Rouvoet motion calling for recognition in EU talks with Turkey. The minister answered that the 1948 Convention does not apply retroactively, pointed to joint archive access and mixed commissions, and said recognition is not a Copenhagen criterion while continuing to press Turkey on free expression and the Zurich protocols.
To that end I will continue to use my contacts with my Turkish and Armenian counterparts.
Ik zal daartoe de contacten met mijn Turkse en Armeense counterparts blijven aanwenden.

m: Motie van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over verkennen van een terugvalmogelijkheid voor de subsidie voor CODART
Asks the minister to mediate between CODART and RKD and explore routing the CODART subsidy through another institution as a fallback.
requests the Minister to enter into discussion with both parties to get them to reach an agreement
verzoekt de Minister, het gesprek aan te gaan met beide partijen om ze te bewegen er met elkaar uit te komen
Motie van de leden Paternotte en Geluk-Poortvliet over in gesprek gaan met Frascati en PLAN Brabant
Asks the government to talk with Frascati and PLAN Brabant to find a way to support young theatre makers despite the advisory council's negative subsidy advice.
requests the government to enter into talks with both institutions
