MPs Van Hijum and Agnes Mulder asked how the €664 million from cross-border capacity auctions on the electricity grid would be spent, and whether it could improve supply security in vulnerable 'uitloper' areas. The minister answered that EU rules require the proceeds to fund interconnector investments or lower network tariffs, not grid reinforcement in uitloper areas, and described the existing TenneT reinforcement programme and timelines.
Under European regulations, TenneT is obliged to use the auction proceeds for investments related to interconnector capacity or for lowering network tariffs.
Op basis van Europese regelgeving is TenneT verplicht om de veilinggelden aan te wenden voor investeringen die samenhangen met de interconnectiecapaciteit of voor verlaging van de nettarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Van Hijum en Hachchi over het bericht ‘Ziek personeelslid vliegbasis Twenthe kreeg 100.000 euro schadevergoeding’

MPs asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a media report that a sick former employee at Twenthe air base received 100,000 euro in damages after 14 years, allegedly on condition of dropping further legal steps, and whether such payouts had occurred before. The Minister confirmed the settlement after a long process delayed by medical uncertainty, denied any gag clause, reported fourteen related claims with five liability acknowledgements, and agreed to an independent broad investigation of all Defence staff exposed to chromium-6.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Hijum over een onderzoek op het voormalige NAVO-depot in Vriezenveen naar een mogelijk verband tussen gezondheidsklachten van oud-medewerkers en het werken met de giftige verf

MPs Knops and Van Hijum asked the Defence Minister why an investigation into health complaints of former workers with the paint CARC was launched for a depot in Limburg but not in Vriezenveen, and how former workers can have their complaints independently examined. The Minister answered that the research is being expanded to all defence sites using CARC and chromium VI, including Vriezenveen, that both studies run simultaneously, and that former workers can register with a reporting point, with individual follow-up after the RIVM results.
The investigations in Limburg and Vriezenveen are taking place simultaneously.
De onderzoeken in Limburg en Vriezenveen vinden gelijktijdig plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Icesave-deal minister’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about criticism that the sale of the Icesave claim against Landsbanki would worsen the bargaining position of local governments and the 100,000+ depositors, and whether he had consulted them beforehand. The minister denied skipping consultation, argued that the position of creditors is not harmed, and offered advice and monitoring while not committing to active mediation.
Moreover, the Dutch government will closely monitor the settlement of Icesave.
Bovendien zal de Nederlandse overheid de afwikkeling van Icesave nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kredietverlening aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ECB lending support for SMEs, the causes of weak SME credit, and whether family loans could be encouraged through a revived Tante Agaathregeling tax scheme. The ministers say the ECB's TLTRO effects are hard to estimate, attribute low SME lending mainly to falling demand and weaker borrower positions, and point to SME financing measures while staying cautious about new tax measures.
The cabinet has therefore decided to support market parties in setting up a subordinated loan fund (AGL) fund
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten marktpartijen te gaan ondersteunen bij het oprichten van een achtergestelde leningenfonds (AGL)-fonds
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over de zorgen van de gemeente Raalte over de beperkte dekking van het C2000 netwerk

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about coverage gaps in the C2000 emergency radio network near Heeten, raised by the municipality of Raalte, including consequences for emergency services, the number of white spots and plans for full coverage. The minister confirmed the gap, said 24 coverage problems are open with eight being addressed yearly, explained that emergency services can fall back on direct radio and mobile phones, and said the Heeten problem may be solved in 2015 with a decision in January 2015.
I share the concern of the municipality of Raalte.
Ik deel de zorg van de gemeente Raalte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Frankrijk laat begrotingsdoel los’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that France was relaxing its deficit target, its growth and deficit forecasts versus April, and whether the Netherlands would push France on structural reform. The minister said the EU fiscal rules already allow flexibility, France must still show sufficient measures, and structural reform is discussed in Eurogroup and Ecofin without committing to a specific intervention.
The Dutch government is of the view that the European budget rules provide sufficient flexibility to take economic circumstances into account.
De Nederlandse regering is van mening dat de Europese begrotingsregels voldoende flexibiliteit bieden om rekening te houden met economische omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over het bericht dat Frankrijk hulp en opvang gaat bieden aan christenen

Two CDA MPs asked whether France's offer of aid and shelter to Christians expelled by IS from Mosul would be matched by Dutch asylum options, and what support minorities and the EU provide. The minister answered that asylum cases from IS-controlled Iraqi areas are postponed until a new country report appears in early September, while the EU and Netherlands continue supporting minorities.

Once the new country report is available, the State Secretary for Security and Justice will consider whether the information in it should lead to an adjustment of the current asylum policy regarding Iraq.

Zodra het nieuwe ambtsbericht er is, zal de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien of de informatie in het ambtsbericht tot een aanpassing moet leiden in het huidige asielbeleid ten aanzien van Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het fiscaal mogelijk gemaakte (tot een bepaald bedrag vrijgesteld van vermogensrendementsheffing) banksparen ten behoeve van de kosten van een uitvaart

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why no bank offers the tax-favoured bank savings product for funeral costs created in 2010, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that banks find the amounts too small to justify the product, that the government will not oblige banks to offer it, and that it intends to abolish the facility in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 unless the NVB shows such products will be offered.
I intend to abolish the facility in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015, unless the NVB makes it plausible that bank savings products for funeral costs will still be offered.
Ik heb het voornemen om de faciliteit af te schaffen in de Fiscale verzamelwet 2015, tenzij de NVB aannemelijk maakt dat bankspaarproducten voor uitvaartkosten alsnog aangeboden zullen gaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het Parex-schandaal in Letland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rescue of Latvian bank Parex, alleged Russian dirty money, EBRD stakes in its successor Citadele, and lessons for Lithuania's euro entry. The government answered most questions by pointing to Latvian authorities, the Commission and the EBRD, stated that no Dutch loans or guarantees were used beyond a roughly 5% share of EU balance-of-payments aid, and declined to disclose EBRD due diligence and transaction details.
Beyond the information under questions 13 and 14, the EBRD has indicated that it cannot make further specific information public.
Buiten de informatie bij vraag 13 en14 heeft de EBRD aangegeven dat het verdere specifieke informatie niet openbaar kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de vergoeding voor rietlandbeheer

MPs Geurts, Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why subsidies paid by provinces to nature managers are exempt from VAT while payments from nature managers to reed cutters are subject to VAT, and asked about the basis for a possible exemption. The State Secretary explained the VAT treatment under EU case law, that the subsidy scheme is taxable only where the payment is consumed, and that stakeholders and government are exploring a restructured single-entity arrangement.

Representatives of private reed managers, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, the province of Overijssel and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are examining whether the relationship between reed managers and land owners can be changed and formalised so that there is a single entity.

Vertegenwoordigers van de particuliere rietlandbeheerders, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, de provincie Overijssel en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken onderzoeken of de relatie tussen rietlandbeheerders en terreineigenaren zodanig gewijzigd en geformaliseerd kan worden, dat sprake is van één entiteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Van Hijum en Slob over de situatie dat Zwolse rolstoelafhankelijke vrouwen voor de screening op borstkanker niet meer terecht kunnen in het ziekenhuis in Zwolle

MPs asked why wheelchair-dependent women from Zwolle cannot use the Isala hospital for breast cancer screening and must travel to a fixed unit in Apeldoorn, and whether the 45-minute travel rule and Valys transport limits should be changed. The minister confirms the situation, defends the policy of prioritising fixed units for quality reasons, refuses to exempt screening trips from Valys kilometre limits, and mentions a possible fixed unit in Zwolle.
I am not willing to exempt transport to the population screening from the maximum number of kilometres a person can travel per year with Valys, as this could set a precedent for other situations.

Ik ben niet bereid om het vervoer naar het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te zonderen van het maximaal aantal kilometers dat iemand op jaarbasis met Valys kan reizen aangezien dit een precedent kan scheppen voor andere situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht dat IJsland Nederlandse spaarders niet wil uitbetalen

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it would push Iceland to release Icesave deposit funds to Dutch savers, including the 100,000+ savers, and what steps it was taking. The government answered that it urges Iceland to grant exemptions for future estate payouts, that Iceland's central bank has not yet decided on a fifth payout request, and that efforts benefit all preferred creditors equally, with about €617 million of principal still outstanding.
The cabinet considers it of the utmost importance that the Icelandic authorities grant exemption without delay for future estate payouts
Het kabinet vindt het inderdaad van het grootste belang dat de IJslandse autoriteiten zonder vertraging vrijstelling verlenen voor toekomstige boedeluitkeringen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over mobiel grenstoezicht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about delays in amending the Aliens Decree to widen mobile border checks by the Marechaussee, whether Germany had expanded such checks, and whether the government would push for risk-based flexibility at EU level. The State Secretary confirmed the amendment is in progress after advice from the ACVZ and Raad van State, explained the planned extension of train-check limits and a temporary exceptional power, said Germany's expansion is not evidenced, and stated the government will keep pressing for room at EU level while noting the national power must respect EU law.
With this proposal to amend the Aliens Decree, the legal framework for MTV checks on trains is being extended.
Met dit voorstel tot wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit wordt het juridisch kader voor de MTV-controles op treinen uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over het conflict tussen Rijkswaterstaat en de gemeente Ommen over de aanpak van de verkeersonveilige kruising van de N36 bij Beerze

CDA MPs asked the minister about the dispute between Rijkswaterstaat and Ommen over a traffic-light solution at the N36/Beerze junction instead of a grade-separated junction, including how the decision was made, cost differences, the basis for cost-sharing, and whether a new talk or deadline extension was possible. The minister defended the traffic-light option as most cost-effective and quickest, said no cost-sharing agreement with the VNG exists, and refused to reopen talks or extend the deadline.
No. Within the budget for cost-effective road safety measures there are no funds available for a grade-separated junction.
Nee. Binnen het budget voor kosteneffectieve verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor een ongelijkvloers kruispunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de aanpassing van regelgeving voor maritieme opleidingen in Nederland in verband met de Manilla-wijzigingen op het STCW-Verdrag

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why the Enkhuizer Zeevaartschool's examination oversight and related articles were removed from the maritime crew regulation during the STCW Manila amendments, despite sector opposition. The minister answered that oversight of the school's sailing-vessel training remains with the ILT, that merchant-shipping training must run within regular WEB/WHW education, and that no regulatory change is planned.
I do not want to give up the supervisory role over the EZS.
Ik wil de toezichtsrol op de EZS niet kwijt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de zorgen die leven bij de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten over de beheersvergoedingen in het kader van het rietlandbeheer in Nationaal Park de Weerribben-Wie

CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy levels for reed-land management in the Weerribben-Wieden park are adequate, and whether the 2014 income-tax changes and 6% VAT rate undermine the SNL standard-cost system. The State Secretary says provinces set compensation at 75% of norm costs under the Natuurpact, that VAT is due on paid management outsourcing, that no relevant tax changes occurred, and that a reduced VAT rate is not possible under EU rules, while committing to no concrete action.

On the basis of the information known to me, I cannot assess whether and to what extent the management compensation provided to reed cutters is insufficient to achieve the desired nature quality through the summer mowing regime.

Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens kan ik niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre de verstrekte beheersvergoedingen die in het kader van het rietlandbeheer aan riettelers verstrekt worden ontoereikend zijn om de gewenste natuurkwaliteit via het regime van zomermaaibeheer te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de werkwijze van afdelingen bijzonder beheer van banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the conduct of Dutch bank special-management departments toward SMEs, including transparency, AFM complaints, and whether oversight and the duty of care should be extended to small businesses. The minister answered that the UK Tomlinson findings are not representative for the Netherlands, that complaints are being monitored by the AFM, and that he does not intend to extend the general duty of care to small business clients for now.
I am therefore not currently intending to extend the general duty of care to (small) business clients.
Ik ben op dit moment dan ook niet voornemens om de algemene zorgplicht uit te breiden naar (klein)zakelijke klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “scheepswerf Peters in Kampen vraagt faillissement aan”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the bankruptcy of shipyard Peters in Kampen, including whether a guarantee application under the shipbuilding finance guarantee scheme was rejected and how many guarantees had been granted. The minister confirmed the bank withdrew its offer after no sound post-delivery financing was arranged, that EZ/RVO did not grant a guarantee, that €44 million in guarantees were approved in 2013, and that the curator will assess options while UWV handles job placement for affected workers.
Early 2014 RVO received a request from the bank to agree to a changed financing structure.
Begin 2014 ontving RVO een verzoek van de bank om in te stemmen met een gewijzigde financieringsopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Overheveling van taken treft vooral zwakste gemeenten’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether the decentralisation of youth care, elderly care and Wajong to municipalities hits the financially weakest municipalities hardest and whether municipalities can carry these tasks. The minister answered that the claim is not supported by the comparison made, that a historical distribution model applies for 2015, and that municipalities will get budget clarity in the May circular, while largely restating existing policy.
There is no question of a trial calculation.
Van een proefberekening is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Hijum en Keijzer over stijging van de zorgpremie

MPs Bruins Slot, Van Hijum and Keijzer asked why the CPB projects the nominal health insurance premium rising by EUR 144 to 2015 when the minister had claimed an increase of at most EUR 20 from the transfer of AWBZ care, and asked about funding, compensation and the own-risk increase. The minister answered that the EUR 20 figure covers only the transfer effect, that the remainder stems from the 50/50 rebalancing, reserves and autonomous cost growth, that the temporary state contribution is covered within the revenue framework, and that low-income households are fully compensated via the healthcare allowance, including for the own-risk rise.

The premium increase of at most EUR 20 mentioned in the letter of 4 March 2014 relates only to the expected rise in the nominal premium under the Health Insurance Act (Zvw) in 2015 due to the transfers.

De premiestijging van maximaal € 20 die wordt genoemd in de brief van 4 maart 2014 heeft enkel betrekking op de verwachte stijging van de nominale premie in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) in 2015 door de overhevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over “de goudclaim van Nederland op Zwitserland”

Parliamentarian Van Hijum (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch government had silently abandoned its gold claim against Switzerland, whether the Van Kemenade commission's conclusions on the claim were adopted, what efforts were made to recover the gold, and whether the government would take further steps or raise the matter with Switzerland. The minister answered that the Van Kemenade conclusions were fully adopted and no further legal steps will be taken, that past efforts are described in the commission report, and that the government sees no reason to reopen the matter now, while it will reassess if other countries act or new looted gold surfaces.
To the extent there may still be any uncertainty about this: the conclusions have been fully adopted by the Dutch government.
Voor zover daar nog onduidelijkheid over mocht bestaan: de conclusies zijn door de Nederlandse regering integraal overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Knops over gemeentelijk voorrangsbeleid bij het uitgeven van bouwkavels

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked whether the Minister opposes Raalte's rules giving local-binding priority in building-plot allocation, and whether municipal autonomy and the Huisvestingswet allow this. The Minister answered that such binding criteria require a huisvestingsverordening under the Huisvestingswet, which Raalte lacks, so its rules conflict with the law; the municipality has said it will comply, and a pending bill would further restrict such local rules.
It has emerged that no housing ordinance has been adopted in the municipality of Raalte. The criteria it set therefore conflict with the Huisvestingswet.
Gebleken is dat er in de gemeente Raalte geen huisvestingsverordening is vastgesteld. De vastgestelde kaders staan daarom op gespannen voet met de Huisvestingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Gemeente verhult grondverliezen met dubieuze boekhoudtrucs’

Van Hijum (CDA) asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether municipalities hide land-development losses through accounting tricks, including reclassifying investments, low interest charges, stretched sale horizons, off-balance PPS risks and the size of write-downs. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities appear to act within the BBV rules as far as provincial supervisors can judge, referred to Deloitte figures, and saw no reason for further action.
As far as I can judge, based on information we receive from the provincial supervisors, municipalities act within the framework of the regulations.
Voor zover ik kan beoordelen – op basis van de informatie die wij verkrijgen van de provinciale toezichthouders – handelen gemeenten binnen de kaders van de regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Hijum over de berichten dat online met aanschaf van bitcoins een semi-automatisch wapen is aangeschaft en een tiener zichzelf gedood heeft met een omgebouwd pistool

MPs Oskam and Van Hijum asked about reports that an illegal semi-automatic weapon was bought online with bitcoins and a teenager died from a converted pistol, including what has been done to tighten firearms law, border controls, international cooperation and online arms trade. The minister answered that prior measures concerned legal gun ownership, that border scanning is overwhelmed by volume but being strengthened, that existing enforcement is adequate, and that existing laws and an upcoming bill address online weapon trade, while declining to ban bitcoin.

Yes, the Computer Crime III bill, which I expect to be able to send to the Council of State within a reasonable time, provides among other things for creating an explicit statutory power for the police to enter a computer remotely.

Ja, het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat ik binnen afzienbare termijn naar de Raad van State verwacht te kunnen sturen, voorziet onder andere in het creëren van een expliciete wettelijke bevoegdheid voor de politie om op afstand een computer te betreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Pieter Heerma over de overdracht van bevallingsverlof bij het overlijden van de moeder

MPs Van Hijum and Heerma asked whether a father whose wife died during childbirth should be able to take over the mother's maternity leave, as in Belgium, and whether such a right would be added to the zorgverlof modernisation bill. The minister answered that work-life arrangements should be settled between employer and employee, that he will first consult social partners on the issue without anticipating solutions, and that amendments to the bill are targeted for spring.
I will first discuss this subject with the social partners and therefore do not want to anticipate possible solutions.
Ik zal over dit onderwerp eerst in gesprek gaan met sociale partners en wil dan ook niet vooruitlopen op eventuele oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het investeringsfonds BlackRock

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether BlackRock was hired to advise on the sale of ING's Alt-A mortgages and to revalue Dutch bank property portfolios, and whether its investments and advisory role create conflicts of interest. The minister confirmed the advisory roles, stated that BlackRock's stakes are held for clients largely in passive funds, and explained that Chinese Walls separate its advisory and investment arms.
Between these branches of a company such as BlackRock there are so-called Chinese Walls to prevent conflicts of interest or misuse of confidential business information.
Tussen deze takken van een onderneming als BlackRock staan zogenaamde Chinese Walls om te voorkomen dat belangenverstrengeling kan plaatsvinden of bedrijfsgevoelige informatie misbruikt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de 3VO kaart

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked the ministers whether a prepaid 3V card topped up via beltegoed.nl and billed later to the phone bill, and whether AFM and DNB pass responsibility to each other. The minister answered that DNB and AFM share supervision, that AFM is examining whether such top-ups amount to credit, that ABN AMRO and 3V have blocked the method and launched an internal inquiry, and that the minister will raise the issue in the EU e-money directive evaluation.
DNB and the AFM cannot make statements about investigations into individual companies and products.
DNB en AFM kunnen geen mededelingen doen over onderzoeken naar individuele ondernemingen en producten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de vastgelopen onderhandelingen met de Deense Maritieme Autoriteit (DMA) over de erkenning van de nationale certificaten van traditionele zeezeilschepen door Den

MPs Van Hijum and De Rouwe asked whether negotiations with Denmark's maritime authority over recognition of Dutch traditional sailing ship certificates had stalled, and whether the minister would intervene personally. The minister denied a full stall, reported progress on sailing areas and agreed to continue talks, while saying personal intervention was not yet needed but would follow if necessary.
However, I am closely monitoring progress towards an agreement and will, if necessary, personally take action towards my Danish counterpart.
Ik volg echter de voortgang over een overeenkomst nauwlettend en zal indien noodzakelijk alsnog persoonlijk actie ondernemen richting mijn Deense counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Hijum over de Oranjeschool in Zalk

MPs Rog and Van Hijum asked whether the Oranjeschool in Zalk faces closure because Kampen did not split its municipal territory for the closing-norm, whether the 5 km rule and discretionary powers can help, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that the municipality decided in 2001 not to split, retroactive splitting is not permitted, the 5 km exception cannot be waived, the discretionary power does not apply, and the school board should explore cooperation or merger options.
The Primary Education Act does not provide the possibility to permit a split with retroactive effect.
De Wet op het primair onderwijs biedt niet de mogelijkheid om met terugwerkende kracht een splitsing toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum inzake de Facebook-actie "Banken weigeren betalingsverkeer te beveiligen"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Facebook campaign claiming banks refuse to secure payment transfers and how often citizens send money to wrong account numbers. The minister said exact figures are unknown but errors are limited due to check digits, and that banks should decide on name-number checks, noting the move to IBAN; disputes are left to bank-customer agreement or KiFiD.
Exact figures on how often citizens unintentionally transfer money to an incorrect account number are not known to me.
Exacte cijfers over het aantal keer dat burgers onbedoeld geld overmaken naar een foutief rekeningnummer zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het bericht “Leugens en bedrog bij burgerzaken”

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked about a report on tax nomads who deregister from the municipal population register (GBA) to evade the state, including how many emigrants filed final tax returns, whether data is exchanged with foreign tax authorities, and whether passports are denied. The government answered that the report was shared confidentially, outlined the Taskforce VOW and an FIOD investigation, gave deregistration and filing figures, and said about 40 persons were flagged for passport refusal, with a broader anti-fraud approach promised for December 2013.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations sent you this report by letter for confidential handling.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft u dit rapport bij brief ter vertrouwelijke behandeling toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “AH Veendam bood kwart miljoen voor zondagopenstelling”

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked whether a supermarket offering a quarter million euros in sponsorship for Sunday opening amounted to bribery and whether such deals are common. The minister said he was unaware of similar practices, that municipalities must guard against conflicts of interest, and saw no reason to assume bribery in this case.
If a municipality is approached by a company asking it to use its powers in a certain way, the municipality must guard against conflicts of interest and partiality.

Indien een gemeente wordt benaderd door een bedrijf met het verzoek op een bepaalde wijze van zijn bevoegdheden gebruik te maken, dient deze gemeente te waken voor belangenverstrengeling en partijdigheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat voorbereidingen treft voor een nieuwe bezuiniging op de bediening van sluizen en brugge

Two CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat is preparing a new cut to the operation of locks and bridges, whether the Eilandbrug and Ketelbrug in Overijssel will be operated remotely, and how charter shipping in Kampen is being taken into account. The minister replied that the measure implements existing coalition-agreement savings due by 2018, that remote operation of the Eilandbrug already exists while the Ketelbrug is not planned for it, and that consultation with the charter shipping association has already taken place.
After the nationwide remote-operation pilot still under way ends, the technical aspects will be examined in an evaluation, which will be sent to your House.
Na afloop van de nu nog lopende landelijke pilot «bediening op afstand» zullen de technische aspecten worden belicht in een evaluatie. Deze zal aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Van Hijum over het terughalen van productie uit lagelonenlanden door Nederlandse bedrijven (reshoring)

MPs Heerma and Van Hijum asked whether reshoring of production from low-wage countries is a trend, how the 600 million euro for sector plans would stimulate it, and about a Tilburg total-cost-of-ownership model. The government answered that it is too early to speak of a trend, described sector plan co-financing and NFIA outreach, and said it will assess whether a national model is desirable.
Of course the cabinet is monitoring whether reshoring will occur on a larger scale.
Uiteraard wordt door het kabinet gevolgd of «reshoring» zich op grotere schaal gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de problemen waar de Bond van Belastingbetalers tegenaan is gelopen

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked why the Bond van Belastingbetalers could not learn which firms received subsidies under the Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven scheme, and whether recipients and uses would be published. The minister agreed in principle to publish recipients and amounts for 2011 (excluding sole traders), but refused to disclose the specific security measures funded, citing the risk to firms and staff.
I am certainly willing to make public which companies received subsidy in 2011 under Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven and which amounts these companies received.
Ik ben zeker bereid bekend te maken welke bedrijven in 2011 subsidie hebben ontvangen in het kader van Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven en welke bedragen deze bedrijven hebben ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de verklaring van geen bezwaar (vvgb) (Ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether an asset manager acquiring over 10% of another asset manager must obtain a new declaration of no objection (vvgb) even when the target already holds one, and whether a shortened procedure is possible. The minister confirmed a new vvgb is required because the financial soliditeit of the other firm must be assessed anew, and that the rules are EU-harmonised so no deviation is possible.
Because it concerns a different enterprise (asset manager), a new assessment, and therefore a new vvgb, is required.
Omdat het gaat om een andere onderneming (vermogensbeheerder) is dus een nieuwe toets, en derhalve vvgb, vereist.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum over het onthouden van medische zorg aan de 7-jarige Renate tijdens haar verblijf in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why a seven-year-old asylum seeker, Renata, allegedly was denied medical care in the Netherlands and whether the transfer to Poland was medically justified. The State Secretary answers that the child received medical care, details the contact moments and procedural history, declines fuller disclosure citing medical confidentiality, and states that inspectorates will investigate the medical handling.

The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) have announced they will launch an investigation, in particular into the medical handling and medical information transfer in the chain.

De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) hebben inmiddels gemeld een onderzoek in te zullen stellen, in het bijzonder naar het medisch handelen en de medische informatieoverdracht in de keten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over een gewelddadige roofoverval op een gelddepot van waardetransporteur Brinks

MPs Van Hijum and Oskam asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about a violent robbery of a Brinks cash depot and the rising number of ram and explosive raids, including what is being done to protect cash transport and staff, whether drones could be used in pursuits, and whether banks reducing ATMs is acceptable. The minister answered that ram and explosive raids on ATMs have risen while other robbery types have not, listed existing preventive and repressive measures, declined to give full operational detail for confidentiality reasons, judged drones largely impractical, and pointed to ongoing consultation in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer.
In the interest of the operational strategy, I cannot in this letter address all the measures taken to counter these serious robberies.
In het belang van de operationele strategie kan ik in deze brief niet ingaan op álle maatregelen die genomen worden om deze zware overvallen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de kwaliteit van de cijfers van de Spaanse overheidsfinanciën

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about the reliability of Spanish deficit figures, the accounting of bank capital injections, and retroactive ESM bank recapitalisation. The minister answered that Spanish and Commission deficit figures are broadly consistent once financial-sector interventions are included, that Eurostat applies rules consistently case by case, and that the Netherlands is very reluctant about retroactive ESM recapitalisation.
There is no reason to assume that the rules are being bargained over.
Er is geen reden aan te nemen dat er gemarchandeerd wordt met de regels.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Merkies en Van Hijum over een mogelijke gang naar de Ondernemingskamer in het kader van mogelijk mismanagement bij SNS

MPs Merkies and Van Hijum asked why the government would not initiate an enquiry by the Enterprise Chamber into alleged mismanagement at SNS REAAL, and whether this creates uncertainty. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that an enquiry would add no value beyond the nationalisation, the evaluation commission and the supervisory board's investigation, and would burden the company, while the Council of State ruling confirmed the nationalisation was lawful.
I am of the view that an enquiry procedure regarding SNS REAAL adds no value compared with the measures already initiated and moreover has disadvantages.
Ik ben van oordeel dat een enquêteprocedure ten aanzien van SNS REAAL geen meerwaarde heeft ten opzichte van de reeds in gang gezette maatregelen en bovendien nadelen kent.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de gevolgen van de extra taken van Geld Service Nederland

An MP asked the finance minister about the consequences of Geld Service Nederland (GSN), a joint venture of the three big banks, taking over cash counting, storage and transport, including effects on logistics, safety, costs for shopkeepers, competition and ATM availability. The minister answered that GSN concentrates counting onto fewer sites with efficiency gains, that DNB supervises and positively views GSN, that the competition authority is investigating a complaint, and that ATM availability is monitored.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of this research.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de invoering van het provisieverbod

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister about confusion and bottlenecks after the introduction of the commission ban on financial advice, including free advice, Rabobank's delayed model change and the level playing field. The minister answered that the transition is a deliberate culture shift, that cost separation is adequately regulated with AFM enforcement powers limited to excessive fees, and that information channels for consumers and firms are sufficient.
The aim of the commission ban is to bring about a culture change.
Het doel van het provisieverbod is een cultuuromslag te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts asked the finance minister whether clients harmed by Deutsche Bank's takeover of an ABN Amro unit, required by the European Commission, should be protected, whether unilateral changes to financing terms are allowed, and what government role exists. The minister replied that material terms stayed the same, that Deutsche Bank says it will seek solutions per client, that strategy changes are a private business decision not for government to override, and that courts remain available.
I therefore see no role for the government in this.
Ik zie nu dan ook geen rol voor de overheid hierbij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel “DNB: blijf af van bankschuld. Korten obligaties treft financierbaarheid sector”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a DNB official's warnings on bail-in of bank bondholders and the differences between the Dutch Interventiewet and the European recovery and resolution directive. The minister explained the two bail-in approaches, the Dutch preferred combination, and existing powers to impose losses on creditors.
The Dutch government, with DNB's support, is working in the RRD negotiations for a combination of both approaches.
De Nederlandse regering zet zich, met steun van DNB, in de RRD-onderhandelingen in voor een combinatie van de beide benaderingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van stopzetten (agrarische) financiering door Deutsche Bank

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts (CDA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the consequences of Deutsche Bank ending agricultural lending, including possible unfair terms for clients moved from ABN AMRO, complaints received, and support for farmers' financing. The government answered that the decision is a private business choice, that the EC remedy set no lending-terms commitments, that AFM cannot disclose investigations, and that existing agricultural support measures are in place.
However, the AFM cannot make any statements about possible investigations into individual institutions.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken naar individuele instellingen kan de AFM echter geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

CDA MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the ministers about the Nationale Hypotheekgarantie (NHG): claim numbers, debt write-offs, sale methods, approval of forced sales, controls on lenders and the maximum state risk. Minister Blok answered with WEW data, noting forced-sale approval rules were tightened from 1 January 2013 and that the maximum exposure is well below the guaranteed EUR 149 billion.
The WEW states it has no data on this.
Het WEW geeft aan hierover geen gegevens te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over executieveilingen en onderhandse executies

Three CDA MPs asked ministers about foreclosure auctions and private sales of homes, citing lower prices, falling auction numbers, bank conduct, notaries' role and NMa cartel fines. Minister Blok answered that auction prices are lower for structural reasons, that data on private foreclosure sales are incomplete, that the pending bill on foreclosure auctions and existing NHG and AFM measures are the response, and that no new legislation or research is planned.
There is no publicly available data on the number of private foreclosure sales for the entire Dutch housing market.
Er zijn geen openbaar beschikbare gegevens over de aantallen onderhandse verkopen voor de gehele Nederlandse woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Komt de JSF er en gaat de koningin’?

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet would abandon the EU 3% deficit limit, whether pre-agreed spending cuts and a reserve list existed from the coalition formation, and whether any side-letter agreements exist. The minister denied any deviation from the Stability and Growth Pact, denied that such agreements were made during the formation, and stated no additional agreements were made.
No additional agreements have been made.
Er zijn geen aanvullende afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Heerma en Van Hijum over "de inzet van werkloze leermeesters in opleidingsbedrijven in de bouwsector"

Two CDA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether unemployed workers in the construction sector could keep their benefits while serving as temporary instructors in training companies to cover the apprenticeship shortage caused by the crisis. The minister answered that WW benefits cannot be combined with paid instructor work except in a temporary trial placement, that sector plans and a Techniekpact are being explored instead, and gave no commitment to a pilot.
In my view, however, it is not desirable to use WW unemployment benefit money for this.
Het is in mijn ogen echter niet gewenst om hiervoor WW-geld in te zetten.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum over het Nederlandse goud

An MP asked the finance minister why most Dutch gold is held abroad, whether DNB's locations and reporting are sound, and whether DNB should repatriate or sell gold. The minister replied that DNB, as an independent authority, decides on location and valuation, that the gold is safe and well audited, and that no repatriation or sale plans are announced.
DNB, in its role as an independent monetary authority, makes decisions regarding the Dutch gold reserve.
DNB neemt in haar rol als onafhankelijke monetaire autoriteit beslissingen ten aanzien van de Nederlandse goudvoorraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het Nederlandse schaduwbankwezen

MPs Van Hijum asked the Finance Minister about the Netherlands having one of the largest shadow banking sectors, whether the country is a tax haven, the risks and how they are mitigated, and whether shadow banking caused the 2008 crisis. The minister rejected the tax-haven label, said the FSB's very broad definition inflates the Dutch figure to a much smaller core of about 15% of financial sector assets, described international and Dutch regulatory responses, and disputed that shadow banking was a main cause of the crisis.
The Netherlands does, however, have a very attractive investment climate.
Nederland heeft wel een zeer aantrekkelijk vestigingsklimaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum over het bericht “EU Aid for Cyprus A Political Minefield for Merkel”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of Russian deposits and oligarch passports in Cyprus, Cypriot anti-money-laundering efforts, and the lack of investigation into the Magnitsky fraud case, and whether they would condition EU aid on these issues. The minister replied that information on Russian deposits is limited, that Moneyval rates Cyprus positively, that Cypriot authorities have now opened an investigation without seeking Russian permission, and that he would support conditionality on tax information exchange and anti-money-laundering systems if aid is needed.
At this moment not enough information is known to make a precise estimate of the amounts of deposits by persons with Russian nationality at Cypriot banks.
Op dit moment is niet genoeg informatie bekend om een precieze inschatting te kunnen maken van de bedragen aan deposito’s van personen met een Russische nationaliteit bij Cypriotische banken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Hijum en Knops over de hypotheekrenteaftrek

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the planned phased reduction of the mortgage interest deduction top rate (fourth bracket) from 52% to 38% and its effect on marginal tax rates. The government confirmed the plan, said details on the marginal tax effects and the mechanism (no tax credit route) would follow in a bill, and stated that the phasing-down timetable runs over 28 years to give housing market certainty.
It is premature to make statements now about the tax rate that will then apply in the third bracket or the combined tax and premium rate in the second bracket.
Het is voorbarig om nu uitspraken te doen over het dan geldende belastingpercentage in de derde schijf of het gecombineerde belasting- en premiepercentage in de tweede schijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel “Het goud ligt er. Zeggen ze”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch gold reserve is really held at the locations reported, which transactions took place, and whether the Court of Audit should physically verify it. The minister answered that DNB manages the gold, reported a distribution across Amsterdam, London, New York and Ottawa, and declined to involve the Court of Audit given annual checks by DNB's internal audit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de gebrekkige concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about weak competition on the mortgage market, including whether the 2008 state-aid price-leadership ban on ING was a missed chance and how mortgage margins compare to claims by the Vereniging Eigen Huis. The minister says the ban was a Commission condition that was not freely negotiable, that it is now being ended as part of the ING restructuring, and that the government will keep monitoring the market with the NMa and announces transparency and single-tier rate measures.
I cannot therefore endorse the finding that there would have been a missed opportunity.
De constatering dat er sprake zou zijn van een gemiste kans kan ik dan ook niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de onderpandvereisten die door de ECB gesteld worden en de fout die gemaakt is bij de beoordeling van Spaans onderpand

An MP asks the finance minister about the ECB's collateral rules after a press report that Spanish banks borrowed EUR 16.6bn at 0.5% on poorly rated collateral, and about the ECB's rating methodology, changes to collateral rules, DNB's role, and whether an internal review will lead to consequences. The minister answers that the ECB is independent in monetary policy, that a risk-assessment error on EUR 10bn of collateral occurred without exceeding permitted borrowing, that the ECB's Audit Committee will review the framework, and that the consequences are not yet known.
First of all, I wish to emphasise that the ECB is independent in carrying out monetary policy.
Allereerst hecht ik er aan te benadrukken dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in de uitvoering van het monetair beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de vertraging bij de verbreding van de N35 tussen Zwolle en Wijthmen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the widening of the N35 between Zwolle and Wijthmen is delayed by eleven months, what the cause is, and whether the region can take over management of the road. The minister confirmed the delay (about one year, cause: budget shortfall and new noise rules), set a 2015 completion target, referred to the regional agreements, and declined to decentralise management of the national road network.
My ambition is now to complete the project in 2015.
Mijn ambitie is nu om het project in 2015 op te leveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht “Ikea opent bank in Nederland – zonder toezicht”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Ikano Bank, which plans to open a Dutch branch without a Dutch banking licence, should need one, and raised misleading website claims about deposit guarantees and a 13% interest rate. The minister answered that the bank operates under an EU passport with Swedish licensing, must notify DNB, has removed the misleading website claims, does not take deposits in the Netherlands, and that AFM supervises the statutory 15% maximum credit charge.
Ikano Bank has a Swedish banking licence and therefore falls under Swedish supervision.
Ikano Bank heeft een Zweedse bankvergunning en valt zodoende onder het Zweedse toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum over de gevolgen van het vernieuwde jobcoachprotocol

An MP asks whether the revised job coach protocol, which ends support after three years except for an exception clause, is causing employers to dismiss young disabled workers, and whether UWV rarely honours exception requests. The state secretary replies that rejection rates barely changed, that 81% of long-term job coach recipients still have jobs, and that the trend of mass dismissals is not confirmed by the figures.
The picture that job coaching support is being ended on a large scale by the new Protocol is not reflected in the figures.
Het beeld dat op grote schaal voorzieningen jobcoaching worden beëindigd door het nieuwe Protocol is niet terug te zien in de cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de voorgenomen steunoperaties door de ECB

An MP from the CDA asked the finance minister whether the ECB planned an interest-rate cap for crisis countries, whether this fits the ECB's mandate and the ban on monetary financing, and what the Dutch central bank and the government would do about moral hazard. The minister replied that no cap was introduced, that the ECB is independent and the government will not comment on its bond-buying policy, and noted the conditionality attached to the September 2012 bond-purchase programme.
I further emphasise that the ECB is independent in carrying out its monetary task and accordingly I do not express a view on the ECB's policy regarding the purchase of government bonds.

Ik benadruk verder dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in de uitvoering van de monetaire taak en dienovereenkomstig spreek ik mij niet uit over het beleid van de ECB ten aanzien van de opkoop van staatsobligaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over “het bericht inzake de oproep van de Aannemersfederatie om een meldplicht in te voeren voor personen uit andere EU-lidstaten, die in Nederland als zelfstandige of op detacher

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the construction federation's call for a registration duty for EU self-employed and posted workers, and about enforcement against bogus self-employment. The minister answered that a Limosa-style system is still under assessment pending an EU enforcement directive and a Court of Justice ruling, and listed existing enforcement measures and cooperation efforts.
After adoption of the Enforcement Directive and the ruling in the Commission's infringement procedure against Belgium, I will decide on introducing a system like Limosa.

Na vaststelling van de Handhavingsrichtlijn en de uitspraak in de infractieprocedure die de Commissie tegen België heeft aangespannen, zal ik een besluit nemen over de invoering van een systeem als Limosa.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de Goederenroutering Oost-Nederland van het PHS

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why the studies on east Netherlands freight routing in the PHS progress report were late, why the Zutphen-Hengelo description was not updated as a standalone note, how ERTMS affects freight routing, and whether the freight routing component should be reconsidered. The minister answers that the studies were delivered in mid-2012, the Zutphen-Hengelo description is a technical overview pending the MER due spring 2013, ERTMS will be covered in a roadmap, and reconsideration is not on the table because the Chamber declared the component controversial.
According to the current planning the MER will be ready in spring 2013, so that on that basis, and after public consultation and advice, substantiated choices can be made.
Het MER zal volgens de huidige planning in het voorjaar van 2013 gereed zijn, zodat op basis daarvan, en na inspraak en advisering, onderbouwde keuzes kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over stapeling van ESF-subsidies met middelen uit scholingsfondsen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that ESF subsidies were stacked with training-fund money, whether this was morally acceptable, and when the Chamber would receive a full accounting of the funds. The state secretary answered that the 'stacking' is mandatory 60% co-financing by employers and sectoral training funds alongside the 40% ESF subsidy, promised to tighten future rules and to inform the Chamber before year-end, and expected final accountability around 2014.
At the committee meeting on labour market policy of 28 June, I promised to keep the Chamber informed of developments.
Tijdens het AO Arbeidsmarktbeleid van 28 juni jl. heb ik u toegezegd de Kamer op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Hoe bedrijven sollicitanten misleiden met spookvacatures’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether ghost job vacancies used by companies and staffing agencies to mislead job seekers are acceptable, who is responsible for tackling them, and whether an information duty for agencies should be introduced. The minister answered that recruitment is a private matter for companies, that the sector's own voluntary application code suffices, and declined to convene talks or impose new obligations.
The process of recruitment and selection is a private matter.
Het proces van werving en selectie is een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Koopmans en Koppejan over de inhuur van flexibele arbeidskrachten via de aanbestedingskalender

MPs Van Hijum, Koopmans and Koppejan (CDA) asked why central government spends over 45 million euro on temporary agency staff during spending cuts, whether this undoes departmental downsizing targets, and about the tender's lot structure, CAO application, SME access and an overview of framework contracts. The minister answered that the 10% external-hire norm applies, that agency staff are used for peaks and temporary tasks rather than replacing permanent staff, that the CAO Rijk does not apply to them but the inlenersbeloning does, and listed current framework contracts and their durations.
For years the House of Representatives has been informed about the scale of external hiring of personnel by central government, including temporary agency workers.
Sedert jaren wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de omvang van de externe inhuur van personeel bij het Rijk, waaronder uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe over de N35 Wierden Nijverdal

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about delays and cost overruns in widening the N35 between Wierden and Nijverdal, including budget and planning consequences. The minister confirmed the planning delay, a cost overrun of several tens of millions of euros, and that a fuller cost analysis and agreement with the region are due by end April.
The precise overrun is not yet known, but the current estimate is that it will be several tens of millions of euros.
De precieze overschrijding is nog niet bekend, maar de inschatting is nu dat dit meerdere tientallen miljoenen euro’s zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum over de inspectie van Nederlandse zeilschepen in Duitsland

MPs De Rouwe and Van Hijum asked the minister whether German Wasserschutzpolizei inspections of Dutch sailing ships, some repeated six times in as many months, conflict with the Port State Control Directive, and whether the Netherlands should press Germany for restraint. The minister acknowledged the facts, said interpretation disputes are for the Commission and flag-state channels, and reported a letter and bilateral talks urging restraint before the new sailing season.
That is why I decided to send a letter on this matter to my German counterpart.
Daarom heb ik besloten tot het sturen van een brief over deze kwestie aan mijn Duitse ambtgenoot.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Ormel, Omtzigt, Smilde en De Rouwe over de wens van gemeenten om het Nedersaksisch als streektaal te erkennen

CDA MPs asked whether the government still supports recognising Low Saxon under Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, given the long delay since the 2010 application. The minister confirmed the delay, said the government will not recognise Low Saxon under Part III because the inventory showed it would bring extra administrative and financial burdens, and that it stays under Part II.

In light of this, I consider it inopportune for the Netherlands to notify the Council of Europe that protection of Low Saxon will henceforth take place in accordance with at least 35 provisions of Part III of the European Charter.

Naar aanleiding hiervan acht ik het daarom niet opportuun dat Nederland bij de Raad van Europa kenbaar maakt dat bescherming van het Nedersaksisch voortaan plaatsvindt conform ten minste 35 bepalingen van Deel III van het Europees Handvest.

Antwoord vragen Haverkamp, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de inloopavond in Bathmen over plannen tot intensivering van het goederenvervoer per spoor, in het kader van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS)

CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that a January 2012 information evening in Bathmen on rail freight plans (PHS) descended into chaos, with ministry staff unable to answer residents' questions. The minister acknowledged the disorder, regretted that not all questions could be answered, and pointed to a follow-up evening, websites, written questions and the formal MER objection channel.
I regret that as a result not everyone's questions could be answered.
Ik betreur het dat daardoor niet ieders vragen beantwoord konden worden.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Van Hijum over historische treinstellen

MPs Haverkamp and Van Hijum asked whether historic trains fitted with ATB could still run on ATB-NG lines after an exemption was reportedly withdrawn, and whether this harms heritage and wasted subsidy. The minister denied any exemption remains, said such trains may run on ATB-NG lines only where no alternative route exists and at up to 40 km/h, and saw no need for further measures.
No, there is no longer any such exemption.
Nee, er is geen sprake meer van een dergelijke ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Koopmans over de advertentie “Hollandse asperges met een romige crème van moderne slavernij”

CDA MPs Van Hijum and Koopmans asked the minister why a campaign advertisement labelled 'modern slavery' reappeared in January 2012 after the campaign was supposedly stopped, which media it ran in, and what it cost. The minister admitted the ad should not have run, said the agency was not told to stop it in time, listed the titles and a cost of 79,490 euro, and noted no effect study was done.
The advertisement should not have been placed.
De advertentie had niet geplaatst moeten worden.
Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over beelden van inbrekers gemaakt door RTV Oost (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Çörüz and Van Hijum asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether broadcasting images of burglars by RTV Oost, and public posting of identifiable footage generally, is permitted under privacy law and whether the legal framework should be clarified. The minister answered that the journalistic exemption makes such broadcasting generally permissible, that citizens should first offer footage to police and prosecutors, and that a bill amending the Wbp is in consultation to set conditions for private camera footage.
The bill contains, among other things, a further regulation on the use of surveillance camera images made by private individuals.
Dit wetsvoorstel bevat onder andere een nadere regeling voor het gebruik van beelden van bewakingscamera's die door particulieren zijn vervaardigd.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichtgeving rondom het failliet van Zalco (ingezonden

MPs Koppejan and Van Hijum asked ministers about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Zalco, its impact on employment and the metal industry, and the unequal European energy cost playing field. The minister answered that the parent company tried to rescue Zalco, that EGF support is being prepared, and that the government is pursuing a North-West European electricity market and contacts with the Commission on German and Belgian measures.
I have therefore asked the European Commission to provide an overview of similar schemes in other countries and of the Commission's position on these schemes.
Ik heb daarom bij de Europese Commissie de vraag neergelegd een overzicht te geven over soortgelijke regelingen in andere landen en de opstelling van de Europese Commissie tegenover deze regelingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over korting AOW toeslag bij ex-partner pensioen (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

Deputy Van Hijum asks whether ex-partner pension should be treated as alimony rather than pension income when reducing the AOW partner supplement. Minister Kamp answers that ex-partner pension is a pension benefit under the Wet Verevening Pensioenrechten, so the current treatment as other income stands and no change to the rules is planned.
Therefore I see no reason to amend the Inkomensbesluit.
Derhalve zie ik geen aanleiding om het Inkomensbesluit te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «Boete kweker ingetrokken» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why a €192,000 fine for employing 24 Polish workers without a work permit was withdrawn, whether this signals a policy change on posted workers, and how Netherlands can control posting and bogus self-employment within the EU. The minister answers that the fine was withdrawn because the inspection report lacked sufficient evidence, that the Vicoplus ruling confirms existing policy requiring work permits for 'impure' service provision, that no policy change occurs, and that the government is examining a Belgian-style notification system.
Following a legal assessment in connection with the appeal lodged by the grower, it was concluded that the inspection report on which the fine was based contained insufficient evidence.
In verband met het door de kweker ingestelde hoger beroep is na een juridische beoordeling geconcludeerd dat het boeterapport waarop de boete was gebaseerd onvoldoende bewijs bevatte.

Vragen de leden Van Hijum en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over een verblijfsstatus en het recht op kinderbijslag (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked the ministers about a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that parents without a valid residence permit may be entitled to child benefit after long residence, and what follow-up policy, cassation and measures to prevent such entitlement are planned. The government answered that the ruling is being contested in cassation before the Hoge Raad, will inform parliament once the consequences are clear, and says its streamlining programme aims to prevent prolonged residence through stacked procedures.
The Sociale Verzekeringsbank has lodged an appeal in cassation with the Hoge Raad.
De Sociale Verzekeringsbank heeft cassatieberoep ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor Roemenen in de seizoenarbeid in de tuinbouw. (Ingezonden 26 juli 2011).

MP Van Hijum asks the minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling suspending refusals of work permits for Romanian seasonal horticultural workers, the government's conduct of stricter permit review, the number of permits granted and refused, and consequences for Bulgarian and Romanian applicants. The minister responds that UWV will decide the objections taking the court's reasoning into account, reports permit statistics, argues that the stand-still obligations were not breached because conditions were not made stricter, and states that 180 permits are deemed granted for 16 growers.
I do not think it is right to anticipate these decisions on objection by discussing the content of the court's ruling.
Ik vind het niet juist om vooruit te lopen op deze beslissingen op bezwaar door in te gaan op de inhoud van de uitspraak van de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over belangenverstrengeling bij een leidinggevende van het UWV (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether a UWV executive who runs a commercial firm supplying staff and contracts to UWV was in a conflict of interest, whether the Board knew, and what action would follow. The minister confirmed the Board knew, described the contract safeguards and the decision to end the arrangement, and said an integrity bureau review was ordered while ruling out involving the Rijksrecherche for now.
To prevent any appearance of conflict of interest, the UWV Board decided to end the existing situation.
Om elke schijn van belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen heeft de Raad van Bestuur van het UWV besloten de bestaande situatie te beëindigen.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Hanzelijn (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

CDA MPs Van Hijum and De Rouwe asked whether the promised 15-minute saving on Amsterdam-Zwolle rail journeys from the Hanzelijn would be achieved, what determines reaching the 55-minute target, and what effect a longer journey has on the cost-benefit ratio. The minister answered that the reference times may not be reached at opening, depending on timetable and infrastructure choices, that the Hanzelijn is built to 200 km/h specifications, and that no fundamental change in the cost-benefit ratio is expected.
The expectation is that the travel times stated in the reference cannot yet be achieved at the moment the Hanzelijn opens.
De verwachting is dat de reistijden, zoals genoemd in de referentie, op het moment van opening van de Hanzelijn nog niet kunnen worden gehaald.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkeringen in Turkije (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the minister about the export of Toeslagenwet supplements to Turkey and other countries following the Akdas ruling (C-485/07), including effects on past recipients, export to EU states and treaty countries, and legal options. The minister answered that the Centrale Raad van Beroep must first rule on the Akdas case before the exact consequences are clear, and described existing export rules and treaty renegotiations.
As soon as I have more clarity on this, I will inform your House further.
Zodra ik daar meer duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt , Sterk en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een concurrentiebeding bij een detacheringsbedrijf (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Social Affairs about a non-compete clause in a staffing agency's contracts, including whether UWV refers jobseekers to such employers and whether refusing such a contract affects unemployment benefit. The minister answered that such clauses are legally permitted and courts can moderate them, that refusing a job with a non-compete is generally not a valid ground to deny benefits except in unusual cases, and that UWV cannot force a jobseeker to sign a contract breaching an earlier non-compete.
The mere fact that an employer has included a non-compete clause in the employment contract is not a reason to regard a job offer as unsuitable.
Het enkele feit dat een werkgever in het arbeidscontract een concurrentiebeding heeft opgenomen, is geen reden om een arbeidsaanbod als niet passend te beschouwen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum ask the State Secretary of Finance about blocked childcare allowance payments, parents who cannot resolve delays, wrongful full suspension after partial changes, and whether the tax service will restore regular consultation with help desks. The State Secretary answers that about 9,800 applications were halted pending registry numbers and 3,225 suspended for non-response, that wrongful suspensions would be corrected on objection, and that consultation runs through trade associations and umbrella bodies while help desks can send feedback by mail or phone.
If the applicant has responded but the Tax and Customs Administration has unfortunately not received the documents, we advise the applicant to send the documents again.
Als de aanvrager heeft gereageerd maar de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onverhoopt de stukken niet heeft ontvangen, dan raden wij de aanvrager aan de stukken nogmaals op te sturen.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gastouderopvang (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the government's commitments to control the administrative costs of host-parent (gastouder) agencies, how those costs are calculated and disclosed to parents, the monitoring of agency fees, and whether notice periods and penalty clauses hinder parents' choice. The minister answered that no commitment to control costs was made, that transparency rules already apply, that fees total roughly 16% of turnover, and that no maximum fee or regulation is needed at present.
I agree that imposing requirements on the administration of host-parent agencies does not automatically lead to transparency for parents seeking care.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat het stellen van eisen aan de administratie van gastouderbureaus niet automatisch leidt tot transparantie voor vraagouders.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum (CDA) en Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gemeentelijke leges voor opname van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) (ingezonden 15

Two MPs asked the minister why municipalities charge fees to register childminders in the national childcare register, what those costs are, and whether central registration is planned. The minister answered that municipalities are legally entitled to charge cost-recovery fees, that the funding allocation may be refined for 2012, and that centralising only the registration step would yield no efficiency gain, while promising to inform parliament by end of April.
The precise costs of the action a municipality takes to register a childminder in the LRK are not known to me.
De precieze kosten van de handeling die een gemeente verricht om een gastouder op te nemen in het LRK, zijn mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het Landelijk Register Kindero

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance and two ministers about the national childcare register (LRK), including unmatched parents, the welcome text on the website, multi-child households, and the lack of a real-time link to tax systems. The government answered that most parents responded, that the website text was accurate, that a study of a link will be done, and that multi-provider reporting only becomes possible from 2012.
I can commit to having a study carried out this year into the possibility of such a link.
Ik kan u toezeggen dit jaar een onderzoek te laten doen naar de mogelijkheid van een dergelijke koppeling.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked why childcare-allowance applicants had to re-enter whole forms after failing to match the national childcare register, and about digital copies, confirmation timelines, reminder letters and real-time register checks. The state secretary defended the matching process, admitted the application program is not user-friendly but cannot be fixed with current software, and committed to a reminder deadline of 28 February 2011 while rejecting a real-time register check as infeasible.
The application program is unfortunately not user-friendly in this respect.
Het aanvraagprogramma is hierin helaas niet gebruikersvriendelijk.

Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over privacy en de veiligheid van de gastouders bij registratie in het landelijk register kinderopvang (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether publishing home addresses of childminders in the national childcare register endangers their privacy and safety, and whether the requirement could be limited to name, place and registration number. The minister rejected the privacy concern in general, kept publication of the care location as a transparency measure, but agreed to examine withholding the home address in exceptional cases such as demonstrable safety risks.
I am, however, willing to examine whether it is possible to shield the childminder's home address in the LRK in exceptional cases.
Daarbij ben ik wel bereid te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om in uitzonderingsgevallen het woonadres van de gastouder in het LRK af te schermen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijstorten in de pensioenpolis (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and van Hijum asked the minister whether employers must sometimes pay tens of thousands of euros in top-up payments when pension transfers are compulsory on an employee's departure, and how often this occurs, and what will be done to end the problem. The minister acknowledged such situations can arise mainly for SMEs with insurer-held schemes, said no data exist on frequency, promised to inventory solutions with the Stichting van de Arbeid and to inform parliament by Q1 2011, and stated there is no underfunding of insurers' obligations.
I will, together with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the pension sector, inventory how these effects can be removed or limited.
Ik zal – met de Stichting van de Arbeid en het pensioenveld – inventariseren hoe deze effecten kunnen worden weggenomen of beperkt.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Oost-Europese concurrentie in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 5 oktober 2

CDA MPs asked whether Bulgarian and Romanian home-care workers are being employed through posted-worker constructions, whether this circumvents work permit rules and amounts to bogus self-employment, and how the Arbeidsinspectie controls this. The minister explained the notification route for cross-border service providers, said the Arbeidsinspectie checks for illegal employment and bogus self-employment, and announced a 2011 inspection project in the care sector.
In these cases it is being examined whether there is illegal employment through the use of bogus self-employed workers or through making labour available without the required work permit.
