In deze zaken wordt onderzocht of er sprake is van illegale tewerkstelling door de inzet van schijnzelfstandigen of door het ter beschikking stellen van arbeid zonder de benodigde tewerkstellingsvergunning.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Uitleg over uitkering tijdens gratis knipbeurt allochtonen». (Ingezonden 10 september 2010)

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the Sociale Verzekeringsbank's plan to offer free haircuts to migrants to promote the AIO supplement, and whether this was a proper motivation and what other information the SVB provides. The minister confirmed the pilot in Utrecht, said the SVB has a responsibility to combat non-take-up, listed its other communication activities, and said expansion depends on effectiveness and cost-efficiency.
It concerns a pilot in Utrecht.
Het gaat om een pilot in Utrecht.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan, Blanksma-van den heuvel en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het mogelijke massaontslag bij Organon te Oss (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

Three CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about possible mass dismissals at Organon/MSD in Oss, including requests for postponing reorganisation to allow a science park, coordination with local and provincial authorities, and why R&D sites elsewhere in Europe are less affected. The minister replied that two working groups with the government, region, municipality and MSD have started, that R&D consolidation is a global process with a broad shift towards the US, and that MSD has historically viewed the Dutch investment climate positively.
Active use of the government's instruments for innovation and entrepreneurship will explicitly be taken into account.
Actieve inzet van het overheidsinstrumentarium voor innovatie en ondernemerschap zal daarbij nadrukkelijk worden meegenomen.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de sluiting van de ASR-vestiging in Woudsend (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

MPs De Rouwe, Van Hijum and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the closure of the ASR office in Woudsend, its employment impact, the government's northern economic strategy, and the status of two shrinkage-related motions. The minister acknowledged the job loss, said the decision was a company strategy matter outside government intervention, pointed to Koers Noord and local responsibility, and reported that the motion inventory is finished and will be sent to parliament.
It is not my role to look for solutions at national level for an individual employment problem such as the one now arising around ASR Woudsend.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om voor een individueel werkgelegenheidsprobleem, zoals dat zich nu voordoet rond ASR Woudsend, op rijksniveau naar oplossingen te zoeken.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Atsma (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de medewerking van Staatsbosbeheer aan de realisatie van een fietspad over de Gouden Bodem (ingezonden 27

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer refuses to cooperate on a walking and cycling route over the Gouden Bodem, a Natura 2000 island, and whether it should reconsider with local initiators. The minister confirmed awareness, described the area's protected bird values and rest needs, and said she will await the regional development rather than commit to new talks.
I want to wait for this development.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Saris over het aanpakken van sluiproutes voor derdelanders om toegang te krijgen tot de Nederlandse arbeidsmarkt

MPs Van Hijum and Saris asked how third-country nationals obtain BSN numbers via RNI counters to access the Dutch labour market illegally, and what sanctions and checks apply. The State Secretary answered that a BSN confers no work rights, announced restricted RNI counters for third-country nationals from January 2, higher fines for employers, and an ongoing study on an arrival notification, but gave limited detail on some sanctions and timing.
I am having it examined, as previously reported, whether it can be effective and proportionate to exclude registration at RNI counters for third-country nationals.
Ik laat, zoals eerder gemeld, onderzoeken of het effectief en proportioneel kan zijn om inschrijving aan RNI-loketten voor derdelanders uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Wingelaar en Saris over het gebruik en de bescherming van Nedersaksisch en Limburgs als streektalen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior why Low Saxon and Limburgish are protected under Part II rather than Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, and what the state has done to support them. The minister answered that Part II already provides adequate protection through convenants with regional governments, that Part III's adoption requires further analysis, and that the convenant with Low Saxon is under evaluation.
Whether extension to Part III is appropriate requires further analysis of feasibility and resources and will proceed in consultation with the regional governments concerned.
Of uitbreiding naar deel III passend is, vraagt een nadere analyse van uitvoerbaarheid en middelen en gaat in samenspraak met de betrokken regionale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Migratie is niet hét probleem van de woningmarkt: 'Dat is onzin'’ geschreven voor nu.nl.

Two MPs from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Housing about the role of migration in the housing shortage, including its share of housing demand, its effect on starters, and measures for migrant housing and quality. The minister answered that migration drives most population growth and thus housing need, outlined existing instruments such as flexible housing funding and the Wet goed verhuurderschap, and acknowledged gaps in data on migrant housing, though many answers referred to general policy or other responsibilities.
No data are available on the number of dwellings owned by temporary employment agencies and private investors who rent housing to such agencies.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal woningen dat in handen is van uitzendbureaus en private investeerders die woonruimtes verhuren aan uitzendbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Postma en Saris over de teloorgang van de iconische fietsenfabriek Batavus in Heerenveen en nieuwe kansen voor de maakindustrie

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the relocation of Batavus bicycle production from Heerenveen to Hungary, job losses, private equity motives, Hungarian industrial policy and state aid, and possible national programmes to keep manufacturing in the Netherlands. The minister replied that the move is a company decision within Accell's transformation programme, that the government cannot prevent it, had no direct contact with Accell, and that no new national programme is currently needed.
This concerns a company decision by the company itself, in which the government has no formal role and which cannot be stopped.
Het betreft een ondernemingsbeslissing van het bedrijf zelf, waarin de overheid geen formele rol heeft en die niet kan worden tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Hertzberger over de toezegging over de minimale stagevergoeding gedaan bij het commissiedebat MBO van 1 oktober 2025

MPs Van Hijum and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education whether the promised preparation of a legally mandatory minimum internship allowance was limited, whether employers were expected to act first, and whether the Stagepact had worked. The minister confirmed the commitment to send the outline of a bill in Q2 2026, said an exploration of legal options is ongoing and that legislation is the next step if employer progress stays insufficient.
That is why I am now exploring how we can make this legally mandatory, and you will receive, as promised, the outline of a bill before summer 2026.
Daarom verken ik nu hoe we dit wettelijk kunnen verplichten en ontvangt u, zoals toegezegd, de contouren van een wetsvoorstel voor de zomer 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het plotse uitstel van de deadline over spreiding van vluchtelingen i.v.m. de Europese Top op 23 en 24 oktober 2025

An MP asked why the Commission suddenly postponed the 15 October 2025 deadline for the annual migration report and refugee distribution decision, whether it was linked to Dutch elections, whether the government asked for the delay, and how Poland's exemption could be announced before the report existed. The minister answered that the Commission needs more time, denied any link to the elections, said no new date was communicated, and said the government only raised timing concerns in July without asking for a delay since.
Since then no one in the cabinet has raised this, and the cabinet has indicated it will leave the publication date to the Commission.
Sindsdien heeft niemand van het kabinet hiervoor aandacht gevraagd en heeft het kabinet aangegeven de publicatiedatum aan de Commissie te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Van Vroonhoven en Eerdmans over de toepassing van het Europese solidariteitsmechanisme

MPs Van Hijum, Van Vroonhoven and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the EU solidarity mechanism under the Migration Pact, including Dutch stance, the 2026 solidarity pool, whether the Netherlands could be designated under migration pressure, and Dublin transfer figures. The minister answered that the Netherlands intends to contribute financially rather than through relocations, that its share is roughly 5-6%, that Dublin transfers depend on a plan of action, and that the Commission's decisions will be published, with the Council's pool proposal kept confidential.
The European Commission's proposal for a Council decision on the solidarity pool is confidential under Article 12(6) of the AMMR and other relevant EU legislation.
Het voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een raadsbesluit over de solidariteitspool is op grond van artikel 12 lid 6 van de AMMR en andere relevante uniewetgeving vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van der Burg over de aankondiging van Netanyahu dat migratiestromen uit Gaza zullen ontstaan

MPs Rajkowski and Van der Burg asked the government whether Netanyahu's announcement of Palestinian departures from Gaza would cause migration flows to the EU, how screening would catch Hamas members among asylum seekers, and how the Netherlands would press Israel and support the region. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes forced displacement, screens asylum seekers for war-crime indicators, works on regional reception and EU migration measures, and continues diplomatic pressure for a ceasefire.
For Dutch policy it is beyond question: Gaza belongs to the Palestinians.
Voor het Nederlands beleid staat buiten kijf: Gaza is van de Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de voorgestelde wijzigingen in de Regeling vrijstellingen Wet Bpf 2000

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about proposed changes to the Regeling vrijstellingen Wet Bpf 2000, which govern exemptions from mandatory sector pension funds, and criticism that the actuarial equivalence test may make exemptions too costly or impossible. The Minister defends the amendments as negotiated with the sector, notes that the regulation was revised after consultation (deterministic calculation as standard, no actuarial test per pension type), keeps the actuarial test in place, and promises publication in early October.
It was deliberately chosen to include elements in the test that can be well valued with a relatively simple calculation method (the deterministic calculation).
Er is bewust gekozen om elementen in de toetsing te betrekken die goed waardeerbaar met een relatief eenvoudige berekeningswijze (de deterministische berekening).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorginstituut: ’Prijzen dure geneesmiddelen onnodig lang hoog’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about a Zorginstituut report that prices of expensive medicines stay high too long, including evergreening practices, and whether the state should bring drug development into public hands. The Minister acknowledges concern about evergreening, reports 8 signals in 2025 versus 3 in 2024, says he lacks direct instruments and will respond to motion Thiadens by early 2026, and defends a role for industry while planning a joint advisory report and a fund proposal.
I expect to be able to address the adopted motion in more detail in early 2026.
Ik verwacht begin 2026 nader in te kunnen gaan op de aangenomen motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Verdachte aangehouden voor ernstig zedenmisdrijf op Amsterdamse Weesperzijde

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the rule of law applies to asylum seekers, whether consequences such as withheld allowances or asylum withdrawal always follow offences, how repeat offending is prevented, whether an amendment on unwelcome declarations should be used, whether experts should be consulted, and how unpaid public transport fines are charged to asylum seekers. The minister replied that criminal law applies equally, that lik-op-stuk policy and asylum withdrawal on public order grounds are applied, that existing measures suffice for now, and that fine collection is the responsibility of carriers, with ongoing talks with COA and other parties.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Zorgvuldige nieuwe wetgeving kan regelbrij voorkomen'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about a PwC report showing rising rules for implementing agencies, and about whether the cabinet will act on simplification, stricter upfront scrutiny, IT modernisation and temporary measures. The government largely agrees with the diagnosis, points to ongoing simplification programmes and planned letters, but declines to commit to new specific reviews, provides no Rijksbreed overview of temporary measures, and says it will not in principle reduce the number of laws.
There is currently no government-wide overview of temporary measures or measures with a sunset clause.
Er is op dit moment geen Rijksbreed beeld van tijdelijke maatregelen of maatregelen met een horizonbepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over private equity-keten Evidensia, die jarenlang pensioengeld van werknemers in eigen zak stopte

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the government about private equity-owned vet chain Evidensia allegedly withholding employee pension contributions, poor employer conduct, unqualified staff, bonuses for referrals, and measures against private equity takeovers. The state secretary replied that the pension matter is between employer and employees outside DNB's supervision, that the government will await the ACM market study before deciding on price regulation, and that it is strengthening consumer information and profession-quality safeguards.
I have no insight into the precise circumstances at the company named in the article and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Op de precieze inhoud van de situaties bij de in het artikel genoemde bedrijf heb ik geen zicht en hier kan ik daarom geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het uitfaseren van WBS

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the phase-out of the shared vacancy system WBS, without a functional replacement, breaches the statutory cooperation duty between UWV, SVB and municipalities. The minister denied a breach, stating that a data-exchange alternative (VUM) exists, that CRM functions stay in place until a replacement is ready, and that UWV and VNG provide support.
No. The cooperation obligation applies to services to job seekers and employers. It does not oblige UWV to make an IT system available to municipalities.
Nee. De samenwerkingsverplichting geldt voor de dienstverlening aan werkzoekenden en werkgevers. Het verplicht UWV niet om een IT-systeem beschikbaar te stellen aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de mogelijkheid om af te wijken van parameters artikel 23a Besluit FTK bij bepaling transitie- effecten

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether DNB's Q&A allowing pension funds to deviate from the parameters of article 23a of the FTK Decree in transition calculations undermines legal certainty and democratic control. The minister replies that the Q&A only clarifies that net-benefit calculations are exempt from those parameters under the Pensioenwet, that DNB has since amended the Q&A, and that no existing transitions or legal changes are affected.
It is not the case that DNB, through a Q&A, generally permits pension providers to deviate from the law.
Het is niet zo dat DNB via een Q&A generiek toestaat dat pensioenuitvoerders afwijken van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Lahlah over raadsleden met een uitkering

MPs Chakor and Lahlah asked whether councillors receiving benefits are unduly deterred from office, citing a report on benefit-related salary offsetting. The minister acknowledges the signals but rejects the report's proposals as unworkable, instead pointing to clarification of existing rules and an ongoing WIA policy review.
But I do want to make an effort toward improved and clearer implementation.
Ik wil mij wel inspannen voor een verbeterde en duidelijkere uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether government bodies such as UWV and SVB will reconsider moving services to US cloud providers, given dependence on US tech giants and the CLOUD Act. The government answered that cloud policy is being revised to limit concentration risk and that some migrations were reconsidered, but it gave only general assurances on continuity, data confidentiality, and strategic autonomy.
In the revision of the government-wide cloud policy, attention is also being paid to further limiting dependence on a few suppliers.
In de herziening van het rijksbreed cloudbeleid wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan het verder beperken van afhankelijkheid van enkele leveranciers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de vervolging van Eternit door het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asks the government about the criminal prosecution of Eternit for manslaughter, the performance of the government-funded Instituut Asbestslachtoffers (IAS) and whether a statutory asbestos fund is needed, and whether the 2016 asbestos ban bill will be re-submitted. The state secretary declines to comment on the prosecution (a matter for the court), rejects the claim that the IAS is failing, and says no new asbestos ban bill is planned given existing EU REACH rules and a voluntary roof-removal strategy.
It is for the court to judge in this case.
Het is aan de rechter om in deze zaak te oordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Onderzoekers: uitbuiting schoonmakers Saints & Stars staat niet op zich' en 'Saints & Stars was geen incident: ongedocumenteerden houden Nederland draaiende'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of severe exploitation of undocumented workers in cleaning and hospitality, including the low number of prosecutions, the Labour Inspectorate's passive approach, fines, minimum wage and sector rules. The Minister acknowledged the problem, cited new enforcement powers, pending legislation and planned fine indexation, but declined to earmark fine revenue for undocumented workers and rejected a minimum wage hike to 18 euro as a targeted fix.

As indicated in the letter of 9 July 2025, it is therefore my intention to raise the fines under the Eerlijk Werk labour laws by taking into account fictitious indexation of recent years in the new standard amount.

Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 9 juli 2025 10 is het daarom mijn voornemen om de boetes van Eerlijk Werk arbeidswetten te verhogen door bij het nieuwe normbedrag rekening te houden met fictieve indexatie van de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Fondsen mogen operationele buffer toch aanvullen vanuit solidariteitsreserve’

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension funds may top up their operational buffer from the solidarity reserve, and whether this conflicts with the Wet toekomst pensioenen and with DNB's invaarbesluiten. The Minister answered that the draft verzamelbesluit allows the solidarity reserve to be used to prevent pension cuts, that specific cases (APG, the multiplicative method) are for DNB to judge, and that DNB applies proportionality in enforcement.
I do not comment on specific cases, because I cannot enter into the relationship between the pension fund and the independent supervisor.
Over specifieke casussen doe ik geen uitspraak, omdat ik niet in de relatie kan treden tussen het pensioenfonds en de onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de rechtspositie van pensioendeelnemers bij informatieverstrekking en invaren

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension participants can rely on UPO pension statements and transition information, whether they can obtain binding confirmation and extra calculations, and whether statutory rights and timelines should be strengthened. The minister answers that pension entitlements follow the pension regulation rather than statements, that participants may request calculations and explanations, and that no binding documents or statutory changes are planned beyond announced information measures.
I see no reason nor possibility to grant rights to the UPO.
Ik zie geen aanleiding noch mogelijkheden om rechten toe te kennen aan het UPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de kraamzorg in Nederland onder druk staat

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Health Minister how she would respond to reports that maternity care is under pressure, citing workload, working conditions and pay for maternity carers, and shortages leaving families without the care they need. Minister Tieman answered that staffing shortages are a sector-wide problem, pointed to the joint vision, convenant and acceleration agenda of insurers and providers, said the IGJ has no direct evidence that shortages cause incorrect care, and committed to monitoring developments and looking seriously at any obstacles the parties encounter.
I will continue to follow the progress of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de voortgang van de genomen maatregelen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Patijn over interim-salarissen in de publieke sector

MPs Mohandis and Patijn asked how interim executives in the public sector can combine several assignments to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether the rules should change. The minister says the WNT is not being circumvented, commits to investigating whether the situation recurs and, if so, to proposing an extension of the anti-cumulation rule to interim managers, and explains the enforcement roles of the Tax Authority and supervisory bodies.
Following this case, the Minister of BZK will have it investigated whether the situation described occurs or has occurred more often.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal de Minister van BZK laten onderzoeken of de beschreven situatie zich vaker voordoet of heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht French court rules Gaza residents can get refugee status

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a French court ruling granting refugee status to Gazans, its free-movement and Schengen consequences, and whether the Netherlands should challenge France or restrict social benefits. The minister said Dutch policy on Gaza already yields similar outcomes, so consequences are limited, and declined to raise objections with France, suspend Schengen, or block benefits.
Furthermore, the general picture is that it is practically impossible to leave Gaza without permission from the relevant authorities.
Verder is het algemene beeld dat het vrijwel onmogelijk is om Gaza te verlaten zonder toestemming van de relevante autoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Patijn en Vijlbrief over de kabinetsreactie op de verkenning wettelijk minimumjeugdloon en het artikel Van Hijum kritisch op aangenomen Kamermotie over minimumjeugdloon

MPs Dassen, Patijn and Vijlbrief asked why the government delays the youth minimum wage increase to 1 January 2027 and rejects the adopted motion's 2026 timing, funding sources and steeper staffel. The minister answers that 2026 is not feasible due to AMvB procedures, that the motion lacks sound funding, and that the chosen staffel (62.5%-75%-87.5%) reflects policy considerations.
The cabinet has decided not to implement the motion at this time.
Het kabinet heeft besloten de motie op dit moment niet uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) de wet overtreedt bij keuringen op arbeidsongeschiktheid door een tekort aan personeel.

An MP asked the minister about reports that UWV breaches the law in disability assessments due to staff shortages, including the use of telephone assessments and quality control of assessing physicians. The minister denies that telephone assessments are unlawful, describes quality monitoring (MOK, audits, risk-based investigations) and says results are shared with the ministry and parliament where warranted.
That is factually incorrect, because the telephone assessment is, depending on the circumstances, a method permitted by the Dutch Association for Insurance Medicine (NVVG).
Dat is feitelijk onjuist, want de telefonische beoordeling is – afhankelijk van de omstandigheden – een volgens de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Verzekeringsgeneeskunde (NVVG) toegestane methode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Haage over de achterstanden van kinderen van Europese arbeidsmigranten en de financiering van scholen

MPs Patijn and Haage ask the government about funding shortfalls for schools with many children of Eastern European labour migrants, whose weighting under the disadvantage-funding model is seen as inadequate, and about reviewing the model. The State Secretary says the CBS is recalibrating the disadvantage indicator, expected to be in use in 2027, and that the funding model is not the solution for family instability caused by economic hardship.
It illustrates the need to periodically recalibrate the indicator used for educational disadvantage.
Het illustreert de noodzaak om de gebruikte indicator voor onderwijsachterstanden periodiek te herijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Van Zanten over het artikel Visumvrij reizen 85 miljoen Turken stap dichterbij

BBB MPs asked whether the European Commission is seriously considering visa-free travel for all Turkish citizens despite Turkey's non-fulfilment of benchmarks, and what this means for migration control and sovereignty. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is not on the table because six of 72 criteria remain open, that the Schengen cascade model change only extends visa validity for frequent travellers, and that the government firmly maintains full fulfilment of the benchmarks.
See the answer to question 2. There is no question of visa-free travel.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2. Er is geen sprake van visumvrij reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het bericht dat Online-supermarkten bijval krijgen van ACM

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ACM's letter on online supermarkets and competition sits well with the collective labour agreement exemption and the AVV framework, and how the pending dispensation request will be handled after a court ruling. The minister replies that the ACM acts independently, that the minister decides the dispensation on its own legal assessment, that the procedure must be followed carefully without prejudging the outcome, and that a broader review of the cao and AVV system will be reported after the summer.
It is important that this process is carefully followed through and I cannot anticipate the outcome.
Het is belangrijk dat dit proces zorgvuldig wordt doorlopen en ik kan niet op de uitkomst vooruitlopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Bikkers over de artikelen ‘Picnic en Flink vallen onder supermarkt-cao, zegt rechter’ van RTL-nieuws en ‘Online-supermarkten krijgen bijval van ACM in discussie rond cao

MPs Martens-America and Bikkers asked whether the government will act on court and ACM signals that online supermarkets Picnic and Flink fall under the supermarket collective labour agreement, and whether the AVV and dispensation framework needs updating for innovative firms. The minister says he is reviewing the cao and AVV system, will not comment on the pending dispensation request, and points to existing dispensation criteria while promising a fuller update after the summer.
The dispensation request is currently being handled by me.
Momenteel is het dispensatieverzoek bij mij in behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over jongeren werkzaam in de bollenteelt

An MP asked whether 13-17 year olds may work with bulbs treated with pesticides, how many minors work in bulb growing, whether inspections target them, and whether rules are adequate. The Secretary of State answered that minors may only handle such bulbs under strict conditions (no CMR substances, residues minimised, employer obligations under the Arbobesluit), that data on minors' health risks are not yet known, and that the government is in talks with the sector about clarifying the rules.
SZW is in talks with the sector (LTO, Stigas) and trade unions about the practice regarding young people and crop protection products.
SZW is in gesprek met de sector (LTO, Stigas) en vakbonden over de praktijk rond jongeren en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Westerveld over de voortgang van een passende zorgverlofregeling voor ouders van ernstig zieke kinderen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the ministers about progress on a motion requiring a suitable leave scheme for parents of seriously ill children, and about the lack of paid care leave and financial hardship. The minister says an exploration with stakeholders is underway, results expected this autumn, and acknowledges the difficult situation without committing to specific substance.
This autumn I expect to be able to inform your House further about this exploration.
Dit najaar verwacht ik uw Kamer verder te kunnen informeren over deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitputtingsziekte ME/CVS

An MP asked the Minister of Health about doubts over the evidence for cognitive behavioural therapy for children with ME/CVS, reports of harm and coerced treatment, and whether guidelines and reports to Veilig Thuis were appropriate. The Minister largely deferred to the medical profession (NVK), said the government does not decide on treatment, and only committed to continued funding of biomedical research and the ZonMw programme.
As Minister I do not decide on the diagnosis or treatment of patients, because that is the doctor's domain.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de diagnose of de behandeling van patiënten, want dat is het terrein van de arts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over ‘therapie voor kinderen met uitputtingsziekte ME/CVS in twijfel getrokken’

MP Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about reports questioning cognitive behavioural therapy for children with ME/CVS, including concerns from parents and reported Veilig Thuis notifications. The Minister answered that treatment is a matter for medical professionals and Samen Beslissen applies, referred most questions to the medical field or other bodies, and pointed to ZonMw-funded research and encouraged constructive dialogue.
As Minister, I do not decide on the diagnosis or treatment of patients; that is the domain of the physician.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de diagnose of de behandeling van patiënten, dat is het werkdomein van de arts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Patijn, Bikker en Saris over de vertraging van het UWV-onderzoek naar de beoordeling van post-COVID-patiënten

MPs asked why the UWV study into how post-COVID patients were assessed for WIA benefits was delayed, and what is being done about knowledge gaps among insurance physicians and the duration-capacity standard. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the study is expected to finish in September, outlined a handbook and casuistry being developed with the NVVG, and rejected the view that the problem is structurally underestimated.
I regret that the study has been delayed.
Ik betreur dat het onderzoek vertraging heeft opgelopen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de berichten ‘Patiënten met een darmontsteking staan maanden op wachtlijsten: onverantwoord’ en ‘Manon wachtte 7 maanden op darmoperatie: impact van darmziekte wordt onderschat

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the health minister about reports of long waiting times (about 22 weeks on average) for surgery for chronic bowel inflammation (IBD) patients, versus the 7-week Treeknorm, and about registration, oversight and possible action. The minister acknowledged the problem and the concern, but said she has no insight into the number of affected patients, placed responsibility on providers, insurers and the NZa rather than the IGJ, pointed to existing agreements and a registry being developed by the medical society, and saw no further role for herself.
I have no insight into these specific numbers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in deze specifieke aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de vergoeding van fysiotherapie als behandeling van endometriose

An SP MP asked why physiotherapy for endometriosis is not reimbursed under the basic health insurance package and whether it should be added. The Minister answered that effectiveness evidence is insufficient, asked the Zorginstituut to review the evidence, and declined to add physiotherapy to the basic package for now while offering to reconsider parts if shown effective.
That is why I am not willing to fully add physiotherapy to the basic package.
Daarom ben ik niet bereid om fysiotherapie alsnog volledig op te nemen in het basispakket.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 'NAVO-verplichtingen' met betrekking tot 'pandemische paraatheid'

An MP asked the Health Minister when and how she was informed of alleged NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness. The minister answered that no such NATO obligations exist, while noting NATO asks allies to make health systems resilient for crises and conflict, in line with a cabinet letter on resilience.
There are no "NATO obligations" regarding "pandemic preparedness".
Er zijn geen «NAVO-verplichtingen» met betrekking tot «pandemische paraatheid».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het opleggen van een sectoraal uitzendverbod aan de vlees-en pluimveesector

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about progress twelve months after the June 2024 meeting with the meat and poultry sector on stopping malafide temporary employment agencies, and about the planned sectoral temporary-agency ban by AMvB. The minister acknowledges that misconduct persists despite sector measures, that the sector is not improving sufficiently, and that preparing the AMvB will take about twelve months, while keeping it as a backstop.
I will therefore also prepare and work out the AMvB so that the cabinet can intervene.
Ik ga daarom ook de amvb voorbereiden en uitwerken zodat het kabinet kan ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over de verjaring van schadeclaims bij invaren van pensioenen

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the 20-year absolute limitation period for pension-fund errors during the transition to the Wtp should be extended or start later, and whether members should get additional rights and documents. The minister acknowledged the court ruling, defended the existing limitation rules and Wtp safeguards, and declined most proposals, while promising some information measures.
I understand the concerns of the questioners about whether participants have sufficient room to act if errors are discovered late.
Ik heb begrip voor de zorgen van de vragenstellers over of deelnemers voldoende handelingsperspectief hebben, in geval fouten pas laat worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht 'Overstap naar nieuw stelsel drijft kosten pensioenfondsen flink op'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that transition costs to the new pension system are driving up pension fund expenses by about 20%, questioning their acceptability, deductibility from participants' pensions, and transparency. The minister answered that transition costs are expected and estimated at about 1 billion euro in total, that the cost rise is not solely due to the transition, and that a separation of transition costs is not feasible without creating false precision, while pointing to existing reporting duties and monitoring.
However, as previously agreed with your House, I consider it important to keep a close eye on this together.
Wel vind ik het, zoals eerder afgesproken met uw Kamer, belangrijk om met elkaar de vinger aan de pols te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Groot te kort UWV-keuringsartsen, wachtlijstdreigt op te lopen van 30.000 naar 100.000’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the UWV faces a large shortage of insurance physicians and a growing waiting list for WIA disability assessments, asking whether this was foreseeable, why UWV does not steer better, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the negative outlook, cites hiring strategies, extra funding and a productivity agreement with UWV, and says further measures are being taken, but offers no new commitment to structural change beyond existing plans.
At the time I did not explicitly state what the forecast for the coming years was, but I have now done so because it is so negative.
Ik heb destijds niet expliciet gemaakt wat de prognose voor de komende jaren was, maar dat heb ik nu wel gedaan omdat deze dermate negatief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitbuiting van buitenlandse zorgverleners

An MP asked the ministers about exploitation of foreign care workers providing 24-hour home care via personal budgets (pgb), including inspection, enforcement, and aftercare. The government answered that the Labour Inspectorate is investigating, outlined existing oversight and enforcement, and said it will consult the Inspectorate once its investigation is complete.
No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht 'UWV gaat opnieuw de fout in, deze keer met de Ziektewet: 55.000 extra dossiers gecontroleerd'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV made errors in calculating sickness benefit (Ziektewet) payments and must recheck 55,000 extra files, asking about the cause, timing, scope of the recovery operation and possible reclaiming of overpayments. The minister acknowledges the problems, explains they stem from inadequate system safeguards, promises an added system signal and a recovery plan to be reported to parliament, but defers timelines and details on the number of files and recovery costs.
Once the recovery approach is clear, we will inform the House of Representatives about this as soon as possible.
Zodra de herstelaanpak duidelijk is, informeren we uw Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Joseph over het havenpensioenfonds Optas en Aegon en de voortdurende juridische strijd, waarbij miljarden pensioengeld in verkeerde zakken beland is

Omtzigt and Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Optas harbour pension fund and Aegon, including the decades of litigation over pension money, a timeline of events, how much pension money was lost, DNB's supervisory role, whether a new mediator would be appointed, and the risk of future litigation under the Wtp. The Minister gave a largely defensive answer: past procedures were lawful, DNB has learned lessons and oversight of DNB is in place, no new mediator is planned, and the Wtp situation is different.

Since then DNB has taken as its starting point that insurers must individually notify policyholders in advance of a proposed merger and explicitly mention the right of objection policyholders have with DNB.

DNB hanteert sindsdien als uitgangspunt dat verzekeraars polishouders voortaan vooraf individueel aanschrijven over een voorgenomen fusie en dat verzekeraars daar expliciet het verzetsrecht noemen dat polishouders hebben bij DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon over het bericht “Tienduizenden arbeidsmigranten van buiten de EU zonder papieren in Nederland’

An MP asked the minister about reports of tens of thousands of non-EU labour migrants without papers working illegally, including visa-free routes from Brazil and Georgia, the RNI system giving BSNs, lack of exit control, and enforcement against illegal employment. The government said it cannot quantify the illegal population, sees no basis yet to suspend visa-free travel, will address the RNI loophole and report to parliament in September, and explained existing enforcement (Labour Inspectorate fines, return decisions, residence permit withdrawal).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Van der Lee en Stultiens over de gevolgen van toenemende robotisering voor werkgelegenheid en belastinginkomsten

Greens-Labour MPs asked whether the government sees Mercedes and BMW testing humanoid robots as a sign of labour market change, whether research and tax-base scenarios on robotisation exist, and whether alternative taxes such as a robot tax should be explored. The minister answered that automation is a continuing structural trend rather than a sudden shift, pointed to labour market reforms and lifelong learning plans, and said uncertainty is large, so the tax system should be robust and simple, citing ongoing box 3 and tax reforms.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Pensioenfonds PME doet honderden bedrijven in de ban'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that pension fund PME excludes hundreds of companies on ideological grounds, and whether this breaches the motion-Aartsen principle of risk and return over political considerations. The minister rejected concerns about ideological investing, said existing law and DNB supervision suffice and no tightening is needed, and declined to comment on a fund director's remarks about the US.
I therefore saw no reason to tighten the supervisory framework.
Ik heb dan ook geen aanleiding gezien om het toezichtskader aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over de berichten dat KaFra Housing winst maakt op de huisvesting voor asielzoekers

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that KaFra Housing, a commercial provider, houses asylum seekers in former worker accommodation and profits from public funds, and whether the state should investigate such arrangements. The minister replied that COA renting commercial locations is not unusual, that emergency shelter is costlier and is being phased out, that the locations meet quality standards, and that no further investigation is deemed necessary.
I do not recognise the picture painted that asylum seekers are being housed in poor living conditions at these locations.
Ik herken niet het beeld dat geschetst wordt dat er asielzoekers met slechte woonomstandigheden op deze locaties worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikkers en De Kort over het artikel ‘Gemeente Amsterdam gaat groep bijstandsgezinnen ‘zomaar’ extra geld geven’

MPs Bikkers and De Kort asked the State Secretary about Amsterdam giving unconditional monthly gifts to welfare families in a Kansfonds research project, questioning fairness, the Participatiewet, and the Gemeentewet. The State Secretary answered that the research fits within Participatiewet limits, is privately funded, is temporary, and that the government wants simpler municipal poverty schemes while noting gifts up to EUR 1,200 per year may be exempted.
Because the municipality of Amsterdam does not pay out the gift and the gift is part of a temporary study, there is no question of income policy.
Doordat gemeente Amsterdam de gift niet uitkeert en de gift onderdeel is van een tijdelijk onderzoek, is er geen sprake van inkomenspolitiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Van Kent over de afgesloten cao IKEA met de bedrijfsbond WIM

MPs Patijn and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the IKEA collective agreement with the company union WIM, including strikes by FNV members, a narrow 50.3% vote, and whether the union is independent of the employer and compliant with ILO Convention 98. The minister declined to judge the specific case, stated that the Netherlands is reviewing the independence of unions as part of a broader exploration of the cao system, and said no grounds exist to declare the agreement invalid if legal requirements are met.
I have therefore entered into discussions with social partners and other stakeholders and am including this point in the further elaboration of the exploration.
Daarom ben ik hierover met sociale partners en andere stakeholders in gesprek gegaan en neem ik dit punt mee met de verdere uitwerking van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over plannen van de Europese Commissie om de rechten van gedetacheerde werknemers in te perken in het kader van de 'Single Market Strategy'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU plans to harmonise certificates for posted and temporary-agency work could weaken the Dutch Wtta licensing regime and create loopholes. The minister acknowledged the Single Market Strategy, said it was too early to judge the effects, warned that applying the Wtta to foreign agencies is essential, and committed to raising the issue with the Commission and to a BNC-fiche.
I consider it important that the Wtta can be introduced without delay and that its level of protection is not undermined, in the short or long term.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de Wtta zonder vertraging kan worden ingevoerd en dat het beschermingsniveau daarvan – op de korte of lange termijn – niet ondermijnd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitbuiting van Indonesische verpleegkundigen en hun zaak tegen een Hogeschool

MP Van Nispen asked ministers about the exploitation of Indonesian nursing students under a work-study scheme run by a university of applied sciences, including a settlement gag clause, IND concerns, the revocation procedure and whether exploiters profited. The government answered that the settlement is private and outside its competence, that the IND recognised the institution after a revised programme, that a Labour Inspectorate fine investigation is ongoing with results to be published, and that it will review legal vulnerabilities.
The cabinet will examine vulnerabilities in the current laws and regulations and determine which follow-up steps are desirable.
Het kabinet zal kwetsbaarheden in de huidige wet- en regelgeving bezien en nagaan welke vervolgstappen gewenst zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het sturen van uitkeringen en inkomsten door statushouders en migranten naar hun land van herkomst

An MP asked whether benefits paid to refugees and migrants (notably Eritreans) are sent abroad, whether this should be restricted, and about counter-terrorism financing. The government said it does not track how benefit recipients spend money, that discrimination by origin is prohibited so benefits cannot be cut for these groups, and it described existing controls and the end of the remigration scheme.
The Ministry of SZW does not keep an overview of how recipients spend benefits.
Het Ministerie van SZW houdt geen overzicht bij van de besteding van uitkeringen door ontvangers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het initiatief in Hardenberg waarbij asielzoekers een MDT-certificaat kunnen behalen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Hardenberg project in which asylum seekers could earn an MDT certificate, and whether the Labour Inspectorate's investigation and existing rules are proportionate. The minister explained the volunteer-work exemption and UWV procedures, said the inspection investigation is ongoing and it will not comment on it, and declined to contact the municipality directly.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
De Arbeidsinspectie doet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Lahlah en Bushoff over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen aan kinderen

MPs asked whether children's basic necessities and healthcare aids, such as incontinence material, glasses, braces and special learning materials, are being left to charities and whether insurers and municipalities are failing to cover them. The Minister says the government knows of rising requests, points to the basic insurance rules, municipal responsibilities and ongoing work on child glasses, but largely defers responsibility to insurers, schools and municipalities.
I consider it important that children have access to sufficient incontinence material when they need it due to a medical indication or disability.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat kinderen toegang hebben tot voldoende incontinentiemateriaal als ze die vanwege een medische indicatie of beperking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘crisismodus’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs Saris and Postma asked the ministers about the 'crisis mode' at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, including prior engagement, energy costs, subsidies, and possible support for affected workers. The minister answered that the closure is a business decision mainly for the company, described past government efforts to keep production in the Netherlands, listed received support, and declined to commit to visits or EU funding requests until the company clarifies its next steps.
This information is not public and is not known to me.
Deze informatie is niet openbaar en is niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het rapport 'Investeren in samenleven. Hoe arbeidsmigranten beter ingebed kunnen worden in de Nederlandse samenleving' van de Adviesraad Migratie

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the Adviesraad Migratie report on better integrating labour migrants, covering language skills, access to language courses, employer responsibility and a national integration programme. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to existing language provision and subsidies, and promises a letter before the summer recess with a policy response.
Before the summer recess I will send a letter on my policy to improve the social integration of labour migrants.
Voor het zomerreces zal ik een brief sturen met mijn beleid om de sociale inbedding van arbeidsmigranten te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over pensioenfondsen en verzekeraars die bereid zijn geld te steken in de versterking van defensie

Two CDA MPs asked whether pension funds and insurers are willing to invest in defence but are waiting for a plan from The Hague, and why this takes so long. The government answers that Defence is talking with industry and investors, that financing is a shared responsibility, that investment decisions remain with financial institutions, and lists initiatives such as Defport, a financing table and planned measures, without giving a firm timetable.
Ultimately it remains up to banks, insurers, pension funds and other investors themselves to decide to what extent and how they want to invest in the defence industry.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen en andere investeerders zelf om te bepalen in welke mate en op welke wijze zij willen investeren in de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de geregistreerde huisvestingslocaties voor arbeidsmigranten van Stichting Normering Flexwonen

An SP MP asked the minister about housing for migrant workers in regular homes, the number of SNF-certified accommodations, and whether councils should see the private SNF register. The minister reported that 79% of SNF-registered locations and 59% of beds are regular homes, declined to make the register public to councils, but encouraged data-sharing agreements and use of the Wgv licensing tools.
I therefore encourage municipalities to make such agreements with SNF and will myself discuss further with SNF what role I can play in promoting such agreements.
Ik moedig gemeenten dan ook aan om dergelijke afspraken met SNF te maken en zal zelf ook met SNF verder bespreken welke rol ik kan spelen om dergelijke afspraken te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Ppi’s splitsen pensioenkapitaal na schrappen restitutiebeding'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension providers (PPIs) are splitting accumulated pension capital after the Wtp removed the restitution clause, which otherwise returned a deceased member's savings to a partner or children. The minister confirmed that capital-funded survivor pension before retirement is no longer allowed under the Wtp, defended risk-based survivor coverage as clearer and fairer, and rejected the view that restitution must be restored, while noting existing accrued rights are protected by transitional law.
The survivor pension would indeed be low if the member has only been building pension for a short time and has relatively low wages.
Het nabestaandenpensioen zal namelijk laag zijn als de deelnemer nog maar kort pensioen opbouwt en bij deelnemers met relatief lage lonen.
Antwoord op Vragen van leden Dassen en Patijn over het rapport ‘Verkenning wettelijk minimumjeugdloon’ en de rapportage van onderzoeksbureau Blauw ‘Jongeren en het minimumjeugdloon’

MPs Dassen and Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the report on the statutory youth minimum wage and the Blauw interview study with young workers, including its justification, cost, evidence on employment and schooling, and consistency with EU adequacy rules. The minister answered that the cabinet will reconsider the youth minimum wage, reserved funds in the Voorjaarsnota 2025 for raising rates for ages 16 to 20, and will send a cabinet response before the summer recess, with some follow-up data still to be produced.
The cabinet sees reason to substantively reconsider the youth minimum wage.
Het kabinet ziet aanleiding voor inhoudelijke heroverweging van het minimumjeugdloon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het bericht ‘Bij Transavia overwintert personeel op kosten van het UWV"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs how long the government and UWV have known about Transavia's seasonal on-call-style contracts that let staff claim unemployment benefits in winter, why nothing was done sooner, and whether the planned Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill will prevent similar practices. The minister answered that UWV flagged the issue in 2021 as a complex overlap between labour and social security law, that the bill (bandbreedtecontract with a 130% maximum) would close the gap, that a new WW test would require legislation and be no faster, and that current law does not yet prohibit the practice.
I expect employers to comply with applicable laws and regulations and will hold companies to account if they do not.
Ik verwacht van werkgevers dat zij zich aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving houden en zal bedrijven erop aanspreken als dat niet zo is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de verkenning minimumjeugdloon

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the review of the statutory youth minimum wage, its age-based rates, equal pay and the effects on youth education and work, including vocational (bbl) students. The minister answered that the cabinet sees grounds for substantive reconsideration with a reservation in the Voorjaarsnota 2025, that the full policy assessment will follow in the cabinet response before the summer recess, and that the questions on rates, equal pay and bbl wages will be addressed there, while noting evidence on work effects and dropout and referring the bbl staffel to the Minister of OCW.
Before the summer recess I expect to send the cabinet response to your House.
Voor het zomerreces verwacht ik de kabinetsreactie aan uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Nederland laat kansen liggen en moet Leven Lang Ontwikkelen wél een prioriteit maken'

MP Saris asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about an article calling for Lifelong Learning to be a priority, covering the labour market tightness summit, productivity, the LLO agenda, personal development budgets and EU flagships. Minister Van Hijum answered substantively on each point, describing the summit, the forthcoming LLO agenda around summer 2025, SLIM subsidies and EU coordination, while stating commitments to send letters but no binding legislative change.
We will send the summit report to the House ahead of the planned committee debate on labour market tightness on 21 May 2025.
Wij sturen het verslag naar de Kamer in de aanloop naar het geplande Commissiedebat arbeidsmarktkrapte van 21 mei 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de berichten 'Toegang tot het recht krimpt, terwijl maatwerk faalt' en 'Maatregelen regeerprogramma inkomenszekerheid: waarom de gemeente aan zet blijft'

An MP asks the ministers about news reports saying access to justice is shrinking and that gemeenten remain responsible for income support, and whether the government shares the ombudsman's view that citizens are sent from desk to desk. The ministers answer that the government is committed to accessible services, cite a kwartiermaker to map legal aid gaps, the expansion of overheidsbrede loketten to 25 initiatives, and a proactive services bill to be submitted in 2025.
To implement the Van Nispen/Palmen motion, a kwartiermaker will be appointed before the summer (J&V, BZK, SZW) to explore how a nationwide network of socio-legal services can best be organised.

Ter uitvoering van de motie Van Nispen/Palmen 4 wordt voor de zomer een kwartiermaker benoemd (J&V, BZK, SZW) die verkent hoe een landelijk dekkend netwerk van sociaaljuridische dienstverlening het best vormgegeven kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over het Raad van State-advies ten aanzien van het amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. op het wetsvoorstel voor de verlenging van de transitieperiod

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State's critical advice on the Joseph amendment, which would make non-transfer the default in the pension transition, and its consequences for members, implementation, social partners and courts. The minister answered that the amendment weakens intergenerational solidarity, risks compulsory participation, causes transition delays and legal conflict, conflicts with ILO conventions on collective bargaining, and that he considers it undesirable and will address this in the government's response.
From my administrative responsibility for compliance with the Pension Agreement, orderly legislation and predictability for implementation, I consider this undesirable.
Vanuit mijn bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor de naleving van afspraken uit het Pensioenakkoord, ordentelijke wetgeving en voorspelbaarheid voor de uitvoering acht ik dit niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Van Vroonhoven over het bericht ‘Arbeidsongeschikten zien inkomen fors dalen door beëindigen arbeidskorting’

MPs Saris and Van Vroonhoven asked about reports that partially disabled workers would see income drops when the employment tax credit (arbeidskorting) is removed for benefit income under the samenvoegbepaling from 2027. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the average affected beneficiary would lose about 3,000 euros net per year, that the government will explore the interaction of benefits, tax credits and allowances, and that it will inform affected people and consult employers and UWV.
The cabinet therefore will consult with employers, the UWV and the Tax Authority to examine how this group can be identified as well as possible and informed as quickly as possible.

Het kabinet treedt daarom in gesprek met werkgevers, het UWV en de Belastingdienst om te kijken welke manieren er zijn om deze groep zo goed als mogelijk in beeld te brengen en zo snel mogelijk te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de premiestelling en fondsen van werknemersverzekeringen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about how contribution rates and funds for employee insurance schemes are set, how they have developed over time, and whether premiums serve purposes beyond covering costs. The minister explained that UWV sets the Whk premium while the cabinet sets the Aof, Awf and Ufo premiums within the income framework, and provided figures on fund income, expenditure, differentiation and reserves.
UWV sets the height of the Whk premium. The cabinet sets the height of the other three premiums.
Het UWV stelt de hoogte van de Whk-premie vast. Het kabinet stelt de hoogte van de andere drie premies vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Burgemeester bezorgd over uitkomst onderzoek illegale prostitutie en mensenhandel: ‘Misstanden aangetroffen”

An MP asked the ministers about reports of serious abuses found in illegal prostitution during a Hague inspection, and about the scale of victims of exploitation, shelter capacity and protection of migrant sex workers. The government answered that the abuses are serious, that cooperation with municipalities is being supported through the Action Plan, and that it is preparing further steps such as a vision letter, a review of the motion on talks with countries of origin, and a study on decoupling victim status from prosecution.
The abuses found as described in the report are serious.
De aangetroffen misstanden zoals benoemd in het bericht zijn ernstig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Pensioenen flink omhoog in nieuw stelsel: Stijging tot 8 procent

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension payouts would rise under the new pension system, and about data errors, the timing of corrected payouts, accountant checks, and how members were informed and can seek redress. The minister answered that data quality is secured through fund-level checks, external accountant reviews and DNB assessment, that errors may still surface and must be corrected, and that members can seek redress via the fund, GIP/Kifid or the courts.
It cannot be ruled out that errors will still come to light in the future.
Het is echter niet uit te sluiten dat er, in de toekomst, alsnog fouten naar voren komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk, en Haage over het bericht ‘Minister Van Hijum kraakt plan pensioenreferendum van zijn eigen partij: kritisch advies in concept-brief’

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a critical draft advisory note on a pension referendum amendment was real and why supporting documents had not been published. The minister confirmed awareness, said underlying departmental notes will be published with the cabinet response before the plenary debate, and explained that advice is withheld until a ministerial decision is made.
All underlying departmental notes from SZW and Finance used in decision-making will be made public at the same time as the cabinet response.
Alle onderliggende departementale nota's van SZW en van Financiën die zijn gebruikt bij de besluitvorming, zullen tegelijk met de kabinetsreactie openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht “De slapers worden wakker”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about claims that the Wet toekomst pensioenen sidelines inactive pension members (slapers) during the pension transition, including the hearing right and the risks for young slapers. The minister rejected the claim that slapers are excluded, pointed to collective safeguards such as the hearing right and fund-level balancing, and declined to comment on individual fund cases.
I do not go into individual cases, because it is not for me to provide insight into pension fund-specific situations or to give a judgement on them.
Op individuele casussen ga ik niet in, omdat het niet aan mij is om inzicht te verschaffen in pensioenfondsspecifieke situaties en/of hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over nieuwe fouten bij het UWV

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors at UWV affecting WIA and Ziektewet benefits, including how and when they were discovered, the amounts and numbers of people affected, and why problems keep surfacing piecemeal. The minister answered that UWV found the indexation errors in late 2024, that the affected people are being analysed with results expected later that month, that the errors also affect the Ziektewet, and that he will report in the next progress letter.
I will inform you about this in the next progress letter on UWV's improvement approach.
Hierover zal ik u informeren in de volgende voortgangsbrief over de verbeteraanpak van UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fouten bij UWV schelen soms honderden euro’s per maand’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a 2021 internal UWV report that reportedly flagged doubts about calculating the reference wage used in WIA disability decisions, which could wrongly reject claims. The minister confirmed the 2021 report, said it was not shared with the ministry until 2024 and was not reported in UWV's annual reports, and promised a follow-up letter with results and remedial steps.
It is important that relevant information, such as errors in the determination of benefits, is detected in time and that my ministry is informed of this in time.
Het is belangrijk dat relevante informatie, zoals fouten in de vaststelling van uitkeringen tijdig worden geconstateerd en dat mijn ministerie hier tijdig over wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de opbouw van de reservering van 1,2 miljard voor arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkeringen

MP Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the basis for a reported 1.2 billion euro reservation for disability benefit (WIA) errors, the scope of affected beneficiaries, and related correction operations. The minister said she does not recognise the 1.2 billion figure, cannot pre-empt spring budget decisions, and promised to inform parliament in April on UWV's review of benefit errors, with 43,000 cases to be individually checked.
I will inform your House about the outcome of that review in April, with the ambition of doing so before the parliamentary debate on the WIA problems on 16 April.
Over het resultaat van dat onderzoek informeer ik uw Kamer in april, waarbij het mijn ambitie is om dat te doen voor het Kamerdebat WIA-problematiek van 16 april.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over de ontwikkelingen rondom zelfstandige zorgprofessionals (zzp’ers in de zorg) onder andere zoals beschreven in het artikel van RTL ’In maand tijd ruim 4000 minder zzp

MPs Tielen and Aartsen (VVD) asked ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the drop in self-employed care workers and the enforcement against bogus self-employment, asking for definitions, examples, signals from the sector, and flexibility options such as regional employment and VAT-exempt pools. The ministers answered that the legal test is the Civil Code employment definition applied to all circumstances, that model agreements remain valid until 2029, that the sector has so far reported limited effects, and that they are working with the sector on regional employment models and VAT clarification.
The cabinet will respond in the short term on the case examples drawn up by the LHV, as far as possible before the committee debate on self-employed workers of 3 April.
Over de hiervoor door de LHV opgestelde casuïstiek zal het kabinet op korte termijn reageren, voor zover mogelijk voor het commissiedebat zzp van 3 april a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

An SP MP asks ministers how interns placed as employees at Transavia, who can only recover wages through the civil courts, are helped by school complaint procedures, SBB and the Inspectorate, and whether a complaints point or lower court threshold is needed. The minister answers that schools, SBB and the Inspectorate have no power to enforce wages, that legal aid and the regelrechter experiment exist, that the Arbeidsinspectie fined Transavia and later accepted its adjusted internship practice, and that additional measures are premature.

Educational institutions, SBB and the Inspectorate of Education have no legal authority to enforce wage payments or settle wage disputes, because this falls under civil employment law and not their tasks.

Onderwijsinstellingen, de SBB en de Inspectie van het Onderwijs hebben geen juridische bevoegdheid om loonbetalingen af te dwingen of geschillen over loon te beslechten, omdat dit valt onder het (civiele) arbeidsrecht en niet onder hun taken.
Antwoord op van het lid Vijlbrief over 'de verhouding tussen KLM (en Transavia) en pilotenvakbond VNV'

An MP (D66) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about KLM and Transavia favouring members of pilots' union VNV in collective agreement benefits, and about the state's role as shareholder regarding the union's influence on KLM management. The minister answered that wage and union matters are management's responsibility, that the state as shareholder raised disappointment at the 2024 AGM, and that discrimination disputes are for the courts, which she could not prejudge.
KLM's management is responsible for the day-to-day management of the organisation.
De directie van KLM is verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat een geheime deal een gapend gat achterliet in de pensioenen van DSM

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a reported EUR 99 million transfer from the DSM pension fund to the employer, low premium payments, the fund's complaints committee and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister answered that the fund must follow the law under DNB and AFM supervision, that the Ombudsman acts independently, and that the questions could not be answered within three weeks because information was being obtained from external parties.
I cannot go further into specific questions about the supervision that AFM and DNB exercise over institutions.
Ik kan verder niet ingaan op specifieke vragen over het toezicht dat AFM en DNB op instellingen uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Patijn over een winterstop bij Transavia op kosten van UWV

MPs De Hoop and Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Transavia's 46-6 flexible contracts, under which cabin crew receive no pay for six winter weeks and may claim WW unemployment benefit at UWV's expense, including whether this amounts to fossil subsidy, state aid, misuse, and how it can be curbed. The minister answered that the arrangement is legal and open to any employer, that KLM as shareholder is responsible for labour terms, and that the planned Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill will ban zero-hour on-call contracts from 2027, which would end this construction; the answers are partly evasive on Transavia-specific data.
I have no information about Transavia's workforce.
Ik heb geen informatie over het personeelsbestand van Transavia.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Bij Transavia overwintert personeel op kosten van het UWV'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Transavia's 46-6 zero-hours contract that leaves cabin crew without pay for six weeks a year and shifts the cost to unemployment benefits (WW) and the UWV, and whether the UWV and government would control or stop this. The minister called the constructions undesirable, said they are currently legal, pointed to the Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill that would largely ban zero-hours contracts, and declined to direct Transavia as shareholder or to examine other sectors.
The cao for Transavia cabin crew shows that Transavia uses permanent employment contracts with a variable working time.
Uit de cao Cabinepersoneel van Transavia blijkt dat Transavia gebruik maakt van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd met een daarbij wisselende arbeidsomvang.
