Antwoord op vragen die leden Aartsen, Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Rikkers en Flach over het bericht “Hoge Raad: bij beoordeling of sprake is van arbeidsovereenkomst geldt geen rangorde tussen de mee te wegen omstandigheden

Five MPs asked the minister how the Supreme Court ruling that no hierarchy exists among factors in classifying employment, including entrepreneurship, affects the online tool hetjuistecontract.nl, Belastingdienst practice, government hiring of freelancers and the VBAR bill. The minister answered that the tool already covers external entrepreneurship, that no change or takedown is needed, that the Belastingdienst weighs all factors, and that the VBAR follow-up will be communicated soon.
Because, in line with the Supreme Court ruling, all factors are weighed in the web module, there is no reason to take the web module offline.
Omdat, in lijn met de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad, alle gezichtspunten worden meegewogen in de webmodule, is er geen reden om de webmodule offline te halen.
Op verzoek van het lid Patijn zijn de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht ‘Ombudsman onderzoekt perikelen pgb’ ingetrokken

MP Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many care providers received no PGB payments from the SVB in January due to administrative problems, the Ombudsman's finding that these issues were not quickly resolved, and the effect of proposed SVB budget cuts. The questions were withdrawn at the MP's request, so no government answers were given.
At the request of MP Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA), the written questions to the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the report 'Ombudsman investigates PGB troubles' have been withdrawn.

Op verzoek van het lid Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA) zijn de schriftelijke vragen aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Ombudsman onderzoekt perikelen pgb» zijn ingetrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Joseph over het feit dat het pensioenfonds Gasunie wil beleggen met geleend geld voor jonge deelnemers, die daardoor hun hele pensioenopbouw kwijt kunnen raken

Two MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that young pension members could lose their entire accrued pension if a pension fund lifts the borrowing restriction and invests with leverage, and what will be done about it. The minister answers that governance requirements and DNB supervision sufficiently limit the risk, that an evaluation of the practice will follow, and that no further agreements or regulation are seen as necessary.
I believe the current governance requirements and safeguards sufficiently limit the risk.
Ik vind dat de huidige governancevereisten en waarborgen het risico voldoende beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht 'Steeds meer longcovidpatiënten arbeidsongeschikt, 'topje van de ijsberg''

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising WIA disability inflows linked to long covid, the guidance and training for UWV physicians, and expected future trends. The minister reported about 5,500 WIA applications with post-covid as main diagnosis in 2024, around 85% receiving benefits, outlined existing guidance and training, and expected fewer post-covid inflows from 2026.
The UWV assumes that from 2026 fewer people with post-covid will end up in the WIA compared with 2024.
Het UWV neemt aan dat er vanaf 2026 minder mensen met post-covid in de WIA terecht zullen komen ten opzichte van 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Eijk over schijnzelfstandigheid bij de UHT

MPs Aartsen and Van Eijk (VVD) asked whether the UHT childcare benefits recovery body stopped working with self-employed contractors from 1 April 2025, why it withdrew its offer to pay fines for intermediaries, and how it assesses bogus self-employment under the Deliveroo criteria. The government answered that UHT still uses self-employed workers where legally possible, applies an internal risk framework, withdrew the fine-compensation offer after tax-compliance concerns, and sees no legal-certainty problem.
As you know, your House asked the government to implement as well as possible the motion of 1 October 2024 by MP Boon (PVV).
Zoals bekend heeft uw Kamer de regering gevraagd om zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de Kamermotie van 1 oktober 2024
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over bezuinigingen op de uitvoering van de sociale zekerheid

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the exact scope and distribution of the 22% budget cut on social security implementation agencies, including an extra 34 million cut via the education deal and whether UWV's recovery operation will be affected. The Minister replies that the allocation is still under discussion and will be communicated with the spring memorandum, though the cut is explicitly linked to the Hoofdlijnenakkoord's promise to spare implementation.
The Chamber will be informed about this with the spring memorandum.
Bij voorjaarsnota wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Oezbeekse trucker staakt bij truckstop in Venlo: “ik vrees voor m’n leven”’

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Infrastructure and Social Affairs how they will protect a striking Uzbek truck driver from employer coercion, ensure full wages, safeguard his residence permit, and act against the Lithuanian firm Baltic Transline and sector-wide abuse. The minister replied that the Labour Inspectorate has investigated and is still examining the case, that cabotage rules were not breached on the cited route, that an implementation study is under way with results expected end 2025, and that EU-level research on third-country drivers is ongoing.
I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht “Belastingdienst weegt persoonlijk ondernemerschap zelden mee in oordeel over schijnzelfstandigheid. ‘Onjuiste toepassing’”

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority properly weighs the Deliveroo criterion of external entrepreneurship in assessing employment relationships, and whether its practice treats it as subordinate. The State Secretary answers that all criteria including external entrepreneurship are weighed holistically, that the Tax Authority follows the Supreme Court, and that it will clarify its online communication and case examples.
The Tax Authority assesses employment relationships using this framework and weighs all considerations, including external entrepreneurship.
De Belastingdienst beoordeelt arbeidsrelaties aan de hand van dit afwegingskader en weegt alle gezichtspunten inclusief het extern ondernemerschap mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Zwaarst getroffen UWV-gedupeerden worden door Minister niet geholpen’, en dat mag volgens juristen niet'

An MP asks why the minister's UWV recovery operation excludes errors in sociaal-medische beoordelingen and whether limiting it to 2020–2024 is legally sound. The minister says the scope is a policy and political choice within legal room, that UWV will set up a specialist client support team, and that an outside-UWV operation is not currently desirable.
There is no legal obligation to actively trace the errors ex officio.
Er is geen juridische verplichting om ambtshalve de fouten op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het niet verlengen van de 60-plusmaatregel

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the non-extension of the 60-plus measure and whether a replacement 62+ scheme for WIA assessments is being prepared. The minister confirms the earlier letter, says the 62+ prioritisation has been withdrawn by UWV, and promises a letter before summer on backlog measures; the answers also correct earlier figures on court-ordered penalty payments.
As previously promised to your House, I will send a letter before the summer on progress regarding the mismatch and set out the steps we want to take.
Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer toegezegd stuur ik voor de zomer een brief over de voortgang rondom de mismatch en geef ik daarin aan welke stappen we willen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen begint al in de schoolbanken'

An SP MP asked the education and social affairs ministers about a survey showing women interns receive fewer and lower internship allowances and contracts, and about sexual harassment during internships. The minister answered that the gap largely reflects field of study, pointed to existing agreements (Stagepact, anti-discrimination programme, WEB contract rules), and declined to commission new research or announce extra measures.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Vijlbrief over signalen dat de belastingdienst zich niet houdt aan de handhavingsstrategie van de zachte landing en geen waarschuwingen geeft bij de handhavi

MPs from VVD, BBB and D66 asked whether the Tax Authority is following the agreed soft-landing enforcement strategy on sham self-employment, including giving warnings before audits. The State Secretary answered that such signals had not reached them, described the warning practice and the lack of formal registration, and provided the requested counts of visits and audits while promising to report progress in a separate letter.
The number of letters is not centrally registered.
Het aantal brieven wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over uitsluiting juridische hulp bij conflicten die te maken hebben met invaren door DAS rechtsbijstandverzekering

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked whether insurer DAS excluded legal aid for disputes about the transition to the new pension system (invaren) and what this means for citizens' legal protection. The minister confirmed the exclusion, said the Wtp offers internal complaint routes and the GIP and Kifid as low-threshold external bodies, and said insurers set their own terms while the government has not yet found reason for intervention.
The effective legal protection for people during invaren is not determined by the policy terms of any legal expenses insurer.
De effectieve rechtsbescherming voor mensen bij het invaren wordt niet bepaald door de polisvoorwaarden van enige rechtsbijstandsverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de handhaving van schijnzelfstandigheid

An MP asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers how enforcement against sham self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) will differ in 2024, 2025 and 2026, and why fines are waived for 2025 even in cases of bad faith or evident sham self-employment. The state secretary explains the lifting of the enforcement moratorium, the no-fines rule for 2025 (following a motion), continued enforcement via audits and visits, and the extension of model contracts to end-2029.
Following the Flach-Aartsen motion, no administrative fines will be imposed for 2025.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Flach-Aartsen 5 worden over 2025 geen bestuurlijke boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski, Aartsen en Becker over het bericht 'Duizenden asielzoekers krijgen werkvergunning nu regels soepeler zijn'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that thousands of asylum seekers receive work permits since the 24-week rule was lifted, including refusal rates, processing times, and whether asylum seekers from safe countries or with low chances of asylum can work. The minister answered that the rule change largely explains the rise, about 11% of 2024 applications were refused and 25-30% withdrawn or refused, processing has been partly delayed, only under 1% of permits went to safe-country nationals, and restricting such groups awaits implementation of the EU reception directive by June 2026.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Omtzigt over de berichten "‘En wij dan?’ vragen duizenden UWV-cliënten zich af nu ze buiten de grote hersteloperatie vallen". En “'Zwaarst getroffen UWV-gedupeerden worden door mi

MPs Saris and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV audit reports, reviews of internal audit services, court-ordered penalties, lost court cases and unexecuted rulings after press reports on UWV problems. The minister answered most questions, releasing audit summaries and penalty figures, but withheld some passages for legal reasons and referred to a pending Court of Audit investigation.
In the report, a number of passages have been redacted on legal grounds.
In de rapportage zijn op juridische grond een aantal passages weggelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de extra bezuinigingen op SZW als gevolg van de 'onderwijsdeal'

Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the extra 34 million euro cut to the SZW budget from the education deal, how it will be filled, how much falls on UWV, SVB and the Labour Inspectorate and whether FTE will be lost, and how this fits the coalition pledge to protect implementing bodies. Minister Van Hijum confirmed the cut, said the allocation is not yet decided and will be communicated around the spring memorandum, and noted that the implementing bodies were included in the basis for the cut while promising to weigh the importance of implementation.
As soon as a decision has been made on the allocation, the House will be informed as quickly as possible, probably with the spring memorandum.
Zodra besloten is over de invulling wordt de kamer zo snel mogelijk hierover geïnformeerd, waarschijnlijk bij voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het wegtrekken van talent uit de Verenigde Staten naar aanleiding van de verkiezingswinst van Trump

Two D66 MPs asked how the Netherlands could attract talent leaving the United States after Trump's 2024 election, including whether to introduce a talent visa like the UK's or France's. The government answered that it runs a neutral, inviting knowledge-migrant policy, pointed to existing schemes, outreach and tax facilities, and said a new talent visa was unnecessary.
The cabinet will not speculate about possible policy the next government in the United States will introduce.
Het kabinet gaat niet speculeren over mogelijk beleid dat de volgende regering in de Verenigde Staten gaat invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over overwerktoeslag voor deeltijdwerkers

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two EU Court of Justice rulings (2023 Lufthansa, 2024 Kuratorium) that treat overtime pay differences between part-time and full-time workers as potentially discriminatory, and whether this changes the Helmig doctrine, WW premium differentiation and Dutch law (art. 7:648 BW). The minister answered that the rulings clarify existing law, that objective justification must be assessed case by case with a high bar, that WW premiums are unaffected, and that no legislative change is needed.
Once there is more clarity on that, I will inform your House.
Zodra daar meer duidelijkheid is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de informatievoorziening rondom invaren en de kritiek van de AFM

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the AFM's criticism that informing pension fund members only one month before transition to the new pension system (invaren) is not in their interest, and whether the statutory notice period should be extended to two to three months. The minister answered that one month is adequate, that funds set their own timing, that no extension is planned, and that existing guidance and the AFM's own transition bulletins suffice.
No, at this moment I, like the AFM, see no reason to extend this minimum term.
Nee, op dit moment zie ik net als de AFM geen redenen om deze minimale termijn te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Oud-IT-hoogleraar waarschuwt voor chaos bij UWV' en 'Onrust bij UWV over nieuwe werkwijze’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's reorganisation plan (the Verandermotor) and warnings that it could delay the WIA/Wajong repair operation and should be paused for an independent review. The minister answered that the reorganisation is monitored closely with UWV, that the repair operation is run separately and given top priority, and that UWV has no plan to pause the work.
Specifically, it has been agreed that SZW will be involved in further planning, rollout and interim evaluations, including decisions on the pace of what follows.
Concreet is de afspraak gemaakt dat SZW wordt betrokken in de verdere planvorming, uitrol en de tussentijdse evaluaties, waarbij onder meer besloten wordt over het tempo van het vervolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over ‘schuldhulpverlening’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the limited effectiveness of debt relief, the role of municipalities, the lack of a central national approach, and measures to reduce problematic debt. The government replied that its policy agenda (basisdienstverlening, Nationaal Programma Armoede en Schulden, extra funding) will be detailed in spring 2025, and largely pointed to existing measures and municipal responsibility.
The cabinet sees it as its responsibility to work on reducing the number of people with problematic debts.
Het kabinet ziet het als haar verantwoordelijkheid om in te zetten op het terugdringen van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over “de vooraankondiging voor reparatiewetgeving met terugwerkende kracht in verband met invaren 1 januari 2025”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about tax knots that could make pensions of the early-invaring funds (PWRI, Loodsen, APG) tax-excessive from 1 January 2025, and why the government did not postpone invaren while retroactive repair legislation is pending. The government answered that the knots are technical, that a policy decision anticipating legislation will provide legal certainty, that the repair is not budgetary, and that it could not answer all questions before 25 December 2024.
It did not succeed in answering these before 25 December 2024.
Het is niet gelukt deze te beantwoorden voor 25 december 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de uitzending ‘Werkt een online cursus tot BHV’er?’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a broadcast reporting that workers can become company first-aiders (BHV'ers) through a 75-minute online course without practical training, and whether the law should require practice drills and annual repetition. The minister answered that employers are responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that sectors should agree specific training via arbocatalogues, that no law change is needed, and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces where violations are found.
It is therefore up to the sectors themselves to make further agreements on specific training and equipment that match practice.
Het is daarom aan de sectoren zelf om nadere afspraken over specifieke opleiding en uitrusting te maken die aansluiten bij de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op bidden tijdens pauzes bij Zadkine

An MP asked ministers about the Zadkine school's ban on prayer during breaks and its compliance with equal-treatment law. The minister says the institution's email was withdrawn, pauses are free time, and the school is revising its student statute and discussing quiet rooms, with no further national measures planned.
The Zadkine board states that the wording of the email was unfortunate and gave rise to misunderstandings.
Het bestuur van Zadkine geeft aan dat de formulering van de betreffende e-mail ongelukkig gekozen is en aanleiding geeft tot misverstanden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van Eijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst zelf zich niet gaat houden aan de wet DBA en van belastinggeld ook de boetes en naheffingen gaat betalen

MPs Aartsen, Van Eijk and Flach asked why the Dutch government's own Dienst Toeslagen (UHT, the childcare benefits restoration operation) would keep using potential bogus self-employed workers after 1 January 2025, despite rules requiring the rest of the market to stop, and whether it would pay fines and back-payments with public money. The government answered that it regrets the situation, will keep deploying such workers into 2025 and possibly 2026 to avoid delaying compensation, will offer brokers reimbursement of fines, has no budget provision for these, and will report on the scale of self-employed use across government later in 2025.
The cabinet does not consider it exemplary behaviour for government organisations to act in breach of the law.
Het kabinet vindt het niet van voorbeeldgedrag getuigen dat overheidsorganisaties in strijd met de wet handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over het nieuws dat arbeidsmigranten worden uitgebuit door werkgevers die de noodopvang voor asielzoekers verzorgen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked about reports that migrant workers were exploited by private firms running emergency asylum accommodation on cruise ships, including unpaid long shifts and dismissal without housing, and about tax avoidance and why asylum seekers do not do the work. The minister called the conditions unacceptable and said investigation is needed, that emergency sites require specialist staff and fast setup, that COA checks contractors via Bibob and CSR rules, and that COA is reviewing contracts and activating residents more, while not committing to contract-wide sanctions.
It is my ambition to limit this expensive and suboptimal form of accommodation to a minimum as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze dure en suboptimale vorm van opvang zo snel mogelijk tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "staatscommissie demografie"

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the government's position on the State Commission's demography report, including which scenario policy follows and whether the programmatic governance approach and a four-yearly demography report will be adopted. The minister answers that the cabinet endorses steering toward moderate population growth, plans an annual monitor and knowledge infrastructure, and will report on the governance exploration in spring 2025, but declines to answer the questions in time for the debate.

Following the caretaker cabinet's commitment in its letter of 24 May 2024, in November 2024 an assignment was given to ABDTOPConsult for an exploration of how to achieve a cross-domain, multi-year programmatic approach within the central government.
Naar aanleiding van de toezegging van het demissionaire kabinet in de Kamerbrief van 24 mei 2024 is in november 2024 een opdracht verstrekt aan ABDTOPConsult voor een verkenning
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de gepresenteerde Agenda voor Werkend Nederland

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Agenda for Working Netherlands, covering middle incomes, the work-pays-more norm, marginal tax pressure, childcare costs, self-employed workers and the reachability of government services. The minister replied that the agenda is organised by policy domain, that existing and planned measures support middle incomes, and that many questions depend on case-by-case assessment or future decisions.
However, the cabinet does not follow a norm that workers always end up better off than non-workers.
Het kabinet volgt echter geen norm dat werkenden er altijd meer op vooruitgaan dan niet-werkenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over pensioenfonds PWRI dat 1 januari 2025 wil invaren

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the regulators (AFM and DNB) should have approved the transition of pension fund PWRI on 1 January 2025, given the fund's own warnings that members will not understand or trust the mandatory information and that individual data are not yet loaded. The Minister answers that the fund is responsible for communication, that DNB assesses the transition on legal criteria without a power to judge the specific fund's merits, and that members can request inspection of their individual calculations.
I cannot go into supervisory-confidential questions about specific institutions under the supervision of the regulators AFM and DNB.
Ik kan niet ingaan op toezichtvertrouwelijke vragen over specifieke instellingen die onder toezicht staan bij toezichthouders AFM en DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de effecten van invaren voor gewezen deelnemers

Rep. Joseph asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the position of deferred members ('slapers') when pension rights are transferred to the new pension system, citing an opinion piece and concerns about the hearing right, transition plans, projected losses and DNB's supervision. The Minister answers that individual cases are not commented on, that statutory safeguards (balanced interest weighing, hearing right, advisory and approval bodies) apply, and that the responsibility for transition plans and their assessment lies with social partners, pension funds and DNB.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, it is not for me to go into individual cases and give a judgement on them; social partners decide on the design of their pension scheme.

Het is, zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven, niet aan mij om op individuele casussen in te gaan en daar een oordeel over te geven; sociale partners gaan over de invulling van hun pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het indexatiebeleid van pensioenfondsen die willen invaren

MP Joseph asked the Minister of Social Affairs about pension funds such as ABP and PFZW choosing lower indexation than the rules allow while citing protecting the transition to the new pension system, and whether this is fair to members who may die before transition or who have small pensions. The minister replied that fund boards decide independently under the balanced-interests norm, that the relaxed indexation rules are a legitimate option when transitioning, and declined to require DNB supervision changes or public, quantified justification by funds.
It is up to a fund to account to its participants.
Het is aan een fonds om verantwoording aan zijn deelnemers af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over Wereldstotterdag

An MP asked the cabinet about stuttering in the labour market, including a reported case of a UWV Werkbedrijf job-seeker told not to stutter, the banenafspraak target group register, and public campaigns. The government acknowledged the difficulties, pointed to a broader equal-opportunities approach, a future vision for the banenafspraak, the Whispp speech technology pilot, and no planned public campaigns.
At this moment there are no planned public campaigns.
Op dit moment zijn er geen voorgenomen publiekscampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het niet uitnodigen van zzp-vertegenwoordigers bij het Catshuis-overleg met de sociale partners van 21 november jl.

MP Aartsen asked why self-employed (zzp) organisations were not invited to the Catshuis consultation with social partners on 21 November 2024, and whether they are treated as full social partners. The minister answered that the consultation was with the central employer and employee organisations and the SER chair, that self-employed interests are handled through other consultations, and that no agreements were made on the labour market package, DBA enforcement, BAZ, Vbar or pensions.
However, no organisations representing only self-employed persons were invited to this consultation.
Er zijn voor dit overleg echter geen organisaties uitgenodigd die enkel zelfstandigen vertegenwoordigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de keuzehulp van het ministerie van SZW over schijnzelfstandigheid

MP Aartsen asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the SZW webmodule for assessing employment relations (schijnzelfstandigheid), its legal status, its fit with the Deliveroo criteria, its relation to the entrepreneur check and proposed VBAR law, and consultation with self-employed groups. The minister replies that the webmodule is only an indication offering no legal certainty, that it is being reviewed in light of pending Supreme Court questions, and that the Rijk is tightening its approach to false self-employment.
No certainty can be derived from this indication.
Aan deze indicatie kan geen zekerheid worden ontleend.
Antwoord op de nog openstaande vraag (nr. 5) van het lid Joseph over het onderzoek naar de tevredenheid over het hoorrecht onder gewezen deelnemers en gepen

An MP asked the minister for all correspondence between EY and the ministry on the survey into satisfaction with the right to be heard among former participants and pensioners, including draft versions. The minister sent partial correspondence, withholding drafts and redacting names and business-confidential material, while offering a follow-up assignment to produce verifiable interview summaries.
I hereby send you the answer to question 5 from MP Joseph of NSC about the survey into satisfaction with the right to be heard among former participants and pensioners.
Hierbij zend ik u het antwoord op vraag 5 van het lid Joseph van NSC over het onderzoek naar de tevredenheid over hoorrecht onder gewezen deelnemers en gepensioneerden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de gevolgen van asbestbranden

MPs Van Kent asked whether, after the government's earlier answer on asbestos fires, no party is now obliged to clear asbestos debris outside built plots, and whether a statutory duty is needed. The Secretary of State corrected his earlier answer, says the owner of the burned building must clear debris on neighbouring land (including undeveloped land), explains the Civil Code and environmental law basis, and concludes no new legislation is needed.
That answer relied too heavily on case law about responsibility for clearing drug waste.
In dat antwoord is te veel uitgegaan van de jurisprudentie over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het opruimen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de spreidingsmethodes in de uitkeringsfases van de nieuwe premieregelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about spreading methods for benefit phases in new collective pension schemes, including whether asymptotic spreading conflicts with the 10-year rule in article 63a Pensioenwet and whether the coverage-ratio method should be legally enabled. The Minister answered that the Besluit gelijke aanpassingen met spreiden provides a workable framework, that the coverage-ratio method is not desirable to enable by law, and that the flexible scheme's options will be reviewed and reported in spring.
I will inform your House about this in the spring, so that you can take it into account in the planned handling of the Toezeggingenwet.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in het voorjaar informeren, zodat u dit bij de voorgenomen behandeling van de Toezeggingenwet kunt betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Ceder en Patijn over het bericht 'Crisis UWV nog groter, ook missers bij mogelijk duizenden jonggehandicapten: 'Kommer en kwel''

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry knew earlier of problems at UWV affecting Wajong disability benefit assessments, and whether it would commission independent research, extend the Court of Audit request, and address WW and Ziektewet. The minister answered that Wajong quality measurements were discontinued from 2020 so quality cannot be verified, promised further investigations, a letter on remedies, and a check on WW and Ziektewet, but declined to commit to an Algemene Rekenkamer investigation until ongoing studies finish.
Unfortunately, quality measurements were scaled down from 2020 onward, and it is now insufficiently clear how the quality of Wajong assessments stands, because it is not traceable.
Helaas zijn de kwaliteitsmetingen vanaf 2020 afgeschaald en is het nu onvoldoende duidelijk hoe het is gesteld met de kwaliteit van de Wajong-beoordelingen, omdat dit niet navolgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Steeds meer studenten met een beperking krijgen extra studietoeslag'

MP Dassen asked the ministers about a news report that more students with disabilities receive the individual study allowance (IST), and why not all eligible students use it, whether the allowance should move to the Study Finance Act and DUO, and how municipal administration causes unequal amounts. The government welcomed the rise, said non-take-up is unknown because data on medical conditions cannot lawfully be collected, defended keeping administration with municipalities, and pointed to information campaigns and possible harmonisation of amounts.
This is not known. For that, the government would need insight into how many students are eligible for the study allowance.
Dit is niet bekend. Daarvoor zou de overheid zicht moeten hebben op hoeveel studenten voor de studietoeslag in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat het aandeel werkenden in armoede in vijf jaar tijd met liefst 25% is toegenomen

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that the share of working people in poverty rose 25% in five years, and whether work pays more than benefits, with questions on the composition of working poor, benefit-take-up, marginal tax burdens and measures. The State Secretary answered that the rise reflects falling poverty among benefit recipients rather than more working poor, cited data on working poverty and planned measures such as proactive service delivery, though several breakdowns were unavailable.
The cabinet does not currently have figures for all the requested breakdowns within the group of workers.
Het kabinet beschikt op dit moment niet over cijfers voor alle gevraagde uitsplitsingen binnen de groep werkenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over diverse post-COVID problematieken

An MP asks the ministers of health and social affairs about post-COVID problems: unfamiliarity and missing guidelines at agencies, Wajong eligibility for young people, bijstand rules, municipal Wmo support, occupational physicians' knowledge, and self-employed workers' income loss. The government answers that it funds research, guidelines and expertise centres, notes Wajong reassessment routes and fallback benefits, and sees no need for specific policy changes beyond ongoing knowledge-building with the VNG and C-support.
The cabinet regrets that post-COVID is still a (too) unknown condition to make a proper assessment during an investigation under the Wmo 2015.
Het kabinet betreurt het dat post-COVID nog een (te) onbekende aandoening is om tijdens een onderzoek in het kader van de Wmo 2015 een goede afweging te maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht ‘Paniek over veiligheid pensioenen APG: kritisch rapport legt problemen bloot’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Minister's office whether APG, a major pension administrator, is adequately protected against cyberattacks, including a worst-case no-IT scenario, after a critical consultancy report surfaced. The minister answered that APG's security is high, that the worst-case scenario is extremely unlikely, that emergency payment processes were tested and reliable, and that supervision by DNB and AFM covers ICT risk, while not committing to a specific new step.
Following the reporting in De Limburger, I contacted APG about this.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in De Limburger heb ik hierover contact opgenomen met APG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Stultiens over het bericht 'Paniek over veiligheid pensioenen APG: kritisch rapport legt problemen bloot'

MPs Kathmann and Stultiens asked the ministers about reported IT vulnerabilities at pension administrator APG and how critical institutions and supervisors such as DNB handle cybersecurity. The government answered that APG has taken mitigating measures under supervision of DNB and AFM, that the minister is not directly involved, and that the forthcoming Cyberbeveiligingswet will impose a risk-management duty on organisations, while declining to disclose supervisory details.
Due to supervisory confidential information, DNB cannot make statements about what share of supervision is devoted to cybersecurity of pension funds.
Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie kan DNB geen uitlatingen doen welk aandeel van het toezicht besteed wordt aan cyberveiligheid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het onderzoek van het Nibud, in opdracht van de Mobiliteitsalliantie

MP Postma asked the government about a Nibud study commissioned by the Mobiliteitsalliantie showing that low and middle incomes face transport poverty, and what measures will restore affordable mobility and how ETS-2 affects transport costs. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the study, gave no precise figure, pointed to past tariff measures, discount products and a planned Social Climate Fund, but did not commit to a specific new measure or timeline.
There is no precise figure to give on this.
Hierover is geen precies getal te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het onderzoek naar de tevredenheid over hoorrecht onder gewezen deelnemers en gepensioneerden

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the EY study on satisfaction with the right to be heard among former pension participants and pensioners, requesting the tender, contract, case studies, and correspondence. The Minister provided the tender and contract as attachments, declined to disclose fund-level figures and the underlying case-study reports citing confidentiality, and offered only partial access to the correspondence while refusing to share draft versions.
It should be noted that commercially confidential information will not be provided.
Hierbij dient opgemerkt te worden dat bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie niet zal worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over ongerechtvaardigde ontslagen op staande voet van arbeidsmigranten in de vleessector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs for details on staffing agencies in the meat sector with high shares of dismissals on the spot, including their names, sizes, locations and owners. The minister refused to name the agencies or give the requested details citing GDPR and confidentiality rules, while acknowledging the misuse concern and saying the agencies' inspection bodies lack the legal mandate to act and that further steps are being considered.
The UWV may not share this data on the basis of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and several confidentiality provisions.
Het UWV mag deze gegevens op basis van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) en meerdere geheimhoudingsbepalingen niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

MPs Van Kent and Beckerman asked about Transavia trainees deployed as regular staff in 2023 and what the government would do about it. The minister says trainees must not replace regular workers, that the Labour Inspectorate fined the airline and withdrew its preventive shutdown warning after adequate changes, and points to complaint routes but declines to rule on individual cases.
However, it is not for the cabinet to make statements about this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om hier in individuele gevallen uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk, Helder en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Honderden agenten met PTSS krijgen geen passende WIA-uitwerking door gebrek aan kennis over ziekte bij UWV’

MPs from CDA, BBB and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether UWV medical assessors lack knowledge of PTSD, leaving police officers without proper WIA benefits, and proposed a specialist desk and training. The minister denied a knowledge gap, said PTSD is covered by general medical knowledge and assessor re-registration, and offered no new training or desk beyond existing optional courses.
I do not recognise that picture.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Velde en Heutink over ‘de onacceptabele uitsluiting van PVV-bewindspersonen door UN Women bij de aftrap van een campagne tegen geweld tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Enschede.’

PVV MPs asked whether UN Women excluded PVV state secretaries from a campaign launch against violence against women in Enschede because of their party affiliation, and whether this is acceptable. The government condemned unequal treatment on political grounds, said UN Women Nederland is an independent Dutch foundation rather than a UN body, and noted the Enschede municipality has withdrawn from the event.
If ministers are excluded because of their political affiliation, that is completely unacceptable.
Indien bewindslieden omwille van hun politieke affiliatie worden uitgesloten is dat volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister ontkent inzet slimme software voor WIA-fouten, ondanks dat dit wel verteld is aan UWV-medewerkers'

An MP (CDA) asked the minister whether signals about smart software being used to detect WIA benefit errors at UWV had been properly disclosed, given the minister earlier denied such use. The minister answered that a 'digital assistant' tool, not AI, may be used to sort the roughly 250,000 WIA decisions from 2020–2024 for manual review, that it makes no decisions, and declined to reconsider a motion.
I was not insufficiently informed. See my answer to question 2.
Ik was niet onvoldoende op de hoogte. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Grote zorgen over nieuwe regels voor toeristen in Spanje'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment whether Spain's mandatory tourist registration, based on EU rules, overlaps with the Dutch debate on registering EU labour migrants, and why EU tourists can be registered while EU migrants cannot be required to register for stays under three months. The minister answered that the Spanish rule serves security and that the Dutch debate concerns labour conditions and BRP registration, that no unjustified difference exists, and that the Ministry of Interior is exploring use of night-register data for labour migrant registration.
The Ministry of the Interior is currently exploring, together with the VNG, whether data from the night register can be used to improve the registration of labour migrants in the BRP.
Het Ministerie van BZK verkent op dit moment in samenwerking met de VNG of gegevens uit het nachtregister gebruikt kunnen worden voor de verbetering van de registratie van arbeidsmigranten in de BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de kabinetsreactie op de parlementaire enquête fraude en dienstverlening (PEFD)

MP Stultiens asked why the cabinet has not yet responded substantively to the PEFD enquiry report on the childcare benefits scandal, and whether it will respond to all 19 recommendations before the autumn recess. The minister answers that the cabinet deferred its substantive response to the next cabinet, that a response is being prepared, and that it expects to send it before the Christmas recess.
After the coalition agreement was published on 16 May 2024, the caretaker cabinet chose to leave a substantive cabinet response to the next cabinet.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft na verschijnen van het hoofdlijnenakkoord op 16 mei 2024 ervoor gekozen om een inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie aan het volgende kabinet te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de eisen van de vakbonden om minder te werken

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether a four-day work week with higher pay, demanded by unions, would reduce labour supply and the economy, and how this fits government policy to increase working hours. The minister answers that no macroeconomic calculation exists, that the effects are hard to quantify, promises an agenda for workers, and states that wage bargaining is for social partners and the government should not intervene in CAO agreements.
No macroeconomic calculation is available for the introduction of a four-day work week with wage increases.
Voor de invoering van een vierdaagse werkweek met loonstijging is geen macro-economische doorrekening beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het niet betrekken van zzp-organisaties bij de totstandkoming van het regeerprogramma

An MP asks why the government consulted employer and employee bodies but not self-employed (zzp) organisations when drafting the coalition programme, and whether it will invite zzp organisations to talks in the polder. The minister answers that the SER now has six reserved seats for self-employed representatives, that several self-employed organisations were consulted, and that the Stichting van de Arbeid is a private body that sets its own composition.
As indicated above, the position of self-employed persons in the SER has structurally improved with the recent expansion of seats.
Zoals hierboven aangegeven is de positie van zelfstandigen in de SER met de recente zeteluitbreiding structureel verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de afscheidsrede van prof. Nijman over misleidende berekeningen in transitieplannen en pensioencommunicatie

MP Joseph asks the Minister of Social Affairs about Prof. Nijman's claim that transition calculations comparing old and new pension contracts are misleading, because buffers in the old FTK contract inflate the comparison, and whether pension funds should proceed with the 1 January 2025 transition. The Minister disagrees that the calculations are misleading, states they are supplementary to a balanced transition decision with context required in communication, and says the AFM supervises this and that funds may proceed.
I can confirm that. I note that these transition calculations do not in themselves define a balanced transition, but can only serve as a basis for reaching a balanced decision.

Dat kan ik bevestigen. Daarbij merk ik op dat deze transitieberekeningen op zichzelf niet een evenwichtige transitie definiëren, maar enkel kunnen dienen als onderbouwing om tot een evenwichtig besluit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ongerechtvaardigde ontslagen op staande voet van arbeidsmigranten in de vleessector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unjustified summary dismissals of migrant workers in the meat sector, including sector-level data and the number of agencies with high rates. The minister answered with administrative data showing elevated summary dismissals among agency workers and non-Dutch nationals, and described sector talks and the forthcoming Wtta licensing law and a review of possible agency-work bans.
In addition, the Act on admission of temporary agency labour (Wtta) is being introduced, with which malicious organisations in the temporary employment market can be tackled.
Daarnaast wordt de Wet toelating terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten (Wtta) geïntroduceerd waarmee malafide organisaties in de uitzendmarkt kunnen worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Ceder over het artikel ‘Roep om einde aan ‘incasso-industrie’ te maken: ‘Schuld van 50 euro kan nu oplopen tot 800 euro’’

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked whether maximum debt-collection costs and the debt-collection industry's profit margins are still reasonable, and how the government will respond to the Consumentenbond's proposals and the IBO on problematic debts. The State Secretary answered that the current cost rules are being examined in the IBO follow-up, that a Rijksincassovisie and a research on overheid claims are pending, and that a cabinet response to the IBO will follow this year, without committing to the Consumentenbond's specific proposals.

Given also the analyses from the IBO report, I intend to examine the funding system within the out-of-court collection phase more closely in the coming period, with particular attention to the cost escalation on small claims.

Gegeven ook de analyses uit het IBO rapport ben ik voornemens om de bekostigingssystematiek binnen de buitengerechtelijke incassofase de komende periode nader onder de loep te nemen, met bijzondere aandacht voor de kostenoploop bij kleine vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over studiefinanciering voor internationale studenten

An MP asked the ministers how many international students enrolled in 2024/25, the working-hour rules for student finance, cross-EU comparisons, cumulation with foreign child benefit, and how parental income is assessed. The minister said 2024/25 enrolment data are not yet available (expected in the 2025 forecast), gave EER student finance figures, described the 32/24-hour rules, committed to pushing an EU-level definition of migrant worker, and answered the remaining questions on cumulation and income assessment.
The number of international students who have enrolled to study in the Netherlands in academic year 2024–2025 is not yet known.
Het aantal internationale studenten dat zich heeft ingeschreven om in studiejaar 2024–2025 in Nederland te studeren is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de sluiting van online geldvraagbaak Kandoor

An MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the closure of the online financial help service Kandoor just before the pension transition, and whether pension funds are prepared for the resulting flood of questions. The minister answered that pension providers are responsible for informing members, that existing government information channels exist, that he has confidence in the sector's preparedness, and that he will examine with the sector whether Kandoor's functions could be added to the communication approach.
I cannot give insight into the annual costs, as this concerns business-confidential information of Kandoor.
Inzicht in de jaarlijkse kosten kan ik u niet geven, dit betreft namelijk bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie van Kandoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de aanpassing van ingegane variabele uitkeringen bij verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about whether insurers and pension funds may lower already-started variable pension payments after a rise in interest rates reduces the permitted fixed reduction, and whether this risk was intended by law. The Minister answered that some providers interpret the rules differently, that changes to the risk-free rate should not alter agreed reductions after payments start, and that DNB will clarify the explanation.
There is no overall overview available.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Omtzigt en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Crisis bij UWV: tienduizenden uitkeringen na jaren aangepast wegens fouten' en brief van minister SZW d.d. 4 september 2024 naar aanleidin

MPs Saris, Omtzigt and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV errors in WIA benefit calculations, whether benefits decided long ago can be adjusted against recipients, the legal basis and protection, known problems, audit reports, and the timing and scope of the government's knowledge and remedies. The minister answered at length: errors are being identified, UWV expects a complete picture by December, recovery depends on individual case review with attention to the human scale, and the government plans WIA reforms and an independent inquiry.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de uitspraak van de CRvB dat er sprake is van discriminatie vanwege handicap bij de berekening van het dagloon van de WIA, waarbij de loonloze tijdvakken in de WIA wel meegeteld

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs how the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on WIA daily wage calculation for unpaid periods, which it found discriminatory on grounds of disability, will be implemented, including who is affected, the financial impact, and UWV's capacity to correct past benefits. The minister answers that a plan to revise existing WIA benefits is being drafted with UWV, that the government will inform parliament later this year, and that the budget impact will be dealt with in the spring 2025 budget decision.
I aim to inform your House about this later this year.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer later dit jaar hierover te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Omtzigt over de problemen met de WIA-keuringen en de vaststelling van de hoogte van de uitkeringen, die niet terug te vinden zijn in de vele verslagen, Kamerbrieven en andere zake

MPs Saris and Omtzigt asked about discrepancies in UWV's error and uncertainty figures for WIA benefits and why problems in WIA assessments and benefit calculations were absent from UWV reports and the Minister's letters. The Minister defended the provisional figures, acknowledged UWV failed to report internal findings, and said a legislative proposal on benefit recovery and the 'reasonably clear' criterion is being considered.
UWV has so far not reported on the inaccuracies found in internal samples in calculating and determining WIA benefits.
UWV heeft tot dusverre niet gerapporteerd over de bij interne steekproeven geconstateerde onjuistheden bij het berekenen en vaststellen van de WIA-uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over nieuwe problemen bij het UWV

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister and the Prime Minister about reported long-running errors at UWV affecting about 53,000 files, requesting a full overview of known problems and restoration operations, and whether these were reported. The government answered that the issues were shared with parliament via letters and that UWV is working on several restoration operations, while declining to withdraw earlier reports and stating no further massive errors beyond those already communicated.
Through the Stand van de Uitvoering we periodically inform the House of restoration actions with a large (societal) impact.
Via de Stand van de Uitvoering informeren we uw Kamer periodiek over de herstelacties met een grote (maatschappelijke) impact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het bericht 'Al 18 jaar gaat UWV de fout in: massale controle van zeker 53.000 dossiers wacht op groen licht'

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV had made errors in WIA daily wage indexation for 18 years, requiring review of about 53,000 files, and when the problem was known and what was done. The Minister confirmed awareness since August 2023, explained the cause, estimated 2,500-3,000 files needing correction, and described a pilot starting by October 2024 and fuller correction in 2025.
UWV intends to start a pilot of the remediation action by October 2024 at the latest, for the indexation moments of 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2014, to test the intended approach.
UWV is voornemens om uiterlijk in oktober 2024 te starten met een pilot van de herstelactie voor het indexatiemoment 1 januari 2020 en 1 januari 2014 om de beoogde werkwijze te testen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked ministers about the enforcement of labour exploitation, including prosecution figures, UWV's failure to revoke work permits in the Cornwall case, information sharing between ministries, housing tied to employment, inspectorate capacity and the scope of the criminal definition. The minister answered with figures on prosecutions, the legal limits on revoking permits, the new trafficking bill and the expansion of inspection capacity, while saying some earlier recommendations were not adopted.
On 25 April, the bill on modernising and extending the criminalisation of human trafficking was therefore submitted to the House of Representatives.
Op 25 april jl. is daarom het wetsvoorstel modernisering en uitbreiding strafbaarstelling mensenhandel bij de Tweede Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over arbeidsuitbuiting.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, about labour exploitation of migrant workers, the information exchange between the ministry and UWV, and the enforcement record of the Labour Inspectorate. The government says it treats exploitation as a high priority, describes changes to the Wav and enforcement capacity, and announces a bill to modernise the criminal offence of human trafficking, expected to take effect around mid-2025.

Alongside the planned amendment, the strengthened action plan 'Together against human trafficking' is exploring whether criminal investigation of suspects can be decoupled from establishing victim status.

Naast de voorgenomen wetswijziging wordt daarom in het kader van het versterkte Actieplan «Samen tegen mensenhandel» verkend of het uitvoeren van strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar verdachten van mensenhandel losgekoppeld kan worden van het vaststellen van slachtofferschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Vermeer over het convenant tussen de Belastingdienst en de uitzendbranche betreffende de toepassing van de extraterritoriale kostenregeling

MPs Van Oostenbruggen and Vermeer asked about the 2024 covenant between the Tax Authority and the staffing industry on the extraterritorial cost scheme, including recruitment abroad, enforcement, financial impact and the link to the coalition agreement. The State Secretary answered that the conditions are unchanged from 2010, enforcement is regular, no concrete amendment to the scheme exists yet, and an evaluation addendum is forthcoming.
Following this, we are further examining whether and how the ETK scheme can be made less generous.
Naar aanleiding hiervan onderzoeken wij verder of en zo ja hoe de ETK-regeling kan worden versoberd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht: ‘Overijsselse gemeenten houden tientallen miljoenen over aan opvang Oekraïners.’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government about reports that Overijssel municipalities kept tens of millions in surplus funds for Ukrainian refugee reception, asking for total costs, surpluses by province, repayments, supervision, and whether surpluses can be spent freely. The Minister replied that the Rijk lacks insight into per-municipality surpluses, that only 9 municipalities returned unspent 2022 funds, that normbedragen are fixed and surpluses may be spent on public tasks with accountability to the council, and that repayment is voluntary, not reclaimed.
The Rijk has no insight into possible surpluses or shortfalls relative to the standard allowance at the level of individual municipalities or provinces.
Het Rijk heeft geen inzicht in de eventuele overschotten of tekorten ten opzichte van de normvergoeding op het niveau van individuele gemeenten of provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over uitingen van de AFM over verkeerde pensioenverwachtingen als gevolg van een ‘rentedip’ in de modelberekeningen

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister about the AFM warning that a 'rate dip' in the scenario sets can misstate pension expectations for people about to retire, by up to about 8%. The minister acknowledged the concern, said DNB is studying adjustments to the scenario sets, and that pension funds bear responsibility for communicating with context.
DNB has indicated that it is researching possible adjustments to limit the impact of the interest rate jumps.
DNB heeft aangegeven onderzoek te doen naar mogelijke aanpassingen om de impact van de rentesprongen te beperken
Antwoord op van de leden Bushoff en Patijn over het bericht ‘Erkenning van longcovid voor WIA-uitkering gaat vaak mis: “Beoordeling bij driekwart van de patiënten onvoldoende”

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether incorrectly prepared long-COVID WIA disability assessments by UWV, reported as unsound in about 75% of a preliminary sample, are acceptable and what remedies exist. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the sample is not representative, announced a follow-up study by UWV expected by year-end, and outlined training and capacity measures, while not committing to reopening decisions.
Because the preliminary study is not a representative sample, UWV is starting a follow-up study.
Omdat het vooronderzoek geen representatieve steekproef betreft, start UWV een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Mensen voelen zich niet serieus genomen door UWV bij WIA-aanvraag: 'Arts zei dat ik mijn klachten aandik'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many people feel not taken seriously by UWV in WIA disability assessments, and whether a complaints point will be opened and when analysis and OCTAS alternatives will be sent to parliament. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the ministry and UWV are examining the reports and will inform parliament shortly after summer, and that OCTAS proposals will be detailed with parliament informed in autumn.
As promised by my predecessor, my ministry is working with UWV to find out exactly what the reports underlying the recent media coverage contain.
Zoals door mijn voorganger is toegezegd, zoekt mijn ministerie samen met UWV uit wat de rapporten waarop de recente berichtgeving in de media is gebaseerd precies inhouden

m: Motie Boelhouwer/Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over een structurele oplossing voor de problemen bij de uitvoering van het omgevingsrecht
Asks the government to ensure a structural solution for enforcement problems in environmental law implementation, with quality standards and progress reported to the House.
requests the government to ensure a structural solution comes for the problems in implementation
verzoekt de regering erop toe te zien dat er een structurele oplossing komt voor de problemen bij de uitvoering
Amendement van het lid Vietsch c.s. over effectievere parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de delegatiebepaling van artikel 2 Woningwet
Requires that draft general administrative orders under the Housing Act be submitted to both chambers at least four weeks before they are adopted, giving parliament early involvement.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the first paragraph shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het door de architect geven van informatie over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid
Adds the word 'relevante' so architects must state only relevant expertise and competence in a quotation under the Architects' Title Act.
who asks him for a quotation about his relevant expertise and professional competence
die hem een offerte vraagt over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid

Amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer over het schrappen van de verplichting van de architect om een oprdrachtgever te informeren over zijn rechten en plichten jegens een derde die het werk he
Removes the architect's duty to inform the client about rights and duties toward a third party who designed the work, under the Architect Title Act.
the phrase concerning the client's rights and duties toward a third party who designed the work is deleted
vervalt de zinsnede «, alsmede over diens rechten en plichten jegens een derde, ingeval die derde het werk heeft ontworpen
Amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer over het door de architect slechts desgevraagd informatie geven over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid
Limits the architect's duty to inform clients about expertise to cases where the client asks, and to relevant expertise only.
informs upon request the person requesting a quote about his relevant expertise
informeert desgevraagd de persoon die hem een offerte vraagt over zijn relevante deskundigheid
Motie Boelhouwer en Koppejan over beheer van de natuur in de uiterwaarden

Asks the government to align water safety and nature goals in the river area, reconsider nature requirements where they conflict with flood protection, and prioritise management of floodplain nature for water safety.
requests the government to align the objectives of water safety and nature in the river area as much as possible
verzoekt de regering om de doelstellingen van waterveiligheid en natuur in het rivierengebied zoveel mogelijk op elkaar af te stemmen
Motie Cramer c.s. over efficiënte inzet van middelen voor regionaal ov
Asks the government to prioritise the scarce regional public transport budget toward the most promising projects; a spending allocation request.
requests the government to deploy the limited funds from the regional/local projects budget as efficiently as possible
verzoekt de regering de beperkt beschikbare middelen uit het zogenaamde budget voor regionale/lokale projecten zo efficiënt als mogelijk in te zetten
Motie Koopmans en Boelhouwer over behoud stedelijke bereikbaarheid en leefbaarheid na invoering PHS
Asks the government to explain how urban accessibility and liveability will be preserved after the PHS rail project and to propose concrete measures.
requests the government to explicitly address preserving urban accessibility when further developing the PHS project
verzoekt de regering om bij de nadere invulling van het project PHS expliciet in te gaan op het behoud van de stedelijke bereikbaarheid
Motie Cramer c.s. over quick-scan van spoorlijnen buiten de PHS-corridors
Asks the government to present, alongside the NMCA, a quick-scan of all rail lines outside the PHS corridors, updating the regional rail quick-scan data.
requests the government to present with the NMCA a quick-scan of all rail lines outside the PHS corridors
verzoekt de regering bij de NMCA een quick-scan te presenteren van alle spoorlijnen buiten de PHS-corridors
Motie Cramer c.s. over MIRT-onderzoek naar spoorverdubbeling Deventer-Olst
Asks the government to carry out an MIRT study into the Deventer-Olst rail doubling and report results to the Chamber within a year.
requests the government to carry out an MIRT study into the Deventer-Olst rail doubling
verzoekt de regering een MIRT-onderzoek te doen naar de spoorverdubbeling Deventer-Olst
Motie Boelhouwer en Koopmans over een wegverbinding tussen Tilburg en Turnhout
Motion asks the government to explore with Flemish and Belgian counterparts the possibilities for a road link between Tilburg and Turnhout.
requests the government, in consultation with Flemish and Belgian federal counterparts, to examine the possibilities of a good road link between Tilburg and Turnhout
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de Vlaamse en Belgische federale ambtgenoten de mogelijkheden van een goede wegverbinding tussen Tilburg en Turnhout te onderzoeken
Motie Van der Ham en Boelhouwer over onderhoud oevers Wilhelminakanaal
Asks the government to start regular maintenance of the Wilhelmina canal banks, since Rijkswaterstaat already knows where the future banks will be.
requests the government to start regular maintenance of the banks
verzoekt de regering het reguliere onderhoud aan de oevers te starten
Motie Vendrik c.s. over versneld vervangen van tweetakt bromfietsen
Asks the government to lobby for stricter emission standards for mopeds and to propose faster replacement of two-stroke mopeds with electric or four-stroke vehicles.
also requests the government to come with proposals to speed up replacing two-stroke scooters, mopeds and light mopeds with electric vehicles and four-stroke versions
verzoekt de regering tevens met voorstellen te komen om tweetakt scooters, brom- en snorfietsen versneld te vervangen door elektrische voertuigen en versies met viertaktmotoren
Motie Pieper c.s. over een minder complex stelsel voor het omgevingsrecht
Asks the government to commission a fresh, tabula rasa review of environmental law to reduce its complexity, consistent with democratic rule-of-law principles, and to report on progress.
requests the government to actually organise such a tabula rasa assignment
verzoekt de regering daadwerkelijk zo'n tabula rasa-opdracht te organiseren
Motie Boelhouwer/Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over mogelijk maken van vergunningvrij bouwen
Asks the government to allow permit-free building up to the maximum surface and dimensions set in the local zoning plan.
requests the government to enable permit-free building where the possibilities in the zoning plan for surface area and dimensions are the maximum
verzoekt de regering vergunningvrij bouwen mogelijk te maken waarbij de in het bestemmingsplan geboden mogelijkheden qua oppervlakte en maatvoering het maximum zijn
Amendement van de leden Koppejan en Boelhouwer over het verwijderen van de indirecte lozingen uit de waterwet
Amendment restoring a licence requirement for direct discharges to surface water and removing the licence requirement for indirect discharges from the Water Act.
