qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Veen over noodstroom in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about the reliability of backup power in hospitals, including outdated systems, untested equipment, unclear oversight responsibility and applicable standards. The minister answered that hospital boards are responsible for their electrical infrastructure, cited a 2009-2012 sector resilience study, and pointed to NEN 1010 as the applicable norm used by the inspectorate.
It is the responsibility of the institution itself to ensure that the equipment and infrastructure meet the requirements that current practice places on them.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling zelf om ervoor te zorgen dat de apparatuur en de infrastructuur voldoet aan de eisen die de hedendaagse praktijk hieraan stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Veen over contractering Audiologie

An MP asked the health minister about contracting problems for independent audiology centres, including the ban on holding equity before 2012, banks withdrawing credit, and patients cancelling appointments. The minister answered that a shared solution was agreed with insurers and providers within the macro budget, that a three-year transition model applies, and that existing treatments remain fully reimbursed.
It has been agreed that the problems at these centres will be resolved within the available macro framework.
Afgesproken is de problematiek bij deze centra op te lossen binnen het beschikbare macrokader.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Kuiken over het feit dat tandartspatiënten te veel hebben betaald voor implantaten

PvdA MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister whether dental patients overpaid for implants because dentists did not pass on manufacturer discounts, and about related pricing, oversight and market concerns. The minister referred to earlier answers on the same questions, said prices for dental materials in the Netherlands are not clearly higher than in comparable countries, and reported no formal complaints about counterfeit products.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions on this matter from MPs Van Gerven and Leijten.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen terzake van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over een aanpassing van de Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen (WGP)

MP Van der Veen asked the minister whether a ConQuaestor study on changing the Dutch drug price law (WGP) exists, whether it considers using the three lowest EU prices as a benchmark, and when its results will be sent to parliament. The minister confirmed the promised analysis, said the study covers the WGP's functioning and possible changes and will assess a three-lowest-EU-prices benchmark, but stated the report is not yet finished and promised to send it with her reaction before summer 2012.
The report is not yet finished and therefore not yet in my possession.
Het rapport is nog niet klaar en dus ook nog niet in mijn bezit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen over onrust rondom de contractering tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about contracting disputes between insurers and hospitals that could leave insured patients paying for care, including passant prices and whether acute and ongoing treatment is covered. The minister said she has no view on passant prices, that insurers and hospitals must inform patients, that ongoing and acute care is fully reimbursed, and declined to give details of individual contracts as commercially confidential.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over de veiligheid van geneesmiddelen en de rol van het CBG

An MP asks the health minister about the safety of medicines, the CBG's assessment practice, contract research organisations, funding, conflicts of interest and the Brandpunt allegations. The minister defends the CBG's assessments and procedures, notes existing checks, pharmacovigilance and a new conflict-of-interest code, and declines to send a letter to parliament.
I see no reason to send such a letter.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het sturen van een dergelijke brief.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over de kosten van bloed

An MP asked the health minister about the high price of blood units sold by Sanquin to hospitals, comparisons with Germany and Belgium, Sanquin's cost structure, its reserves of about 280 million euros, and board salaries. The minister answered that the price is based on total cost allocation, that a ConQuaestor study was commissioned and a position letter will follow, and that board pay follows the applicable pay rules.
I indicated in my reply that I have agreed with the Sanquin Supervisory Board that new board members will be remunerated in line with the Remuneration Code for Healthcare Board Members (BBZ).

Ik heb in mijn beantwoording aangegeven dat ik met de Raad van Toezicht Sanquin ben overeengekomen dat zij nieuwe bestuurders gaan honoreren conform de Beloningscode voor bestuurders in de zorg (BBZ).
Antwoord vragen Vermeij en Van der Veen over diabetes op het werk

MPs Vermeij and Van der Veen asked about a study showing employers are unprepared for diabetes among workers and about the role of occupational physicians and policy to support early recognition. The state secretary answered that the picture is not uniform, pointed to a Gezond Bedrijf action plan and a ZonMw diabetes-and-work guideline, and gave no new binding measures.
In the action plan Gezond Bedrijf I also devote attention to workers with a chronic condition, such as diabetes.
In het actieplan Gezond Bedrijf besteed ik ook aandacht aan werkenden met een chronische aandoening, zoals diabetes.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Van der Veen over de voorgenomen concentratie van Sanquin en het daardoor dreigende banenverlies

MPs Van Dekken and Van der Veen asked the health minister about Sanquin's planned concentration of activities in Amsterdam and Nijmegen, which would reduce its Groningen blood bank and cost jobs there. The minister said the reorganisation was only tested on safety, efficiency and quality rather than employment, that it aims to save costs, that a social plan is under discussion, and that Groningen will keep key functions with no negative service effects.
A reorganisation plan is not tested by me on operational aspects such as employment.
Een voornemen tot reorganisatie wordt door mij niet getoetst op bedrijfsvoeringsaspecten, zoals werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Van der Staaij over de beslissingsmacht van zorgverzekeraars over een ambulancepost op Walcheren

MPs Van der Veen and Van der Staaij asked whether the minister remains responsible for keeping the Walcheren ambulance post open, given that the NZa and insurers could let it close, and how this fits the 45-minute norm and her responsibility for vital care. The minister answered that the NZa independently assessed the request, approved retroactive extra budget for the ambulance service, and that responsibility for acute care is clearly divided between insurers, the NZa and the RAV.
I will ask the NZa to add these funds to the budget of the RAVZ.
Ik zal de NZa verzoeken deze middelen aan het budget van de RAVZ toe te voegen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over overstappen en concurrentie tussen zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the minister about switching between health insurers, premium coordination, market concentration, collective contracts and the Independer website stake held by Achmea. The minister declined to give switcher figures before the NZa market scan, rejected coordination claims as speculative, and argued that competitive pressure and oversight by NZa and NMa remain adequate.
At this moment I do not have sufficiently reliable information to answer questions 1 to 3. I am awaiting the NZa market scan for this, due in the second quarter of this year.
Op dit moment heb ik onvoldoende betrouwbare informatie om antwoord te kunnen geven op de vragen 1 t/m 3. Ik wacht daarvoor de marktscan van de NZa af in het tweede kwartaal van dit jaar.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over selectieve zorginkoop door verzekeraars (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a CBB interim ruling that restricts insurers' selective purchasing of specialist drugs, including whether the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit approved policy terms limiting coverage, cost differences and DBC tariff effects. The Minister says she is examining how to respond to the ruling, considers selective purchasing desirable, admits the costs are hard to estimate, and promises to inform parliament in March.
I intend to inform your House further on this matter in March.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer in maart nader te informeren over deze kwestie.

Vagen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Van der Veen (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulp in het

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about the closure of three emergency and maternity departments at the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum and the regional opposition to it. The government answered that regional access to acute care is secured within 45 minutes through extra ambulance capacity and a helicopter arrangement, that other hospitals can serve the region, and that a hospital availability allowance for 2012 is conditional on an adequate plan.
With these measures, the accessibility of acute care in the region within 45 minutes is secured.
Met deze maatregelen is de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio binnen 45 minuten geborgd.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het weigeren van patiënten door te weinig budget van zorgverzekeraar Achmea (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asks whether health insurer Achmea, which has a duty of care, is responsible for patient access when a Tilburg hospital stops treating its insured patients due to limited volume budgets, and whether budgets were set unfairly and whether a zero-growth stance was agreed. The minister answers that Achmea retains its duty of care with no indications of breach, that volume caps were agreed by contract with the hospital, and that the zero-growth stance for 2012 was an independent choice by insurers.
I have no indications that Achmea is not fulfilling its duty of care.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat Achmea de zorgplicht niet nakomt.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an extra ambulance post on Walcheren remains unsecured despite earlier commitments and a parliamentary motion. The minister said she asked the NZa in spring 2011 to expand the regional ambulance budget retroactively, but the NZa still lacks correct data from the regional service and insurers, and promised a decision within weeks.
The assessment of this request is for the NZa.
De beoordeling van dit verzoek is aan de NZa.

Vragen de leden Hamer en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verzoeken van Europese steun om ontslagen medewerkers van Zalco weer aan het werk te helpen (ingezonden 23

MPs Hamer and Van der Veen asked the minister whether he would submit an urgent application to the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund to help workers dismissed by Zalco, and why not if he would not. The state secretary answered yes, he is willing to apply, subject to the application meeting the conditions, with Zeeland province and Zalco preparing the draft in close cooperation with his ministry.
Yes, I am willing to submit an application to the European Commission for support from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund.
Ja, ik ben bereid een aanvraag in te dienen bij de Europese Commissie voor steun uit het Europese Globaliseringsfonds.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over artsen die 1 miljard Euro extra declareren (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

The MP asks the health minister about physicians allegedly inflating declarations by about one billion euros between 2006 and 2008, including double billing, upcoding of DBC treatments and the incentive structure of the DBC system. The minister disputes the 'sjoemelen' framing, states the billion is an extrapolated, uncontrolled figure, points to verifier controls, the DOT reform, the new physician budget model, and says it is impossible to quantify any unnecessary premium paid.
The 1 billion euro is a cumulative and extrapolated amount for 2006 to 2008 on which the usual checks by the insurer concerned had not yet taken place.
De 1 miljard Euro betreft een cumulatief en een geëxtrapoleerd bedrag tussen 2006 en 2008 waar nog niet de gebruikelijke controles door de onderzochte verzekeraar over hadden plaatsgevonden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brancheanalyse gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the PwC sector analysis showing hospitals' debts to insurers and risks of payment problems in 2012 from the new billing system and insurers withdrawing advance payments. The minister said advance payments are a matter between insurers and hospitals, pointed to a liquidity grouper due mid-2012 and a request to NZa and CVZ on advance payments of transition amounts, and gave no new debt figures.
VWS does not have more recent figures available on this point.
VWS heeft op dit punt geen recentere cijfers beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ruimte in het Budgettair Kader Zorg BKZ (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks whether the 2012 budget for pharmaceutical care outside hospitals falls by 68.4 million euro after moving TNF-alpha inhibitors to the hospital budget and delisting heartburn drugs, and whether this creates room of about 530 million euro, and whether the freed-up room will be used to reverse measures affecting insured persons. The minister confirms the figures, says the room is already fully used within the 2012 budget, rejects a 7% room for pharmacist pay, and says windfalls may be used to cover shortfalls under budget discipline rules.
However, this does not mean that a room of about 530 million euro is expected on this file.
Dit betekent echter niet dat er een ruimte wordt verwacht van ongeveer € 530 mln. op dit dossier.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over niet-reanimeerpenningen voor kwetsbare ouderen (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether elderly patients are being resuscitated against their wishes and whether non-resuscitation tags could be introduced. The state secretary agreed the issue matters, said patient choice must be respected, and pointed to a guideline from the medical society due mid-2012.

I expect that Verenso will incorporate all of this into the guideline on resuscitation policy for vulnerable elderly people in care homes, nursing homes and at home, which they hope to deliver in mid-2012.
Ik verwacht dat Verenso dit alles verwerkt in de «Richtlijn reanimatiebeleid kwetsbare ouderen in verzorgingshuizen, verpleeghuizen en in de thuissituatie» die zij medio 2012 hoopt op te leveren.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gezamenlijke nulgrensafspraak tussen zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asks whether the joint zero-growth agreement among health insurers, communicated by Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, is contrary to competition law and whether the NMa should investigate, and whether insurers should reduce unnecessary care rather than simply buying less. The minister answers that the letter is an interpretation of the macro agreement, not a binding per-hospital zero-growth rule, that no NMa investigation is warranted, and that volume limits and smart purchasing can go together.
I see no reason to ask the NMa to conduct an investigation.
Ik zie geen reden om de NMa te vragen een onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stijgend aantal wanbetalers voor de zorgpremie (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

The MPs ask about the rising number of health premium defaulters (over 300,000 in the enforced collection regime), causes, income groups, whether debt relief works, and cumulative effects of 2012 health measures. The state secretary replies that CVZ does not make payment arrangements, defaulters rose 10.8% to 307,312, a 2008 study was inconclusive, preventive measures will be intensified, and an overview of income effects is in the budget annex.
Statistics Netherlands will provide further data in November 2011 on the income distribution of defaulters as of 31 December 2010.
Het CBS zal in november 2011 nadere gegevens verstrekken over de verdeling van het inkomen bij wanbetalers per 31 december 2010.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het overschatten van besparingen door meer marktwerking (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the planned 2015 savings from more market competition in health insurance are overstated, given that DNB's proposed higher solvency requirement (9% to 11%) will raise capital buffers and possibly premiums. The minister answers that the capital increase is about EUR 720 million, that premium effects are expected to be limited because insurers already exceed the requirement, and that the structural savings of EUR 330 million are based on CPB calculations.
These amounts are based on calculations such as those the CPB made in the note 'Analysis of economic effects financial framework'.
Deze bedragen zijn gebaseerd op berekeningen zoals het CPB heeft gemaakt in de notitie «Analyse economische effecten financieel kader».
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over foute compensatie bij de ex-post risicoverevening (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Deputy Van der Veen asks the health minister how an error in the 2007 high-cost compensation (HKC) within the ex-post risk equalisation went unnoticed for so long, what the financial effects are for insurers, and whether a correct recalculation can be presented before 2012 premiums are set. Minister Schippers explains that wrong 2007 settlement percentages for academic hospitals were caused by using 2006 data, that the error only affects 2007, and that insurers have been given provisional corrected percentages, with a full recalculation taking longer than four weeks.
Following the error mentioned, additional agreements have already been made on an audit of the data.
Naar aanleiding van de genoemde fout zijn er al aanvullende afspraken gemaakt over een audit op de gegevens.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het anoniem melden van misstanden door zorgpersoneel aan de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ing

MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister about the underreporting of patient-safety incidents by hospital staff and whether anonymous complaints should be investigated individually by the IGZ inspectorate. The minister acknowledged underreporting, pointed to existing hospital reporting systems and the whistleblower scheme, and said the IGZ investigates anonymous reports only when serious risk is suspected, otherwise using them to detect structural problems.
In all other cases, anonymous reports are primarily used to identify patterns pointing to structural shortcomings in healthcare.
In alle andere gevallen worden anonieme meldingen primair gebruikt om patronen te herkennen die wijzen op structurele tekortkomingen in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Nederlands Kinderoncologisch Centrum (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a dispute between the Dutch paediatric oncology physicians' initiative (NKOC) and the university medical centres (NFU) over concentrating childhood cancer care in one centre, including the NFU's revised advisory report, UMCG letters to parents, and whether boards of directors blocked physicians. The minister says the parties are negotiating, declines to judge the NFU's internal process, and sees no reason to intervene now, while noting intervention could follow if patient safety or parents are endangered.
I currently have no reason to intervene.
Ik heb thans geen reden tot ingrijpen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onrechtmatig gebruik van de wanbetalerregeling en absolute minima met een betalingsachterstand (ingezon

MPs Van der Veen and Spekman asked whether health insurer Zorg en Zekerheid wrongly reports policyholders as defaulters to the CVZ, whether incassokosten and the 130% bestuursrechtelijke premie push people below the social minimum, and related questions on appeals, the beslagvrije voet and refunds. Minister Schippers denied wrongful reporting, explained the statutory collection and protection framework, and said the CVZ is working to speed refunds and embed insurer verification in its process.
The problem is addressed because in appropriate cases a refund can be carried out manually when a citizen requests it.
Het pijnpunt wordt weggenomen omdat in voorkomende gevallen een terugbetaling «handmatig» kan worden uitgevoerd wanneer een burger daarom verzoekt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de helft van de spoedeisende hulpen in Nederland dicht zouden kunnen (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MP Van der Veen asked the health minister whether the 45-minute ambulance norm could close half of Dutch emergency departments, whether insurers may decide which EDs stay open without breaching competition law, and who holds democratic legitimacy over such decisions. Minister Schippers answered that the 45-minute norm is achievable nationally except in peripheral areas, that insurers hold the purchasing role under conditions of quality and accessibility, that NMa would not normally intervene, and that a basic-ED advice and a basic-care note would follow.
Of course I will inform you about this.
Ik zal u uiteraard hierover informeren.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over risico’s door uitzendkrachten op ambulances (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the health minister about risks from temp agency staff and unqualified nurses driving ambulances, including whether response-time norms are affected. The minister said AZN sees adequate training safeguards, RAV services are responsible for staffing, unqualified staff are not permitted, and the IGZ has been asked to stay alert without a dedicated investigation yet.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert in the coming period to signals from the field or sector that may point to deficient care or risks that norms and agreements are not being met.

Ik heb aan de IGZ gevraagd om in de komende periode extra alert te zijn op signalen uit het veld of de sector die kunnen wijzen op tekortschietende zorg of risico’s dat normen en afspraken niet worden gehaald.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake het functioneren van een vaatchirurg (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Van der Veen asked the health minister why the inspectorate had not yet referred vascular surgeon H to the disciplinary tribunal, and what happened to the commitment to push for a European blacklist of dysfunctional doctors. The minister replied that the inspectorate would decide on measures by end April 2011 after its investigation, and that European efforts for such a list have not yet succeeded due to system differences and privacy concerns, with the issue to be raised again at an EU health council.
Based on the findings and a still-to-be-held conversation with the vascular surgeon himself, the IGZ will determine by end April 2011 whether, and if so which, measures are appropriate.
Op basis van de bevindingen en een nog te houden gesprek met de vaatchirurg zelf, bepaalt de IGZ voor eind april 2011 of, en zo ja welke, maatregelen passend zijn.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een neuroloog die in Nederland uit het BIG-register is geschrapt nu in Duitsland ongestoord zijn beroep ka

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a Dutch neurologist struck from the BIG register continues practising in Germany, and what action is taken. The minister said there is no EU obligation to recognise such restrictions, that she will raise a European list of disciplined practitioners in Brussels, and that a criminal investigation into the neurologist is ongoing.
This has so far not led to a European list of healthcare professionals on whom a practice-restricting measure has been imposed.
Dat heeft tot op heden nog niet geleid tot een Europese lijst van beroepsbeoefenaren in de gezondheidszorg, aan wie een beroepsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de totstandkoming van één centrum voor kinderoncologische zorg (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about delay and disagreement over establishing a single national paediatric oncology centre, including the selection of the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek hospital in Amsterdam and the UMCs' opposition. The minister answered that the process lies under the NKOC cooperative, that the selection followed published criteria and an independent committee, and that the parties now appear to be converging, while declining to say how the institutional arrangement should be shaped.
For the avoidance of doubt, I note that this is a procedure fully under the responsibility of the board of the Nationaal Kinderoncologisch Centrum (NKOC) cooperative.
Voor alle duidelijkheid merk ik op dat het om een procedure gaat die geheel onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de coöperatie Nationaal Kinderoncologisch Centrum (NKOC) valt.
Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over 1 miljard kosten voor lobbyen in de zorg (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Van der Veen and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about a study claiming over one billion euros of public money is spent on lobbying in healthcare, and whether toezichthouders are outmatched in information by intermediary organisations. The minister replied that the study mapped information flows rather than lobbying spend, that about 60% of the money goes to supervisory and government agencies, and that she sees no reason to assume patient interests are harmed.
The study aimed to establish which information flows exist between the various organisations active in healthcare that do not themselves deliver direct patient care.
Het onderzoek had ten doel vast te stellen welke informatiestromen er bestaan tussen de diverse organisaties die wel in de zorg actief zijn, maar zich niet bezig houden met directe patiëntenzorg.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de integrale bekostiging van zorg aan chronisch zieken (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

Two MPs asked the health minister about a Utrecht court ruling in the Meditta versus Achmea dispute on integrated funding of chronic-care programmes, its effect on care chains, and the financing uncertainty facing care groups. The minister said the ruling does not change policy, that the transitional rules allow separate-service billing, and that evaluation results are expected early next year.
I hope the ruling provides the necessary clarity so that care providers and insurers can reach agreement on funding integrated care in the near future.
Ik hoop dat het vonnis de nodige duidelijkheid geeft op basis waarvan zorgaanbieders en verzekeraars in de nabije toekomst tot overeenstemming kunnen komen over de bekostiging van integrale zorg.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over te veel fysiotherapie voor kinderen (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether too many children are referred to physiotherapy, whether referral figures and guidelines exist, and whether parents' expectations and GP/youth-health roles are addressed. The minister answered that no specific referral figures exist, that guidelines are primarily the profession's task, and that youth health care should inform parents about normal development.
Specific figures on child physiotherapy in (academic) hospitals and referrals to them are not available.
Specifieke cijfers over kinderfysiotherapie in (academische) ziekenhuizen en de verwijzing daarnaar, zijn niet voor handen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verschil tussen ziekenhuisomzet en economische groei (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a Gupta report showing hospital revenue growing far faster than GDP, the resulting gap of about 2.5 billion euros, alleged double payments to hospitals, hospital profits, market shares, and whether performance improvement should precede cuts to care use. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the spending framework was not lowered for the crisis, disputed the 300 million euro double-payment figure while admitting some imperfect clean-up, provided profit information via public annual reports, gave partial market data, and promised a cabinet position in February 2011.
Regarding the clean-up of the 2009 B-segment tranche, I had Vektis carry out an indicative investigation.
Over de schoning van de tranche 2009 B-segment heb ik Vektis een indicatief onderzoek laten doen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat patiënten de dupe worden van voortdurende onduidelijkheid over ziekenhuisverplaatste zorg

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about insurer Menzis ending reimbursement for home-administered immunoglobulins, forcing patients toward hospital day treatment and raising unclear NZa rules. The minister answered that Menzis contracted hospitals for this care, that patient-side options exist, and that the bekostiging of home nursing will be evaluated, while not committing to a change in the rules.
Moreover, the House of Representatives has been promised that this new form of funding for nursing will be evaluated.
Overigens is aan de Tweede Kamer toegezegd dat deze nieuwe bekostigingsvorm van de verpleging zal worden geëvalueerd.
Vragen van de het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergunningverlening voor radiotherapie aan de Hansa Oncology Clinics (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister why a radiotherapy licence was granted to Hansa Oncology Clinics after the new 2009 planning decision, despite risks of overcapacity and quality loss, and whether consultation with professional bodies and the Gezondheidsraad was bypassed. The minister answers that the clinic will serve a national function, that the licence was assessed under the 2009 planning decision, that consultation with the NVRO took place, and that the Inspectie will assess quality before patient treatment starts.
I assessed the licence application against the applicable framework, namely the Planningsbesluit Radiotherapie 2009 adopted on 23 October 2009.
Ik heb de vergunningsaanvraag beoordeeld aan de hand van het geldende kader, in casu het Planningsbesluit Radiotherapie 2009 dat op 23 oktober 2009 is vastgesteld.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het advies van het College voor Zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) inzake extra financiering Beleidsregel NZa (ingezonden 3 mei 2010)

An MP asked the health minister about the NZa's decision to add pemetrexed for first-line non-small-cell lung cancer to the expensive-drugs policy rule with retroactive effect, the procedure followed, its consultation of Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, the French assessment, and a Lilly claim on its website. The minister answered that the NZa followed the usual procedure with adequate consultation, that documents are not public beyond the parties, that the procedure may be reviewed with CVZ and NZa, and that the inspectorate considers the Lilly statement informative and not grounds for removal.
The documents underlying the decision-making, including the minutes, are not public, except for the parties involved.
De stukken die ten grondslag liggen aan de besluitvorming – waaronder de notulen – zijn niet openbaar, behalve voor de betrokken partijen.

Vragen van de leden Heerts en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Medische missers slecht vergoed» (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MPs Heerts and Van der Veen asked the Justice and Health ministers whether insurers slow down settlement of medical malpractice claims, whether the complaints committee for care institutions is adequate, and whether professional parties focus too much on euros. The minister acknowledges slow settlement at times, points to the voluntary code on medical liability (GMA) and the planned Wet Cliëntenrechten Zorg with a binding complaints body capped at 25,000 euro (initially 10,000 euro).
A component of the Wcz is that all care providers are obliged to join a dispute body.
Een onderdeel van de Wcz is dat alle zorgaanbieders verplicht worden zich bij een geschilleninstantie aan te sluiten.

m: Motie van het lid White c.s. over met de eilandbesturen komen tot een verbetering van de toepassing van het "comply or explain"-principe
Asks the government to work with island councils to improve application of the comply-or-explain principle to BES legislation and inform the Chamber before summer 2026.
requests the government to work with the island councils to improve application of the comply or explain principle
verzoekt de regering om samen met de eilandbesturen tot een verbetering van de toepassing van het «comply or explain»-principe te komen
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over per direct een huurcommissie instellen voor Saba en Statia
Asks the government to immediately establish a rent commission (Huurcommissie) for the islands Saba and Sint Eustatius to handle tenant disputes.
requests the government to immediately establish a rent commission for Saba and Statia
verzoekt de regering om per direct een huurcommissie in te stellen voor Saba en Statia
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over zorgen dat steun uit de verhuurderssubsidie altijd direct bij huurders terechtkomt
Asks the government to ensure rent-subsidy support reaches tenants directly even when landlords do not cooperate, for example through legal obligations or alternative routes.
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over de Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur structureel maken en uitbreiden naar Saba en Statia
Asks the government to make the Bonaire rental contribution pilot permanent and extend it to Saba and Statia.
requests the government to make the Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur pilot on Bonaire permanent
verzoekt de regering om de pilot van de Bijdrage Particuliere Verhuur op Bonaire structureel te maken
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de defensiecapaciteit van het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk versterken
Asks the government to improve information on international threats to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and to strengthen their defence capacity, for example with drones.
requests the government to improve information provision on international threats and protection against them to the governments and administrations in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom
