qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de situatie in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the situation in Sudan, El Fasher, RSF genocide designation, sanctions, arms exports via the UAE, fact-finding, journalist support and humanitarian aid. The government answered that it shares concern, applies a high bar for genocide qualification, pursues sanctions and engagement with the UAE, supports the fact-finding mission and humanitarian aid, and reviews export licences case by case.
The cabinet assesses all export licence applications for military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over opnemen van Palestijnse patiënten uit Gaza

MPs Bamenga, Paternotte and Paulusma (D66) asked why the Netherlands has not admitted any Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment, while many Western European countries have, and whether this breaches international obligations, including the ICJ ruling and the WHO appeals. The government answers that it prioritises regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support for medical evacuations, cites funding amounts, and says it will continue pressing Israel to allow more evacuations, without committing to bring patients to the Netherlands.
The cabinet focuses on treating seriously ill patients in the region.
Het kabinet zet in op behandeling van ernstig zieke patiënten in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over medische evacuaties uit Gaza

D66 MPs asked the government to release a study by two former ambassadors on medical evacuations from Gaza, to explain why the Netherlands does not take patients while many European states do, and to take in a contingent of patients. The government refused to share the study, said it prioritises support for care in the region over evacuation to the Netherlands, and listed financial contributions and a contact point for medical professionals.
The exploration discussed during the RDINEV is confidential and will not be shared with your House to protect the unity of Cabinet policy.
De verkenning die tijdens de RDINEV werd besproken is vertrouwelijk, en wordt niet met uw Kamer gedeeld ter bescherming van de eenheid van Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Der Werf en Bamenga over de mobilisatie in Venezuela en de veiligheidsontwikkelingen nabij Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about US naval deployment near Venezuela, its implications for the ABC islands (Cooperative Security Location, Kustwacht, NOTAMs, travel advice, involvement of Aruba and Curaçao) and whether Parliament would be informed. The government answered that the US deployment is nationally directed and the Kingdom is not involved, that existing defence and aviation arrangements remain unchanged, and that it will inform Parliament promptly if the security situation changes.
If the situation in the region leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, the government will inform your House without delay.
Indien de situatie in de regio leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal de regering uw Kamer daarover onverwijld informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt en Bamenga over “Het Uitvoeringsprogramma Impuls KRW Utrecht”

Two D66 MPs asked why the Netherlands is failing Water Framework Directive targets, why Utrecht province is adopting extra measures (notably on pesticides) that the national government is not, and how pesticide, nitrate and KRW rules can be aligned. The minister answers that the targets are shared with provinces and municipalities, that national action focuses on generic pesticide and nutrient measures and reauthorisation, and that the Utrecht programme is a provincial choice, while acknowledging further measures will be needed.
It is up to individual government bodies to weigh to what extent additional measures are appropriate.
Het is aan individuele overheidsorganen om af te wegen in hoeverre aanvullende maatregelen gepast zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Paulusma en Bamenga over een mogelijk naderend staakt-het-vuren in Gaza

MPs from D66 asked the government about a possible Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation model, medical evacuations and dual-use restrictions on prosthetics. The minister answered that Nederland demands unhindered humanitarian access through UN-led channels, rejects the GHF model, and will support medical capacity in the region and the WHO, but does not consider evacuation to the Netherlands desirable at present.
The cabinet cannot verify these figures.
Het kabinet kan deze cijfers niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over het artikel ‘Opnieuw grenscontroles door groep burgers, dit keer bij  Groningse Sellingen’

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether citizen groups stopping cars at the border and intimidating people is acceptable, what the government thinks of the chat messages with racist and violent content, and whether the government's initial response was too lax. The minister answered that border controls are reserved to authorities such as the Marechaussee, that taking the law into one's own hands is not allowed, that one suspect has been arrested, and that prosecution decisions rest with the prosecutor and judge.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have been committed.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de brand op een vrachtschip in de haven van Amsterdam

MPs Bamenga and Rooderkerk (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cause of a May 2025 ship fire in the Amsterdam port, repeated fires, prevention measures, and health monitoring of residents. The minister answered that the cause is unknown and the matter is a local responsibility, cited general measures on battery waste and prevention by industry, and reported that GGD and the safety region issued advice to residents.
This concerns a local incident, which is handled by the local competent authority.
Het betreft een lokaal incident, dat door het lokaal bevoegd gezag behandeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht dat 15 hulpverleners zijn vermoord door het Israëlische leger

Parliamentarian Bamenga asked the government whether it considers the killing of 15 aid workers in Gaza by the Israeli army a war crime, what it is doing to investigate, whether it will impose consequences or restrict arms exports and military cooperation with Israël, and what it is doing to protect aid workers. Minister Veldkamp condemned the attack, reported the Israeli internal investigation and reprimand, said Nederland will call for an international investigation, and reviewed arms export licences and EU-Israel Association Agreement steps without ruling out further action.
In line with the Kahraman/Ceder motion, the Netherlands will call for an international investigation at the European level.
Nederland zal conform de motie Kahraman/Ceder ( 21 501-02, nr. 3107 ) in Europees verband oproepen tot een internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Bonaire bezorgd om militaire dreiging vanuit Venezuela’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Bonaire fears a military threat from Venezuela, including whether activity was observed, threat levels, contacts with Venezuela and Bonaire, and protective measures. The minister answered that no recent Venezuelan military activity near Bonaire has been observed, that there is no reason to assume a heightened threat, that routine intelligence monitoring and regional Defence presence continue, and that Parliament will be informed if the situation changes.
If the situation in Venezuela leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, I will, also on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, inform your House about it.
Indien de situatie in Venezuela leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de economische kansen van verduurzaming op Curaçao

Two D66 MPs asked about a Curaçao solar park, EV charging and electric buses, including a 13.2 million euro financing gap and Dutch funding commitments. The minister says Curaçao is responsible for procurement and financing, that Dutch SDE funds cannot be used directly but grid and storage costs may be eligible, and that a feasibility study and a May visit to Curaçao are planned.
It is up to Curaçao to shape the implementation and financing.
Het is aan Curaçao om de uitvoering en financiering vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over minder intercitystops in Weert, de intercityverbinding Eindhoven – Aken, en de algemene bereikbaarheid met en binnen Limburg

An MP asked the State Secretary about reduced intercity stops around Weert during PHS works and about the long-delayed Eindhoven–Aken intercity connection. The government says the works are necessary and that NS keeps regional connections, while the IC Aken depends on Eindhoven capacity works and cannot be realised before 2031 at the earliest, with a timeline to follow only once financing is clear.
A condition for drawing up a realistic timeline is that there is (prospect of) financing.
Voorwaarde om een realistisch tijdspad op te stellen is dat er (zicht op) financiering is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Podt over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (KRW)

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the EU Water Framework Directive, including the Commission's finding that the Netherlands will likely miss its 2027 targets, the Tussenevaluatie, nitrogen and manure rules, permit backlogs and legal risks. The minister acknowledged the shortfall and the legal risks, pointed to the impulse programme and forthcoming measures before summer 2025, but gave largely general answers and deferred several points to other ministers and authorities.
Before summer 2025 the House will be informed about this.
Vóór de zomer van 2025 wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Boswijk over het artikel 'Rebels Backed by Rwanda Announce Capture of Key City in Eastern Congo'

MPs Bamenga and Boswijk asked about the M23 advance in eastern DRC, the humanitarian situation, Dutch and EU responses, and the EU-Rwanda critical minerals memorandum. The government answers that Dutch humanitarian funding continues, that Rwanda is being pressed bilaterally and in the EU to halt support for M23, and that the minerals MoU is under discussion for possible suspension.
Due to the confidentiality of this process, the cabinet cannot make further statements on this.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit proces kan het kabinet hier verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Bamenga over het artikel op de website PITANE.BLUE van 19 januari 2025: ‘OV-NL: doel uitstootvrije bussen in 2030 onder druk door gebrek aan stroom’

MPs Rooderkerk and Bamenga asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about mobility CO2 emissions, whether the 2030 restemissie target is reachable, funding, grid congestion delaying bus electrification, air quality and whether climate targets could be dropped. The State Secretary answered that the government is not on track, will consider alternative measures in spring, has no budget space yet, cites grid-congestion agreements and subsidies, and states it will only deviate from climate targets if alternative policy fails.
Therefore the cabinet is looking this spring at the possibilities for taking alternative measures, as also agreed in the coalition programme.
Daarom kijkt het kabinet dit voorjaar naar de mogelijkheden om alternatieve maatregelen te treffen, zoals ook afgesproken in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent en Kostić over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how citizens, animals and the environment are protected against LD steel slag, which RIVM classifies as hazardous, and how regulation, enforcement and interbestuurlijk toezicht will be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that duty-of-care rules and enforcement apply, that several steps (information duty, updated circular, regulatory review) are underway, and that the risks are recognised, while stating that municipalities and provinces carry enforcement responsibility.
That is why steps have been taken and I am currently working, as part of the review of soil regulation, on
Daarom zijn er stappen ondernomen en ben ik op dit moment in het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving aan de slag met
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over Chemours

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and Volt asked the State Secretary about Chemours, its recent leak and past accidents, its lobbying in Europe against the PFAS ban, and the scientific claims used by industry. The State Secretary answered that supervision of the Seveso site is shared with inspection partners, that the leak caused no soil, water or drinking water effects, and that the PFAS restriction is under assessment by ECHA, with the government saying it would take a position once the Commission proposal exists.
I am not responsible for that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Brandbrief over racisme bij de rijksoverheid: medewerkers van kleur lijken systematisch doelwit te worden'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that employees of colour are systematically targeted with racism in central government and how complaints are handled. The minister acknowledges the problem, outlines planned measures (guidance for managers, a protocol update, a model for an integrated anti-discrimination approach, external confidential advisers) and gives a partial answer that defers several points to later.
I expect the relevant departments to get this in order as soon as possible, and I will make sure that this happens.
Ik ga ervan uit dat de betreffende departementen dit zo spoedig mogelijk op orde maken en ik zal mij ervan vergewissen dat dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Israël saboteert stelselmatig Nederlandse ontwikkelingsprojecten voor Palestijnen'

An MP asked the minister whether Israeli forces and settlers have repeatedly destroyed Dutch-funded development projects in the West Bank, what compensation was sought, and what further action is planned. The minister confirmed incidents such as the Wadi al-Seeq raid and stated that damage is raised with Israeli authorities, pursued for compensation under the Knops motion, and that no compensation has yet been paid, while declining to provide a full incident list.
It is therefore not possible to share an overview of all incidents of the past ten years.
Het is dus niet mogelijk om een overzicht van alle voorvallen van de afgelopen tien jaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Staatssecretaris Jansen en de veiligheid op de werkvloer op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MP Bamenga asks ministers about a letter from 175 civil servants at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management protesting Staatssecretaris Jansen's remarks about Moroccans, the reported sick leave of advisers, and how ministers will restore a safe working climate and address institutional racism in the civil service. The government answers that it takes the concerns seriously, that talks with staff are ongoing, that a broader integrated anti-discrimination approach and reporting model are planned, and declines to give individual personnel details.
We do not comment on internal individual personnel matters.
Over interne individuele personele aangelegenheden doen wij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Bamenga over de plannen voor (intensievere) controles aan de landsgrenzen

An MP asked the ministers about intensified border controls, whether checks occur without individual suspicion, what safeguards prevent ethnic profiling, and related use of number plates and sensors. The government answered that the Marechaussee is bound by non-discrimination rules, no longer uses ethnicity in selection, complaints go to the KMar, Inspectie JenV and the Nationale ombudsman, and that controls are risk- and information-driven rather than random.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security supervises the conduct of the KMar.
De Inspectie van Justitie en Veiligheid houdt toezicht op het handelen van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bamenga over het bericht dat een van de Regionale Informatie en Expertisecentra (RIEC) jarenlang persoonsgegevens over nationaliteit en land van herkomst verzamelde

MPs Van Nispen and Bamenga asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a RIEC recorded nationality and country of origin for years, including a 2016 draft analysis with discriminatory wording about Turkish Dutch people and neighbourhoods labelled as enforcement bottlenecks. The minister distanced the government from the wording, stated that nationality is not a signal for RIEC cases, that the practice was dropped in 2022, and declined to commission statistical research or ask the Data Protection Authority to investigate.

Are you willing to conduct statistical research into indications that people with a non-Dutch background or lower socio-economic class have been investigated by the RIEC far more often than people with a Dutch background or higher socio-economic class? If not, why not?

Bent u bereid statistisch onderzoek te doen naar aanwijzingen dat personen met een niet-Nederlandse achtergrond of een lagere sociaal-economische klasse veel vaker zijn onderzocht door het RIEC dan mensen met een Nederlandse achtergrond of een hogere sociaal-economische klasse? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Nieuwe Eurocity direct naar Brussel voor veel mensen te duur'

An MP asked the State Secretary why the new Eurocity Direct fare to Brussels is far higher than a comparable domestic trip, how this fits a motion asking for domestic-like treatment, why border crossings carry extra cost, and why OV-chipkaart check-in posts and some discount subscriptions do not extend across the Belgian border. The State Secretary answered that international operating costs justify the higher fare, that cross-border tariffs fall outside the concession, that check-in posts depend on bilateral agreements and technical complexity, and that the Eurocity Direct discounts end at Rotterdam Centraal.
However, the pricing of international train journeys falls outside the scope of the new concession (2025–2033).
De tarifering van internationale treinreizen valt echter buiten de reikwijdte van de nieuwe concessie (2025–2033).
Antwoord op van de leden Kostić, Van Kent, Gabriëls en Bamenga over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

MPs asked whether LD steel slag is a waste or a by-product usable as building material, citing a critical report from Stichting Natuurlijk Schoon Eerbeek, and asked about contamination risks, enforcement, financial incentives and possible suspension of use. The Minister rejected the report's conclusions, stated that the 2017 legal opinion is not a generic ruling, said use is permissible within regulatory frameworks, and announced a planned nationwide information obligation and review of soil regulation, while declining to suspend use or detail Tata Steel agreements.
As part of the review of soil regulation, I will examine to what extent it is desirable to tighten the regulations further.
In het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving zal ik bezien in hoeverre het wenselijk is de regelgeving nog verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over nieuwkomer dierenartsen

MPs Podt and Bamenga asked about the NVWA's onboarding team for refugee veterinarians, recognition of foreign veterinary diplomas, remediation pathways, language training and similar programmes. The government confirmed the team contributes to NVWA staffing shortages, explained the recognition process and the legal limits on restricted veterinary licences, and described existing language subsidies and cooperation efforts, but did not commit to new funding or a specific new initiative.
The committee debate is no longer scheduled for 6 November.
Het Commissiedebat is niet langer gepland op 6 november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over maatregelen die contraproductief werken voor het oplossen van de klimaatcrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CO2 impact of opening Lelystad Airport to commercial flights and of possibly reversing zero-emission zones, including whether the climate minister was consulted and what the timeline is. The government said the decision is still pending in 2025, that an updated environmental impact report will assess CO2 emissions and be submitted to parliament, and that the zero-emission zone reduction was estimated at 1 Mton CO2 per year from 2030.

Once there is clarity on a definitive planning of these products, the House will be informed about the decision-making steps. The role of parliament is (also) safeguarded through the pre-submission procedure.
Zodra er zicht is op een definitieve planning van deze producten wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de besluitvormingsstappen. De rol van het parlement is (ook) via de voorhangprocedure geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over «Ongewenst en onacceptabel, maar we hebben geen keus, provincie woedend over treinloze maanden in 2029»

An MP asked the state secretary about the consequences of choosing the Zeeuwse Lijn as the ERTMS test section, which would mean about 3-4 months without passenger trains and later unreliability, and whether the decision was coordinated with Zeeland authorities. The state secretary answered that the choice was made after an analysis of candidate sections, that Zeeland's province agreed to a package of mitigation measures including replacement bus services, and that exact timing is not yet known.
The test section will be further developed over the coming years, in preparation for the period of track closure, together with other stakeholders in the region.
Het proefbaanvak zal de komende jaren – in voorbereiding op de periode van buitendienststelling- samen met andere belanghebbende partijen in de regio verder uitgewerkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Chinese luchtvaartmaatschappijen stunten met goedkope vliegtickets op de Europese markt omdat zij over Rusland kunnen blijven vliegen.’

D66 MPs asked whether Chinese and other non-EU airlines flying over Russia gain cost advantages over EU carriers, whether this poses a safety risk, and whether the government will restrict such overflights or seek EU or ICAO action. The minister confirmed these airlines use Russian airspace and an unfair advantage is possible, but said EU law does not allow banning them, that non-discriminatory charges are barred under the Chicago Convention, and that ICAO cannot impose such sanctions.
However, it turns out that it is legally not possible to prohibit airlines from countries that may still operate via Russian airspace from conducting flights to and from the European Union (EU).

Het blijkt echter juridisch niet mogelijk om luchtvaartmaatschappijen uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren te verbieden om vluchten van en naar de Europese Unie (EU) uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht ''Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is''

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government's climate policy suffices to meet the 2030 targets in mobility, and about the emission effects of the lower fuel excise, higher motorway speed, delayed zero-emission zones and road pricing. The State Secretary answered that the effects can only be assessed in the Klimaat- en Energieverkenning due 24 October, that additional policy will be considered in spring 2025 if needed, and that the fuel excise cut is not newly analysed.
From this it will become clear whether additional policy is needed to achieve the climate targets for mobility.
Hieruit zal blijken of aanvullend beleid nodig is om de klimaatdoelstellingen voor mobiliteit te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de zorgwekkende humanitaire situatie in Zuid-Soedan

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked about the humanitarian crisis in South Sudan, donor conferences, resettlement of Sudanese refugees and Dutch contributions to peace efforts and budget cuts. The minister answered that Netherlands is a major humanitarian donor, that a separate donor conference is unlikely to yield substantial extra funds, that resettlement resumes under country-based policy, and that budget effects were already reported in the draft budget.
You were informed about the effects of the cuts from the Coalition Agreement in 2025 in the draft budget 2025.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 bent u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Het RIVM-onderzoek ter onderbouwing van het Europese PFAS restrictievoorstel en het bericht: Advies aangescherpt: speel niet in zeeschuim, maar strandganger weet van niets

An MP asks the ministers about the RIVM study underpinning the EU PFAS restriction proposal, whether municipalities and environmental services have legal grounds to curb PFAS emissions, revision obligations, the precedent of court rulings, and the late and narrow public advice on PFAS in sea foam. The government answers that the RIVM report is a building block for permit decisions, that existing duties of care and permit revision apply, that a guidance document is coming in autumn, and that the advice is unchanged with clarifications added on the website and app.

However, this report can be used as a building block to substantiate individual decisions on tightening permits or imposing tailor-made requirements to ultimately bring PFAS (and much of F-gas) emissions down to zero.

Wel kan dit rapport als bouwsteen worden gebruikt voor de onderbouwing van individuele besluiten over het aanscherpen van vergunningen of het opleggen van maatwerkvoorschriften om emissies van PFAS (en een groot deel van de F-gassen) uiteindelijk naar nul terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga  over de faillissementen in de plastic recyclingindustrie

MP Bamenga asked about plastic recycling bankruptcies, rising plastic incineration, CO2 effects, job losses, the EU plastic levy, the circular economy law, and support measures for recyclers. The government attributes the downturn to low virgin plastic prices and expects a temporary dip, pointing to planned EU and national measures, a 267 million euro subsidy package, and anti-dumping tools, while declining to provide job-loss figures and saying the data on incineration trends are unreliable.
The cabinet does not have this information.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over de verontreiniging met PFAS op Vliegbasis Gilze-Rijen en elf andere defensieterreinen

MPs Van der Werf and Bamenga asked ministers about severe PFAS contamination at Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites, including whether soil norms are exceeded, why 2019-2020 measurements were not published earlier, what remediation and prevention steps are planned, and whether health risks exist. The government answers that the contamination is known to the competent authority, that a risk-based remediation plan was approved in 2024, that no health risks have been identified so far, and that the Chamber will be kept informed periodically.
Yes, the reporting by Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is known.
Ja, de berichtgeving van Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de procedure van Nederland en Australië tegen Rusland bij ICAO ten gevolge van de aanslag op vlucht MH17

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked whether Russia's withdrawal from the ICAO proceedings over MH17 is sabotage, what steps the government will take, whether Russia's voting rights should be suspended, and whether the issue will be raised at the current ICAO Council meeting. The government regrets Russia's withdrawal, says the Netherlands and Australia will pursue the case and asked the Council to decide in their favour, and states that suspending voting rights requires a finding of a Chicago Convention violation, which the withdrawal alone is not, though the claim already requested such suspension.
The Netherlands and Australia are determined to pursue the proceedings in order to achieve truth-finding, justice and accountability.
Nederland en Australië zijn vastbesloten de procedure door te zetten, om waarheidsvinding, gerechtigheid en rekenschap te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de toeslag op de hogesnelheidslijn (hierna: HSL) na de nieuwe, tijdelijke snelheidsverlagingen op de HSL

An MP asks why travellers still pay a supplementary fee on the high-speed line (HSL) Intercity Direct when trains now run at reduced speed, and whether the fee should be scrapped and refunded. The state secretary defends keeping the fee to spread passengers and avoid crowding, declines to re-open talks with NS, and reports the estimated financial effects of abolishing it as previously promised.
Even with this new, temporary speed reduction, the travel time between Schiphol and Rotterdam over the HSL remains shorter (about 20 minutes) than via the conventional railway.
Ook met deze nieuwe, tijdelijke snelheidsverlaging blijft de reistijd tussen Schiphol en Rotterdam over de HSL korter (ongeveer 20 minuten) dan via het conventionele spoor.
Antwoord op van het lid Bamenga over ‘grote lasten onder dwangsom voor drankenproducenten als gevolg van niet behalen statiegeld doelstellingen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about five penalty orders (lasten onder dwangsom) imposed by the ILT on Verpact for missing deposit-return collection targets, the size of uncollected deposit funds, and related measures such as more return points, transparency on fund use, and possible inclusion of retailers. The State Secretary largely defended the independent enforcement process, confirmed the 2023 target was missed (74% against 90%), promised to press Verpact on return points and transparency, and committed to evaluating the deposit system this year, including linking return obligations to retail sales.

Given the ILT's independent position as supervisor and the ongoing enforcement procedure, a response to the penalty orders, or a judgement on Verpact's conduct in reaction to them, is not appropriate.

Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van de ILT als toezichthouder en het nu lopende handhavingstraject ligt een reactie op de lasten enerzijds, of een oordeel over het handelen in reactie daarop door Verpact anderzijds, niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over het bericht Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels

Two D66 MPs asked the nitrogen minister whether Schiphol's permit, built on buying out farms, breached additionality rules and PAS case law, and whether it could be revised before court rulings. The minister says she applied the same additionality test as for other external netting and that the permit is under appeal, so she cannot comment on substance.
Given the ongoing appeal procedure, I cannot make substantive statements on this.
Gelet op de lopende beroepsprocedure kan ik hierover geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Duitsland verhoogt vliegtaks: nu 70 euro belasting op verre vlucht'

MP Bamenga asked the government about Germany's distance-based aviation tax increase and whether the Netherlands should differentiate its flat flight tax by distance and include transfer passengers, as well as the effects on emissions, noise and state revenue. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch tax is kept flat for simplicity, that further changes are for a new cabinet, and that the government will not act on the alternatives in the February report.
The caretaker cabinet therefore did not follow up on the report.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft zodoende geen vervolg gegeven aan het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de humanitaire crisis in Oost-Congo

Two MPs (Boswijk, CDA, and Bamenga, D66) asked the minister about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, including the Rwandan role, aid, protection in displacement camps, diplomacy, and the EU Great Lakes envoy. The minister answered that the situation is very serious, outlined Dutch humanitarian funding, diplomatic efforts with Rwanda, DRC and the AU, and said the EU envoy appointment is near completion so no agenda item is needed at the Foreign Affairs Council.
In view of these developments, I do not consider it necessary for the Netherlands to put this on the agenda of the next Foreign Affairs Council.
Gezien de voorgenoemde ontwikkelingen acht ik het niet nodig dat Nederland dit tijdens de eerstvolgende Raad Buitenlandse Zaken agendeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Etnische zuiveringen in Darfur en mogelijk zelfs genocide, stelt Human Rights Watch'

MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the government about Human Rights Watch's findings of possible ethnic cleansing and genocide in West Darfur, including sanctions, ICC cooperation, fact-finding access, humanitarian access and resettlement. The minister responded that the government is very concerned, is working with the EU on expanded sanctions, supports the ICC and the FFM, and explains the current asylum moratorium that blocks resettlement of Sudanese refugees.
The cabinet is very concerned about the situation in Darfur.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over de situatie in Darfur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga en Stoffer over toegenomen Nederlandse importen uit de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MPs Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga and Stoffer asked whether Dutch imports from Xinjiang rose, whether Oeigoeren forced labour is increasing, and how businesses, consumers and the EU forced-labour regulation and CSDDD address this. The minister could not verify the trade figures, said the government cannot confirm the Zenz findings, expects companies to apply OECD and UN guidance, and said enforcement of the forced-labour regulation will apply from around autumn 2027.
However, the government has no independent information position on the situation on the ground and therefore cannot confirm the specific conclusions of this research.
Het kabinet heeft echter geen eigenstandige informatiepositie over de situatie ter plaatse en kan de specifieke conclusies van dit onderzoek dus niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en De Hoop over het bericht dat vijf jaar na ramp met MSC Zoe duidelijk wordt waar de troep ligt

MPs Bamenga and De Hoop asked why the Master Target List of the MSC Zoe wreck debris was withheld for years, whether the shipping company was asked to publish it, and whether the remaining cargo will be recovered. The minister answered that the operation is closed, MSC cannot be forced to salvage more, the list was made public in December 2023 after an open-government request, and remaining objects are largely not MSC Zoe cargo.
MSC refused to make the Master Target List available to anyone other than Rijkswaterstaat, and gave no reasons for doing so.
MSC weigerde de Master Target List ter beschikking te stellen aan anderen dan Rijkswaterstaat. MSC heeft daarvoor geen redenen aangevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga en Piri over het bericht ‘UNRWA Chief Tells Haaretz: We Take Israel's Claims of Hamas Infiltration Seriously, but Yet to See Evidence Against Gaza ‘Employees’

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga and Piri asked the Dutch ministers about UNRWA staff allegedly involved in the 7 October attacks, whether Israel had shared evidence, and whether Dutch aid to UNRWA should be resumed during the investigation. The minister replied that the UN OIOS is investigating, that Israel has shared public information without it being independently verified, and that donors will decide individually on resuming funding while referring to a letter of 26 April 2024.
The cabinet and other donors therefore call on all parties to fully cooperate with the investigation.
Het kabinet en andere donoren roepen alle partijen daarom op tot volledige medewerking aan het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht Nieuwe sof voor treinreizigers: Nederland verliest directe spoorverbinding met Zwitserland

Bamenga (D66) asked the state secretary about the loss of the direct Amsterdam-Basel train, including its climate impact, whether NS and German and Swiss authorities can keep the link, and what support new international operators will get. The state secretary says international services move to open access from 2025, a new Munich service replaces Basel, the government will facilitate new operators without direct intervention, and exact passenger and emissions figures are not available.
I do not have the exact figures on the number of train passengers, also because this involves commercially sensitive information from various operators in different countries.
Over de exacte cijfers van het aantal treinreizigers beschik ik niet, ook omdat het hier gaat om bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van verschillende vervoerders in verschillende landen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over de berichten 'Vitens: mogelijk geendrinkwateraansluiting bij nieuwe woningen' en 'Al tientallen bedrijven krijgengeen aansluiting op drinkwater'

D66 MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that drinking water shortages may prevent new housing and businesses from getting connections, and whether the crisis affects schools, hospitals and infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said Rijk intervention is not excluded but not preferred, outlined an action programme with provinces, and committed to a national drinking-water saving plan and further information, while giving partly general answers on guarantees and the human-right angle.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over EU and Rwanda sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Sustainable Raw Materials Value Chains

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked the Minister about the EU-Rwanda Memorandum of Understanding on sustainable raw materials, including whether the Commission consulted member states, the scale of Rwanda's resources, and the timing given DRC-Rwanda tensions. The minister answered substantively on the MoU's content and rationale, acknowledged the DRC tensions, and promised a separate letter to the House on the situation in eastern Congo.
I recently committed to sending the House a letter on this matter.
Ik heb recent toegezegd uw Kamer daarover een Kamerbrief te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de anti-lhbti- wetgeving die het parlement in Ghana heeft goedgekeurd

An MP asked the government how it would press Ghana's president not to sign an anti-LGBTI law, whether it would involve civil society, join joint condemnation, support victims, and allocate extra aid funding. The government answered that it has raised its views bilaterally, works with like-minded countries and the Equal Rights Coalition, already supports victims and civil society, and will inventory needs with partners.

As co-chair of the international diplomatic working group within the Equal Rights Coalition, the Netherlands has repeatedly placed developments in Ghana on the agenda and will respond appropriately within this coalition should the law be enacted.

Nederland heeft, als covoorzitter van de internationale diplomatiewerkgroep binnen de Equal Rights Coalition, de ontwikkelingen in Ghana meermaals geagendeerd en zal binnen deze coalitie met een passende reactie komen in het geval dat de wet bekrachtigd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over hinder op het spoor door vergeten werkzaamheden

An MP asked the state secretary about the sudden rail disruption around Schiphol on 8 March 2024 caused by forgotten rust-removal work, and how ProRail handled communication and prevention. The state secretary acknowledged the poor notice to passengers, said ProRail regrets the error and is sharpening its process, but did not commit to a specific guarantee beyond that.
ProRail has informed me that it regrets this and wants to learn from it.
ProRail heeft mij laten weten dat ze dit betreurt en dat ze hiervan wil leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de situatie op station Maarssen over een langdurig defecte lift

MP Bamenga asked the state secretary whether accessible public transport is a right, how often lifts are out of service, whether monitoring covers short outages and tram/bus/metro lifts, and what measures will reduce long-term lift failures. The state secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for maintenance, that NS and ProRail have agreed to provide alternative transport for stranded passengers, that a real-time monitoring system is in test, and that measures against vandalism and water damage are underway.
I remain in discussion with ProRail to take further measures to resolve this problem.
Ik blijf in gesprek met ProRail om verdere maatregelen te treffen om deze problematiek te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over 438 studentenwoningen op Kronenburg

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked why only about 438 student homes will be built at Kronenburg instead of the planned 2,500-plus, and about short-stay and self-contained housing. The minister says 438 is a first phase chosen for noise and safety reasons under the Schiphol flight path, that short-stay units may be added, and that a new plan and an adjustment of the LIB are still needed, with progress reported by mid-2024.
The aim is to inform the House of progress by mid-2024.
Het streven is uw Kamer medio 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bamenga over zakelijke vliegreizen binnen de Rijksoverheid

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Interior about the number of business flights by central government staff since 2018, the necessity test, and whether economy class should be the default. The State Secretary gave yearly figures by class, pointed to CAO rules and a checklist, and said economy is default only for certain categories while business class remains optional for flights of six hours or more.
On employment terms agreed in the CAO Rijk I must reach agreement with the trade unions and cannot change them unilaterally.
Over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken uit de CAO Rijk moet ik overeenstemming bereiken met de vakbonden en deze kan ik dus niet eenzijdig aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht Nieuw plastic is goedkoper dan gerecycled plastic, waardoor fabrieken omvallen: Wil je een circulaire economie, dan moet je deze industrie helpen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether Dutch plastic recycling firms are being squeezed out by cheaper virgin plastic and what the government will do, including a mandatory recycled-content norm, an extra levy on virgin plastic, and stopping plastic waste exports that end up abroad. The government answers that it favours recyclate, will introduce a national circular plastic norm from 2027 and pushes for EU targets, but rejects an earlier national mandate and a virgin plastic levy, and points to the revised waste shipment regulation to tighten export controls.
It is not feasible to bring the norm into effect earlier.
Het is niet haalbaar om de norm eerder te laten ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht dat een trein overvuld met licht ontvlambare vloeistof en niet afgesloten deksels door Amsterdam reed

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a train loaded with flammable liquid and with loose hatch covers left Amsterdam, and why the ILT imposed only a penalty order rather than a fine. The state secretary answered that the ILT blocked the transport, imposed a penalty order, referred the case to the Public Prosecution Service, and that inspections and drone checks continue, with no signal that the ILT cannot fulfil its duties.
Action was taken immediately and enforcement was initiated.
Er is direct opgetreden en overgegaan tot handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de situatie in Soedan naar aanleiding van de oorlog die is uitgebroken in april 2023

MP Bamenga asked the minister about the humanitarian crisis in Sudan, including the funding gap, Dutch engagement, whether extra aid channels such as local NGOs will be explored, and attention to women, girls and vulnerable groups. The minister confirmed the scale of need, said the 2023 plan was 42.8% funded, described Dutch contributions and ongoing diplomacy, but did not commit to new concrete measures and admitted the answers could not be delivered before the budget debate.
Question 6: Will you answer these questions as soon as possible, but in any case before the budget debate on Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation 2024?
Vraag 6 Wilt u deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk, maar in ieder geval voor de begrotingsbehandeling Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking 2024, beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Tjeerd de Groot over de ‘Verzamelbrief bodem en ondergrond’

MPs Bamenga and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the ILT report does not justify a notification or permit requirement for steel slag, why a decision is taking so long, and whether standards for heavy metals and pH should be set quickly. The State Secretary answered that a decision on the best measure will be taken within weeks, that an updated circular on steel slag will be published by end of March, and that the evaluation of the standards framework will be reported in mid-2024.
I want to take a decision within a few weeks on which measure best fits.
Ik wil binnen enkele weken een besluit nemen over welke maatregel het beste past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de brief “Informeren gedoogsituatie zero-emissie bedrijfsvoertuigen van 3.501 tot en met 4.250 kg”

MP Bamenga (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tolerance arrangement letting zero-emission commercial vehicles of 3,501 to 4,250 kg be driven on a category B licence, and why the government changed course from making the exemption permanent, including road safety effects and whether the exemption could be extended to 1 January 2025. The minister answered that no accident data exists yet, that SWOV research will report by April 2024, that the arrangement cannot be legalised under current EU rules, and that the tolerance will end on 1 July 2024 as the Public Prosecution Service has agreed.

To assess the link between the increased mass of these vehicles and the risk of more serious injury to other road users, broader studies of larger groups of vehicles over a longer period will be needed.

Voor het verband tussen toegenomen massa van deze voertuigen en de kans op zwaarder letsel bij andere verkeersdeelnemers zal moeten worden gekeken naar bredere onderzoeken op grotere groepen voertuigen en een langere periode.

m: Motie van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Tielen over startbanen voor jonge mensen die aan hun loopbaan willen beginnen
Asks the government to encourage municipalities, UWV and unions to work with regional employers to open startbanen for young graduates.
requests the government to encourage municipalities, UWV and unions to cooperate with regional employers in labour market regions
verzoekt de regering, om te stimuleren dat gemeenten, UWV en vakbonden met regionale werkgevers in de arbeidsmarktregio's samenwerken
Motie van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts c.s. over coulance bij de betalingstermijnen voor energielasten
Asks the government to talk with energy suppliers about being more lenient on payment deadlines and fines for overdue energy bills.
requests the government to enter into talks with energy suppliers to explore being more lenient on payment deadlines and on fines for overdue payments

verzoekt de regering, in gesprek te gaan met energieleveranciers om te onderzoeken wat er mogelijk is om coulanter om te gaan met de betalingstermijn en het opleggen van boetes achterstallige betalingen
Motie van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan c.s. over inzicht in knelpunten bij de inhuur van zzp'ers
Asks the government to explicitly include insight into practical problems with contractor status rules for freelancers in the goal and evaluation of the pilot of the web module.
requests the government to explicitly include gaining insight into practical problems arising from legislation on hiring freelancers in the goal and evaluation of the pilot

verzoekt de regering, om het verkrijgen van inzicht in knelpunten in de praktijk als gevolg van wetgeving met betrekking tot de inhuur van zzp'ers expliciet op te nemen in de doelstelling en evaluatie van de pilot
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Renkema c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over middelen voor kinderen in armoede
Amendment moves 2 million euros within the social affairs budget to a subsidy for children in poverty.
to increase the national subsidy for children in poverty once by 2 million euros
de landelijke subsidie voor kinderen in armoede eenmalig te verhogen met € 2 miljoen
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over integreren van klinische arbeidsgeneeskundige zorg in de reguliere oncologische zorg
Asks the government to propose by Q1 2021 how clinical occupational medicine care can become an integral part of regular oncology care and be financed.
requests the government to come up with a proposal by the first quarter of 2021
verzoekt de regering, uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 met een voorstel te komen
Motie van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Tielen over modernisering in wet- en regelgeving om gezond en veilig thuiswerken mogelijk te maken

to examine whether a further development of the candidate explorer is possible

the submitters of this amendment want to organise a single point of contact for employers in the labour market region
willen de indieners van dit amendement één aanspreekpunt in de arbeidsmarktregio organiseren voor werkgevers

requests the government, in consultation with the Tax Authority, to examine how a more equal implementation of the hybrid system can be shaped

Asks the government to make 10 million euro available to UWV to clear its backlog of professional reassessments in 2016.
requests the government to make 10 million euro available to UWV to clear the backlogs

to regularly inform the House about this
de Kamer hierover met regelmaat te informeren

Asks the government to use mobility bonus funds from 2021 specifically for the banenafspraak or quota target group, via employer bonuses or subsidies.
requests the government to deploy the aforementioned financial resources specifically for the banenafspraak target group from that date
