qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst weer in de fout: veel te veel toeslag voor arbeidsmigranten’

Two VVD MPs asked why the Tax Administration keeps granting the child-related budget with the single-parent supplement to migrant workers whose foreign partners are not registered, despite known errors since 2015. The government admits the verification process is complex, lists partial fixes since 2015 and promises proposals this year, but gives no count of affected migrants and no firm date for a structural solution.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht van wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Snoeren en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Wethouder voor twee maanden kost Meerssen bijna drie ton!'

MPs Snoeren and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Interior about a Meerssen alderman whose two-month tenure triggers a large wachtgeld (severance) payment, and whether the costs and BBV provisioning rules create perverse incentives for small municipalities. The minister defended the career principle in the APPA pension law, said the Meerssen case is exceptional, and rejected amending the law.
I am not considering any amendment of the Appa on this point.
Ik overweeg op dit punt geen aanpassing van de Appa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de arbeidsmarkt in Limburg

MPs Tielen and Nijkerken-de Haan asked about support for around 750 VDL Nedcar workers facing dismissal in Limburg, including reemployment, training and regional labour-market coordination. The minister answered that UWV, the regional labour-market partners and staffing agencies are supporting workers, that extra crisis reemployment funds and regional mobility teams are being set up, and that platforms and training schemes are available.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over de regeling terugbetaling van de eigen bijdrage kinderopvang in relatie tot Covid-19, na signalen dat de aangekondigde herzieningsmogelijkheid bij substantiële afwijk

An MP asked whether parents could rely on the April 2020 promise of a revision mechanism for substantial deviations from the childcare hours used, and how it was implemented. The state secretary answered that a revision was automatically granted only to parents who newly applied for childcare allowance for a new child by the new reference date, that 0.6% of decisions were objected to, and that hour-count objections were handled through the normal objection procedure.
For children for whom no childcare allowance had been applied for before the reference date of 6 April 2020, there is a revision scheme.
Voor kinderen waar voor de peildatum van 6 april 2020 nog geen kinderopvangtoeslag voor één of meerdere kinderen was aangevraagd, is er een herzieningsregeling.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Nijkerken-de Haan en Ziengs over het bericht dat het rijbewijs van een gehandicapte chauffeur is ingenomen

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the CBR refused to renew the driving licence of a disabled professional driver who had held one for 31 years, and whether a coulance scheme should exist for such cases. The minister acknowledged the impact, cited the expert assessment and a 2003 CBR policy note requiring two-handed control, rejected a general coulance scheme on road-safety grounds, and said the case was with the CBR without committing to contact it.
A general coulance scheme based on positive past indications is not justified from a road-safety perspective, because past indications do not necessarily say anything about future fitness to drive.

Een algemene coulanceregeling op basis van positieve indicaties uit het verleden is vanuit het oogpunt van de verkeersveiligheid niet verantwoord omdat indicaties uit het verleden niet noodzakelijk iets zeggen over de rijgeschiktheid in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over de verzamelbrief kinderopvang

The MP asks how the July 2020 reimbursement of childcare parental contributions went, what municipalities are doing for parents using municipal childcare schemes, what COVID-19 meant for early-education children, how many parents use formal childcare without childcare allowance, and whether parents not covered by any scheme should be compensated. The State Secretary reports the payout ran to schedule, that municipalities are being funded to refund their parents, that a scheme for the uncovered group is being worked out, and that the government agrees to compensate them.
Yes. See the answer to question 1.
Ja. Zie de beantwoording bij vraag 1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over uitspraken van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie m.b.t. grensarbeid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the implications of recent EU Court of Justice rulings, notably Vester, for cross-border workers' disability benefits and pension/income gaps. The Minister answered that UWV will shorten the WIA waiting period where a Vester-type income gap arises, and will consult Belgian and German authorities on age-related gaps, but gave no figures on how many are affected.
No figures are available on the number of cross-border workers resident in the Netherlands who face one of the aforementioned income gaps.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar betreffende het aantal in Nederland woonachtige grensarbeiders dat geconfronteerd wordt met een van de voormelde inkomenshiaten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Nijkerken-de Haan en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Limburg vreest verlies duizenden banen door luchtvrachttaks'

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the national aviation tax would cost jobs and traffic at Maastricht Aachen Airport and whether further research and consultation with Limburg had taken place. The government answered that no airport-specific analysis was made, that national effects show a small emissions decline and limited job effects, and that the EU-level alternative remains uncertain.
No specific research was conducted into the position of Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Er is geen specifiek onderzoek gedaan naar de positie van Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Gehandicapte mag werkbonus nog steeds niet houden, Kamerleden boos'

Two VVD MPs asked why a disabled worker (Wajong recipient) must hand a 12.5-year service bonus to UWV and whether the Wet LB 1964 could be amended for this group, and whether alternatives will be explored. The State Secretary answered that the bonus counts as wage and is offset against the Wajong benefit, that amending the Wet LB 1964 is not the appropriate instrument, and that a harmonised income rule keeps at least 30 percent of extras while UWV lacks reliable data to exempt them fully.
A one-off payment after at least 12.5 years of service is wage within the meaning of the Wet LB 1964 and therefore falls under the income concept.
Een eenmalige verstrekking bij ten minste 12,5 jaar in dienst is loon in de zin van de Wet LB 1964 en valt daarmee onder het inkomensbegrip
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Cyberaanval Universiteit Maastricht duurt mogelijk tot na de kerstvakantie’

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the cyberattack on Maastricht University, its impact on students, data protection, the ransom payment, and prevention. The minister answered that systems were restored in January, that the university paid the ransom from proceeds of a holding stake and that the government had advised against it, and that the Inspectorate has opened an investigation and further cyber-security measures are planned.
It was the executive board of Maastricht University's own decision to pay the ransom.
Het is de eigen afweging van het college van bestuur van de Universiteit Maastricht geweest om het losgeld te betalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de artikelen ‘Data arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden ontbreken massaal bij UWV’ en ‘UWV-manager Astrid Hendriks legt uit hoe de onlinekaartenbak mislukte’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about press reports that data on candidates with work limitations were missing from UWV's candidate finder, and about the tool's failure, including the completeness of candidate profiles and the Mediatest evaluation. The government acknowledges the tool's value as one channel, says profile completeness is an ongoing challenge shared with municipalities, and points to the broader Breed Offensief and Doe agenda measures without a concrete new step on the tool itself.
The report was enclosed with the answers and thereby shared with the House.
Het rapport is meegezonden als bijlage bij de antwoorden en daarmee gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken–de Haan over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid op de A79 bij Meerssen naar 90 km/u.'

MPs Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked why the speed limit on the A79 near Meerssen was reportedly lowered to 90 km/h, whether this reflected poor road maintenance, and how long it would last. The minister answered that no lasting speed reduction applies; a temporary 90 km/h decision was wrongly taken and will be withdrawn, a slippery-road sign was placed instead, and maintenance is scheduled for a specific night subject to weather.
This decision turns out to be incorrect and will be withdrawn.
Dit besluit blijkt onjuist en zal worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Diploma honderden medewerkers kinderopvang ongeldig door nieuwe cao’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the list of diplomas giving access to childcare jobs, produced in collaboration with social partners in the collective labour agreement, was consistent with the quality requirements of the Innovation and Quality Childcare Act and whether it should be revisited amid staff shortages. The State Secretary replied that the diploma list is a matter for social partners under the CAO, that the IKK agreement contains no diploma rules, and that the ministry will discuss labour shortages with the sector without taking up the diploma list itself.
Addressing bottlenecks around the established list of training programmes is up to the social partners themselves and does not fit the role of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Het oppakken van knelpunten rondom de vastgestelde lijst van opleidingen is daarbij aan de sociale partners zelf en past niet bij de rol van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over het bericht van Innovo dat iemand die eerder aan de pabo is begonnen niet voor een zijinstroomtraject in aanmerking komt

Three VVD MPs asked whether someone who started but did not finish the pabo (primary teacher training) is blocked from the zij-instroom (career-changer) teaching route, and whether the rule should be lifted. The minister answered that eligibility requires a completed higher education degree, that the person may be able to start a shortened part-time programme, and that he does not intend to change the degree requirement.
I do not intend to change the condition that a career-changer must have a higher education diploma, which appears to be the problem in this situation.
Aan de voorwaarde dat een zijinstromer een ho-diploma moet hebben, wat in deze situatie het probleem lijkt, wil ik niet tornen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Nijkerken- de Haan over regeldruk bij volkscultuur en het adviesrapport Vermindering regeldruk bij evenementen in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about red tape on volkscultuur (folk culture) events, citing a Limburg province report on regulatory burdens for organisers. The minister acknowledged the pressure of regulation on folk culture and immaterieel erfgoed communities, and committed to a round table with the Ministry of Interior and the Limburg province to identify bottlenecks and draft an action plan.
I agree with you that folk culture and intangible cultural heritage inspire.
Ik ben met u eens dat volkscultuur en immaterieel erfgoed inspireren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over de berichten ‘Rotterdam loopt teruggeëist bijstandsgeld mis’, ‘Man mag 35.000 euro te veel uitgekeerde bijstand houden’ en ‘Stoïcijnse reacties op CRvB-uitspraak vord

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about news reports that municipalities such as Rotterdam may fail to recover welfare overpayments because of the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that the five-year limitation period was not properly interrupted, and about the possible financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that the limitation rules are the same regardless of fraud, that municipalities are responsible for administering recovery and interruption, that the financial impact is not known nationally, and that she will raise the issue with VNG and Divosa.

It is the explicit authority and (financial) responsibility of the municipal executives and councils to properly carry out the recovery of undue payments and to determine the consequences of the CRvB ruling in their own municipality.

Het is de expliciete bevoegdheid en (financiële) verantwoordelijkheid van de colleges en gemeenteraden om de terugvordering van onverschuldigde betalingen goed uit te voeren en om de gevolgen van de CRvB-uitspraak in de eigen gemeente vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat werklozen uit Amsterdam op gesprek moeten komen

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how she views reports that all 40,000 Amsterdam benefit recipients will be invited to interviews, given that municipalities already have the task and tools under the Participatiewet. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for activation, she makes no judgement on individual municipalities, supports activation through a Perspectief op Werk programme, and commissioned a study of promising municipal approaches due in autumn.
Municipalities are responsible for labour support for people receiving social assistance. I make no statements about individual municipalities.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de arbeidsondersteuning aan mensen met een bijstandsuitkering. Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap, Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Venlo hotspot voor snelwegcrimineel’

MPs asked about rising cargo theft and mobile banditry targeting truck drivers near Venlo, including secure parking, EU action and prosecution of foreign suspects. The minister answered that incidents are falling, cited secure truck parking projects, joint task forces and prosecution measures, and committed to continued talks with the transport sector.
Compared with other European countries, the number of registered reports of transport crime in the Netherlands is relatively higher.
Vergeleken met andere Europese landen is het aantal geregistreerde meldingen van transportcriminaliteit in Nederland relatief hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Aukje de Vries over een bericht op facebook

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary about a Wajong recipient whose 12.5-year work anniversary bonus was deducted from his benefit by UWV. The State Secretary said UWV is independently responsible for individual cases, explained the income-offset rules, and committed to exploring with UWV whether a limited list of bonuses could be exempted, while stating broader exemptions are not currently feasible.
UWV is an independent administrative body with its own responsibility for implementing, among other things, the Wajong. I therefore cannot respond to individual cases.
Het UWV is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan met eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van onder meer de Wajong. Ik kan daarom niet reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Nijkerken-de Haan en Laan-Geselschap over ‘Politie Limburg wil DNA-onderzoeken onderbrengen bij een commercieel forensisch instituut’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a plan by Limburg police and the prosecution to have DNA and digital trace examinations carried out by a commercial institute (TMFI) rather than the NFI, asking about capacity, delays, the expected acceleration, and data protection. The minister replied that the trial is still in its research phase, that such arrangements are already possible via the NFI's One Stop Shop, that effects can only be measured after about three years, and that private partners must meet NFI and GDPR privacy requirements.
It is unclear which traces the article refers to; the article does not distinguish between digital traces and DNA traces.
Het is onduidelijk op welke sporen in het artikel wordt gedoeld, het artikel maakt geen onderscheid tussen digitale sporen en DNA-sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Laan-Geselschap en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Tienduizenden boetes trajectcontrole A2-tunnel bij Maastricht zijn onterecht'

MPs asked whether unclear signage at the A2 tunnel near Maastricht made tens of thousands of average-speed fines invalid after a court ruling, and how affected drivers would be compensated. The minister replied that the signage met the rules, was clarified in late 2017, that the court only set one fine to zero on its facts, and that no collective correction is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that the signage on the A2 meets the requirements for traffic signs. There is therefore no question of wrongly imposed fines.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven dat de bebording op de A2 voldoet aan de eisen inzake verkeerstekens. Er is dan ook geen sprake van onterecht opgelegde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht in De Limburger ‘Fileleed A2 Weert-Eindhoven: snelle maatregelen laten op zich wachten’

MPs Remco Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why quick measures on the congested A2 Weert–Eindhoven route were delayed, including whether the 2017 traffic analysis still holds, what happened to a motion on innovative measures, and why road widening was not pursued. The minister replied that the 2017 picture remains current, listed the measures taken (a travel assistant, filesignalering, a lighting study) and the planned research, and explained that other regional bottlenecks were prioritised over widening, with a no-regret package being implemented.
The SmartwayZ.NL Programme Council has commissioned a feasibility study of additional measures from the 2017 MIRT research, excluding widening.
De Programmaraad SmartwayZ.NL heeft opdracht gegeven de haalbaarheid te onderzoeken van aanvullende maatregelen uit het MIRT onderzoek uit 2017, niet zijnde verbreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Duitsers willen nieuwe universiteit op grens met Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that German politicians want a new cross-border university near Venlo, and whether Dutch universities can access EU funding for European university networks. The minister said the idea was only briefly mentioned in talks with North Rhine-Westphalia, sees no added value in a new cross-border university, and says Dutch institutions may apply to the Erasmus+ European university networks pilot, which the Commission assesses without member-state involvement.

I therefore in principle see no added value within the system for a new cross-border university, but possibly for cross-border cooperation between existing universities and universities of applied sciences.

Ik zie dus in beginsel geen toegevoegde waarde binnen het bestel voor een nieuwe grensoverschrijdende universiteit, maar mogelijk wel voor grensoverschrijdende samenwerking tussen bestaande universiteiten en hogescholen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over berichten uit het land dat belastinginspecteurs amateurmuziekverenigingen en verbonden steunverenigingen aan een belastinginspectie onderwerpen

MPs Lodders and Nijkerken-de Haan asked whether the tax authority has imposed VAT assessments, some retroactive, on supporter associations of amateur music societies, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary confirmed VAT assessments against two supporter associations and seven support foundations, explained the withdrawn VAT approvals for fundraising bodies and the general VAT exemption limits, and stated that the VAT liability follows from law and cannot be waived, though payment arrangements are possible.
The possible VAT liability, however, follows from the law. It cannot be deviated from.
De eventuele verschuldigdheid van btw vloeit echter voort uit de wet. Daar kan niet van worden afgeweken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Aantal mensen in de bijstand daalt verder’ en de Divosa Benchmark Werk & Inkomen jaarrapportage 2017

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that 62% of benefit recipients say they are exempt from job-search duties, versus 10% formally exempted, and about informal exemptions, the role of exemption grounds, and municipal reporting to councils. The State Secretary acknowledged the gap and cited inspection findings on informal exemptions, but declined to intervene in municipal reporting to councils and said informal exemption numbers are not registered.
I cannot and will not step into this.
Ik kan en wil hierin niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Ouders draaien op voor hogere kosten in de kinderopvang» en het rapport «War for talent» ontspruit op de kinderopvang'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that tighter childcare staffing rules (BKR) would require at least 2,500 extra staff, raising costs for parents and risking reduced opening hours. The government answered that the sector has known of the stricter ratio since 2017, that parents are largely compensated through higher childcare allowances and maximum hourly rates, that recruitment and retraining are the sector's own responsibility, and that inspection by municipal GGD bodies will uphold minimum quality standards.
I am monitoring the development of the number of childcare hours offered in day care with the quarterly figures.
De ontwikkeling van het aantal aangeboden opvanguren in de dagopvang houd ik in de gaten met de kwartaalcijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over de voorgenomen sluiting van HOVO in Limburg per 1 mei 2018

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Hogeschool Zuyd's decision to end HOVO (higher education for older people) in Limburg from 1 May 2018, covering its funding, causes, comparisons with other provinces and the government's levers. The minister answered that HOVO is a non-subsidised activity that must be cost-covering, that the decision followed failed attempts to make Limburg's programme self-financing, and that the government has no direct responsibility for non-formal courses, pointing to a forthcoming letter on lifelong learning.
I am not responsible for the course offerings or for ensuring a regionally comprehensive course supply for older people or other target groups.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor het cursorisch aanbod en de zorg voor een regionaal dekkend cursusaanbod voor ouderen of andere doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht “VNO wil UWV-lijsten openbaar"

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the minister and state secretary of Social Affairs about VNO-NCW's call to make UWV and municipal candidate lists public, and about the labour market mismatch. The government answered that it is working through regional matching programmes, data exchange between UWV and municipalities, extra funding for personal services, and a forthcoming follow-up letter, but did not commit to opening the lists.
We share your concern about mismatches on the labour market.
Wij delen uw zorg betreffende mismatches op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kindcentra krijgt 'extra punten' in Den Bosch’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the new admissions policy of a primary school foundation in Den Bosch, which gave extra points to children attending certain childcare centres, was acceptable and whether it creates unfair competition. The minister replied that the policy was adjusted after local debate, that schools may use priority criteria within legal limits, that complaints or court review are available, and that no further action is planned.
In the meantime I have understood that the proposed admissions policy in Den Bosch has been adjusted in response to the local debate.
Ondertussen heb ik begrepen dat het voorgestelde aanmeldbeleid in Den Bosch is aangepast als reactie op het lokale debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over “Aantallen beschut werkplekken per gemeente 2018 en 2019”

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how municipal sheltered-work place allocations for 2018 and 2019 were calculated, why some municipalities receive zero places, and whether the list could be adjusted. The state secretary explained the allocation method, admitted the budget exceeds the place numbers due to a phased schedule, and committed to examine adjusting the list from 2019 so every municipality has at least one place.
I am willing to examine how this can be adjusted from 2019 onwards.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken hoe dit met ingang van 2019 aangepast kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Gemeenten negeren wettelijke taaleis bijstand’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about a report that municipalities ignore the statutory language requirement for welfare recipients, and how this fits with plans to give municipalities a bigger role in integration. The government acknowledged the CBS findings, said municipalities must enforce the law, committed to talks with the VNG, and noted that ultimate sanctions against municipalities are possible.
It is unacceptable if it were to turn out that people who do not speak the language receive a welfare benefit for years and are left alone.
Het is onacceptabel als zou blijken dat mensen die de taal niet spreken jarenlang een bijstandsuitkering ontvangen en met rust gelaten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Nijkerken-de Haan en Bosman over het bericht ‘Voorbereiding op kernramp kan beter’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about an OVV report finding that Dutch nuclear-disaster preparedness is largely on paper and little exercised, and about cooperation, iodine tablet distribution and evacuation planning with Belgium and Germany. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is constructive, that joint exercises are a priority (including a planned exercise with Belgium), that iodine rules were harmonised but differ in practice, and that regional safety boards will be consulted on cross-border risks.
The Dutch Safety Board finds in its report that the approach to a possible nuclear crisis is largely set down on paper but has been exercised only to a limited extent.

De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) stelt in haar rapport vast dat de aanpak van een eventuele nucleaire crisis goeddeels vastligt op papier maar dat de aanpak slechts in beperkte mate is geoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Koopmans over "het artikel ‘gemeente Tilburg mag niet specifiek speuren naar Turkse bijstandfraudeurs’"

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Koopmans asked whether municipalities may screen welfare recipients by country of origin and pursue foreign assets after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling found Tilburg's targeting of Turkish benefit fraudsters discriminatory. The State Secretary answered that selecting on country of origin alone violates the non-discrimination rule, that municipalities should work with the IBF on cross-border fraud, and that he will promote IBF cooperation and guidance for municipalities.

The consequence of the CRvB ruling is that selecting on the basis of country of origin, as the sole factor, is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

De consequentie van de uitspraak van de CRvB is dat selecteren op basis van land van herkomst, als enkele feit, in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Polen blijven weg: tuinbouwsector zit omhoog’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the horticulture sector's shift toward recruiting non-Polish workers and the labour-market reach of unemployed people reflects a growing problem, and what steps would make Dutch jobs attractive. The minister acknowledged the trend, placed primary responsibility for recruitment on employers, and described the government's role as preventing unfair competition and abuse through equal pay rules and anti-schijnconstructie legislation.
In this dossier I see my role mainly in preventing unfair competition and tackling abuses such as underpayment and exploitation.
In dit dossier zie ik mijn rol vooral in het voorkomen van oneerlijke concurrentie en het aanpakken van misstanden zoals onderbetaling en uitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Von Martels, Nijkerken-de Haan en Middendorp over het behoud van het station Valkenburg door de Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary about the ILT's refusal to let the Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij run over the main line to Valkenburg station without machinist licences, and whether the rules are stricter than EU requirements. The State Secretary answered that no regulatory change occurred, the ILT had no legal basis for an exemption, and ZLSM is expected to obtain a new safety certificate by early 2018 with a study into training for its machinists.
The ILT's decision arose from a request by the ZLSM.
Het besluit van de ILT komt voort uit een verzoek van de ZLSM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat mensen in de bijstand in Utrecht niet hoeven te solliciteren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Utrecht may waive the job-search obligation for welfare recipients in an experiment without national approval, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have room to experiment within the Participatiewet, that Utrecht's experiment was postponed pending talks on its unapproved design, and that the government would first raise concerns with the municipality.
Pending a solution to be found, the municipality is postponing the planned start of its experiment on 1 May 2017.
In afwachting van een te vinden oplossing schort de gemeente de beoogde start van haar experiment per 1 mei 2017 op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-de Haan en Visser inzake de Duitse tol

MPs Ten Broeke, Nijkerken-De Haan and Visser asked whether the German Bundesrat's approval of the road toll (vignette) removes obstacles to its introduction, what its effects are for Dutch motorists, transport and border regions, and what the minister will do, including a border-impact assessment. The minister answered that the EU-required changes were adopted, that the infringement procedure continues, that he opposes the toll, will seek clarification from the Commission and Austria, and will carry out a border-effects assessment once the German law is final.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het besluit van de Belgische regering om te investeren in het spoortraject Antwerpen-Weert

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about Belgium's plans to electrify the Antwerp–Weert rail line, its CEF funding application, cost-benefit analysis, Brabant route relief, and a possible 4 million euro national contribution. The state secretary answered that Belgian federal decision-making is pending, no Dutch financing is involved, no cost-benefit analysis is yet available, the existing line has sufficient capacity, and electrification is not a national priority so no infrastructure fund reservation is appropriate.
I therefore conclude that electrification of the route is not a national priority.
Ik constateer daarmee dat elektrificatie van het tracé geen nationale prioriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-De Haan en De Boer over een werkbezoek aan de provincie Limburg d.d. 6 februari 2017

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about commitments on a rail connection and Carhandling Terminal Swentibold in Limburg, including the status of studies, ProRail's cost validation, provincial guarantees and whether national funding would be provided. The state secretary confirmed the agreements, said the connection now costs about EUR 40 million rather than EUR 20 million, and offered up to EUR 10 million in national funding (EUR 5 million each from the ministries) subject to conditions such as public access, job effects, a one-off contribution and a validated business case.
It has been agreed that the definitive cost estimate for the public connection of this rail terminal will be validated by ProRail according to the standard requirements.
Afgesproken is dat de definitieve kostenraming van de openbare aansluiting van deze railterminal door ProRail zal worden getoetst conform de standaard eisen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over de berichten 'Scenario kernramp grote onzin' en 'Vals rampscenario Tihange'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports calling a Vienna IRS study of a nuclear disaster at Tihange 2 nonsense and exaggerated. The minister answered that the national nuclear regulator ANVS found the study unrealistic and of no added value for preparedness, that the German government also questioned it, and that transparent information sharing with the Limburg region is being pursued.
It is good that a public debate is held on a subject as important as nuclear safety.
Het is goed dat over een zo belangrijk onderwerp als nucleaire veiligheid een maatschappelijk debat wordt gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Nijkerken-De Haan over de Duitse tolheffing in grensregio’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch Infrastructure minister about German road tolls affecting border regions, including whether he would act and whether he would go to court with Austria. The minister said he has objected to Germany's plans, that the German plan was amended after his objections, that consultations with Austria and the European Commission are ongoing, and that going to court is not currently an option.
Going to court is therefore not currently an issue.
Een gang naar de rechter is nu dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat slechts 3% van de bijstandsgerechtigden een tegenprestatie levert

A VVD MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities such as Amsterdam are failing to implement the legal tegenprestatie (counter-performance) requirement for welfare recipients, what has been done about it, and the basis for the claim that only 3% perform one. The state secretary confirmed Amsterdam's ordinance does not comply with the Participatiewet, says it asked the alderman to amend it, reports that 17 of 20 non-compliant municipalities are amending their ordinances, and attributes the 3% figure to the Divosa benchmark.
Amsterdam does not implement the tegenprestatie in line with the requirements the Participatiewet sets for it.
Amsterdam voert de tegenprestatie niet uit conform de eisen die de Participatiewet daaraan stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het ongeval bij de stuw bij Grave

MPs of the VVD asked the minister about the causes and consequences of a ship colliding with the Grave weir on the Maas, including damage claims, repair timing, responsibility for coordination, and an evaluation. The minister answered that the cause awaits police findings, damages are unknown and claimable from the ship owner, repairs take at least six months, and an independent evaluation will be delivered by spring 2017.
Pending the results of the police investigation, I cannot make statements about the precise cause of the accident.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek door de politie kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken- de Haan, Van ’t Wout en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Baan via gemeente of UWV? Vergeet het maar!’

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a Trouw report based on an Inspectorate SZW study showing weak cooperation between municipalities and UWV in placing jobseekers, and about knowledge management, the knowledge programme 'Vakkundig aan het werk', and how to raise employer uptake. The government acknowledged the cooperation problems, described existing and planned measures (knowledge programmes, Kandidatenverkenner, Programmaraad activities) and committed to a progress letter before 15 March 2017.
As promised during the Participation Act committee debate of 27 October, your House will be informed by letter before 15 March about progress.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO Participatiewet van 27 oktober jl., zal uw Kamer voor 15 maart per brief geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Van ’t Wout over het bericht "Weinig Nederlanders zoeken een baan over de grens"

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow start of the cross-border job placement plan 'Grenzeloos Werken', the status of a related motion, and UWV's separate Limburg-Germany placement plan. The minister said the plan has not started yet due to difficulty raising private co-financing, that subsidy rules will be adapted to allow more public funding, and that the UWV cross-border work is financed from its regular budget and is distinct from the sectoral plan.
For the specific situation involving employers across the border, I am therefore willing to adjust the scheme and thereby create room for more public financing.
Voor de specifieke situatie waarbij men te maken heeft met werkgevers over de grens ben ik dan ook bereid de regeling aan te passen en daarmee ruimte te creëren voor meer publieke financiering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat ‘kanslozen’ niet hoeven te solliciteren

An MP asks whether municipalities may classify benefit recipients as 'hopeless' on general criteria such as age and benefit duration and exempt them from job-search duties, without individual assessment. The state secretary replies that the Participation Act gives municipalities discretion, requires individual assessment for exemptions, and promises no new concrete action beyond existing instruments and monitoring by municipal councils.
It is therefore expressly for the municipal executive, when imposing obligations and measures, to take account of the individual situation of the benefit recipient.
Het is dan ook uitdrukkelijk aan het college om bij het opleggen van de verplichtingen en maatregelen rekening te houden met de individuele situatie van de bijstandsgerechtigde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat driekwart van de bijstandsgerechtigden in Amsterdam geen sollicitatieplicht heeft

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether Amsterdam's exemptions from the job-seeking obligation for about three-quarters of welfare recipients amount to prohibited categorical exemptions, and what would be done to address the large group left without support. The State Secretary replied that Amsterdam applies individual tailoring via a participation ladder, that about 30% of the long-distance group has temporary exemptions for individual reasons, that supervision of municipal implementation lies primarily with the municipality and the Inspectie SZW will not investigate, and that she will visit municipalities and rely on Divosa for knowledge development.
The primary responsibility for checking the lawful implementation of the Participatiewet lies with the municipality, and the municipal council has a supervisory role in this.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor de controle op de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Participatiewet ligt bij de gemeente en de gemeenteraad heeft daarbij een controlerende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Nijkerken-De Haan over Suwinet

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Nijkerken-De Haan asked whether the government will act against municipalities whose protection of citizens' personal data on the SUWI-net system is inadequate, including fines and escalation. The Secretary of State says the Inspectorate has sent 198 municipalities non-compliance warnings with 6 to 12 week deadlines, that an instruction (aanwijzing) and, as a last resort, disconnection from SUWI-net are possible, and that 192 municipalities now meet all seven essential standards.

Following the Inspectorate SZW investigation started in September 2015 into the security of SUWInet, I have sent the 198 municipalities that do not meet all 7 essential standards a notice of intent to issue an instruction.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van het onderzoek dat de Inspectie SZW in september 2015 is gestart naar de beveiliging van SUWInet de 198 gemeenten die niet voldoen aan alle 7 essentiële normen een aankondiging tot een aanwijzing gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat Amsterdam nee zegt tegen de taaleis in het kader van de bijstand

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether she knows Amsterdam refuses to apply the language requirement for social assistance and offers free vet visits to low-income residents, and asked what action she will take to enforce the statutory language requirement in all municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the Participatiewet is decentralised, that municipal councils and officials are primarily responsible for implementation and supervision, and that she trusts municipalities to apply the law properly, without committing to new measures.
The Participatiewet, of which the language requirement is part, has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De Participatiewet, waarvan de taaleis onderdeel uitmaakt, is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken - De Haan over "het bericht dat Amsterdam de bijstandswet ontduikt"

An MP asks whether Amsterdam circumvents the cost-sharing norm in the new Participatiewet by granting extra special assistance, and whether other municipalities do the same. The State Secretary replies that implementation is a municipal responsibility, that Amsterdam grants special assistance after individual case review, that no national data exist on similar practices, and that she has asked the VNG for implementation signals.
Implementation of the Participatiewet is a competence and responsibility of the municipal executive (college van burgemeester en wethouders).
De uitvoering van de Participatiewet is een bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Anne Mulder over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan gratis geld uitdelen’

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Mulder asked whether municipal plans to hand out unconditional money, reported in the press, fit the experiment clause (art. 83) of the Participation Act and whether gemeenten know the rules on part-time and temporary work. The state secretary said no concrete proposals had been received, that details must be assessed first, and that an experiment would need an AMvB with parliamentary pre-consultation, while promising to inform municipalities again after a bill passes.
An experiment deviating from the statutory framework of the Participation Act can take place only if it is regulated by an AMvB under article 83(2).
Een eventueel experiment waarin wordt afgeweken van de wettelijke kaders van de Participatiewet kan plaatsvinden indien dit bij AMvB op grond van artikel 83 2 wordt geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht “Fraude loont”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that welfare fraud goes unpunished, including inconsistent enforcement by municipalities, the criminal reporting threshold, the recovery rate of fraud fines, and a Rotterdam court ruling on information duties for suspects. The minister acknowledged the concern, said municipalities must apply the law and that he will keep raising enforcement with the VNG and municipalities, and gave partial answers, noting that national data on recovery and benefit termination are not available.
The cabinet does not have a national picture.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk beeld.

m: Amendement van het lid Van der Ree over een lid uit de beroepspraktijk in de examencommissie
Requires that at least one member of the examination committee come from professional practice in higher education programmes.
At least one member of the examination committee comes from professional practice
Ten minste één lid van de examencommissie is afkomstig uit de beroepspraktijk
Amendement van de leden Van der Ree en Rog ter vervanging van nr. 21 over gelijke voorwaarden tussen publiek en privaat

Amendment limiting the minister's power to grant provisional recognition to private education: it may be used only when the inspectorate sees concrete reason on quality grounds, based on a warning for another course of the same institution.
For that reason the Minister may use this power only if the inspectorate concretely sees reason to do so from a quality-monitoring perspective.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ree over het artikel ‘Diploma’s zonder examens’ uit het Dagblad van het Noorden

MP Van der Ree asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report that students at Alfa-College in Groningen received diplomas without completing all exams, and about unrest at one location. The Minister answered that no diplomas were wrongly issued, that the Inspectorate is investigating and monitoring the institution, and that the problems appear to be an incident rather than structural, with a bill on exam committees submitted.
On 14 November 2016 the Inspectorate visited the location and discussed the current situation with the Executive Board.
Op 14 november 2016 heeft de inspectie de locatie bezocht en met het College van Bestuur de actuele situatie besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ree inzake De impact van automatisering op het Nederlandse onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report on the impact of automation on Dutch education, including whether study programmes should be assessed for labour-market efficiency and what will be done about students choosing programmes with poor job prospects. The minister agreed technological change will reshape jobs, pointed to existing vocational and higher-education measures (macrodoelmatigheid policy, study-choice information, career guidance), but gave no new commitments beyond planned letters.
The ten-point plan "attack on dropout" was responded to in the earlier-mentioned letter on career guidance dated 26 September.
Op het tienpuntenplan «aanval op uitval» is met de eerder genoemde Kamerbrief Loopbaanoriëntatie en -begeleiding van 26 september jl. gereageerd.

noting that this year again an enormous sum, namely 534 million, earmarked for development cooperation is spent on first-year asylum reception in the Netherlands
constaterende dat dit jaar wederom een enorm bedrag, te weten 534 miljoen, aan geld bestemd voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking wordt uitgegeven aan eerstejaarsasielopvang in Nederland

Asks the government to give the external investigation commission on sexual intimidation in the armed forces enough resources and powers to examine practice within operational units.

verzoekt de regering de commissie die dit onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek gaat doen, voldoende middelen en mogelijkheden te geven om ook de praktijk mede bij de operationele eenheden te onderzoeken

also to be extra alert to signals that could point to a culture of fear within Defence
ook extra alert te zijn op de signalen die op een angstcultuur zouden kunnen wijzen binnen Defensie
Motie van het lid Popken c.s. over psychologische hulp voor de slachtoffers van de incidenten in Schaarsbergen
Asks the government to offer psychological help and personal support to victims of the Schaarsbergen incidents for as long as they need it.
requests the government to offer the victims of the Schaarsbergen incidents psychological help and personal guidance
verzoekt de regering, de slachtoffers van de incidenten in Schaarsbergen psychologische hulp en persoonlijke begeleiding aan te bieden
Motie van het lid Ploumen c.s. over een expliciet verbod op ontgroeningen binnen de Defensieorganisatie

requests the government to establish an explicit ban on hazing within the Defence organisation
verzoekt de regering tot het instellen van een expliciet verbod op ontgroeningen binnen de Defensieorganisatie

Asks the government to make negotiations on tax treaties more transparent and to consult stakeholders on draft treaty texts, so parliament can influence them.
requests the government to make negotiations on tax treaties more transparent from now on and to consult stakeholders in the interim

requests the government to use the UN model treaty as the lower limit in negotiations with developing countries
verzoekt de regering om, bij onderhandelingen met ontwikkelingslanden het VN-modelverdrag als ondergrens te hanteren
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over in volgende jaarverslagen ook duidelijk aangeven wat niet goed ging

requests the government, in future annual reports, to also clearly state what did not go well

requests the government, together with the SER, to explore how to arrive at an instrument to make visible the progress, results or conclusions of the agreements
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de SER te onderzoeken hoe tot een instrument te komen op basis waarvan de voortgang, resultaten of conclusies van de convenanten zichtbaar gemaakt kunnen worden

Asks the government to examine whether SDG monitoring can use criteria that track the effect of development policy on marginalised groups such as persons with disabilities and children in social need.
requests the government to examine whether additional criteria can be set up within SDG monitoring
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of binnen de SDG-monitoring nadere criteria ingericht kunnen worden

Asks the government to tighten security at defence sites so that persons linked or suspected of terrorism cannot gain access, within legal limits.
increase security at TBB-4 military sites regarding persons who may be linked to terrorist activities or suspected of them
de beveiliging van TBB-4-locaties van militaire terreinen ten aanzien van personen die gelieerd kunnen worden aan terroristische activiteiten of daarvan verdacht worden te verhogen
Motie Diks een inventarisatie van de Nederlandse ambities op veiligheidsgebied
Asks the government to draw up and submit to the Chamber an inventory of Dutch security ambitions before the final Project Verkenningen report on long-term defence spending.
requests the government to first make an inventory of Dutch security ambitions before the final report of Project Verkenningen, submit it to the Chamber and take it into account

verzoekt de regering om voorafgaand aan het eindrapport van het Project Verkenningen eerst een inventarisatie van de Nederlandse ambities op veiligheidsgebied te maken, deze aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie Eijsink c.s. over rapportage over de voortgang van het SPEER-project
Asks the government to report to the Chamber on progress of the SPEER IT project, including concrete time, money and result limits, with the first supplementary budget.
requests the government to submit to the Chamber a progress report on the SPEER project no later than the first supplementary budget for 2009
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk bij de aanbieding van de eerste suppletoire begroting over 2009 de Kamer een rapportage aan te bieden over de voortgang van het SPEER-project

Asks the government to investigate a central, independent complaints commission for veterans and their families and include it in the Kaderwet Veteranen.
requests the government to examine the desirability of a central, independent and expert complaints commission for veterans
verzoekt de regering de wenselijkheid van een centrale, onafhankelijke en deskundige klachtencommissie voor veteranen

Asks the government to draw up coherence criteria for development policy, test new trade, agriculture, financial and environmental policy against them, and inform the House explicitly per policy proposal of the results.
to inform the House explicitly and per policy proposal about the results of this test
de Kamer expliciet en per beleidsvoornemen te informeren over de resultaten van deze toets

Asks the government to take initiatives with EU partners to support a fair trial for terrorism suspects if the United States does not provide one.
requests the government, if the United States fails to provide a fair trial for terrorism suspects or release them, to develop initiatives with EU partners.

verzoekt de regering indien de Verenigde Staten nalaten, een eerlijke procesgang voor verdachten van terrorisme uit te voeren of hen in vrijheid te stellen, hierover samen met partners binnen de EU initiatieven op te stellen
Motie Diks c.s. over een vrouwenparagraaf in de "stand van zaken"-brief
Asks the government to add a women's rights paragraph to country 'state of affairs' letters where relevant.
requests the government to add a women's paragraph to each country state-of-affairs letter where relevant
verzoekt de regering om, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, in elke «stand van zaken»-brief over een land een vrouwenparagraaf toe te voegen
