Asks the government to allocate an extra 25 million euro for climate adaptation in the spring memorandum 2009.
requests the government to allocate 25 million extra non-ODA and non-environment funds for climate adaptation in the Spring Memorandum 2009
verzoekt de regering bij de Voorjaarsnota 2009 25 mln. extra non-ODA en non-milieumiddelen voor klimaatadaptatie uit te trekken
Motie Van Baalen c.s. over de erkenning van het lot van troostmeisjes door Japan
Motion asks the government to keep recognition of the comfort women issue in Japan relations and to press Japan for an additional gesture, raising it during visits.
requests the government, in line with the letter, to raise recognition of the comfort women and pressing Japan for an additional gesture with the Japanese government, including during future visits

verzoekt de regering overeenkomstig het gestelde in de bovengenoemde brief, de erkenning van het lot van de troostmeisjes en het aandringen op een aanvullend gebaar van Japan in de richting van hen, ook bij voorkomende bezoeken onder de aandacht van de Japanse regering te brengen
Motie Diks c.s. over uitbreiding van de civiele staf in Afghanistan met een genderspecialist
Asks the government to add a gender specialist to the civilian staff of the Afghanistan mission.
requests the government to expand the civilian staff of the Afghanistan mission with a gender specialist
verzoekt de regering de civiele staf van de missie in Afghanistan uit te breiden met een genderspecialist
Motie Voordewind c.s. over het aan de orde stellen van eerbiediging van de mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top
Asks the government to press China on human rights such as press freedom, housing compensation and labour rights at the EU-China summit.
requests the government to vigorously raise respect for the aforementioned human rights during the EU-China summit
verzoekt de regering om de eerbiediging van bovengenoemde mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top sterk aan de orde te stellen
Motie Pechtold en Diks over sluiting van Guantánamo Bay
Asks the government to push for a UN resolution on closing Guantanamo Bay if its closure has not started within three months of the new US president taking office.
in cooperation with the European Union to advocate for a UN resolution on closing Guantanamo Bay
in samenwerking met de Europese Unie te pleiten voor een VN-resolutie inzake sluiting van Guantánamo Bay
Motie Diks over een verhoogd beveiligingsniveau voor de categorieën 1 en 2 op militaire bases
Asks the government to keep a raised security level for categories 1 and 2 at military bases until security rules are properly complied with.
requests the government to maintain a raised security level for categories 1 and 2 at military bases
verzoekt de regering een verhoogd beveiligingsniveau voor de categorieën 1 en 2 op militaire bases te handhaven
Motie Pechtold c.s. over wegnemen van de onrust bij de Krijgsmacht
Asks the government to quickly remove unrest in the armed forces caused by the defence minister's statements.
requests the government to remove this unrest in the short term
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn deze onrust weg te nemen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de invoer van een lading visolie afkomstig uit West-Sahara

An MP asked the minister whether a tanker's cargo of fish oil from Western Sahara was entered as Moroccan origin, whether NVWA checked it, and whether EU rules and the 2016 Court ruling make such imports unlawful. The minister said customs cannot disclose declarations, NVWA relies on the EU-approved establishment list which includes Western Sahara firms, and the trade extension was legally supported, with a Court case pending.
Customs cannot provide information on the declarations submitted for the cargo on that ship due to its statutory confidentiality obligation under EU customs law.
De Douane kan vanwege haar geheimhoudingsplicht op basis van EU-douanewetgeving geen informatie verstrekken over de aangiften die zijn ingediend voor de lading op het desbetreffende schip
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over modeketens die de kosten van de coronacrisis afwentelen op kledingfabrieken in Azië

MP Diks (GroenLinks) asked whether Dutch fashion chains such as C&A are cancelling orders from Bangladeshi factories during the COVID-19 crisis, leaving workers unpaid, and whether the minister will hold these chains to account. The minister confirmed the practice is widespread, said cancelling placed orders is undesirable, called on companies to act responsibly in their supply chains, and committed only to monitoring responsible purchasing practices and raising the issue with industry groups.
Cancelling orders that have already been placed is undesirable.
Het intrekken van reeds geplaatste orders is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat de VN waarschuwt voor een hongerpandemie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a UN warning of a hunger pandemic, including the WFP projection of extra hungry people, early release of pledged funds, food export risks, the desert locust plague in East Africa, and a request to the advisory council AIV. The Minister answered that the government shares the concern, cites the unearmarked multi-year funding and EUR 36 million paid early, the WTO export-restraint statement, the locust response contribution, and the AIV request already submitted.
The cabinet leaves it to the AIV to give that the place in the advice it deserves.
Het kabinet laat het aan de AIV om dat in het advies de plek te geven die het toekomt.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over schaliegas en plastic

MPs Van der Lee and Diks asked about plastic pellet pollution, shale gas-driven plastic production, bank and insurer investments in shale gas and plastics companies in Argentina, and whether damages can be recovered from polluters. The minister answered that the government shares concern about plastic pollution, points to EU and national initiatives, says it has no oversight of the investments or the claimed harms, leaves responsibility for IMVO due diligence and compensation with companies and financial institutions, and confirms that polluters bear restoration costs under Dutch law.
The cabinet has no insight into the investments of the named banks and insurers in shale gas and plastics companies and therefore cannot confirm the investment figures.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de investeringen van de genoemde banken en verzekeraars in schaliegas- en plasticbedrijven en kan investeringscijfers dan ook niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de voortgang van het project Grensverleggende IT (GrIT)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Defence about the delayed GrIT IT project, the possible damages claim from IBM, operational risks, the single-contractor decision, governance and cost limits. The State Secretary answered that scenarios are being validated and will be shared confidentially, that the chosen scenario will be checked by ADR and a BIT test, and that cost details remain confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
During the tender, Defence makes no statements about commercially confidential information.
Tijdens de aanbesteding doet Defensie geen uitspraken over commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Diks over de over recente berichtgeving omtrent het Marginal da Corimba-project in Angola

MPs Snels and Diks asked about press reports on the Marginal da Corimba project in Angola, including Atradius export credit insurance due diligence, forced evictions, the Dutch embassy's knowledge, trust office supervision and Dutch anti-bribery enforcement. The state secretary answered that the state's involvement in the evictions could not be established, that due diligence did not include commercial pricing, and that the government would evaluate CSR policy and enforcement measures, with some questions referred to later reports.
Based on its own investigation, the Dutch state has not been found to be directly involved, via Atradius DSB, in the alleged human rights violations in June 2013 in Luanda.
Op basis van eigen onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de Nederlandse staat via Atradius DSB rechtstreeks betrokken is bij de vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen in juni 2013 in Luanda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het Emergency Trust Fund for Africa (EUTF)

MP Diks asked the minister about the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa, including whether the 2015 Commission decision declaring crisis situations in many African countries allowed bypassing public tender rules, and about transparency and local ownership. The minister defended the fund as a flexible complement to regular instruments, said crisis is broadly defined and not the sole selection factor, and reported on funding sources, coordination in Nigeria, and transparency reporting, without committing to amend the Commission decision.
The cabinet considers it important that the EU has flexible instruments at its disposal to respond quickly to crises and changing circumstances.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat de EU flexibele instrumenten tot haar beschikking heeft om snel in te kunnen springen op crises en veranderende omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over bestaan van een onderzoek naar Nieuw-Milligen als nieuwe locatie voor een marinierskazerne

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether a study exists on Nieuw-Milligen as a new location for the Marine Corps barracks, whether all completed location studies will be sent to parliament, and what steps will be taken toward affected municipalities. The government refers to its letter of 14 February 2020, enclosing four memos on the selection process, says it regrets the flawed process and will take two voorgenomen besluiten, and says talks with Apeldoorn have been held confidentially.
Enclosed with that letter you will find four memos describing the step-by-step selection using the assessment framework.
Bijgesloten bij die brief vindt u een viertal nota’s die de stapsgewijze selectie aan de hand van het afwegingskader beschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geheime diensten morren over nieuwe toezichthouder’

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the intelligence services are unhappy with the Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB), which authorises their special powers, over alleged assertive, detailed review and disputes about its scope and appeal rights. The minister acknowledges some disagreement on the scope of the TIB's legality review, says it is not a marginal review, and defers any change such as an appeal option to the evaluation of the Wiv 2017 starting in 2020.
As confirmed during the parliamentary treatment of the Wiv 2017, the TIB's review is not a marginal review.
Zoals tijdens de parlementaire behandeling van de Wiv 2017 is bevestigd, is de toets van de TIB géén marginale toets.
Antwoord op het lid vragen van  het lid Diks over de Nederlandse soja-import uit Zuid-Amerika

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch soy imports from South America linked to deforestation in the Cerrado and Amazon, and whether RTRS standards and EU forest legislation should be required. The minister answered that all soy used in Dutch animal products is RTRS-certified, that Dutch-only measures are insufficient, and that the government will push the European Commission to examine ways to make supply chains deforestation-free.
The Netherlands is therefore working towards EU policy to increase market demand for certified sustainable and deforestation-free products within the Union and beyond.
Nederland spant zich daarom in om te komen tot EU-beleid om de marktvraag naar gecertificeerd duurzame en ontbossingsvrije producten binnen de Unie en daarbuiten te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Diks, Bouali en Van de Hul over de moord op de Braziliaanse activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara

Four MPs asked the government about the murder of Brazilian indigenous activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara, whether Brazil's environment and indigenous rights are deteriorating under Bolsonaro, and what concrete action the Netherlands will take. The government said illegal loggers likely were involved but could not confirm it, said violence against indigenous people appears to have grown, and outlined diplomatic dialogue, EU-Mercosur review and support for rights defenders without committing to a new concrete measure.
It seems very likely that illegally operating loggers were involved in his death, although we cannot confirm that.
Het lijkt zeer waarschijnlijk dat illegaal opererende houthakkers betrokken waren bij zijn dood, hoewel wij dat niet kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat de minister van Defensie niet aanwezig was bij de bijeenkomst van NAVO-ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken op 20 november 2019

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked why the Defence Minister did not attend the NATO foreign ministers' meeting on 20 November 2019, as reported by Trouw. The government answered that the Defence Minister stayed in The Hague to prepare for a possible parliamentary debate on transparency about civilian casualties, and that Netherlands' permanent NATO representative attended instead.

Yes, the Minister of Defence took into account a possible wish of your House to hold a debate in the short term on transparency about civilian casualties, and therefore decided not to travel to Brussels.

Ja, de Minister van Defensie hield rekening met een mogelijke wens van uw Kamer om op korte termijn een debat te voeren over de transparantie over burgerslachtoffers en heeft daarom besloten om niet naar Brussel af te reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de aanwezigheid van informatie op ministeries over de burgerdoden bij het Nederlandse bombardement op Hawija

MP Diks asked ministers whether ministries had been informed about the outcome of the CENTCOM investigation into civilian deaths at Hawija and whether the Defence Minister misinformed parliament in 2015. The government answers that ministries received only general, non-numerical information in 2015 meetings, the initial CENTCOM report was not shared with other departments, and the 2015 statements to parliament were found to be incorrect.
The initial CENTCOM report as such was never provided to other departments, in line with standing practice.
Het initiële CENTCOM-rapport als zodanig is nooit verstrekt aan andere departementen, conform staande praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van den Hul over misstanden bij projecten mede gefinancierd door FMO

MPs Diks and Van den Hul asked the minister about alleged misconduct in FMO-cofinanced projects, including inadequate due diligence on the Feronia land titles, the murder of activist Imbangola Lunea, weak complaint procedures, and unpaid or sub-living wages. The minister answered that FMO's due diligence and policies have been strengthened, that the Feronia land issue was handled by DEG and found acceptable at the time, that the Lunea investigation is complete with findings to follow, and that a new evaluation covering 2013-2018 is expected in Q2 2020.
In the case of serious incidents, the cabinet presses for independent investigation.
In het geval van ernstige incidenten dringt het kabinet aan op onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya , van den Hul, Ouwehand en Diks over de bosbranden in het Amazonewoud en het Mercosur-verdrag

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdA-adjacent PvdD and GroenLinks asked whether the Netherlands would side with France and Ireland in opposing ratification of the EU-Mercosur agreement while Amazon fires continue, and whether it would support G7 aid for the Amazon. The minister replied that the government will take a position only once all texts and the Sustainability Impact Assessment are available, expected late 2019, with the Commission expecting a Council decision no earlier than November 2020, and that it will press Brazil bilaterally and within the EU on sustainable forest policy and will report separately on a possible Dutch contribution.
The cabinet will take a position once all necessary texts on the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement are available.
Kabinet zal een standpunt innemen als alle daarvoor noodzakelijke teksten over het EU-Mercosur-Associatieverdrag beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat een onderzoek over burnpits jarenlang op de plank heeft gelegen

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a 2012 TNO report on burn pit monitoring methods was not sent to Parliament in full, why Defence downplayed its health relevance, and when a validation of the CEAG literature review would be completed. The minister admitted it would have been better to publish the report, released it, and said validation is being re-tendered after RIVM declined, with the scope limited to the literature review rather than combination toxicity.
In hindsight, it would probably have been better to make the report public.
Achteraf gezien was het waarschijnlijk beter geweest het rapport openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het drastisch versnellen van het tempo waarop het Amazoneregenwoud wordt vernietigd

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the sharp rise in Amazon deforestation, its climate consequences, the EU-Mercosur deal, Dutch company involvement, and measures to stop the destruction. The Minister answered that deforestation matters greatly for climate, that the Mercosur deal includes deforestation provisions and a sustainability impact assessment is pending, and described ongoing cooperation and IMVO measures, while declining to provide a list of Dutch companies linked to deforestation.
Dutch companies are not obliged to report to the Dutch government which activities they carry out abroad.
Nederlandse bedrijven zijn niet verplicht om aan de Nederlandse overheid te melden welke zaken zij in het buitenland doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over de export van cybersurveillance technologie

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Dutch firms should supply emotion-recognition and surveillance technology used by China's Ministry of Public Security, and what controls apply to cybersurveillance exports. The minister says such use is unacceptable, firms must exercise due diligence, export licences are refused where human-rights concerns exist, and the Netherlands keeps pushing for EU-level controls while declining to pre-empt the stalled dual-use regulation revision.
The Netherlands will continue to work to keep the subject on the agenda.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat het onderwerp op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het voornemen van Japan om de commerciële walvisjacht te hervatten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether JEFTA offers ways to pressure Japan over resuming commercial whaling and how Iceland and Norway could be moved to stop whaling. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes Japan's whaling, will raise it under the trade and sustainable development chapter in early 2020, and that the EU has made diplomatic demarches and Council conclusions calling on Iceland and Norway to respect the moratorium.
The Netherlands will press within the EU for discussing Japan's resumption of whaling under the sustainability chapter at the Trade and Sustainable Development Committee in early 2020.

Nederland zal binnen de EU aandringen op het bespreken van de Japanse hervatting van de walvisjacht in het kader van het duurzaamheidshoofdstuk tijdens het Comité inzake handel en duurzame ontwikkeling begin 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het financieren van belastingontwijkende bedrijven door FMO

MP Diks (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether FMO's financing of companies using tax avoidance structures via Mauritius, including the Kenmare/Moma mine in Mozambique, is acceptable and whether rules or shareholder influence should change. The minister answered that FMO's policy already excludes financing through tax-avoidance structures, that no regulatory change is needed, and that the government sees no reason to press FMO for policy change.
Given that FMO policy already is not to provide financing through structures aimed at tax avoidance, the cabinet currently sees no reason to engage with FMO on a possible adjustment of this policy.

Gezien het feit dat het FMO-beleid reeds is om geen financiering te verstrekken middels structuren gericht op belastingontwijking ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen reden om met FMO in gesprek te gaan over mogelijke aanpassing van dit beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Diks over het door de Chinese autoriteiten oppakken van activist(en) die zich onder meer inzetten voor hiv-/aidspatiënten

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Diks asked the ministers whether they would seek clarity on the charge against Chinese NGO workers detained for alleged subversion, and how this relates to China's UNAIDS chairmanship. The ministers answered that the embassy follows the case, raises it through the EU and the bilateral human rights dialogue, and that the chair is performing correctly, while concerns about NGO pressure will continue to be raised.
Concerns about individual cases, such as the arrest of Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze and Xiao Wu, are raised through the bilateral human rights dialogue or in meetings of the UN Human Rights Council.

Zorgen over individuele gevallen, zoals de arrestatie van Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze en Xiao Wu, worden via de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog overgebracht of in vergaderingen van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Western firms get tangled in China’s Uighur crackdown’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether forced labour in Xinjiang re-education camps and a surge in yarn production is linked to garments sold in the Netherlands, and what the government will do about supply chains and the textile covenant. The government condemns forced labour, says it cannot confirm or deny that Xinjiang yarn ends up in Dutch clothing, and promises to raise the issue within the covenant and with China, without committing to talks with individual brands.
The government therefore can neither confirm nor deny that yarn from Xinjiang, produced with forced labour, has been processed into clothing sold in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan daarom bevestigen noch ontkennen dat garen uit Xinjiang, geproduceerd met gedwongen arbeid, is verwerkt in kleding die in Nederland wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over omgang van Defensie met getraumatiseerde veteranen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Defence about the treatment of traumatised veterans, including leading questions in MIP pension assessments, calculation of damages from the date of assessment, oversight of assessments, delays, and return interviews with partners. The Minister denied that questioning is suggestive, explained the oversight by the Pensions and Insurance Authority, acknowledged delays addressed by extra physicians, and said a partner-inclusive return interview is under review.
The ABP customer survey shows that the vast majority of clients who attended a consultation experienced contact with the ABP Social Medical Examination as pleasant and friendly.
Het Klantonderzoek ABP laat zien dat het overgrote deel van de klanten die op spreekuur zijn geweest het contact met Sociaal Medische Onderzoek van ABP als prettig en vriendelijk ervaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Buitenweg over de mogelijke verhuizing van interceptieschotels uit Burum

MPs Diks and Buitenweg asked the ministers of Defence and the Interior whether the government is frustrated with the intelligence services over relocating the Burum interception dishes because of 5G, and what consultation, analysis and parliamentary involvement there would be before any relocation decision. The minister denied the frustration, said a TNO study concluded coexistence is not possible, and promised an alternative by September 2022 via international cooperation, while withholding details of that cooperation for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality required in this context, I cannot say anything further about the precise shape of this international cooperation.
Ik kan vanwege de in dit verband vereiste vertrouwelijkheid verder geen uitspraken doen over de precieze invulling van deze internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over interne memo’s inzake een corruptieaffaire bij Damen Shipyards

An MP asked the Ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about internal memos concerning a corruption case at Damen Shipyards, alleged pressure from Damen against publication, and whether pending investigations affect procurement. The government answered that additional memos cannot yet be released pending a court appeal, denied undue pressure, explained that ongoing investigations are not grounds for exclusion under procurement law, and described contacts with Damen on submarine and other projects.
Once there is a final legal judgment, I will share with the House the information that may be released.
Zodra er een juridisch eindoordeel ligt, zal ik de informatie die mag worden vrijgegeven met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht ‘Meer dwangarbeid Eritrea door EU’

Diks (GroenLinks) asked the foreign trade and development minister whether a EU Africa Trust Fund investment in Eritrean road infrastructure contributes to forced labour and conscription, and asked for guarantees and suspension. Minister Kaag replied that the EU funds only materials and equipment through UNOPS, that workers are paid, that the EU agreed labour and wage conditions with Eritrea, and that Netherlands supports the project as part of a two-track approach while rejecting forced labour.
The Netherlands is opposed to the use of forced labour and slavery and critical of the way long-term conscription in Eritrea is implemented.
Nederland is tegen de inzet van dwangarbeid en slavernij en kritisch over de wijze waarop de langdurige dienstplicht in Eritrea gestalte krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat Brunei extreme straffen invoert, onder meer de doodstraf voor homoseksuele handelingen

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about Brunei's introduction of harsh Sharia penalties, including the death penalty for same-sex acts, and whether the Netherlands would cut arms trade, summon the ambassador, or take other action. The minister answered that the government strongly opposes the measures, has publicly and diplomatically objected via the EU, the Equal Rights Coalition and the Foreign Affairs Council, and that arms exports are screened for human-rights risk, with no export moratorium deemed necessary at present.
For this reason, the cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to announce a moratorium on the export of strategic goods to Brunei.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het op dit moment niet noodzakelijk om een moratorium af te kondigen op de export van strategische goederen naar Brunei.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de toename van geweld in Mali

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about the rise in violence in Mali, MINUSMA's role, causes linked to natural resources, diplomatic and development responses, and the Fomi Dam in Guinea. The minister answered at length, describing MINUSMA's continued necessity, Dutch diplomatic and development efforts, and noting the Fomi Dam matter is handled mainly at technical level with the Niger Basin Authority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over niet gemelde gebreken bij de F-35

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked the State Secretary for Defence about unreported defects in the F-35A, including gun accuracy, the ALIS maintenance system, reliability metrics, maintenance cost estimates and why critical US oversight findings were not in the progress reports. The government answered that the annual report reflects agreed committee arrangements, that identified issues are being addressed by the programme office without operational impact, and that it will report cost updates and test results in the annual report later.
Once there is clarity about any differences, this will be reported in the annual report on the F-35 acquisition project.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over eventuele verschillen zal dit worden gerapporteerd in de jaarrapportage over het project Verwerving F-35.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de uitvoer van 57 miljoen kogelpatronen aan de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An MP asked the minister about 57 million cartridges transported via the Netherlands to the UAE, a country in the Yemen conflict, and why Parliament was not informed of the transit. The minister replied that transit without transhipment by an EU/NATO+ ally needs no Dutch licence, that the Czech authorities licensed the shipment, that Parliament was not informed because no Dutch licence existed, and that the Netherlands has urged other states to adopt its stricter policy.
Since this shipment does not require a licence in the Netherlands, Dutch export control authorities issued no licence. For that reason, Parliament was not informed.
Aangezien deze zending in Nederland niet vergunningplichtig is hebben de Nederlandse exportcontroleautoriteiten geen vergunning verstrekt. Om die reden is de Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de levering van uit Nederland afkomstige wapens en patrouilleboten aan (para)militaire entiteiten in Libië

An MP asked whether arms and patrol boats supplied by Damen Shipyards to Libyan (para)military entities complied with the UN and EU embargoes, whether export licences were required, and how the ML list was applied to the boats' mountings. The minister answered that the deliveries were non-licensable under the then-applicable embargoes, that no licences were issued for military goods to Libya since 2011, that the ministry required prior contact from Damen after finding the boats were later armed, and that the generic mountings do not fall under the ML list.
In July 2016 the ministry contacted Damen and expressed concern about the arming of these ships.
Het ministerie heeft in juli 2016 contact gehad met Damen en zorg uitgesproken over de bewapening van deze schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over bodemverontreiniging op de locatie van de te bouwen marinierskazerne in Vlissingen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Defence why an October 2017 provincial order on soil contamination at the Vlissingen marine barracks site was not shared with parliament, and what health risks the contamination poses to marines. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known earlier, that the order was shared with Defence in October 2017 but not with parliament, and that only about 2 of 70 hectares will be remediated before construction while the rest is deemed safe for the intended use.
The order itself indeed was not shared with the House of Representatives.
De beschikking zelf is inderdaad niet met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Palmolieproducent verstopt ‘foute’ plantage in schaduwbedrijf en maskeert ontbossing'

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked whether palm oil firms use shadow companies to hide deforestation and whether rules and enforcement should be tightened. The Minister answered that the matter is largely for producer countries to regulate, that Dutch industry commitments are the key lever, and that existing certification and forest governance efforts continue.
Adjusting the legislation on this is up to these countries themselves and is currently no reason to tighten laws in the Netherlands or Europe.
Aanpassing van de wetgeving daar omtrent is aan deze landen zelf, en vormt nu geen reden om de wet- en regelgeving in Nederland of Europa aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het handelsverkeer tussen de EU en Westelijke Sahara

An MP asked whether EU trade arrangements with Morocco extended to Western Sahara can proceed without consent from the Sahrawi people, whether the Commission genuinely consulted them given the Court of Justice ruling, and about a salt shipment entering duty-preferentially. The minister replied that the Commission took all reasonable steps to consult the population, that Morocco exercises effective control so the agreement is possible, and that customs will levy duties if the salt's true origin proves to be Western Sahara.
If these investigations show that the actual origin of the salt is not Morocco but, for example, Western Sahara, the relevant import duty will nevertheless be levied.
Als uit deze onderzoeken volgt dat de feitelijke oorsprong van het zout niet Marokko is maar bijvoorbeeld de Westelijke Sahara, zal het betreffende invoerrecht alsnog worden geheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de opties rond de verhuizing van de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne te Doorn

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Defence about the costs of cancelling the relocation of the Van Braam Houckgeest barracks from Doorn to Vlissingen, the option of keeping Doorn, cost overruns, facility shortfalls and the impact on partners and families. The State Secretary answered that cancellation would cost at least 36.8 million euro in sunk and related costs plus possible consortium claims, that the 2012 decision cannot easily be reversed, and gave partial, largely substantive answers while withholding the detailed cost figures as commercially confidential.
For the answer to this question I refer to the commercially confidential annex to this letter.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de commercieel vertrouwelijke bijlage bij deze brief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Diks, Van den Hul en Kuik over buitenlandse investeringen in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about foreign investment in Ethiopia after a documentary on large-scale land grabs, and how Dutch investment, World Bank programmes and civil society support could prevent harm to people and the environment. The minister acknowledged the problems in large-scale projects, said Dutch investments are generally much smaller and that the embassy requires due diligence and IMVO compliance, and committed to pressing the World Bank on FPIC and civil society space.
Alleged violations of the OECD Guidelines can be reported to the National Contact Point for the OECD Guidelines (NCP).
Vermeende schendingen van de OESO-richtlijnen kunnen worden gemeld bij het Nationaal Contact Punt voor de OESO-richtlijnen (NCP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de leegloop bij het Korps Mariniers in verband met de kazerneverhuizing naar Vlissingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about rising unplanned departures of marines linked to the planned relocation of the Doorn barracks to Vlissingen, and whether the move could be reversed. The government answered that the tender is ongoing with award planned for July 2019, that departures are rising and their causes are being examined, that reversing the move would cost tens of millions of euros and the space problem remains, and that the Chamber is kept informed through periodic property reports.
I am of course at all times prepared to discuss this with the Chamber.
Ik ben uiteraard te allen tijde bereid daarover met de Kamer in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO landroof in Sierra Leone heeft gefinancierd

An MP asked whether the Dutch development bank FMO financed land grabbing in Sierra Leone, including unmet compensation promises, inadequate due diligence and its exit from the Addax project. The minister replied that FMO followed applicable standards, that Addax largely met its obligations, and that FMO's exit and complaints mechanism were in line with UN and OECD principles, while declining to expand the complaints mechanism.
I do not share the view that the complaints mechanism should be extended.
Ik deel de mening niet dat het klachtenmechanisme moet worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over bedreigde mensenrechtenactivisten in Guatemala

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about threatened indigenous human rights activist Aura Lolita Chávez in Guatemala, her return risk, and Dutch efforts against corruption and attacks on activists. The ministers said the embassy supports her through a working group and funds anti-impunity and protection programmes, and that no Dutch palm oil or logging firms had contacted the embassies, though this could not be fully excluded.
Protection of human rights is a cornerstone of Dutch foreign policy.
Bescherming van mensenrechten is een hoeksteen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over het rapport «Human rights in windturbine supply chains» van ActionAid en SOMO

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government to respond to an ActionAid/SOMO report on human rights in wind turbine supply chains and whether Dutch wind park permits and subsidies require due diligence. The government acknowledged the report, said current permits lack supply-chain human rights criteria, pointed to the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, and committed to encouraging a sector IMVO covenant for wind energy without a firm binding timetable.
The cabinet encourages the wind energy sector to conclude an IMVO covenant; the government also wants to participate in that covenant itself.
Het kabinet moedigt de windenergiesector aan om een IMVO-convenant te sluiten; de overheid wil ook zelf deelnemen aan dat convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat Nederland een ISDS-claimparadijs is

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands is a hub for ISDS claims, including the role of letterbox companies, settlements, arbitrator independence and transparency. The minister says the government will seek to exclude letterbox companies from protection, pursue a modernised model treaty and a Investment Court System, and states it finds no proof of regulatory chill.
The cabinet will therefore seek to exclude letterbox companies from protection.
Het kabinet zal daarom pogen brievenbusmaatschappijen uit te sluiten van bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Diks over de inbeslagname door Israël van een door Nederland gesubsidieerd zonne-energieproject in het Palestijnse dorp Jubbet adh Dhib

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Israel would return seized Dutch-subsidised solar panels in Jubbet adh Dhib, compensate the damage, and how the Israeli permit regime relates to humanitarian obligations and EU responses. The government reported that the panels were returned to COMET-ME as a temporary solution pending a zoning plan decision, gave permit statistics showing very few Palestinian approvals in Area C, and described EU efforts to press Israel on demolitions while declining to answer some questions on Israel's intentions.
It is not for the cabinet to answer this question about the intentions of the Israeli government.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om deze vraag naar voornemens van de Israëlische regering te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Karabulut over seksueel misbruik in het leger

MPs Diks and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about alleged sexual abuse in the armed forces, including the handling of a 2015 report to the Inspector-General and the number of reports and prosecutions. The minister answered that a confidential investigation commission has been set up, that 54 reports of possible sexual misconduct were filed with the Royal Marechaussee since 2013 and 39 cases reached the prosecutor, and listed existing integrity and prevention measures.
Defence has meanwhile set up a commission of inquiry to establish the facts as far as possible.
Defensie heeft inmiddels een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld om de feiten zoveel mogelijk te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Özütok over het bericht dat het bedrijf Fox-IT de zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Defence and Interior ministers whether negotiations with Fox-IT over state control of its cryptographic subsidiary were still unfinished, why the state dropped its first right to buy shares, what safeguards protect state secrets, and whether other vital-company takeovers caused problems. The government replied that talks are constructive and near conclusion with no plan B, that dropping the first right of purchase poses no risk because other measures exist, that ABDO security requirements and state supervision apply, and it referred to earlier letters for the remaining questions.
Dropping the first right of purchase has no consequences for the cryptographic protection of state secret information.
Het afzien van het eerste recht van koop heeft geen consequenties voor de cryptografische bescherming van staatsgeheime informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over belastingontwijking door mijnbouwbedrijven via Nederland

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked the government about tax avoidance by mining companies using Dutch financing and holding companies, including the lack of employees, trust offices, treaty misuse, UBO register access for developing-country tax authorities, and whether tax avoidance should be a priority in mining sector convenants. The State Secretary answered that Dutch structures are a risk signal but tax evasion was not proven, pointed to BEPS measures, the MLI, Addis Tax Initiative, planned partial public UBO register access, and said tax avoidance would be actively raised in convenant prioritisation.
The government will actively raise the theme of tax avoidance for consideration when setting the convenant priorities.
De overheid zal het thema belastingontwijking actief ter overweging inbrengen bij de vaststelling van de convenantprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bezoek van de Mozambikaanse president aan Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why President Nyusi of Mozambique was received in the Netherlands before the hidden-debt fraud investigation concluded, and about his role and the government's response. The ministers answered that the topic was raised in talks, that the independent audit and criminal investigation are ongoing, and that aid resumption depends on concrete action.
In that context, the need for concrete follow-up with possible criminal prosecution was central.
Daarin is de noodzaak tot concrete opvolging met eventuele strafrechtelijke vervolging centraal gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Duijvenvoorde over het onderzoek van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs over de schrijf- en rekenvaardigheid op het vmbo

An MP asked the minister about an Inspectorate study finding that about 40% of vmbo basis and kader pupils fall below basic reading and arithmetic levels, probing causes of declining basic skills, teacher capacity, immigration effects and reform measures. The state secretary answered largely by citing the ongoing Masterplan basisvaardigheden, noting recovery in primary education, rejecting a separate study on immigration and language gaps, and declining to provide some requested data on pupils with language delays.
No, I cannot do that. I do not have figures on children who have serious language delays at the start of their school career.
Nee, dat kan ik niet. Ik heb geen cijfers van kinderen die bij aanvang van hun schoolloopbaan ernstige taalachterstanden hebben.
